reviews.author: Anna Chang
reviews.text:
This was our first time in Punta Cana and we were initially concerned that the reviews were incentivized but the positive reviews turned out to be true!
We felt everyone was really kind and genuine.
First shoutout to Santo at Flor- he was very warm and provided us an amazing Mediterranean lunch at Sante.
Our rooms were spacious and clean.
Food was great- buffet had a wide selection for all meals and reservation required restaurants were decent quality: Mina steakhouse (would recommend skirt steak and picanha) Flor (recommend the flower basket, slow cooked ribs) Sante ( recommend the salmon, octopus salad, heard the shrimp rice was good too).
The spa was pretty good- thank you to my masseuse Dorka who was so nice!
The beach was amazing. Definitely the highlight. We had access to affiliated Melia resorts.
Overall this is an excellent deal.
The only thing that left us feeling off and disgusted was one of the girls in our group had her check out card labeled as Kim II Joong. This didn't feel like a reflection of the hotel chain as a whole but whoever wrote that should be held accountable for being unprofessional and frankly racist. Maybe it was an honest mistake, but the room number was correct.
We felt no discrimination during our stay except for this instance.

reviews.author: Laura Thomas
reviews.text: I recently stayed here with my sister to celebrate my 50th birthday.  The resort is gated which made us feel safer and the grounds are beautiful and maintained daily.  We had an Oceanfront room in the reserve adult only section,  it was worth the extra money.  I loved waking up to the water view every morning.  We had our own concierge,  Harry,  who was amazing! The food was good, nothing exceptional but good. We were not impressed with the restaurant that was only for the guests staying at the reserve, we both agreed that the other restaurants were better.  The resort is large and we never felt like it was overcrowded. The pools are beautiful and they maintain the beach. It's more of a quieter resort,  so if you are looking for something that has a lot of activities,  this is not the place for you. They do have a few daily activities but not much. Everyone we encountered that worked at the resort was so nice and helpful.  Fernando,  who i believe ia the activities director,  was very fun and personable.  I highly recommend this resort if you are looking for a place to unwind.

reviews.author: Mike Conigliaro
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful stay at the resort last week.  Yje resort and grounds are beuituful The room was located in the Reserve adult only section of the the hotel.  The room itself was large and well appointed.  Only small issue I had was the air conditioning.  It only went to 69 degrees, which is still a little warm at night.  Our concierge was Yinesca,  who helped with our dinner reservations and made the stay very pleasant. We loved all the pools, and never had any issue with seats.  The towel program is fantastic.  Need a towel...take a towel.  The reserve side if the beach was nice, and like the pool hasd no issues with finding sun loungers.

As for the restaurants,  we really enjoyed the steak house, Italian and Mexican restaurants.  This may surprise some, but we were not impressed with Sante, the Reserve restaurant.  It's that the food was "bad", just not impressive.  Several people.we.spoke with agreed.  On the other hand, we thought the buffet was surprisingly good.

Overall it was a very nice experience.

reviews.author: Lily Must
reviews.text:
Love it here! We’ve only been here a few days so far and everyone’s been so friendly! Melbine from blue agave got us in without a reservation and hooked us up with another restaurant for the next night. So friendly. And wander served us at Minu and was also sweet and friendly! Our safe broke and they came and fixed it real quick. The bedroom was so clean and all the staff is just so sweet. The beach itself they actually clean it every morning so that keeps the seaweed down.
We would love to come again!

reviews.author: Sarah Squire
reviews.text:
Yuderi is amazing at the beach bar! He made our entire vacation. He is quick, friendly and we never had to worry about our beds being ready for us in the morning. He is the reason for the high rating! He deserves a huge raise.

Regarding the resort- it is beautiful, clean and easy to get around.

Service at the restaurants is slow. Often took 20+ minutes to get water or drinks filled. Food was great overall tho.

We did the reserve, it is nice to have a private pool and sante restaurant, but I would argue the buffet on the main side was much better for breakfast lunch and dinner. Room service food was also amazing, and quick which was a huge plus.

The concierge service was not worth it. We came for my birthday, and we were greeted with balloons in room which was amazing, but after that, we barely saw our concierge Gustavo. He set our reservations daily, at times we did not want and we had to argue to get the restaurants we wanted to eat at, because he was just picking for us for the first 3 days. We had wanted to book excursions but ended  up just handling it ourselves because he was not to be found.

Overall, the Dominican is amazing and I’d recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Amanda Wontor
reviews.text: The staff here has been wonderful. Servers, bartenders, hostesses - everyone has been polite and welcoming. Daniela at Mascalzone was especially great. She was able to seat us 2hrs earlier than our reservation so our almost 2yr old, who was exhausted after a day of swimming, could have dinner before he fell asleep. She treated him (and us) with kindness, giving him a high-five and crayons and was very sweet. The food was great, too! Our server, Yuleni provided top-notch service! Jean at Flora was awesome, too. Our son slept through dinner, so we asked for a cup of milk to bring back to the room for when he woke up.  He gave us a whole milk container. We felt like our son has been a priority for the staff here, which is really great to see at a resort that primarily caters to adults. Jeremy and Luis at Ginger (hotel lobby bar and coffee bar) were fun to hang out with while we ordered a few drinks (alcoholic and non-alcoholic - craft cocktails with plenty of options, including fruit juices and smoothies). They make great mojitos and espresso martinis! Overall, we highly recommend this resort, especially for families with very little ones who love to swim (and try new food!).

reviews.author: Jayce Smith
reviews.text: Andrés is the best! No exaggeration. Amazing service, fun energy, and really became a friend to us. From check in to check out. We were celebrating a birthday and graduation and he surprised us with so many gifts and special accommodations for the celebrations. Above and beyond. Truly made it feel special.  Overall the resort is 5 stars as long as you aren’t use to the MOST extreme luxury resorts. That said, the place is beautiful. Plus Surprisingly good daily Activities to do and pools are big. Had some small issues with the room, but they were resolved quickly. def a step above the other options of lost resort’s around DR. Some staff are more welcoming and friendly than others but they all do a great job and have great service. Food you don’t need to worry about, I suppose it is “hit or miss” but there’s plenty of hits that it does not matter food will still be good👍🏾

reviews.author: Russell Maulick
reviews.text:
Our 15th time to this hotel. We celebrated our 37th wedding anniversary with our DR friends. Perfect time of the year to visit this resort. We saw friends we missed the last time we visited. We would like to mention them by name. Juan Pena, Lewis de la Cruz, Antonio and Olga at the ginger bar, Jonathan, Jesus, Eddy, Jorge and Luis at the pool bar, Gilberto, Martin and Pedro at the 96 degree beach bar, Teofino, Maria, Rosanna, Hirlenne,Yoleidy, Emily. Gerardo the best omelet maker at lunch box, Milton and Yuleni at Mascalzone, Franklin, the Chef and our busboy at Sante where we had a fantastic and memorable anniversary dinner, and can't forget to mention Julin who brought our morning pot of coffee promptly at 7am every day, as he did in November 2024. We met so many nice people from all over. We made so many happy memories. Can't wait to go back. Almost forgot to mention Gladys and Dorka at the YHI spa who were exceptional. Forgive me if I left someone out. We love everyone there
I

reviews.author: Jan G
reviews.text: We enjoyed private, quiet, pool by our suites! Magnificent! Our server, at 36 degrees,  throughout the entire 8 days was beyond perfection. Jose was attentive, calm, peaceful. He served adults and children our favourite drinks everyday. His friendliness and cheerful attitude was what is ur vacation so appreciated. We cannot say enough about our friend Jose! Thank you Jose for many happy memories for our family vacation.

reviews.author: PETER A
reviews.text: Best Service I've received, Yamilet and Melvin at Blue Agave made our day very special. We Celebrated my Birthday here and these two Staff members went above and beyond their hospitality and attentive nature are something to be admired. Very well done!

reviews.author: Biokaris Nunez
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, right on the beach, very clean. We had the ocean front room and it exceeded our expectations. It was a villa steps from the water. The service was good throughout the hotel, no complaints! Antonia, Jason, Michael at the Celsius bar, really made our experience unforgettable. And our concierge Zenovia, went above and beyond.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Olyntho
reviews.text:
Amazing experience at Tokimeku! From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. A special thank you to Romeris for the warm hospitality and for guiding us through the menu with excellent recommendations — it truly made a difference.

Also, a big thanks to Maria and José, who took such great care of us throughout the evening. The service was attentive, friendly, and made us feel completely at ease.

The food was outstanding, and the overall atmosphere made the experience even more memorable. Highly recommended — we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Zineb Benkirane
reviews.text:
We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Melia Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa and would highly recommend it.

The location is fantastic, with some of the most beautiful, soft white sand beaches and consistently gorgeous weather that made the entire experience feel like a true escape. The grounds are stunning—lush, green, and impeccably maintained, creating a serene and luxurious atmosphere throughout the resort. The standard rooms were very spacious and included a private balcony and sunbeds, with nice amenities and modern decor, with high quality marble flooring.

What really stood out, though, was the staff. Everyone was incredibly warm and welcoming, and the level of service was consistently on par. A special thank you to Jesus, Jose and the kind ladies at the kids’ club, who was especially kind, attentive, and with whom my children had a blast!

The breakfast buffet was very very nice with multiple options. We really appreciated that there à la carte restaurants included included our favorite Blue Agave, the Japanese and Italian, and the food across the board was very good, with an opportunity for improvement at Kanna lunch when the bbq meat was consistently undercooked. The lunch and dinner buffets, though good, were the same every day. The only small note would be the Hibachi Japanese restaurant—the chef didn’t include any of the usual entertainment, which would have made the experience even more enjoyable.

Another great perk was the sports amenities, including the top of the line gym that I enjoyed every morning and the Rafael Nadal Tennis Center, which added something unique and elevated to the stay.

Overall, this is a beautiful resort that delivers on quality, service, and atmosphere. We can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: David Kolumber
reviews.text:
Absolute satisfaction. From the very beginning everything was perfectly organized – transfer to the hotel, staff taking care of our luggage, and escorting us to the reception. At check-in we were offered an upgrade, but without any pressure at all. When we declined because of the price, it was completely fine.

The receptionist noticed (probably because of our wedding rings) and asked whether we really wanted two separate beds as booked. Of course, we wanted one bed as a couple, and after a very short wait she arranged a different room (1228) without any issue. The room was spacious, bright, and very comfortable. The only minor technical issue was the air conditioning, which occasionally didn’t work perfectly. The room had an excellent location, and even though there were music events in the hotel area, nothing could be heard inside. Only after a few days we noticed some noise from the room above us, likely due to a change of guests.

We mostly dined in the main restaurant. The food selection was extensive and of very high quality. I would like to commend the entire staff, especially the hostess Jessica and Laura, who appeared to be in a supervisory role. Even though she seemed to be there privately, she immediately stepped in to resolve a small issue when it arose – exactly the kind of attitude guests appreciate. Overall, the staff was attentive, professional, and genuinely engaged.

One small remark: when everything is running smoothly, it feels unnecessary for another supervisor to publicly reprimand staff, as it slightly disrupts the otherwise pleasant atmosphere.

The adults-only pool was excellent. Only once were children allowed in for a special occasion, but it started raining shortly after, so it didn’t really matter.

The stay was outstanding even without any upgrade. The only thing I would suggest is offering a late check-out option. Due to high occupancy, we had to wait several hours in the bar after check-out. Food and drinks were still available, but it’s not quite the same when you can no longer use everything. That said, I fully understand this given how busy the hotel was. Considering the size of the resort, the number of guests, and how smoothly everything operated, the organization was truly exemplary.

Overall, I rate the hotel extremely highly. Excellent value for money, high-quality services, and very attentive staff – including remembering our usual drinks at the pool bar. I can recommend this hotel one thousand percent.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Hoffman
reviews.text:
Just back from an incredible stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Beautiful, upscale resort on one of the best beaches in Punta Cana. This is definitely a sun-lovers resort - huge pools surrounded by ample seating. It feels more regal than tropical. Food and drink quality was outstanding - particularly the steakhouse.

Alam, our concierge, made us feel like we were his only focus. Responsive, friendly and invested in our group having a wonderful vacation. At the beach, Rafael took care of our every need - he had shaded chairs ready each morning and ensured everyone in the group had a drink in hand at every moment. Jairo taught a great dance lesson and the rest of the entertainment team worked hard to keep guests involved in activities such as morning yoga/stretch, painting, water sports and dancing.

We've stayed at half-a-dozen resorts in the Bavaro beach area and Paradisus Palma Real is now at the top of our favorites list. We are already planning our next trip!

reviews.author: Denisha Campbell
reviews.text:
The experience here was AMAZING! For my birthday everyone made sure that I felt special and that I was celebrated! The resort was very clean and the staff was incredible and made me feel special! It was a great time and I would certainly come back! They even had a special cake for me for my
Birthday! I’m feel so amazing! Drinks were strong and the food grew on me! Y Antonia,  Junior, y Irvin de animación fueron mi fantástico! Una experiencia muy bonita  y agradable por que celebraron my cumpleaño !!

reviews.author: Ruma Begum
reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay and the service really stood out.

Nojandro  was incredibly friendly and attentive – he remembered our complex dietary requirements and always made us feel comfortable at Sante, with great humour and service.

Romeris was excellent at both Sante and Tokimeku, very accommodating and attentive to our needs.

Marcus at the bar was great too, keeping things fun with different drinks that all tasted amazing.

Melqui also provided great service at the Mexican restaurant – very friendly and made the experience memorable.

Overall, amazing staff who made our stay special – thank you!

reviews.author: VIP Vichitra Indian Production
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this resort. The pool area was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained — perfect for relaxing throughout the day. The beach was equally impressive, with soft sand and stunning water that made every moment feel like a true vacation.

What truly made the experience special was the welcoming and friendly hotel team. Every staff member we interacted with was professional, attentive, and genuinely cared about making our stay comfortable and enjoyable. Their warm hospitality created a very positive atmosphere.

Overall, this resort offers the perfect combination of a great pool, a gorgeous beach, and excellent service. We would definitely love to return and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing and memorable getaway.

reviews.author: Annie Medina
reviews.text: So far, everything has been fantastic. We just finished dinner at Blue Agave, and all three of my children talked about how their meals (chicken tacos, chicken burrito, quesabirria) were the best they’ve ever had. Yamilet was lovely and worked to find something for all of us and to ensure everyone was sated (second helpings for some!) Overall, a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Donald Buckle
reviews.text:
Luis and luis
in the ginger bar is fantastic. My wife loves his Expresso Martinis. Rosa Maria also has such a welcoming smile.
Junior and Antonia at the Fahrenheit always went out of thier way to make sure my experience was exceptional. Always welcoming with a smile and great service. They never missed a beat.

reviews.author: Jamie-Lynn Huitema
reviews.text:
What a fantastic resort ! Definitely exceeded expectations.
Resort and amenities are fabulous.
Food was great. So many options to choose from and a great place to try something new as it was all too notch.
Highly recommend Sante for breakfast and lunch in the adults only section.
My waitress Katherine, and her manager Santo always ensured my needs were met.

Honestly I highly recommend this resort to anyone. I was in the Reserve section and the upgrade was well worth it.

As a solo traveler I felt safe.

reviews.author: Damilola Waite
reviews.text: This resort has been amazing! Diana took us on a bike tour around the resort and surrounding area, and it was informative and fun! Wander (server at Kanna restaurant) helped teach us Spanish, but also provided the best service we received this entire time! Jean at front desk was friendly and helpful. Eddy and Jonathan at the beach/pool bar area were amazing, went above and beyond for drinks, and remembered our repeat orders. We will definitely come back!!

reviews.author: Katie A.
reviews.text: I would give them 100 starts if I could. Everything was memorable from start to finish. Fernando in particular was so kind and made sure we had everything we needed. The entire hotel staff we interacted with were very helpful. Their service is truly outstanding.

reviews.author: Sindi Blitzer
reviews.text:
The hotel grounds are beautiful and well maintained.

In general, the beach, restaurants, and pools are gorgeous. Surprisingly, the buffet was amazing for all meals. We especially enjoyed the dinner specials.

We stayed in the adults only section. The rooms and pool are beautiful.

I do need to give a shout out to some of the staff. At the buffet Yanira, Maria, and Yosica were very attentive. We spent a lot of time with the  sommeliers Gustav and Juan at The Winery. They were very knowledgeable, entertaining, and honestly made our vacation. Our room was kept pristine by Marisol, a warm beautiful person,  and Jose our concierge made sure we were happy during our stay.

I would recommend this hotel to my friends and family.

If you are a Club Melia member, they are phasing us out. Do not expect ANY special treatment or additional perks, such as welcome drinks,  baskets in your room, our our private snack and beverage area.   I was literally told that since those things were not written in our contract, they were not required to provide them.  To get those types of perks, you have to switch your membership to Circle. I was extremely upset by this, the reason I bought my membership was for the "special treatment".  Without it, we are ordinary guests like everyone else.

reviews.author: Tonya Shahsavari
reviews.text:
After coming annually for 10 years, we had not visited in awhile. There have been some changes in the service level. However,  Angelo is awesome! Once we found him or he found us (lol) he made pur stay feel like previous visits.

Also, our concierge, Ariel, was very helpful and made reservations, etc seamless..

The beach and resort are still beautiful.  ❤️

reviews.author: Josemary Gutierrez
reviews.text: Best experience ever for my kids at the Kidsdom with Alexandra, Lizbeth and Yésica. They are truly professional and trust worthy my kids were in great hands. They had so much fun they spent all day at the kids club and did not want to spend time with us. I will definitely return to this hotel and trust my kids with the ladies.

reviews.author: Jacob Vega
reviews.text: This is the first resort I ever go to and I'm in love with it. I'm here with my girlfriend having a great time. The rooms are beautiful, the pools are beautiful, the hospitality is beyond anything I've seen in New York (I'm from New York, the hospitality is hit or miss). In The Lunch Box (one of the eateries) there's this one waiter Edison that made me and my girlfriend feel very welcome. He's very nice and funny, super enjoyable, always asked us to sit in his section of tables and made sure every detail was perfect. Table crooked? Fixed the table. Water empty? Instant refill. Dont drink? Whip you up any beverage of your liking. Genuinely I'm gonna miss this place, but I'm gonna miss Edison a lot when I leave, he's a homie. I hope they give him the FATTEST raise

reviews.author: Nidia Sousa
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time at Paradisus Palma real resort. The whole experience was incredible. The staff were amazing and friendly.  What really stood out was the  animation team which includes, Irvin, Henry, Yan, cooper and pollito.
They are all so passionate about their job and how engaging they were—they made sure everyone felt included and had an amazing time. You could tell they truly love what they do, and it made the whole experience even more special. We had an amazing time. Honestly, the nights wouldn’t have been the same without them. If you ever get the chance to experience it, don’t miss out—you’ll leave with memories you won’t forget.

reviews.author: Jenni Beck
reviews.text: We had an absolutely wonderful vacation at Paradisus! Being a Reserve member made all the difference and I definitely suggest splurging on it! We had our own butler, Adriel, that made our experience that much better! We spent each day at the beach in the Reserve only area and had our own personal bar and lounge beds. Martin and Pedro were our beach waiters and they were absolutely PHENOMENAL and treated us so well!! We are so sad to leave them but can’t wait to come back! 🩵

reviews.author: Priyadarshini Manning
reviews.text:
Celebrated my husband’s birthday at Mina Steakhouse and WOW…what an experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely incredible, every bite better than the last, but what truly set the night apart was the top-tier service. The staff was attentive, (especially our server Jean Carlos), welcoming, and kept the drinks flowing without ever making us feel rushed.

And the surprise birthday cake? What the heck…a cake!!! Such a thoughtful and memorable touch that made the night feel extra special. Seeing the biggest smile on my husband’s face said it all.

This dinner truly became the cherry on top of our entire vacation. If you’re looking for an unforgettable dining experience, this is it. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Vilmaliz Rivera
reviews.text:
At the Farenheit Bar by the pool. Service by Antonia was great! Marcos y Junior were very good with their service as well. Antonia takes pride in the drinks she prepared as well as presentation. She is very personable and service with a smile. An asset as a host at the bar area. Thank you! At the Kicks Sports Bar they are not happy if you don’t have a drink in hand ☺️ we were at the main plaza and they come around often to make sure you are having a good time and there’s nothing lacking. My husband and I appreciate all the attention not only to us but to everyone here especially Luis. Thank you!
Restaurant Tokimeku was excellent! Great Hibachi service! Idelka is an excellent server. Very gracious and humble.
At Lunchbox - Rosanna y Yanira are always there to serve us with a smile with excellent service to make us always make us feel at home and like family. We hold them very close to our heart ❤️❤️

reviews.author: Gino Portelli
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Palm Real in Punta Cana!  The staff across the whole resort were amazing. We stayed in the Reserve portion of the resort which provided us with excellent service and one on one attention. The pool was beautiful and very quiet. As a reserve guest we got to eat at the private Sante restaurant for breakfast and lunch. The staff there were especially kind and attentive to any needs we had. We loved everything and will be back again!

reviews.author: Dj Negrote
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real is a hotel that makes you feel welcome from the first moment. The check-in was fast, organized and with a very friendly treatment, which marks an excellent start to the stay. The food is first class, with a lot of variety, well prepared and with flavors that are really enjoyed in every restaurant. I also want to highlight the bar boy, always attentive, friendly and with an incredible attitude, preparing the drinks with quality and making every moment feel more special. In general, the service is very good, but the most striking thing about my experience was the animation team. Everyone is cheerful and dedicated, but Fernando Chispa is on another level. He has a contagious energy, natural charisma and a way of connecting with people that you don’t see every day. It not only animates, it transforms the environment and makes each activity feel unique. You can tell that he loves what he does, always with a smile, motivating everyone and giving more than 100% at every moment. He is one of those people who elevate the entire hotel experience and leave a real mark on the guests. Without a doubt, someone who makes a difference and who makes you want to come back

reviews.author: ewqrfdsa nbadaesf
reviews.text: The Blue Agave was the highlight of our trip. We have special dietary restrictions and the staff and chef were very happy to accommodate. The food was fantastic and the service was impeccable. Highly recommended to anyone visiting the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Debra Ferrier
reviews.text:
Melqui at Blue agave was awesome. So attentive.  Great attitude.  Seemed to love his job and couldn’t wait to make us happy.  Gave us recommendations that were so delicious.   He deserves a RAISE.
Basilio, butler on adult only side was just the best ever!  He was nice, attentive, always around when you needed him and quick to answer any request.  You should ask for him!!!

reviews.author: Jenna Grounds
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus Palma Real was absolutely wonderful and exceeded my expectations. This was the perfect destination for a long vacation, offering a beautiful balance of relaxation, luxury, and exceptional service from beginning to end.

The resort grounds are stunning, meticulously maintained, and create a peaceful tropical atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind. One of the things I appreciated most was how spacious and comfortable the rooms were. The accommodations felt luxurious and thoughtfully designed, with plenty of room to relax. The room was well equipped with everything I needed throughout my stay, making it feel like a home away from home. The beach doesn’t have sargassum as it is cleaned throughout the day and there is a barrier.

The food was consistently excellent across the resort. The hibachi restaurant was one of the highlights of my trip, and Eddy made the experience especially memorable with his great energy and entertaining performance. I also thoroughly enjoyed the Mexican restaurant and the steakhouse, both of which served delicious meals with excellent service. There was a great variety of dining options available, and I always found something enjoyable to eat.

What truly made this vacation special was the incredible staff. A huge thank you to my concierge, Yaleidi, who went above and beyond to ensure that my stay was enjoyable and stress free. Yaleidi was attentive, responsive, and always willing to help with any request. I would also like to recognize Laura, the supervisor, who worked alongside my concierge to make sure I had the best possible experience. Her professionalism and dedication to guest satisfaction did not go unnoticed. Christian was another concierge who was incredibly helpful, friendly, and welcoming throughout my stay as he is easy to locate. Also - Gustavo made sure any little thing I needed was taken care of and checked on me throughout the day. (You can always find him)

The level of hospitality provided by the team made me feel genuinely valued as a guest. Everyone I interacted with was kind, professional, and committed to creating a memorable experience. The service, accommodations, dining, and overall atmosphere all came together to create an unforgettable vacation. Rafael at the beach bar is the absolute BEST!!

I would highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real to anyone looking for a luxury all inclusive resort in Punta Cana. Whether you are visiting for a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or simply a chance to relax and recharge, this resort delivers an exceptional experience. I look forward to returning in the future. If you are an adult, I 100000% recommended upgrading to the reserve because of the value and benefits.

Oh, also the destination inclusive activity was amazing!

reviews.author: Richard Vieira
reviews.text:
This hotel is very luxurious. Reception friendly and efficient, rooms extremely clean and huge. Staff friendly and helpful. Entertainment professional and lots of fun. Meals very good, you can always find food of your liking, specialty restaurants available and easy to book. Beach beautiful white sand and expansive for walking. Enough chairs and sunshade without having to get up early and reserving with towels. Pools large, clean with morning exercise programs. Drinks and bars provided fast friendly service.
We had a great attentive concierge name Guillermo who was always available even though entertaining other guests. He was very accommodating even with our last minute requests.
Planning to return to this hotel without question.

reviews.author: Lisa Rodriguez
reviews.text: Our time at Meliá was amazing!  Antonia was terrific.  She took care of us like family and  made sure our stay was phenomenal.  If you have a chance visit Meliá and ask for Antonia she’ll ensure your time is memorable and special.

reviews.author: Aswini Singh
reviews.text: This hotel exceeded our expectations . The rooms were spotless, the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, and the food selection was outstanding.  Our check in was smooth and enjoyable. The atmosphere was relaxing, the property was beautiful and the amenities are top notch. We loved both the pool and the beach access. Staff were constantly cleaning even the washrooms at the beach were cleaned constantly and surprisingly there was no sand in these washrooms. Perfect place to unwind and enjoy stress free vacation.

reviews.author: Joe Romano
reviews.text: We just got back from Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana. I must say that if I went off peoples reviews I would have missed out on this beautiful and clean resort. The amazing beach with its beautiful sand and pools at every turn, wow such an amazing resort. The staff were always friendly and special thank you to Guillermo our concierge who was not only our concierge but an outstanding Gentleman and a man I know can call my family . He was attentive and always available for me and my family, anything we needed. I would also like to give a special Thank you to Rosanna our pool waitress who was entertaining and always made sure we were ok. Wander and junior fantastic, enthusiastic and always helpful thank you ( gracias) for everything. Food I honestly can say was very good, from the buffet to à la carte. I feel there was plentiful. All in all I would recommend this resort and I will be returning. Do not hesitate to book you will miss out on paradise!!! Also special thanks to Henler and Danielle from the circle Melia. Give it a go and see for yourself! To many things to list. Adios

reviews.author: Bruno Henrique
reviews.text:
I had a wonderful experience at the Meliá Paradisus Palma Real. From the very first moment, the service was impeccable, and the high level of professionalism was evident in every detail. The staff is incredibly friendly, attentive, and always willing to help with a smile, making you feel truly special and welcome.

Customer service exceeded expectations: fast, friendly, and highly personalized. Every employee demonstrates commitment and passion for providing an unforgettable stay. Without a doubt, it's a place where the personal touch makes all the difference. Highly recommended!

I want to personally thank María at the Rum Republic bar, Marcos at the THR Pool, and Santos del Sante, who took care of us from the moment we arrived, providing impeccable service.

Thank you, Laura, the hotel's assistant manager, for giving us the warmest welcome upon arrival.

But above all, I want to give a special thanks to Pedro, the pool concierge. Thank you for making our vacation so special, for taking care of us, and for bringing your joy every morning. You are wonderful! Your charisma, your friendliness, and above all, your dedication to service and taking care of your clients—we are so lucky to have found you! 🤩🤩🤩
Dionys, thank you for your impeccable service.
I would also like to mention the entertainment team: Yan, Irvin, Henry, and Angerik.
Thank you guys for making our vacation wonderful.

reviews.author: Devices Beltre
reviews.text:
Excellent experience at Blue Agave inside the Paradisus Punta Cana. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed the Mexican food. We ordered the enchiladas and the tacos al pastor, and both dishes were delicious, full of flavor, and very well prepared.

As an appetizer, we tried the ceviche, which was fresh and perfectly seasoned. To finish, we shared the churros for dessert, accompanied by an exquisite chocolate sauce for dipping, which was the perfect ending to the meal.

We also want to highlight Lorena, our hostess, who made our experience even more enjoyable. From the moment we arrived, she was very kind, professional, and attentive, making sure we were comfortable and that everything went perfectly. Her warmth and excellent customer service truly made all the difference.

The service was excellent, and the restaurant's ambiance perfectly complemented the experience. We definitely recommend Blue Agave to anyone visiting the resort who wants to enjoy authentic, high-quality Mexican food. We will definitely be back! We ordered the enchiladas and the tacos al pastor, and both dishes were delicious, full of flavor, and very well prepared.

As an appetizer, we tried the ceviche, which was fresh and perfectly seasoned. To finish, we shared the churros for dessert, accompanied by an exquisite chocolate sauce for dipping, which was the perfect ending to the meal.

We also want to highlight Lorena, our hostess, who made our experience even more enjoyable. From the moment we arrived, she was very friendly, professional, and attentive, making sure we were comfortable and that everything went perfectly. Her warmth and excellent customer service truly made all the difference.

The service was excellent, and the restaurant's ambiance perfectly complemented the experience. We would definitely recommend Blue Agave to anyone visiting the resort who wants to enjoy authentic, high-quality Mexican food. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Janin Monserrath Hernández Cruz
reviews.text:
Excellent service from the very first moment. The place is very clean and well-maintained. All the staff were always friendly, attentive, and professional, making our stay truly enjoyable.

I could never fully mention all the staff who contributed to making our experience so wonderful. We stayed for seven days, and each day and each night the service was even better than the day before.

Special thanks to Chef Hugo Alberto Magaña for his dedication and excellent service, as well as to the Ginger Bar in the lobby, where bartenders Luis and Andreina, along with supervisor Yiri, provided outstanding service.

Without a doubt, a place you'll want to return to. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Pinales FF
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Incredible experience at Paradisus!

My stay was spectacular from beginning to end. The beach is a true dream, with pristine sand and crystal-clear waters, ideal for disconnecting.

The bar also deserves a special mention: excellent quality drinks and top-notch service. But without a doubt, the best part of the trip was the entertainment. Fernando "Chispa" is phenomenal; his energy and charisma truly transform the atmosphere and make every activity unforgettable. Thank you, "Chispa," for bringing so much fun to our vacation!

reviews.author: rita cipolla
reviews.text: We are very grateful for the attention of the staff in general. Attentive and polite. Suggestion...it would be wonderful if you had a theater room for shows. For dance classes, a shaded outdoor space would be ideal, as the sun is very strong during class times. Thank you and send your warmest regards. We were consistently invited to the activities by Henry and Yan. We were also very impressed with Chef Carlos Cruz, who was very attentive, checking on us and making sure everything was alright.

reviews.author: Claudia Florez M
reviews.text:
Excellent service, food, and everything in general. A very eco-friendly hotel.
A fantastic experience. From the moment we arrived at the airport, they made us feel very welcome. The welcome at the hotel was very special, and the concierge (Anayely Rivera) was spectacular. She was very professional and guided and assisted us throughout our stay.
Being a hotel complex, the only aspect that could be improved is the layout of the spaces (restrictions in some areas). Otherwise, it was a great experience.

reviews.author: Maria Giovanna Palesa (Gio)
reviews.text: My family and I had a great time at this hotel. The food was very good, the buffet was plentiful at any time. The rooms were very nice and clean. The staff was polite and super helpful. We met Johan (Pollito), a very nice and sociable guy. He's unobtrusive and perfect for making friends and having an unforgettable vacation. Thank you!

reviews.author: Alvaro Vegas
reviews.text:
I'm a repeat customer of this hotel. A loyal client of the brand, because if it ain't broke, don't fix it.

On previous stays, I stayed at the Reserve, and I keep coming back because of the exceptional service from the staff, who make the stay even better than being at home. Martín, the waiter at the beach reserved for Reserve rooms, is the epitome of service and customer care. Every day he prepared our sunbeds in the best available spots and was always attentive to ensure we had everything we needed. I think about him all year round and look forward to running into him again.

Barnelis, from Santé, is the embodiment of joy and attentiveness. His "Good morning" is a great way to start your day.

Lorena, the hostess at several restaurants, was very attentive to our preferences.

Concierges (Kelvin from past stays), entertainment (with the happy little chick), waiters, and all the other staff. Thank you for this wonderful stay.

I've been here, I've been back, and I'll be back again...

reviews.author: Jose Luis Sebastian Varas
reviews.text: This is the second time my wife and I have stayed at the Palma Real. We really like the hotel, the location, the food, and the excellent service. Our stay has been just as pleasant as the last. We especially want to highlight the efficiency of our concierge, Enissa. Thanks to her help, we received everything we requested, and she always treated us with great kindness.

reviews.author: Carla Gonell
reviews.text:
1. I loved it! The best experience of the entire hotel!
Yamilet was our waitress, and from her introduction to the way she helped us choose our dishes and her kindness, everything was wonderful.

We started with a delicious sangria (the bartender was amazing!) and a whiskey.
Then the food was just as good, a 100 out of 10 for the quesabirrias and the carnitas tacos. We finished with some churros that came out nice and warm 💜
It truly was the best part of our entire time in Palma. 100 out of 100 for atmosphere, service, food, and drinks 🍸
Blue Agave Restaurant

2. Continuing the experience 😆 - The Kidsdom girls are the best! So caring and attentive. They elevated my 7-year-old daughter's experience. We went from her feeling a bit queasy to her playing peacefully with the girls and making pizza (and she even ate some! 😂). And today they saw her in the grounds and called her by name. They very enthusiastically invited her to participate in the day's activities, and they invited us to join in too 😆. With a lovely smile, they told us: "Remember, you can leave her with us and we'll take good care of her while you go for a walk."

3. José Acosta, a super mega concierge!
He kept us informed at all times, helped us with any reservations, and made sure everything was perfect during our stay. He made it so easy for us to feel comfortable.

Thanks to José!

It has been a very good experience! The people have been genuinely kind.

reviews.author: VACATION JUICE
reviews.text:
To begin with... Daniela's excellent welcome; she's a wonderful hostess. Next, Ana, our waitress, provided excellent service. She knows the dishes perfectly and can recommend them to suit your taste, especially the dish with a good amount of spice... Absolutely wonderful!

Later, we enjoyed the Celsius pool bar. We also received excellent service from Dilania and Víctor, who were very attentive and helpful.

Congratulations on your enjoyment and happiness!

Thank you for your hospitality.

100% recommended.

Don't hesitate!

reviews.author: Zirileni Garcia
reviews.text: My experience at Paradisus Palma Real was incredible, and I want to congratulate all the staff for their excellent work. The bartenders, the pool staff, and the restaurant staff do a wonderful job, always attentive and with a smile. And a special thank you to the entertainment team: keep it up, guys, you're doing a great job! Fernando Chispa, thank you for inviting me to participate in the activities even though I didn't know anything about them; from the very first activity I did, I loved it, and that's why I kept participating. Thank you for your attention, for being so attentive, and for being such a dedicated person. I sincerely congratulate you, and keep it up, because you're going to go far.

reviews.author: Michael Nolasco
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus was impeccable, but what truly set it apart was the culinary offering. Each restaurant surpasses the last with creative dishes, top-quality ingredients, and impeccable presentation.

However, the heart and soul of the place is its team, and Fernando "Chispa" deserves special mention. His energy is incredible, and his service is, quite literally, a spark that brightens your day. Attentive, professional, and with a charisma that elevates the experience to another level.

I would return without hesitation just for the food and Fernando's service!

reviews.author: Samia Dumani
reviews.text:
Here's an elegant, warm review with that special touch:

—

I had a wonderful experience at Blue Agave. The service was impeccable from beginning to end, but I especially want to highlight Eduardo, who truly elevated our visit.

From the first moment, he provided top-notch service, handled our reservation seamlessly, and ensured everything was perfect. His recommendations were excellent and spot-on, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Dianna Jimenez
reviews.text:
My experience at Paradisus was simply spectacular. If I had to highlight one thing above all else, it would be the hotel's comfort; the facilities are top-notch and make you feel relaxed from the moment you arrive.
The beach is a true dream. White sand, crystal-clear water, and incredible tranquility; it's the perfect place to spend the day enjoying the sea. But what truly makes the stay unforgettable is the team, especially Fernando "Chispa." His entertainment is amazing; he has a unique energy that's contagious and makes every moment fun.

reviews.author: Sory Trinidad
reviews.text:
Special recognition goes to Fernando Chispa, who elevates the experience to another level. His service is exceptional: always attentive, friendly, and genuinely helpful. Fernando stands out for his professionalism and for anticipating guests' needs, ensuring that every visit feels personalized and special.

Without a doubt, the Paradisus Resort combines comfort, excellence, and outstanding customer service, where people like Fernando Chispa make all the difference and leave an unforgettable impression.

reviews.author: Michel Sylvestre
reviews.text:
What a wonderful stay! My wife and I chose the Paradisus Reserve section and were not disappointed. First, the welcome from Alexia was exceptional; she explained everything and introduced us to Basilio, our concierge for the duration of our stay. They were both fantastic.
The food exceeded our expectations in most of the restaurants. Our favorites were Santé, Italian, and Mexican.
Our room, 8108, was in the Swim Up category, which allowed us to enjoy the private section and the pool reserved for guests—simply wonderful!

And what can we say about the staff? Friendly, smiling, and always ready to help.
Thank you to everyone, especially Alexia, Basilio, Guilberto on the beach, Raphael, Raoul, and Jonathan at the Wine Bar.
Hoping to return, Jocelyne Dumas and Michel Sylvestre

reviews.author: Emanuele Occhipinti
reviews.text:
A very beautiful resort, located on the fantastic Bovaro beach. It's the resort with the cleanest beach. Huge pools, a relaxed and friendly atmosphere throughout. We loved it.
The only thing I would say about the management is that the music on the evening of the shows is too loud, making it difficult to communicate and enjoy the entertainment. It's worth noting that the beach is located far from the rooms, and they finish early.

reviews.author: Bryan Buitrago
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana was simply spectacular. From the moment we arrived, everything exceeded our expectations.

We went as a family, with my wife and our two children, and we had an amazing time. The resort is super fun for kids; they have a park called Fun Republic that is large and spectacular, which made our vacation even more special.

The service is top-notch: all the staff are extremely professional, attentive, and always willing to help. The view is incredible, the beach is beautiful, and the pools are perfectly maintained—a true paradise for relaxation.

The rooms are luxurious, spacious, and very clean, which made our experience even more comfortable. In addition, the buffet food was excellent, with a wide variety and delicious flavors every day.

We want to give a special thanks to Ángela, our concierge, for her attention and dedication, and to Junior, the waiter who served us at breakfast, always with a smile and impeccable service. We also want to thank absolutely all the staff: bellhops, servers, bartenders, concierges, housekeeping… everyone made our experience unforgettable!

It was definitely an amazing family experience. 100% recommended!

reviews.author: Ximena Abadi
reviews.text:
Infinitely grateful to Juan Peña, Guest Experience Manager, who welcomed us and entrusted our stay to Angela, our concierge. She was warm, charming, and attentive to every detail, ensuring we had an unforgettable week.
Thank you to Luis at Ginger Bar, who waited for us each day with a wonderful freshly brewed coffee and cookies. 🍪 And to Virtudes, truly delightful, who showered us with kindness every time she greeted us at one of the specialty restaurants.

Thank you for your hospitality and for making us feel so special during our week.

Thank you all...we just want to come back! ✨️✨️✨️✨️

reviews.author: Gris Meyris Del Carmen
reviews.text: I'm at the Paradisus Palma Real resort and I'm leaving this afternoon. My stay has been wonderful. The resort is beautiful and the service has been top-notch. I want to especially mention Jeffrey from the 90-degree pool, who treated me exceptionally well. I also had the chance to meet Fernando "Chispa" from the entertainment team, and he was truly outstanding. The whole team is great, but Fernando "Chispa" always stands out. You can see his energy, dedication, and leadership. He undoubtedly does his job flawlessly and elevates the entire experience. I'm very grateful to everyone for these past few days 🙌.

reviews.author: Abel D LA ROSA
reviews.text:
My experience at the hotel was incredible, with three things standing out:

• The Beach: Spectacular, clean, and with a breathtaking landscape.

• The Bar: With a fantastic atmosphere and top-notch cocktails.

• Fernando "Chispa": The best part. His energy and exceptional service made all the difference to our vacation. A true professional who makes you feel right at home!

reviews.author: Evelin Acevedo
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic few days and I just had to recommend this hotel. What we loved most:

• Fernando "Chispa's" service: He's amazing. His attitude and energy are top-notch; he truly made our stay much more enjoyable and special.

• The beach and the bar: The perfect combination. A beautiful beach with crystal-clear water and a bar with a great atmosphere and delicious drinks.

reviews.author: Yexinower Lizcano
reviews.text:
My experience at this hotel was simply excellent. From the very first moment, the staff's service was impeccable, always attentive and friendly.

The facilities are beautiful, clean, and very well maintained. The food was delicious, with a great variety and high quality, and the rooms were comfortable and well-equipped.
Without a doubt, it's a place I would return to without hesitation. Everything was 10/10. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Javier Contreras
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real has been, so far, the best Meliá hotel we've stayed at. The facilities are incredible, the staff is super friendly, and the evening shows keep families engaged.

I'd like to take this opportunity to highlight and thank Romeris, one of the restaurant supervisors, for her amazing service. She's a wonderful person, very kind, and always concerned that we have the best possible experience.

reviews.author: Cristinna C E
reviews.text:
We are delighted with Janilda from Kids Dom. She has an incredible way with children. Our 3-year-old daughter, after only 10 seconds with her, didn't want to leave her side. My daughter adores her!!! She's a 10 out of 10. We are so grateful.

And Dilania from the large pool bar is also spectacularly attentive, friendly, and helpful. Another 10 out of 10!
Another special mention goes to Carlos, the buffet chef, who has been preparing separate meals for our celiac friend (he even showed her a video of how he cooked for her).

reviews.author: Léa Hadoude
reviews.text:
Upon arrival, we received a very warm welcome from Jean, who immediately made us feel at ease. The concierges, Eraysa and Andres, were very kind. All the staff were incredibly attentive. We will definitely return!

The Japanese and Mexican restaurants were all very good. Excellent service!

reviews.author: Camila Alejandra González
reviews.text:
Great experience! I highly recommend this hotel. All the facilities were working well, the view was beautiful, there was a wide variety of food, and the service was friendly. We traveled as a family, and there were activities for all tastes. I especially want to highlight the creative activities, most of which I participated in. I'm leaving with wonderful handmade souvenirs. The staff were very kind to me; I remember "Pollito," "Alfredo," "Mini Cooper," "Tana," and others. I enjoyed myself immensely and would definitely return to this hotel.

Sincerely, Camila Alejandra González

reviews.author: A-J P.
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful trip.

Despite a rocky start (no water in the room, slow and practically nonexistent service…), the rest of the trip was perfect.

Thank you to Christopher, our hotel manager, who quickly saved the day with his excellent service.

Thank you to Yudeni, whose impeccable and excellent service made our days at the beach (which is truly exceptional) even more enjoyable.

The food was very acceptable considering the destination, and the hotel was well-renovated and clean. We give it a 4.5 and recommend it.

reviews.author: Marta Taladriz
reviews.text: Antonia at The Reserve bar is lovely and very helpful. Attentive and very punctual, many congratulations to her and also to Junior, who was very attentive. I hope to see them again on a future trip. Ten out of ten for them! 🤩

reviews.author: Marina Mosmann
reviews.text:
There's something that stands out about the beach area of ​​this hotel. The Reserve area is tranquil and scenic, but the palm trees and turquoise sea wouldn't be the same without the attention of Gilberto, Pedro, and Raúl… the quality of service from these three people far surpasses any number of stars the hotel might have. We are deeply grateful for how they made us feel! The photo is of Barnelis, who greeted us every day with her beautiful smile and excellent willingness to always find us a comfortable place for breakfast or lunch! The dishes at all the restaurants were delicious, and the variety was remarkable, as we stayed for 19 days and nothing was lacking! Among all the warm welcomes were Luis and Andreia at the bar, and Luis Rodrigues, the waiter who should be in charge, as he excels in every detail of his work.
Santo, Franklin, Kevin, Norjandro, and Luz: they truly became the highlights of our stay. We are already planning our return! We felt right at home… Thank you, Laura, for being attentive to our well-being throughout our stay. Thank you!

reviews.author: Marta Lucas
reviews.text:
We stayed at this hotel for a week on a family trip and couldn't be happier. The first thing that surprised us upon arrival (besides the elegant Christmas decorations throughout the hotel) was the quality of the rooms, which were very spacious and offered every amenity. Everything looked brand new, clean, and well-maintained.
We also want to highlight the friendliness of the staff and their ability to remember the faces and personalities of all the guests (at least ours). I'd like to give a special mention to Basilio, our concierge at "The Reserve," who looked after us throughout our stay.
Finally, we must mention the quality of their themed restaurants, especially Mina and Flora, with their excellent ingredients and original dishes that made for some truly special dinners.
In short… we can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Wojciech Bąk
reviews.text:
The perfect place for a carefree getaway.

The hotel is located on a very large property, which includes several Melia hotels. The price includes on-site attractions at the Fun Republic complex, including a rope park and mini golf. The Rafa Nadal Tennis Center, a tennis and paddle tennis court complex, is available for an additional fee. Transportation within the area is very efficient thanks to electric scooters.

The food in the main restaurant is varied and constantly replenished.

Dinner reservations at themed restaurants, including Italian, Asian, and steakhouses, are available as part of your stay. Some restaurants are adults-only.

The hotel staff is very polite and helpful, not pushy about tips, which are, however, encouraged and appreciated.

If I had to point out any downsides, it would be the irregular room cleaning. Sometimes in the morning, sometimes during the day, and sometimes in the evening. This was a bit of a nuisance.

And the lounger by the room was dirty upon arrival and looked the same upon arrival – it hadn't been cleaned. But these are really just minor problems in paradise:)

reviews.author: Angel Caballero
reviews.text: I want to thank Mirella for the excellent service at Spot Bar. She was very kind, attentive, and professional at all times. Her kindness and helpfulness made the experience much more enjoyable. Without a doubt, top-notch service. Thank you so much, Mirella!

reviews.author: Jomar Rivera
reviews.text:
María Santa, waitress at Blue Agave 🍽️✨
Excellent service, unique charisma, and a touch of hospitality that makes every customer feel right at home. Her dedication and kindness make every visit a wonderful experience. She is a true embodiment of quality and excellent service at Blue Agave.

reviews.author: Viviana Hoffmann
reviews.text: I loved my vacation at Parasus Palma Real. Everything was delicious, tasty, and full of food, but the most fun was the time we spent with the entertainment team, Pollito and Dana. They are fantastic, guys, thank you for your time ❤️❤️❤️. And also Jimbert from the buffet and all the staff; the attention and kindness were wonderful. We left with a wonderful impression.

reviews.author: Irma Huelga
reviews.text: Excellent!!!! Perfect location, spacious and clean rooms, and a buffet with a great variety for breakfast and lunch. The restaurants to choose from for dinner were quite good. But the best part of our stay was the service from the guys at the pool bar. Eddy was a 10/10, always smiling, makes delicious cocktails, and brightened our day with his friendliness. Rosanna was professional and made sure we had everything we needed, as were Victor and Jonathan. Thanks for this experience, guys. Looking forward to coming back soon.

reviews.author: Isa C
reviews.text:
Overall, a positive experience. The facilities were excellent and well-maintained. The food was delicious in general, both the buffet and the à la carte restaurants. The hotel is right on the beach with all the amenities. The entertainment team was excellent: Dana, Carlos, Henry, and Mini Cooper Pollito provided very fun activities.

Thank you for making our vacation so enjoyable. I would definitely return.

reviews.author: Mariana Gomez
reviews.text:
We want to congratulate and especially thank Carlos Enrique and Carlos Pinto, who made our stay truly excellent. From the very first moment, they stood out for their kindness, helpfulness, and constant attention. Always attentive to every detail, with a genuine smile and a palpable warmth. Thanks to them, our experience at the hotel was even more special and unforgettable. People like them make all the difference and leave a lasting impression.
We also want to thank Manuel and Yeri Rafaela, who served us at the event on December 31st and made our evening wonderful. They not only provide excellent service, but they also convey something much more valuable: a genuine desire for their guests to leave happy.

reviews.author: Hortensia Cobo
reviews.text: We stayed at this fantastic hotel in October 2025—it was pure luxury! What I would highlight most is the attention from all the staff, starting with management, who provided very personalized service. This surprised us quite a bit, as in other hotels the management doesn't bother to speak to the guests. In this hotel, it was the complete opposite: they were incredibly friendly and attentive to our every need. The waiters were amazing, especially Ramón at the pool, the staff at the sports bar, Fior (the best!), and the staff at the Ginger bar—they were delightful. Pedro, who was in charge of the towels, was very kind and attentive to us. The entertainment team is small but incredibly attentive: Jairo, Fernando, Ayayay, and Carlos—thank you so much for all your attention and the dancing! The DJs were fantastic. The shows were quite good and entertaining. The rooms were beautiful, and The Reserve service was spectacular. The pool's location was superb, right next to the beach. The food was delicious and varied; I'd especially recommend the Flora y Santé restaurant. The drinks were excellent, particularly Miguel's cocktails at Rum Republic Spice & Sugar Bar—a 10 out of 10! We enjoyed it so much that we'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: Romina Fidalgo
reviews.text: We really appreciate Yorgelys and Melky's hospitality during breakfast; they were always attentive to our needs, whether it was a coffee or a spoon, they were there to help. The food was also outstanding. The variety of everything was incredible! We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Cervantes
reviews.text:
Dinner at Flora

The staff was very friendly and took all our dietary restrictions into account. The food was delicious. Rosa Fernanda gave us amazing recommendations. From the moment I arrived, the captain and the staff welcomed me and were mindful of my reservation. They definitely made the dining experience enjoyable.

reviews.author: Elsy Rosario
reviews.text: I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Paradisus Palma Real. I especially want to thank Antonia, who took the time to explain the cocktails to me. I tried everything she offered, and it was all delicious. She's a true professional. I highly recommend enjoying the cocktails she makes by the pool in the Reserve area. I'll be back soon! Her charisma makes you feel like family!

reviews.author: Urcania Francisco
reviews.text:
My stay at Paradisus was simply exceptional. If you're looking for a place where luxury feels natural and relaxation is guaranteed, this is the perfect destination.

Highlights of my trip:
First-class comfort: From the moment you enter the room, you notice the quality. The bed was like a cloud, the facilities are impeccable, and every corner is designed to help you disconnect from the world. It's the perfect balance between elegance and well-being.

The life of the party - Fernando "Chispa": I can't not mention Fernando "Chispa." His nickname suits him perfectly: he's the epitome of energy and charisma. He made every activity fun and friendly. He has a special talent for making everyone feel welcome and putting a smile on your face, even on the hottest days. He's a true pro!

In conclusion: If you go to Paradisus, prepare to relax like never before, but above all, seek out Fernando "Chispa" to guarantee a fantastic atmosphere! I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Orlando Resto
reviews.text: Our stay was spectacular. The room and pool area were splendid. Rosanna, Yanira, and Maria served us meals with great attention to detail and care. Mr. Carlos informed us of the day's activities every morning. In short, everything was excellent. We will be back!

reviews.author: Miljana Mitić
reviews.text: At this hotel, we had one of the best hotel experiences we've ever had. Of course, the hotel itself, its facilities, and its location make this property truly unique. But if I had to choose one thing to highlight, it would be the exceptional service we received from the hotel's staff. In particular, I'd like to mention two people who went above and beyond: our destination concierge, Yaleidi, who provided an attention and level of detail I'd never seen before; and Yuderi, who managed to make us smile with every interaction. Their hard work and dedication are a testament to the hotel's success, and we hope they receive the recognition they deserve. Other people I couldn't leave out were Pedro, of course, Jimbert, the barista Katherine, and Enrique at Kanna. Congratulations to everyone for their outstanding service.

reviews.author: Daniel Caires
reviews.text:
I want to express my sincere gratitude for the wonderful experience I had during my stay at the hotel.

First and foremost, I want to highlight the excellent work of the Guest Service Manager, Marc Tortosa. His professionalism, kindness, and dedication made all the difference. Always attentive to every detail and willing to help, he truly elevated our experience to another level.

I also want to acknowledge Vanessa, the young woman who works on the beach, for her friendliness and excellent service. Her positive attitude and helpfulness made every moment by the sea even more special.
The restaurants are very well organized, with impeccable service and food quality that, without exaggeration, is 6-star. Every dish exceeded our expectations. Furthermore, the premium quality of the drinks is truly noticeable and a major differentiator. Wonderful cocktails.

The beach is simply fantastic, perfectly maintained and beautiful. The rooms are renovated, practically brand new, very comfortable, and modern.

Another point worth highlighting is the hotel's security, which is excellent. We felt safe and well taken care of at all times. I've had the opportunity to stay at several hotels in Punta Cana, and I can definitely say that this is the best of them all. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-notch experience.

I will definitely return and recommend this hotel to family and friends.

Thank you!

reviews.author: Nathaly Cornelio
reviews.text:
My stay at the Paradisus Hotel was incredible. The beach was stunning, with crystal-clear water and white sand. I loved relaxing on the beach and enjoying the sun and sea breeze.

The pool was another highlight of the hotel. It was large and had several areas to relax, including a poolside bar. I appreciated that there was always a place to sit and enjoy a cocktail or a snack.

But what truly made my stay unforgettable was the staff, especially Fernando Chispa, the entertainment coordinator. He was incredibly fun and always made sure everyone felt included. I loved his energy and passion for ensuring guests had a great time.

Overall, my experience at the Paradisus Hotel was excellent. The location, the beach, the pool, and the staff were all top-notch. I would definitely return to this hotel in the future.

reviews.author: Josleinny masiel Uffre Garcia
reviews.text: Besides the service, another thing that really caught my attention at Paradisus Palma Real was the quality of the facilities and experiences; the rooms are very comfortable and well-maintained, creating a perfect environment to relax; the cuisine is varied and of good quality in all the restaurants; the mixology is simply incredible, with well-crafted and creative drinks that further enhance the experience; the daytime activities are well-organized and there's always something to do; and the entertainment team deserves special mention for their energy and dedication, especially FERNANDO “CHISPA”, who stands out impressively and brings a unique vibe to the atmosphere, making all the difference in the experience.

reviews.author: Juanma Castellano
reviews.text: Everything was perfect. Magnificent hotel and oceanfront room. We were delighted with The Reserve Fahrenheit pool bar and its waiters, Antonia and Junior. The Canary Islands assistant manager, Laura, also provided excellent service. We will be back.

reviews.author: Angelica Maria Garcia
reviews.text: I had the opportunity to stay at the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel, and the experience was excellent. From the moment I arrived, everything was lovely: the rooms were comfortable and clean, the food was delicious and varied, and the hotel's overall atmosphere felt peaceful and welcoming. I want to give special recognition to the entertainment team, who truly make a difference and make guests feel like they belong. There, I met Fernando Chispa, a very well-rounded person, full of energy and talent; he dances incredibly and always gives his best, as does his entire team. Thanks to them, the stay was even more enjoyable. I would definitely like to return.

reviews.author: Sergio Pantano
reviews.text:
EN:
Everything was absolutely wonderful, especially the Dominicans who work at the hotel: all the attendants and staff are extremely friendly and helpful, and as if that weren't enough, the beach team: Rafael, Teo, and Pedro are the best, as well as the waiters at the Sante restaurant: Melqui and Norjandro. Other than that, the resort is wonderful, with beautiful rooms, excellent infrastructure, perfect pools, and impeccable, unmissable food. The champagne and wine are also worth mentioning.

The only negative point was the concierge service, which didn't add much to our stay, and when we spoke to other guests, they told us the same thing.

PT-BR
Everything was absolutely wonderful, with absolute emphasis on the Dominicans who work at the hotel: All the attendants and staff are extremely friendly and helpful, and as if that weren't enough, the beach team, Rafael, Teo, and Pedro, as well as the waiters at the Sante restaurant, Melqui and Norjandro. Apart from that, the resort is wonderful, a beautiful room, with great infrastructure, perfect pools and impeccable and unmissable food. The champagne and wine also deserve a mention.
The downside was the concierge who didn't add much to our stay, and talking to other guests, they told us the same thing.

reviews.author: Antonio Leiva
reviews.text:
I loved my stay. The hotel is right on the beautiful beach, and the room was very cozy and spacious. Sleeping in that bed was a real treat!
It has a Nespresso café just for coffee, ice cream, and pastries, which is delightful.
All the shops and restaurants are tastefully designed, but the best part was the friendliness of the staff. Thank you!

reviews.author: Clareth Cañizales
reviews.text:
The facilities and the beach are excellent.

The beach service is spectacular, especially Antonia's. One hundred percent recommended. I would return a thousand times.

The service from Romeris and Franklin at the Sante restaurant was outstanding.

Equally outstanding was the service from Miguel and María at the Rum Bar.

Luis and Magda at the Sport Club also helped make the experience unforgettable.

Thank you to all the staff for providing us with the best service.

reviews.author: audelina reynoso
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the Sport Bar, with its super friendly atmosphere, great service, and perfect spot to have a good time. The Ginger Bar was also an excellent experience, with expertly prepared drinks and a lovely ambiance. The entertainment team is amazing, always full of energy and making everything more fun; especially Fernando Chispa, who is the best because of his energy and dedication, along with Henry, who also brings a fantastic vibe.

reviews.author: Marisol SOLIS HERNANDEZ
reviews.text: Yafreisy Soler's service was wonderful during our breakfasts during our stay. The food was delicious, and the hotel in general provided a peaceful environment for relaxation. The beach is the best. We will definitely return. Thank you from Mexico.

reviews.author: Javi Malgüe
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at this hotel. From the moment I arrived, the staff was friendly, attentive, and always willing to help.
The hotel's entertainment was spectacular. The entertainment team was always full of incredible energy, especially Jairo Fly, who was super charismatic and attentive to all the guests. You can tell they enjoy what they do, and that makes all the difference.
In addition, the service at Kidsdom, the hotel's daycare, was excellent. The staff is friendly, attentive, and clearly experienced with children. The space is safe, clean, and offers fun activities. It's very reassuring to leave the little ones in good hands while you enjoy the hotel. Without a doubt, an excellent addition for families.

reviews.author: Rolando pena paniagua
reviews.text: “Antonia provides exceptional service. She is kind, helpful, and makes you feel very well taken care of. I would definitely be seen by her again. Thank you for your excellent work!” ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: José Alejandro Zapata Perez
reviews.text: The experience was wonderful. I was with my wife and we had a fantastic time. The food was excellent, the drinks were always top-notch, the tranquility of the place was unbeatable, the beach was incredible, and the location was absolutely beautiful. Mr. Kelvin Fernández was always there to guide and assist us within the hotel.

reviews.author: Nicaury Hodge lamu
reviews.text: My experience at the Paradisus Hotel was incredible. The bar is a welcoming place where you can enjoy refreshing cocktails, and the food is excellent, with a variety of delicious dishes that stand out for their flavor and presentation. But what truly made my stay unforgettable was the entertainment provided by Fernando Chispa. His energy is contagious, and his passion for his work is evident in every activity he organizes. He's a real asset to the hotel!

reviews.author: Lisaury Marte
reviews.text: Paradisus is a beach oasis with golden sand and a bar that never stops serving good vibes. What truly sets it apart are the hosts: Fernando “Chispa,” with his infectious energy, and Alfredo, who puts on a show with his charisma and humor. The whole setting is fantastic, but it's them who make every day a party you'll want to repeat. A must-see!

reviews.author: Aleydis Zabaleta
reviews.text:
I'm at the resort and having an absolutely fantastic time. I loved the food, the restaurants, and the overall atmosphere. Even though the hotel was under renovation, we still enjoyed it immensely.

😍🥰 And when I met Fernando Chispa, the entertainment guy, everything got even better 🔥. His classes are phenomenal, especially the aqua gym, which I loved. He's a guy full of energy and joy, and he makes sure everyone has a great time.

😍 When I go back, I hope to see him there, because he truly makes all the difference to the experience. 💫👏

reviews.author: Valeria Silvana Garrido
reviews.text: Dana, our waitress and entertainer, was excellent. Very cheerful and helpful. Jaime, our concierge, was great too. We liked it so much we became members. See you next time!

reviews.author: Jorge Luis Cuello Mera
reviews.text: Raúl helped us on the beach; he's the most attentive person in the entire hotel! With people like him, you never want to leave! He was attentive to everything we needed and answered all our questions. I'll definitely return to this hotel, and the first thing I'll do is look for him wherever he is! Thank you so much for everything.

reviews.author: Ninoska De La Cruz
reviews.text:
I loved the food, it was very good and there was a lot of variety. The Flora restaurant and the Japanese restaurant were the highlights. There's a lot of entertainment, various activities, and the entertainment was really cool, especially Carlos, Fernando, and the chef at the Japanese restaurant—he's very funny and cooks phenomenally. Juan, who makes the omelets at the buffet, was also great. The room was very nice, and there are always live singers at night.

The only bad thing was that many of the outlets in the room didn't work, so the refrigerator didn't work. I also didn't like the waiters; they would bring you water and then you wouldn't ask for anything else. I never saw any waiters on the beach, and at the beach restaurant, the service was very slow. Except for José at the Japanese restaurant; he's very nice and a very good waiter.

reviews.author: María José Losada
reviews.text:
We stayed at The Reserve, and overall it was very good, except for a few specific issues that I hadn't experienced at other Paradisus resorts offering the same service (delayed check-in, faulty safe).
The restaurant and bar staff were excellent, especially Rafael, who took great care of us on the beach, and Basilio, who helped us with all our needs during our stay.

reviews.author: Patricia Mejia
reviews.text:
We were delighted with our stay. Special thanks to Laura from Food and Beverage and Juan Peña, Guest Experience Manager, for their hospitality.

We'll be back soon with the whole family. 😁

reviews.author: Thiago Casquero
reviews.text:
Everything was excellent!
The service was fantastic, the rooms were spotless, and the food was better than any other hotel in the Dominican Republic.
We're close to the adult pool, and Marileisy, Arisleida, and Alberto at the bar there provided amazing service!
We'll definitely stay here again when we return to the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: Ricardo Javier Bongiovanni
reviews.text:
Lunch box
Milton Jimber Nelson Jesica
Absolutely excellent service today at this restaurant...very friendly and very helpful.
We'll be back because we really enjoyed it.
Congratulations to the team!

reviews.author: Alberto Chacon
reviews.text: Antonia and Marcos are spectacular. The best cocktails in Bávaro. It's a pleasure to come to this country and be served with such care.

reviews.author: Vitor Rezende
reviews.text: Paradisus is an amazing place with great people and very good food. The ginger bar is special, "my friend Anthony" is a character, a very nice and charismatic person. And the others are also great, Olga, Jorge, Dominga, Clari, Zara and Eridania.

reviews.author: Sergi Vilaro Rios
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real has undoubtedly been the best hotel experience we've ever had. Service, food, location, and facilities—everything was impeccable.

We arrived very late the first night, and Aldo attended to us with exceptional kindness (and coincidentally, he also checked us out on our last day). He perfectly understood that we were tired, offered help with our luggage, and suggested room service options if we wanted something to eat. That kind of thoughtfulness makes all the difference from the very first moment.

The next day, we met the two people who elevated our stay to something truly exceptional. Yaleidi, our Destination Concierge, left us a lovely welcome gift, gave us a comprehensive tour of the hotel, managed all our reservations, and provided very useful recommendations for making the most of our time. The level of care, attention to detail, and warmth with which she treats her guests is a source of pride for any company.

And Yuderi, at The Reserve beach bar, was simply outstanding. From day one, their friendliness, conversation, and constant concern for everyone's well-being made the beach and that bar our favorite spot. We weren't the only ones: it was the place other guests raved about.
