We also want to mention Jimbert and Estebani at the main buffet; Pedro, Rafael, and Gilbert at the beach bar; Misael at Santé; our favorite barista, Katherine; and Jenifer, Franklin, and Zenovia, with whom we perhaps interacted less, but whose service was always excellent.

The food, in general, was incredible. We would only highlight two weaker points: Mascalzone, which we found disappointing considering it offered something as simple as pasta and pizza, and the sushi restaurant, both the teppanyaki experience and the à la carte menu. In contrast, the rest of the restaurants, including the buffet, offered truly outstanding quality and variety.

Finally, the housekeeping was impeccable. The common areas, bathrooms, and our room always met our expectations.

We will definitely return. And we say this with enthusiasm, because beyond the facilities, what makes this hotel special are the people who are part of it. We can't wait to see them again.

reviews.author: Diego Espinosa
reviews.text: Luisa at the pool bar is fantastic! She's incredibly attentive and respectful. Luisa did everything to accommodate our daughter's needs. We are so grateful to Luisa for her care and hospitality.

reviews.author: Nelda Ortiz Hidalgo
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful holiday at the Palma Real. The hotel is beautiful and all the staff were very friendly.
We especially appreciated Antonia's service at the adults-only pool bar; she took great care of us and made sure we had everything we needed.

reviews.author: Astrid Osorio
reviews.text: Excellent service from Alexander Gonzalez at Bluagave. The food was delicious. The portions were beautiful and the presentation was perfect. They weren't large plates. They were just right.

reviews.author: Alberto Ramos Heredero
reviews.text:
A fantastic hotel for a family trip.

We stayed for a week. The rooms were spacious, clean, and had all the amenities.

There were plenty of activities to enjoy, including sports, dance, and arts.

The Christmas Eve gala dinner was perfect, and the themed restaurants were fantastic, especially Flora and Mina.

The staff was very attentive and friendly. Since we were at The Reserve, we had direct access to Basilio, who helped us with everything we needed during our stay.

We can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Brigido Carrasco
reviews.text:
Fernando and Pollito, our entertainment team, were responsible for making our stay truly memorable. Their passion and energy were contagious, and they created a joyful and fun atmosphere. Their shows and activities were a huge success, and their ability to connect with the guests was impressive.

The beach is a true natural wonder, with its white sand and crystal-clear waters. It was the perfect place to relax and enjoy the sun and nature.

As for the restaurant, the food was delicious and varied. I loved the à la carte dining options, and the service was attentive and friendly.

Overall, my experience at the Paradisus was excellent, thanks in large part to the hospitality and professionalism of the staff, including Fernando and Pollito. I definitely recommend it! 😊🌴

reviews.author: Danyelis Zapata Beras
reviews.text: Excellent service from the very first moment. The place is very clean and well-maintained. All the staff were always friendly, attentive, and professional, making our stay truly pleasant. I could never finish mentioning all the staff who contributed to such a great experience. We stayed for seven days, and each day and each night the service was even better than the day before. Without a doubt, a place you'll want to return to—highly recommended! And a special mention must go to Fernando Chispa for his excellent service and the way he gets involved to ensure everything runs smoothly and that we have a great experience.

reviews.author: Alejandra Mignone
reviews.text:
Excellent service, very friendly staff. And the facilities are amazing! Highly recommended.
A special mention goes to the kidsdom team; they do their job with so much love and professionalism! You can leave your children there with complete peace of mind. And they have a blast!

reviews.author: Ramses Cardenas
reviews.text: Excellent service, the staff are very friendly and attentive. I only had a problem with the lock, but they sent someone soon to fix it. The rooms are very nice, and the food is very good. It's more of a place for relaxing than partying, but it's very, very pleasant.

reviews.author: Silverio González
reviews.text: Mirella's service at the Sport Bar was excellent, along with the entire team. They were very kind, respectful, and above all, very humane. The captain is a wonderful person. We are very happy with their service and will be back soon.

reviews.author: Julyana Alves
reviews.text: The service at Paradisus Palma Real is wonderful, the staff are very attentive, the cleanliness is impeccable, and the drinks are excellent. They were the best days of my life! Thank you to Antonio, Olga, Jorge, Dominga, Clari, Zara, Eridania, and all the staff for making the experience even better!

reviews.author: Matheus Gomes
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real last week and it was simply the best experience of our lives! All the staff were incredibly helpful and ready to assist you at any time! The food is one of the highlights of the stay; all the restaurants are very good and top-notch! We have to give a special thanks to our friends at Kanna Beach Club, who made our stay even better, always enthusiastic about making it perfect! Thank you so much Yasmailin, Enrique, and Stormin! I recommend this resort without hesitation!

reviews.author: Pamela Velez Pav
reviews.text:
Chef Hugo Alberto surprised us with a delicious dinner at the Japanese restaurant Tokimeku Habachi with his 24-hour slow-cooked ribs... and today he surprised us at the Italian restaurant Mascalzone with a delicious appetizer of lobster, salmon, and caviar in a passion fruit and agave sauce... a spectacle of flavors in perfect harmony.
Thank you to Chef Hugo Alberto and his entire team of chefs and waiter Jesús Robles.

reviews.author: Yuleissy Eusebio
reviews.text:
My stay at the Paradisus was simply spectacular. From the very first moment, the hotel envelops you in an atmosphere of luxury and relaxation that is hard to beat.

🏖️ The Beach
The beach is undoubtedly one of the highlights. White sand, crystal-clear waters, and impeccable maintenance. It's the perfect place to both unwind under the sun and enjoy the sea in a truly paradisiacal setting.

⚡ The Life of the Party: Fernando "Chispa"
But what truly elevated my experience was the entertainment team, and especially Fernando "Chispa." His name doesn't do him justice: he's pure energy and charisma. He gets everyone involved, having fun, and always has a contagious smile that brightens your day. If you go to the Paradisus, look for him! He makes your stay go from "very good" to "memorable."

reviews.author: Annie Binette
reviews.text: We loved our trip! The service was exceptional. Romeris, Melvin, Jimbert, José, and Edisson were always smiling and kind. We will definitely return.

reviews.author: Selvin Reyes
reviews.text: I had the best experience of my life at Paradisus Palma Real. Great food, great drinks, but the best part was visiting Kicks Sport Bar. The service from the staff, especially Diogenes, was fantastic. The bar manager, Luis Rosario, was also very attentive to all our needs. Congratulations to them all!

reviews.author: Ambar Peña Martínez
reviews.text:
Overall, we really enjoyed the hotel: the staff service was excellent, very attentive to everything; the room was comfortable (simple and modern style). The only issue we had was with the air conditioning and its automatic control (it turned off during the night and we woke up feeling hot). Aside from that, everything was very pleasant and had lovely details.

The food at the main buffet was good, and the experience at the Mina restaurant (steak house) was also very good.

reviews.author: Luis Ariel Herman
reviews.text:
A wonderful family vacation. I want to highlight the work of Concierge Guillermo, who was always very attentive to ensure we had a fantastic time.

My sons, Oscar, 9, and Álvaro, 3, were thrilled with the Kids Zone and our visits to Parque República and the Water Park; they were very well taken care of by Janilda, Sugenery, and Alexandra.
The hotel staff, and especially Juan Peña, were always attentive to our needs, particularly those of my wife, my mother-in-law, and my father and his wife.
We will definitely return for the next holidays there. As always, Meliá lived up to expectations by providing quality service and consistently exceeding our expectations.

reviews.author: Tomas Arteaga
reviews.text: Excellent service, especially from the sports bar team. Many thanks to Diogenes and everyone else. They're truly an excellent team, with great food and drinks. They have fantastic chemistry and provide top-notch service. Congratulations to everyone for their hard work! See you next time!

reviews.author: angela arteaga vial
reviews.text:
Excellent hotel, beautiful infrastructure, very clean, great pool, and the beach is on another level.
The service has varied; some days it's better than others, but overall it's good. Special mention goes to Rocio and Maria at the buffet. They were very attentive, kind, and caring.

reviews.author: Darling Maldonado
reviews.text:
After spending a few days at the Paradisus, I'm left with a very positive impression. The hotel itself is fantastic, but what truly makes your stay special is the team.
We spent a lot of time in the restaurant, and the service was outstanding. The staff is incredibly attentive, quickly learns your preferences, and makes mealtimes incredibly relaxed and enjoyable. You can tell there's a great work environment, and that translates to the guests.
A special mention goes to Fernando 'Chispa'. If you go, you'll notice his energy immediately. He's an entertainer who genuinely enjoys making sure people have a good time, without any pressure, and with a natural flair. People like him and the restaurant team are what make a hotel of this caliber not just a beautiful building, but an experience you take home with you. I would return without hesitation.

reviews.author: Rocio Talaveron
reviews.text:
The best guest at this Meliá Palmas Real hotel, without a doubt, and a wonderful person, Fernando, aka "La Chispa" (The Spark) 😊... He treated us incredibly well; he's pure joy and vitality.

Thank you for making our stay so wonderful!
Thank you, Chispa!! Never lose that joy!

reviews.author: adriana franco
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed here last week, and the resort is extraordinary. The rooms are large, the pools are fantastic, there are several restaurants, and the buffet has a wide variety of delicious food. They also now have a play area similar to an amusement park for adults and children. Although there is sargassum on the beach, it's cleaned daily and is ideal for walking and enjoying the mornings. We enjoyed the activities, which cater to all tastes. In short, it's the perfect place to relax without having to leave the hotel.

It's worth mentioning that this place wouldn't be what it is without its wonderful people. There are many staff members, but I want to specifically mention the people who made our stay a 10/10: the lovely Luisa from the beach pool, Alberto from the pool bar, Natanael from security, Fernanda, Yanira, Milton, Jimbert, Frank, Hirlemne, Rosanna from the buffet, José and the bellhop staff, and our dear concierge, Wolfman. Thank you, Paradisus Palma Real team!! 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Juan Monroy
reviews.text: Excellent service and attention. Beautiful facilities. Beautiful and clean beach, as well as the pools. Very good live shows. Good food and restaurants. We especially thank Guillermo for his excellent service and class. Thanks, old friend Guille… I hope we see you climbing the ladder. Best regards.

reviews.author: Luis Gonzalez
reviews.text: Excellent service and hospitality. If I could give 6 stars to Betty, Marta, Anthony, Sujeidy, Alexandra, Charlina, Joly, Lisbeth, José, Jesús, and Richard at FunRepublic, I would.

reviews.author: Widad Mor
reviews.text: Impeccable childcare service. We are very satisfied with the service provided everywhere and especially at Kidsdome. They looked after my 3-year-old daughter throughout our stay. A big thank you to the entire team and especially to Alexandra and Jesus. This is my second time at this Resort and we will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Digna Bezanilla
reviews.text: Absolute excellence. I'm leaving completely amazed. The opposite of being able to stay like this. I say "like this" because it couldn't be better. Excellent service. Spotlessly clean. The food was exquisite. God bless this place. (Entertainment by Henry, the chocolate, and Martha)

reviews.author: Adriana Solari
reviews.text: Our stay was fantastic, Chef Carlos Cruz was a genius. Please provide shade for the dance class. Eduardo Bustamante was delightful. We'll be back.

reviews.author: claudia f m i belonci
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the hotel!!! The food is great. The entertainment staff provides top-notch service! I was especially charmed by Jairo (the dancer). He's super lively and a great guy! Congratulations 👏👏👏👏❤️

reviews.author: Gilma Bibiana Burbano
reviews.text: The hotel is wonderful, elegant, and has service that touches the heart, making you want to come back countless times. The combination of elegance, the scenery, and unsurpassed service has us truly enchanted by the hotel and its staff: Arisleida and Jesus at Paradisus Palma Real beach were unparalleled in their warmth and attention, not to mention Luis Garcés, the supervisor, who was always attentive to our needs. And at the Sante restaurant, the service from Santo and the entire staff was very friendly and attentive. Thank you so much. And Leonela was always attentive to make sure everything was fine in our room, that nothing was missing, that we were kept informed, and that many details were provided. Everything has been wonderful, beyond words. Spectacular!!! Highly recommended. Friends, family, beach, tranquility, elegance... Enjoy it all!! ☺️

reviews.author: Jorge Suarez
reviews.text:
We were delighted and very grateful to Rafael, the beach boy, one of a great team working on the beach in the Reserve area. Pedro was also a real character. They made sure we had a fabulous day.
Our concierge, Deilis, was spectacular, along with Richard and María. In short, the service was excellent. We are members and have been visiting Punta Cana every year for 22 years.

reviews.author: Daniel Morales
reviews.text:
Excellent, very fast, and delicious.
The Mexican food at Blue Agave is very tasty and authentic.
Thanks to Yamilet and Lorena for their service and attention. Excellent service!

reviews.author: Alicia foi
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed the hotel. I'd like to see them add a covered area for activities and a dedicated space for shows. Chef Carlos Cruz was incredible; he always took great care of us.
The quality of the evening entertainment could be improved.

reviews.author: Yokasta Morla
reviews.text:
My stay at the Paradisus Palma Real was delightful. The beach is a spectacular sight with its white sand and crystal-clear waters, and the pools are true oases of relaxation, always spotless.

The best part was the staff, especially Fernando "Chispa." His energy and joy are unique; he truly lives up to his name and makes the entertainment the highlight of the day. A 10 out of 10 for him!

Without a doubt, a place to return to.

reviews.author: Erika O.G.
reviews.text: Our experience at Paradisus by Meliá was wonderful. We especially want to thank Yamilet, who provided exceptional service: kind, professional, and always attentive to every detail. Thank you for making our stay even more special!

reviews.author: Sr.Darling Frefire
reviews.text:
We just returned from a stay at the Paradisus, and while the facilities are top-notch, what truly makes it worthwhile to return is the staff.
In the restaurant, the service was impeccable; you can tell when there's good management because the service is friendly yet highly professional, making each dinner feel special and unhurried. It's not just about the food; it's about how they make you feel.

But what really brings the hotel to life is Fernando 'Chispa'. He's an entertainer of a kind you just don't find anymore: he has a natural charisma and an energy that doesn't feel forced, but rather genuinely spreads his good humor. He gets everyone to feel included and have fun without being intrusive.

reviews.author: Victoria Tomasella
reviews.text: Everything was excellent! The staff in all areas were very friendly and attentive, always greeting you with a smile. The Kids Club was especially wonderful. My son was delighted with the team members; they were all very kind, and the activities were super fun and varied. Thank you! Highly recommended for trips with children.

reviews.author: Dhiovana Prestes Toledo da Rocha
reviews.text: We received excellent service at the 90 Degrees bar from Antonia, Alberto, and Rebeca!! The best bar in the entire hotel, located by the adults-only pool. A wonderful stay!!! We will definitely return!!

reviews.author: cristina sanchez
reviews.text: Many thanks to the waiters at Tokimeku; they made my family and me have a wonderful evening. A special thanks to Romeris, whom we see at breakfast at Sante and who always greets us with her big smile. Hugs!

reviews.author: Déborah Camargo
reviews.text:
I loved my experience staying at the Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana! With a special highlight for the service from Rosanna Yaníra, who provided spectacular service at breakfast 🩷
I will definitely come back many more times!

reviews.author: Isabella a
reviews.text: We came to the beach and were greeted by Angelo, a very charismatic and incredibly attentive employee. Thanks to him, my day at the beach was SPECTACULAR. He was always looking out for us, as was the entire hotel staff. I recommend it without hesitation.

reviews.author: Meli Valencia
reviews.text:
This was my first time traveling to Punta Cana, and my stay here was incredible. The beach was beautiful, and the live music nights were so much fun.

And I want to thank Mr. Guillermo, the concierge, for all the attention he gave my husband and me. Excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Ruth Medina
reviews.text:
Flora Restaurant: efficient and effective. From the moment we arrived, the courteous hostess seated us at a comfortable table and directed our attention to a waiter who offered us exquisite dishes accompanied by a fine wine, named Cesar.
The sancocho was perfectly cooked and exquisite, the cocofongo was delicious, and the steak with onions was delightful.
The delicate ambiance evokes nature.

reviews.author: Eugenia Bongiovanni
reviews.text: Another year back at our second home, and we're all so warmly welcomed. Special mention to Yafreisy, who always puts our needs first! She's an excellent worker and a wonderful person! It's a pleasure to see her again.

reviews.author: Luisa Lovo
reviews.text: Excellent hotel, very good experience. The food at Mina was delicious and Jean Carlos's service was exceptional.

reviews.author: João Vitor Pio
reviews.text: A special, welcoming hotel with excellent service! Special mention to the well-done work and politeness of Luis and Jeremy at the Ginger Bar and Rosanna and Yanira at the breakfast service. 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Sophie Dujon
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful lunch with excellent service. Thank you to Maria from Kanna restaurant (Palma Real) for her cheerfulness and efficiency.
A very enjoyable experience. Thank you!

reviews.author: Hermis Tolentino
reviews.text: I loved the experience; the room, the food, and the entertainment were all top-notch. I'd love to come back for a longer stay because the entertainment was 10/10, especially Carlos, the entertainment coordinator. He's a very attentive and charismatic young man.

reviews.author: Guillermo Ayuso Mustard
reviews.text: Highly recommend Sante restaurant. Excellent service. Superb food. Spectacular location. Congratulations to Enrique, José, and Francisco for making us feel so welcome!

reviews.author: Susie C
reviews.text: We spent a week in the Dominican Republic, and all I can say is that this hotel truly excels in customer service. Jensy, Rosmery, and Carlos went out of their way to make our experience spectacular. Jensy shared her knowledge of rum, Rosmery attended to our every need, and Carlos even taught us how to paint. It was a unique experience, and I can't wait to return to this hotel.

reviews.author: Andrea Rangel
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel with spectacular views and beach. Rocio's service at our breakfast made all the difference with her attentiveness and friendliness! We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Alberto Salvador Martin Gonzalez
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful. My concierge, Emmanuel, was perfect. It's the closest thing to paradise. I wouldn't know what to improve because everything was perfect. Now I'm debating whether to go back, to the Grand Cana, or to the one in Playa del Carmen with the kids.

reviews.author: Anna Valcarcel
reviews.text:
Antonia gave us the joy our trip deserved, VIP service, and she was always so friendly. We loved her!!!

Thank you, Antonia!!!!

reviews.author: PopoLGs
reviews.text:
Of all the restaurants, MINA is undoubtedly the best.

If you come to Paradisus Palma Real, MINA should be the first restaurant you try because you'll want to come back.

10/10 quality in both service and food.

Excellent service from Jean Carlos.

reviews.author: Silvia Luengo
reviews.text: Giancarlo was excellent! Great service! And Mina restaurant was also excellent! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Maximiliano Jiménez Gobantes
reviews.text:
Incredible hotel, top-notch staff, super friendly and caring with their guests. Super comfortable and spacious rooms.
Beautiful hotel grounds with large pools and ambient music in the courtyards. Delicious restaurants, coffee shop, and shops.

reviews.author: Thomas Castiello
reviews.text:
Luxury hotel!

Special mentions to Gilberto and Fabian.
Raúl, the doctor sends his regards from Argentina, my friend!

Honestly, I would return to this hotel without a doubt. The food, the service, everything was excellent, nothing to complain about.

Definitely an unforgettable experience, awesome!!!

reviews.author: Althea Pérez
reviews.text: Greivin is the best bartender in the entire hotel! He gave us excellent service and made our experience even better. His customer service is unmatched. We would definitely return!

reviews.author: BELEN SANZ TOLA
reviews.text:
Incredible vacation at a luxury resort, with countless thoughtful touches that make you feel pampered all day long.

It's impossible to get bored with so many activities, the food is delicious, and the themed restaurants are amazing.

We'll definitely be back!

reviews.author: CONSTANZA DIAZ AGUIRRE
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma Real hotel is very beautiful, always offering a variety of fun activities for all ages. The only drawback is that they don't cater to lactose allergies at breakfast. We went to the beach, which is beautiful and clean; the staff is always there, which I love. The Flora and Mascalzone restaurants were my two favorites, but this vacation wouldn't have been so incredible without the entertainment team. We've stayed at many hotels, but this one impressed us with the quality of its staff. We fell in love with the country and are definitely planning to return for another vacation at this beautiful hotel. Thanks to the people who made my vacation unforgettable, especially Carlos, Alfredo, and Johan, because they are a fantastic dance and entertainment team. We would love to return to the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel next time.

reviews.author: A E
reviews.text: The training team was excellent, always with a great attitude and committed to making sure everyone had a fantastic time. I especially want to highlight the service and attitude of Pollito and Fernando Chispa; their kindness, willingness, and positive attitude were the best.

reviews.author: Sara Feliciano
reviews.text:
Incredible stay, food, service, beach area, facilities… Spectacular and 100% recommended.

Thanks to our concierge, Harry, for his impeccable attention and service.

Thanks to Genessis for her helpfulness.

Rossana and Eddy's service at the main pool was outstanding.

Fernando was an excellent entertainer.

reviews.author: María Lizardi
reviews.text: My family and I recently stayed for four nights and were delighted with the hotel and the service. We especially want to thank Yaleidi for her attentiveness; she was always very helpful, and the team at Flora Restaurant, who were fantastic—the food was superb.

reviews.author: Santi Saltiva
reviews.text:
It's not just a great hotel with fantastic facilities and a unique beach; what truly sets it apart is the service and attention from each and every member of the staff.
I would definitely return, and I would definitely recommend it. A special mention for Andrés and Ángela, who pampered my granddaughter.
Thank you!!

reviews.author: Adri Pérez de Salazar
reviews.text:
The service here is incredible, everyone always has a smile.
The entertainment team is the best. They always create the best atmosphere. Jeile, Cooper, Jairo, Joan, Alfredo, and Fernando are the best. I hope to see them soon!
Jeison and Frank, the waiters who worked breakfast and dinner, were the most attentive and always looking for ways to help us with anything we needed. Julia at the pool bar in the rooms was also always attentive, trying to make sure we had the best day, as relaxed as possible, and always making us laugh.

We had a lot of issues with the air conditioning in our room. It wasn't working properly because we would set a temperature, but it wouldn't stay at the one we wanted; it would stay at the lowest setting. We told them to fix it, but then it wouldn't cool down, and they ignored us. One night we slept very hot, and in the end, we preferred to let it cool down and be cool rather than be hot.

I think they need to check the stock they have in the different bars, like the pool bar and the sports bar, because many times they told us they were out of Clamato or Aperol and we had to go look for it somewhere else, instead of them bringing more.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Sousa
reviews.text:
I stayed with my family from July 25, 2025 to August 1, 2025 and we had an excellent experience. We stayed in the Swim-up suite with the pool right outside the room and the children loved it, especially in the late afternoon when we returned and could have a little more fun while my wife started getting ready. Regarding the service, we had mixed experiences. There was a bit of a delay at check-in and the Expedia concierge (we booked through Hotels.com, which belongs to Expedia) wasn't very helpful, but the next day I replaced the service with concierge Guillermo, who completely changed this experience. Guillermo was extremely welcoming and always concerned about helping. He helped me prepare a surprise dinner on the beach to celebrate my daughter's birthday and became friends with my son, who was eager to see him every day, making our perception of the service much better from his interactions. In the end, he made a point of meeting our family at the hotel exit and even moved us as if we were saying goodbye to a long-time friend.

I also want to praise Wander from Kanna Bar, who was always fun and went out of his way to serve us well. For those visiting the hotel, I recommend looking for him and asking him to prepare a Rum Punch, which was a great suggestion from him, and I drank several during this week there.

As a tip for those traveling from Brazil, the direct GOL flight arrives and departs very late. At checkout at 12:00, I recommend looking for a late checkout and then reserving a room for a few hours until departure for the airport, in our case at 7:00 pm. They charge US$20.00/hour, but it's worth it to be able to have dinner and shower properly before going to the airport, which has few options for dinner.

ENGLISH:
I stayed with my family from July 25th to August 1st, 2025, and we had an excellent experience. We stayed in the Swim-up Suite, which had a pool right at the door of the room, and the children absolutely loved it—especially in the late afternoons when we returned and they could enjoy some extra fun while my wife started getting ready.

Regarding the service, we had mixed experiences. At check-in, there was a bit of a delay, and the Expedia concierge (we booked through Hotels.com, which is part of Expedia) was not very helpful. However, the next day, our experience changed completely thanks to concierge Guillermo. He was extremely welcoming and consistently attentive. He helped me organize a surprise dinner on the beach to celebrate my daughter’s birthday and became a friend to my son, who looked forward to seeing him every day. Guillermo’s interactions significantly improved our perception of the service. At the end of our stay, he made a point of saying goodbye to our family, and it was such a heartfelt moment that it felt like we were parting ways with a longtime friend.

Special mention also goes to Wander from the Kanna Bar, who was always cheerful and made a great effort to serve us well. For those visiting the hotel, I highly recommend asking him to prepare a Rum Punch—it was a fantastic suggestion, and I had several throughout the week.

A tip for travelers coming from Brazil: the direct GOL flight arrives and departs quite late. Since checkout is at 12:00 PM, I recommend arranging a late checkout and then booking a room for a few extra hours until your departure to the airport—in our case, at 7:00 PM. The hotel charges USD 20.00 per hour, but it’s worth it to be able to have dinner and shower properly before heading to the airport, which has limited dining options.

reviews.author: Maria Pena
reviews.text: The food is excellent. The service is top-notch; Roberto, the waiter, was very friendly and attentive, and all the staff were incredibly kind. And the food is superb... truly a 10/10... 300% recommended

reviews.author: Joice Giuliana Salas Hermoza
reviews.text: Antonia and Alberto's service was amazing! They made us feel wonderful! The 90 Degrees pool bar was unbeatable! Very attentive and friendly! The best mojitos ever 🤗

reviews.author: MIGUEL carricondo
reviews.text: As I wrap up my stay, from the main pool, I want to mention the friendliness of all the staff. Rosana at the pool treated us wonderfully the last two days, making our stay truly enjoyable. I also want to give a shout-out to Rosana at the restaurant for her friendliness, and finally, Jorge at the main pool bar, who makes the best piña coladas. The hotel was absolutely perfect. There are plenty of activities to keep you entertained, something for everyone, from adults to children. The food was excellent, especially the Mina (meat) and Blue Agave (Mexican). We stayed as a family. In short, a hotel we'd definitely return to.

reviews.author: Shuma B
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic experience at Blue Agave! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was outstanding. Melqui went above and beyond to accommodate dietary intolerances within our group, making sure everyone felt comfortable and well taken care of. His attentiveness and kindness really made our visit special. Thank you, Melqui—we truly appreciated your help!

We had a lovely experience at tokimeku asian restaurant. The Al carte menu was amazing & our host Romeris was very accomodating and lovely throughout our stay this week. She really catered us well at Sante Restaurant too.

Big shout out to our favourite staff - Norjandro! Always delighted to see him at breakfast & lunch at Sante restaurant. We loved his humor & kindness. Thank you!

Marcus at the pool bar was lovely - really good at making drinks!

reviews.author: Cindy Rivera
reviews.text:
Overall, we had a great trip! We did have a small situation with our room at the beginning of our stay, but the staff worked with us and helped make things better so we could still enjoy our vacation.

What truly made this trip memorable was the amazing staff. We especially want to recognize a few people who went above and beyond for us. Suleidy always took such great care of us at our favorite restaurants — keeping us well fed, our drinks full, and always greeting us with a smile. She was incredibly friendly and made every meal even more enjoyable.

At the main swim-up bar, Jonothan made our days so much fun! He remembered us by name and always made sure we were having an amazing time.

We also met Elvis during our trip, who helped us with our room situation and truly turned things around for us. His kindness and hospitality gave us an experience we’ll always remember ❤️

Thank you to everyone who helped make our stay special. We had an amazing time and made memories we’ll never forget!

reviews.author: Devon Lehmkuhl
reviews.text: Me and my partner enjoyed our short stay at Paradisus. The staff were very welcoming and made  the stay excellent. It’s very clean and many things to do. Breakfast at Sante was very good and Romeris was very attentive and took good care of us. Cristian and Yinesca were both our concierge and were always available to answer our questions and booking reservations at the resort restaurants with ease.

reviews.author: Sean Phelps
reviews.text:
Overall great experience. The rooms were above average, but when they made up the rooms they would sometimes give us new towels and sometimes not; unpredictable turn over service.
The workers were very friendly and took the effort to be friendly with me.
Punta Cana is a great place to relax for a week, beautiful location with lots of places to enjoy it!

reviews.author: Roddy M
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful. All of the workers were nice and approachable the entire stay. They were fluent in Spanish and English. There was 24/7 room service, however the wait was normally 35-55 mins. The restaurants were okay. We liked Blue Agave (Mexican) and Olio (Mediterranean) the most for their flavor. Overall, it was a calm beautiful relaxing honeymoon for us. Just wish the food was a little better. And I wish my husband didn’t make me fill out the review lol. Ciao!

reviews.author: Cristina Tina
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 – Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort

We had a really great experience at Paradisus Palma Real and it’s definitely the kind of resort where you have so many facilities and activities that you never feel the need to leave the property.

The hotel was very clean, and the WiFi was surprisingly amazing — it worked perfectly even on the beach, which is pretty rare for such a large resort. We also got a complimentary room upgrade, which made the start of our vacation even better 😊

The food was diverse and tasty: fish, seafood, sushi every day, lots of fresh fruit, and different meat options cooked to your preference.( thank you Edisson and Jimbert). The included drinks were also varied and good — wine, beer, Aperol Spritz, Cuba Libre, Margarita, Piña Colada, and more.

The resort is divided into 3 sections: adults only, family, and VIP, each with different wristbands and some restaurants/facilities with restricted access. There were a few places we couldn’t access depending on the bracelet category, but honestly we didn’t really feel limited because there were still plenty of restaurants, pools, and bars available to us.

The pools are a huge plus — basically every accommodation area has its own pool, plus one massive main pool. There’s always something happening and it’s impossible to get bored. They also have a coffee shop, sports bar, and live shows/concerts every evening

The beach was also beautiful, clean, and very well maintained, with gorgeous turquoise water and plenty of space to relax . The only downside was the slightly annoying “sunbed reservation culture” — many guests would leave towels or personal items on loungers very early in the morning to keep them occupied for hours, even when nobody was actually there.

Overall, a really good all-inclusive resort for relaxation, fun, and variety. Big like 👍

reviews.author: Melissa Smith
reviews.text:
Top notch service for an all-inclusive resort! The people they have working are excellent. They are very attentive and remember you from day to day. The beach and ocean are gorgeous. I love the adults only section, though some kids definitely trickled in and it dampened some of the experience....

The food in some of the restaurants is excellent, I would definitely talk to the customers and ask where they have had good meals! It makes all the difference!

I would definitely stay again and doing the adults only section is definitely worth it! Especially if you are looking for a break from kids, but wanting to stay on this side of Punta Cana.

(4 star for the room because they didn't always clean it fully when I asked. But otherwise the room was amazing!)

reviews.author: Brianna Szymanski
reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Paradise Palma Golf Resort. The rooms were clean, comfortable, and refreshed daily, which made a big difference throughout our trip.

We played a round of golf during our stay. The course was decent, not the best we have ever played, but still enjoyable. Where this place really stands out is the service. It was top notch across the board.

The food completely blew us away. There were quite a few restaurants to choose from every night and such a wide variety of options. Everything we had was delicious. The drinks were always great as well.

A special shoutout to Martin, our server on the beach. He was outstanding, always attentive and made sure we had a drink in hand without ever needing to ask. He truly elevated our experience.

Overall, we had an amazing trip and would absolutely come back. Thanks again, Martin.

reviews.author: Sogand Ajami
reviews.text:
Stayed for 7 nights ( First week of DEC 2025)

Great resort with amazing staff, but buffet needs improvement

Overall, my stay at the resort was perfect. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, and the entire property was very clean and well maintained. The à la carte restaurants were very good and offered great quality and service.

The only area that really needs improvement is the buffet. The quality of the buffet food was low, and most of the time it didn’t feel fresh. Items like ribs, pork, chicken, and fish were often cold, which was disappointing.

Recommendation:
It would be great if the resort added soft-drink fountains and self-serve coffee machines. This would reduce the pressure on servers and allow them to provide better, more attentive service. Guests could still order alcoholic and specialty drinks from the staff, while handling simple beverages themselves.

Overall, I enjoyed my stay and hope to see these improvements in the future.

reviews.author: Alek Karpoff
reviews.text:
I’m currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real and overall, the experience has been very positive. The beach is beautiful, with wide, comfortable sun chairs that make it easy to fully relax. The property itself is spacious and well-maintained, and the rooms are large and comfortable. The restaurants have been a highlight - both the food and service are very good - and I’ve been especially impressed by the quality of the bar service and the drinks. Overall, we’re having a great time.

That said, there are a few downsides. The buffet has been the biggest disappointment: the food quality at lunch and dinner is not on par with the rest of the resort, and the lack of service there is noticeable - you have to find your own table and chase down drinks, which takes away from the experience. Similarly, there’s no real service on the beach. While staff are present, they seem to focus on serving “VIP” guests, leaving others without attention.

Another issue is the number of local vendors on the beach. There are a lot of them, and they approach frequently - every few minutes - which can become quite disruptive. Some are loud, playing videos or calling out, which makes it harder to relax and enjoy the setting.

Despite these drawbacks, it’s still a very good vacation spot overall. The positives outweigh the negatives, and I would come back.

reviews.author: Nia Sciarretta
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time. The rooms were bright and airy and the pool (especially the adults only pool) was clear and pretty. But—the beach access was the clear highlight. Jeyson took such good care of us on the beach and made sure we were hydrated and happy without ever being pushy. Our only real complaint was that the food was adequate at best.

reviews.author: Blake Kimbrough
reviews.text: Wonderful stay here at a beachfront suite at the reserve. Bartender on the beach was especially great. Only issue was that we reserved a grand reserve suite ocean front suite but it was NOT in the adults only area as we were expecting. Literally had a DJ bumping tunes to a group of kids in the pool. The room may look good online in pictures, but I do not recommend the ocean front grand suites if you’re looking for a quiet, adults only getaway. Otherwise a fantastic spot; highly recommend reserve so your butler can arrange your itinerary/reservations etc.

reviews.author: McKenna Busateri
reviews.text: I got to stay here with my husband for 5 days for a work conference. The resort was beautiful and the reserve suite we stayed in was very nice with a luxury feel. The food was variable; our favorites were the Japanese and Italian restaurants. The bartenders were very friendly and made the trip! Beautiful, well-kept beach. We would return.

reviews.author: Merly Cramer
reviews.text: The Hotel is very nice, clean , modern and full of amenities. We paid for a bali bed in Kana beach wich is in front of the beach. We had Esmelin and Raysa as a servers. They were very nice and treat as like queens. Very attentive and helpfull. Their attitude was great. Highly recommended when you go to Kana beach. Herreique also was their manager. He was very sweet and helpful.

reviews.author: SHELLY RAY
reviews.text:
Overall, I had a fun and enjoyable stay. The room was comfortable, the resort was quiet and relaxing, offered different activities such as yoga, paddle fitness, and workshops. The customer service was beyond excellent and everyone was very helpful, especially Carlos Alberto, who communicated with us every day, gave a great tour and made us feel very welcome.
I’ll start with all the pros: We went during off season, so the resort was not too crowded, extremely quiet with few children, wait times were minimal and service staff was excellent. The resort is beautiful and massive, with several pools and direct beach access. There were several things to do, although I had many external excursions planned, I wish i had more time to enjoy resort events. I experienced the paddle fitness class which was so much fun-the instructor was funny and it was a nice group experience. The coffee making taller was another quick but enjoyable experience. The room was clean and comfortable, and met all my needs. All the restaurants and the lobby were located in the central plaza so it was easy to navigate around the resort. Next, the excursions offered were all very fun and transportation was included.
I felt that my experience was parallel to the price I paid. Getting the Reserve would not have been worth it.

Now for the cons: The major issue being the food. There was breakfast, lunch, and dinner buffet, several gourmet restaurant options but I would rate the quality and taste of the food as less than ideal. The taste of the various meats-chicken, salmon, steak mainly - were very bland. If they wanted to keep food bland its fine, but then they should offer different local condiments for guests who want more flavor. I have had authentic Dominican food and I was disappointed that there wasn’t anything tasty or authentic at the restaurant. Even the salmon lacked something as basic as salt. The restaurants were disappointing as well, there wasn’t any flavor or authenticity and the desserts tasted very cheap. There were only 3 options for ice cream-lemon, vanilla, coconut-and they all tasted the same. The cafe near the lobby had great drink options, but the pastries left on display had bugs flying around and made the food appear less than appealing. The best food I ate was outside the resort at a nearby restaurant, Citrus, though taking the major risk of going out into the city.
Next, the check in process took a little longer than expected, and after they activated my bracelet, it didnt work to open my room.
Also, there was live music every single day, but no singer. Only on Friday there was a live band which was the most enjoyable performance.
On our final day, we went for breakfast and it was completely packed. The service was understaffed and we had to ask for every thing like utensils, cups for coffee etc.

reviews.author: Al S
reviews.text: Only knock was food listed at al la cartel was not always available or not the same meat as described. Overall very relaxing. Yafreisy was amazing in the buffet and the older guy on the egg station mo ed fast!!!  Highly recommend hotel for relaxing vibes!

reviews.author: Tiffany
reviews.text:
We picked this resort for the beach and the location, and both were spectacular. Being only 30 minutes from the airport was a huge added bonus after our long travel day from CA. The water changes colors all day and is absolutely breathtaking.
​The Room: We didn't get our requested King bed, but we pushed two fulls together and the cleaning crew was kind enough to make it work for us (Wyoming King style!).
​The Staff: Great service across the board; our concierge was especially helpful.
​The Food: Lots of variety; some spots are better than others, so try a few different restaurants.

reviews.author: Thomas Garza
reviews.text:
Pools-awesome,  restaurants-meh,  buffet-ok, beach-outstanding service was good as long as you tipped. For excursions,  if you don't go to the first person you talk to, They get mad and blow up your phone.  Waiters and waitresses- every nice. The grounds were beautiful
Shows we're also good.

reviews.author: Warda Hagi
reviews.text: Everyone provided such amazing service, Roylin in the gift shop was very helpful, food was delicious, atmosphere was spectacular. I loved my experience here! The only critique I have is it was very difficult trying to get in contact with service on the phone, and when we were able to connect with someone to request something, they would not fulfill the request after agreeing.

reviews.author: noah de booij
reviews.text:
The hotel is very beautiful and very Well located only 30 minutes away from the airport.
We stayed for 10 days and had overall a very good expérience.
The highlight of it all was Martin. He took care of is everyday at the beach and made sure we always had our sunbeds ready. He is a gem!
Only thing that i would like to point out is the service in the restaurants that can be a lot better.

reviews.author: Olivia Thomas
reviews.text: Second time visiting this resort. The beach, pools, and resort in general are lovely! Food can range from good to okay, depending on what restaurant you go to. Some staff members can seem bothered by questions that are asked, which at time makes it uncomfortable. Overall, we enjoy our time at Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Sara Jones
reviews.text:
Delania provided excellent service by the pool every day of our trip. She remembered our drink orders, had great energy and made us feel welcome!

The buffet should have been refreshed more frequently and some of the restaurants were a bit disappointing. We loved our room and all of the pool bars. The service was excellent with everyone we encountered.

reviews.author: Latoya Cheves
reviews.text: Overall - Great place for a vacation. Staff are friendly. The compound is clean and has all amenities you’d want. The Italian food restaurant was Mui Buena

reviews.author: Daniel Johnson
reviews.text: I would compare it to a 4-star resort, not 5 star.  The service was inconsistent (About 75% great, 25% not), the food options at the different restaurants were pretty similar, and our initial check-in was not good.  We'd paid for the "Family Concierge, Swim up, 2 bedroom master suite." We were supposed to have a special check in area and quicker service, but when we arrived they seemed very confused.  Communication between the staff was poor.

reviews.author: Nicholas Campbell
reviews.text: Romeris and Rosanna absolutely fantastic to us while we there. The property has been great.  Dinner spots amazing and plentiful. Buffet consistent, but not all food is hot both buffet and restaurants. House keeping does well.  I called for maintenance and they never came, something minor thankfully. Activities great!

reviews.author: Karina Escobar
reviews.text:
Upon our arrival, we were greeted with a warm and friendly welcome. Your concierge, Guillermo, provided exceptional service throughout our stay and made us feel truly taken care of.

Our first room was amazing and exceeded our expectations. Unfortunately, we experienced a leak, and although the issue took four days to resolve, the staff eventually moved us to a different room.

The second room was comfortable and well‑maintained, but the oceanfront view was not the same as what we originally had. While we appreciated the accommodation, we did miss the quality of the view from our first room.

reviews.author: Michael Messinger
reviews.text:
First, the cons: The front desk personnel and check in experience was terrible. We really struggled to speak English with 3 different front desk people. The room we booked with a king bed wasn’t available and we received no compensation other than the option to pay to upgrade the following day if we came back after 5pm. Also, they didn’t tell us anything about the resort or amenities other than circling our room on the map, saying very quickly where the restaurants were, and good luck. So day 1 and day 2 started off really poorly. We felt we were bothering the staff trying to figure out the essentials. Then you walk out to the beach and notice it’s not very full… well the main beach has cabanas and beds that are private and cost $250/day for the Kanna club which no one even mentioned during check in. However, we spent the money, and it honestly saved the trip. It was the best service and experience we could have had. The ladies there were amazing and highly recommend. The pools need more beds if you want to spend a day there and are first come first serve. They ran out of towels and when asking the front desk how we could get a couple for our family, they just say sorry we can’t help you. Lastly, the concierge was hit or miss. They text you on WhatsApp which is nice but felt nervous we would miss out on dinner because it was either last minute or not able to send us confirmation. He did help us exchange money and with some reservations so not all bad. Apparently there is a water park off the main resort which they didn’t tell us but costs over $100/person per day.

Now, the pros… the resort was squeaky clean and elegant. The pools were very nice (although very cold). Restaurant food was very good but the buffet wasn’t great. Rooms were very nice and clean as well. We did have a cockroach next to the bed one night but that was the only issue. It was so clean and tidy throughout the resort we could overlook it. Overall the staff was nice but clearly they work for tips and expect it if they are going to help you. We did not get a chance to play golf or tennis which seemed really nice.

Pro tips:
- Spend a little more and rent the large cabanas and tip the ladies well.
- Bring lots of $5 bills. They will change your experience dramatically. The staff will go out of their way and remember you. Don’t bring 20s or higher thinking you can easily get change at the front desk. They will look annoyed and tell you sorry good luck.

reviews.author: Grace Smith
reviews.text: While the food in the restaurant was average, Yafreisy was an amazing server in the lunch Box buffet restaurant. She was very attentive and friendly.

reviews.author: Anastasiya Vardin
reviews.text:
As far as all-inclusives go, I'd give this resort a solid 4 out of 5. Here are my thoughts, broken down by category.

Family Friendliness: I would not strongly recommend this resort for families with young children. I traveled with a 1.5-year-old and felt there simply weren't enough activities for kids during the day or in the evening. The kids' club mainly accommodates children ages 3 and up, and you're required to leave your child there — something I wasn't yet comfortable doing with a toddler. There's also no water park or splash area; just your standard adult pools. This resort is better tailored for couples and adults.

Food: The quality of the food was generally great, though the buffet selection was identical from day to day. The seafood was the standout — the resort offered a wonderfully diverse selection of fish, octopus, sushi, and calamari. The meats were also excellent and well-prepared, with impressive variety including goat, beef, lamb, and chicken. The weak spot was the fried food, which was often lukewarm and stale, as if it had been sitting out too long.
We dined at three of the à la carte restaurants: Flora (Dominican), Agave (Mexican), and the Hibachi. The biggest surprise was Agave — the food was incredible. Flora, which is supposedly the crown jewel of the resort as it's owned by a famous chef, was actually the most disappointing. The service was poor and the food was just okay. We tried the goat and the beef; while the meat itself was well-prepared, the sides were embarrassingly sparse. My "salad" consisted of a few pieces of iceberg lettuce and two cherry tomatoes cut in half with no dressing — it looked like something you'd get at Taco Bell.

Drinks: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real (not the Circle Club, Kanna Club, or the Reserve), which meant none of the top-shelf liquor was available to us. This was one of the most disappointing aspects of our stay. For the price we paid, I expected access to better-quality spirits, especially when some other all-inclusives in the area include them. The cocktail variety across the resort also felt limited. The only bar that impressed me was Rum Republic, where they garnished my drink with a smoked cinnamon stick — it's little touches like that that I appreciate.

Room: We opted for the junior suite to have some separation between us and the crib, and the room itself was fantastic. The layout was well thought out, the soaking tub was huge and deep, and the mattress and down pillows were incredibly comfortable. My one major complaint: the room's eco-friendly motion sensors. In the middle of the night, the baby monitor and AC would shut off when no motion was detected, forcing me to get up multiple times to turn everything back on. That was extremely frustrating.

Final Thoughts: I wished the overall service had been friendlier. Many staff members didn't seem as warm or accommodating as what I've experienced at other resorts. The resort also doesn't have a single jacuzzi, which was a letdown — we had a few rainy, cooler days where one would have been perfect. Even the spa lacked saunas, pools, or hot tubs. When it comes to value for the money, I believe there are other resorts in the area that offer the same experience, or more, at a lower price.

reviews.author: Andy Terzyan
reviews.text:
Definitely one of our better vacations. First the good and then the bad: The hotel itself was great and a lot of areas had been newly remodeled. Pool was great, drinks were not watered down. The resort is right on the beach and has a dedicated area with sun-beds. Food overall wasn’t bad but they definitely need more consistency. I’ve learned to not trust dairy products outside of the US…

Now for the bad. Vendors are pretty annoying and aggressive. They will approach you every couple of minutes on the beach… the hotel needs to put an end to this. Tips are expected TO GET decent service, not the other way around. You’re not tipping because they were attentive and took care of you, you’re tipping to get decent service. The performances on the property in the evenings were hit and miss but mostly enjoyable. The construction was pretty annoying and in certain parts of the hotel you could smell a strong acetone smell and the dust particles from the sawing. Also, when we arrived our luggage was a few days late and upon talking with one of the front desk employees, they arranged for us to be taken to a local store to get some essentials. The store was a small gift shop and had nothing of value and wasted a few hours of time. Everyone is just trying to make a buck off tips and will do anything to cut deals with friends or people on the outside to make a couple extra bucks.

With all that being said, it was worth it and wouldn’t hesitate to come back again. Just needs a little touching up from management.

reviews.author: Monique Plouffe
reviews.text:
Exceptionnal services from Antonia on the beach.  She is a kindness person.

At the Lunch Box, Jeason and Edisson made everything to make you happy.

reviews.author: Andrea Rubino
reviews.text:
Arisleida at 34 degrees (Paradisus Palma Real) was fantastic. She was so personable and attentive to us. We enjoyed spending everyday seeing her smiling face.
Thanks for a great experience!

reviews.author: Owen Bernstein
reviews.text: Wilmina was a fantastic server. Food came very quickly and always had an eye on our empty glasses. Food was better than other restaurants on the resort so highly recommend.

reviews.author: Vaishali Dixit
reviews.text: Excellent service at all restaurants, cafes and especially the buffet. Rosanna, yanira and Maria were great hostesses. However the food taste was not that great, perhaps reduce variety and quantity and focus on taste.

reviews.author: Julia Grama
reviews.text: The Italian resturant Mezcalzone was nice. Alexandra was kind and took good care of us. Food was average

reviews.author: luis mercado
reviews.text: We had dinner at Blue Agave and our server Melqui was excellent. Even though he was busy he always made sure to check on us and also made some good meal recommendations.

reviews.author: JT Tanner
reviews.text: Large resort plenty of pool options. Restaurants were good quality food. Staff is very friendly and helpful.  Lady’s at the coffee shop are always pleasant.

reviews.author: Alykhan Jaffer
reviews.text: Amazing stay at Paradisus Palma Real! Great beach, pool, entertainment and a la carte restaurants. Arisleida made the poolside super relaxing and kept the drinks coming.

reviews.author: Kelley Shaw
reviews.text: Had dinner at Mina’s with great food and service.  John-Carlos was amazing, very attentive and provided great service!

reviews.author: Chris Daleney
reviews.text:
Antonio at knana was great  food was great there
Steak house was great food but a bit of a wait
Other then that
Drinks are good
Locations even better

reviews.author: Karen W
reviews.text:
We had to change rooms three times. Our first room was modern nice ocean view unfortunately it had plumbing issue after reporting the issue on several occasion we were moved to a ocean front room however this room was only partially renovated closet door hanging off the hinge also had a plumbing issue.  This room was Nothing like the modern room we had.
Finally  we were moved  to  the Adult only area the room and view was beautiful.

The Hotel common areas are nice beautiful beach and pool area

Agave Restaurant food was good

Buffets were just ok.

Housekeeping Service for towels needs some improvement it takes forever to get towels

It was unfortunate that we spent a-lot of  our vacation time changing rooms however I like to Thank Karen at the Front desk for her assistance.
Thank You  to Antione from Guest Services he  showed exceptional customer service once he was informed of the our issues.

reviews.author: Martin Harris
reviews.text: Amazing resort, especially with the Reserve upgrade. Good service, especially at the beach - thanks for taking such good care of us Rafael!

reviews.author: Ricardo Talbot
reviews.text:
Outstanding, no doubt. However, the privileges and extra benefits linked to the "Reserve" section are not worth the money. For instance, "late checkout" means 1PM... Not really convenient when your flight leaves at 10PM 😉.

Still, a great experience... Will repeat... Just not in the Reserve 😉.

reviews.author: Lorena Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Flora restaurant was great!
Melina provided great recommendations and service with a smile.

reviews.author: Angela Carroll
reviews.text:
Cons:  bottled waters are never cold! you have to ask for ice every time!   room fridge not very cold.  restaurant portion sizes are very small except for hybachi and steak house.  Deserts are very small as well.   We had teenage boys and it was not enough food for them.   Not much alcohol in mixed drinks.  better off ordering cans.  Needs a bigger sports bar area - it was way too small.  No night club to hang out in.  We  went in July and beach had a lot of seaweed.  we never went in the water - very disappointing.  they were cleaning it up but it remained murky at the shoreline.  Some buffet food is sitting out and it's so hot there I wound't bother to eat certain things if you don't get there early enough.  most staff speaks english but some are very hard to understand.  we all had upset stomachs but never drank the water!

Pros:  Staff very friendly and helpful, some hard to understand.  Neat and clean beautiful resort.  Excellent entertainment at night!  Alot of fun!  Food was fairly good but didn't care for a few things.  buffet has a large selection.  Best food was hybachi,  steak house and italian (small portions tho). didn't care for mexican restaurant.  large beautiful pools.  Had to get a spot early at main pool.  beach has tons of spots with shade.

reviews.author: Joseph Allen
reviews.text:
Palma real is the 2nd paradisus resort we have stayed at and they have both been wonderful. The drinks are well mixed (Raul and Dany at the Circle/ClubMelia pool are excellent!) and the food at the buffet is, for the most part, fresh and plentiful (Yafreisy and George Vargas took great care of us each morning for our group of 9). Every morning Geraldo at the omelette bar remembed my daughters order and had already started it before she walked up, she loved it! Our two younger kids loved the people who worked at Kidsdom (my kids were sad to say goodbye to Joanna) Lastly our concierge Ariel made sure we had dinner each night.

The pool is beautiful and the resort itself is always clean.

Would highly recommended

reviews.author: Lianne Weatherup
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, make sure you get your restaurant reservations made asap, they book up fast and a 9pm dinner with kids is tough. But the food is good, the staff is very friendly! Lots of activities for adults as well, but you need to pay attention to the schedule because it isn’t advertised very well! The Dominican night festivities was a real highlight! Martha, Joanna, and Susu were so great with the kids! However the nightly entertainment is loud and goes until 11pm so getting to sleep before that is challenging. You can also hear the tv’s from neighbouring rooms so definitely bring ear plugs.

reviews.author: Katharine Pichardo-Erskine
reviews.text: Such a great stay for the entire family! The RESERVE adults only experience is exclusive. Jendry, our concierge, was super attentive and ensured we had an amazing time. The regular rooms are well-appointed too and we had activities for both young and old. The service all around was great. Yiri at the sports bar went out of her way to make us feel special. The food was delicious and plentiful in every restaurant. A great experience all around!

reviews.author: Marcie Shaffer
reviews.text: Julia and Edison at the pool 36 degrees bar are awesome. Big shout out and many thanks.  The maid/mini bar service was hit or miss.  They didn't refill the coffee/creamer/beer/water unless we called. The food was excellent in both the restaurants and room. Unfortunately we woke up 3 mornings in a row with no air conditioning. Some days it was fixed in the afternoon and other days not till night. Overall it was a good, relaxing vacation and we will be back. We love how quiet and less crowded it is here.

reviews.author: Betty Jeb
reviews.text:
Our children had such a great time – the activities were engaging, the environment was safe and welcoming, and it gave us peace of mind to know they were in such good hands.

A special shoutout to Alexandria, who went above and beyond while babysitting our kids. She was warm, attentive, and truly connected with them. They couldn’t stop talking about how much fun they had with her! Thank you for making our vacation even more relaxing and enjoyable.

Highly recommend the Kids Club to any families staying here!

reviews.author: Mark J
reviews.text: Excellent service by all staff. We stayed in the Reserve section. Definitely worth the upgrade. Jendrey was our concierge. He was very helpful and gave good recommendations. Rafael was our beach attendant. Excellent service and very attentive.

reviews.author: Courtney Bennett
reviews.text:
Starlin at Flora redeemed the trip. Other items need improvement but food and service at Flora were fantastic thanks to Starlin!

Fior at the Kicks Sports Bar was the best bartender we had the whole trip, she made every drink exceptional and made our stay great.

reviews.author: Yokarina Duarte
reviews.text:
The only aspect that fell short of expectations was the food. Considering the price, I anticipated a more diverse and higher-quality menu selection.

Overall out experience at this venue was outstanding. The facility was well-maintained, clean.

Andres at the front desk went above and beyond to assist us, ensuring that our dinner service was seamless. At the Flor Restaurant, Starlin and Cesar were exceptional, accommodating all of our food requests with professionalism and attentiveness.

Overall, the venue was top-notch, and the service team exceeded expectations.

reviews.author: Christopher Barker
reviews.text: Rafael and Johan at the reserve pool made the whole stay. They took great care of us and constantly went out of their way to make sure we were taken care of. They made the whole experience for us.

reviews.author: Jon McIver
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was a delightful experience, largely thanks to our fantastic concierge, Emmanuel. From the moment we arrived, Emmanuel was attentive, friendly, and incredibly helpful in making our stay memorable.

The excursions were a highlight of our trip. We had an amazing time at Scape Park, where we explored natural wonders and enjoyed thrilling activities. The 3-hour catamaran trip was equally enjoyable, offering beautiful views and a relaxing atmosphere on the water.

While the breakfast and lunch options were satisfactory, the dinner restaurants truly stood out. The variety and quality of the meals in the evening were impressive, providing a wonderful culinary experience each night.

For families, there are plenty of activities to keep kids entertained. Our children had a great time with the various programs and events designed just for them.

The staff at Paradisus Palma Real were consistently nice and made us feel welcome throughout our stay. While the service was generally good, it did vary at times, but overall, we were pleased with the level of attention and care provided.

In summary, Paradisus Palma Real offers a wonderful vacation experience, especially with the help of a great concierge like Emmanuel, exciting excursions, delicious dinners, and enjoyable activities for kids. We look forward to returning in the future.

reviews.author: Andrea Lorenzo
reviews.text: We had a lovely time at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana. We started off in the main adults-only hotel. When a series of things went wrong, we were moved to The Reserve - it was excellent after that. Great service and set up at the pool, lovely staff at Sante including Enrique, Rosa, and Gustavo, among others. I would recommend being at The Reserve.

reviews.author: Sunil Chatlani
reviews.text:
We overall had a good stay. I think staying Christmas week, they weren’t prepared for all the people. We were not able to get reservations at some of the restaurants even though we gave two days notice. My parents stayed at the adults only with a concierge and were treated with more priority. Us having two kids, we were not provided that option.

We really appreciated the Kidsdom. They took great care of my children and were open 10am-10pm. The flexibility of dropping them whenever was excellent and I could not rave about this more. Jesus and Alexandria there made the experience for my kids excellent.

Overall, I am unsure if we would return. I got food poisoning the last day. The rest of the family was fortunately okay.

reviews.author: Gregory Carpenter
reviews.text:
I am leaving my original posting below the line for reference. We had a few individuals who made our stay substantially better; it is my hope that Melia management can read this and know these individuals were a substantial reason we had a positive experience. First was Betzi. He was great at helping solve some of the restaurant reservation struggles we had on our visit. Though the technology issues we encountered persisted, he at least got us in front of the Customer Service Manager and we at least we felt heard.

The second individual was Yuderqui (aka Judy). Judy waited on us at the buffet a number of times and really should be a walking icon of customer service. Our first interaction, she pushed me to practice my Spanish and was equally interested in expanding her English skills. It feels odd to say, but we felt cared for and safe with Judy. Multiple times we saw people having conversations with her and found many of us had a great fondness of her way of interacting with us. Others in this area were similar, in my experience Judy was just above and beyond. Generally I do not like many people (it is just a me thing), but I found myself having some tears over saying goodbye.

I still feel the restaurant reservation system and technology needs fixed; however this was definitely a top vacation for us. I raised this to a four star review from three really because the employees we interacted with the most went above and beyond to make our visit better. Judy and Betzi stand out by name, but there are others from the bartenders to other staff at the buffet who work hard not only to get the job done, but make you feel a touch special.
_______________
I am really struggling with this review. We generally love the resort. Our room (5016) and pool access is fantastic! The cleanliness and staff attentiveness is generally fantastic as well. However we have had smaller issues that are compounding and leaving a sour taste with two days left in our trip.

The first is the technology which is poor on a number of fronts. A couple examples, the app on my phone recognizes we are checked in and reflects the room number, however will not allow access to any menus or application capabilities while onsite. I just keep getting popup errors. So my wife tried to order room service via a phone in the room, and the people on the other end neither knew where we were calling from nor could recognize where we were located when we told them. This is not a deal breaker, but frustrating at best and so room service has been unusable for us.

The bigger challenge we have had is that restaurant reservations seem impossible to make. People seem to figure it out, but we have gotten the runaround since arriving on Tuesday. We finally had reservations last night with a reservation card; however when the card was issued they listed the wrong room number (5106 instead of 5016) and since it did not match our actual room number they would not let us in. The buffet is fine, but we spent about $4000 for five nights and have only the buffet to show for it.

This morning I hit a breaking point when seated in a corner at the buffet. I finally grabbed my daughter and just relocated ourselves to a better table with a view. It stinks being a jerk, but I feel a bit stepped on and used in the dining situation for the amount of money spent on this trip. The buffet wait staff are good and this doesn't reflect on them. They tried to make it right, I just feel pushed around a bit and they received the brunt of the restaurant reservation system. The individuals taking reservations have been unhelpful and unempathetic to the situation. There is definitely a service shortfall in this area.

Without fixing those basics I can't see recommending the Paradisus Palma Real. As a luxury resort, those are not issues guests should experience. I will update this after our trip, but as of right now am not as happy as I expect at the price point.

reviews.author: Soheil Maroufi
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Palma Real from July 26–31 with our small dog. While the hotel grounds were beautiful and the restaurant staff were friendly and professional, our overall experience was disappointing due to poor communication and rude behavior from management.

The website clearly states that bringing a dog costs $120 USD per night and includes services like food, treats, and bowls. Despite staff seeing our dog from day one, no one mentioned the charge or services until day 3, when I was suddenly asked to pay the full amount. I paid in full, but we still didn’t receive any of the promised services.

When I spoke to the supervisor (Rafelin), he was extremely rude, accused me of hiding the dog (which was clearly untrue), and dismissed our complaint by saying, “At least your dog drank water here.” We only received pet services for the last two nights, even though we paid for five.

Thankfully, the restaurant and cleaning staff helped make up for the frustration, and the buffet food was excellent.

⸻

Dear [Hotel Management / Guest Services],

I am writing to express my deep dissatisfaction with the pet services provided during my recent stay at your hotel.

I was charged for six nights for bringing my dog, yet I only received pet services for two days. This is extremely disappointing and unacceptable. I believe your team should be aware that your guests travel from all around the world to stay at your hotel, and in most other countries, customer service and client satisfaction are treated with much more care and professionalism.

Whenever I travel with my family, I always make sure to choose hotels that are pet-friendly. Unfortunately, my experience at your property was the worst I’ve ever had in terms of pet accommodation and service.

I had truly hoped to recommend your hotel chain to my friends, clients, and business partners in Canada, the United States, and Iran, but after this experience, I am certain that I will no longer do so.

I kindly ask you to review this matter seriously and take appropriate action. At the very least, I believe a partial refund for the unused pet services would be fair.

reviews.author: Marcus Ewell
reviews.text: The resort was beautiful, and I had an amazing experience. The food was great, and the people were friendly. However, the room was okay, but the bathtub was leaking. I almost slipped on the wet floor, and it wasn’t fixed throughout my stay. Despite this minor issue, I would still recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Bibi Shifrin
reviews.text:
Amazing staff that will never be forgotten. They made up for anything that was not 5 star!
Special mention to Jose Sedeño, Angelo, Jeffrey, Jonathan at pool bar, Jason at buffet and Jorge pool bar and Virtudes who made the anniversary celebration a blast! Mr Guillermo was very kind and helpful.
Main pool in need of restoration before our return in 2026!

reviews.author: Craig Ticchi
reviews.text: Alberto was the best bartender in the resort! He took care of my entire family for a whole week, waited on us and was very courteous and accommodating. 10/10.

reviews.author: Chris Nuzzi
reviews.text:
My wife and I visited this resort with our 18-month old for a long weekend. Overall we were extremely pleased with our stay however we did come away with a few qualms.

What we enjoyed...
The resort itself is beautiful and the beach is equally fantastic. They take great care of the beach to ensure there's no trash and there was plenty of seating available. We stayed in a swim-up suit. The room was spacious, updated, and great positioning and access to the pool. There was pool service for drinks, but they didn't come around very often. The food was tasty and lots of options available at the buffet. The staff were also super friendly and went out of their way to accommodate us in every way possible.

What we didn't like...
- Our child eats lunch at 11:30, no restaurants were open at that point to serve lunch so we ended up having to order room service. The food was good, but it was a little disappointing that we couldn't eat at the buffet.
- The reservation system for on-site restaurants is limited and not accurate. It's very hard to get reservations for specific times. For example, we got a reservation to the mexican restaurant for 7:30pm when we wanted one for 6pm (again that's when our child has to eat before going to bed). We were told to just take the reservation and we could show up early to the restaurant and they could get us in. We showed up and there were only 3 other parties in the restaurant. They did seat us, but there were tons of empty tables, so we're not sure why they didn't have any reservations for the initial timeslot we wanted.
- When at the beach, no one came around to ask us for drinks. It seemed like it was only for Circle members. We also couldn't find a close place to get extra towels. Overall it was an inconvenience, but not a deal breaker.

reviews.author: Yessenia Franco
reviews.text: The service has been attentive and the rooms are beautiful. The food can be improved. The activities staff have been the best! Jholfry, Fernando and Jairo have made our vacation super fun and made sure we stayed active.

reviews.author: Food For Thought
reviews.text:
Everything at our stay in July was very nice. The resort, the food, the rooms and the service. Our only complaint was the beach
As beautiful as it is it Not a private beach for the resort. It’s a public beach. Meaning locals who are not staying at the beach have access to it. This we found to be very, very annoying. As soon as we got on the beach the first day we were hounded constantly to buy things, to have foot massages and to have hair braids put in
Even just have locals begging for money
I’d thought maybe the resort would try to do something about it but said they couldn’t. Anyway with that said we won’t be back since we can’t tolerate the public beach

reviews.author: Doris Mclean
reviews.text: Great location and beach. Beautiful hotel and we enjoyed the beautiful weather

reviews.author: T Moi
reviews.text: well appointed hotel within a very large complex. Staff is very friendly and helpful during our stay.

reviews.author: Dee Mills
reviews.text: We had a fabulous stay! The rooms were beautiful & well laid out! Ariel Benzo was our concierge for the week! He was amazing!
