He answered any questions we had promptly and  was very helpful with anything we needed! Fior at Kicks the sports bar looked after us exceptionally well every night! She was friendly, and quick and made our week there memorable!! There were a few hick ups but we were a group of 50 arriving and joining 10 that were already there for a wedding! But the wedding ceremony and reception was beautifully done! Will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Angel D
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real this past week and had a wonderful time. The grounds, property and rooms are beautiful and the restaurants had pretty decent food, but I think the buffet could have been a bit better, especially for breakfast. The service, however, was excellent, and it was the staff that really made it a 5-star experience for us. Cristian was our concierge and he was extremely helpful with setting up the hard to get dinner reservations and making sure we had what we needed. Ely was very helpful as well, and was always willing to step in when needed. But my favorite person of the entire stay was my new friend Elidania, who was so kind and sweet and treated us like family. She made excellent mimosas and cocktails, and even let us sample her own special mamajuana recipe! If I could do it again, I would upgrade to the Reserve- adults only area to take advantage of those amenities and exclusive restaurants, but all in all it was a really great time!

reviews.author: Damien Druce
reviews.text: Marileisy and Teófilo at the Palma Real Reserve Pool were so attentive whilst we were there. All done with a smile on their faces, look for these two beautiful human beings if you visit.

reviews.author: Paige Todd
reviews.text: Currently, on the last day of a 4 night family vacation with children 12 and 6. The location, our room (ocean front suite) and the hotel in general is absolutely gorgeous. The atmosphere is very relaxing and it has not been crowded at all. However, this is not a 5 star resort experience at all. The music tonight for what I assume is some type of event is so loud we can not go to sleep. The vendors on the beach did not bother us too much and were nice,  but you should expect to be approached multiple times throughout your stay. We  stayed in the room that provided a concierge and we were not impressed. We received reservations for dining every night; however it took multiple messages and all the reservations were later than requested. The food at the buffet for breakfast was okay but I would recommend staying away for lunch. If you are not able to obtain dinner reservations, you will be disappointed. The food was mediocre at best at all of the places we went for dinner including the steakhouse, Asian, Mexican and Italian. Other than the food, everything else was okay. I would return again with my husband but likely not for a family vacation as there is not much to do with children. If you are looking for a decent get away with gorgeous beaches, this resort is it! If you want a 5 star experience, this is not the resort!

reviews.author: Ben Andrea Vidiella
reviews.text: Ron Republic is one of the best bar in the hotel with Miguel and Melvin! Ask for them… they make the best drinks… espresso martini and Sin Nombre w Legenda

reviews.author: Moses K Tawose
reviews.text: It lives up to its name heaven on earth with all activities fully manned and its security is top notch. It's an awesome place to rejuvenate and comes back fully refreshed with a new energy. Words isn't enough to tells all.

reviews.author: Lesley Falconer
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant was a wonderful atmosphere with delicious cuisine authentic to DR! Paradisus Palma Real is a beautiful resort with elegance and charm, and great service.  I would have preferred to have known about upgrading to the concierge service before arriving.  This cause us to have issues booking reservations in the restaurants while we were here.

reviews.author: Fraol Abebe
reviews.text:
We had a great experience at this resort. The staff was amazing and attentive especially at the flora restaurant inside the resort. They were very welcoming and friendly. The hostess Ana and the waiter Vladimir were extremely sweet and professional. They are an example of great customer service.

Also, Special thank you to Lennison and Jimmy for their attentive and curious customer service when we arrived and leave. They were very welcoming and happy to assist us. They made us feel very special and treated us with so much love. I love it 🥰 ❤️

reviews.author: Leila Lopez
reviews.text: The view was absolutely amazing, and the rooms were beautiful. Most of the service was excellent and accommodating. I had a great time with my family overall. I did have trouble with a marijuana smell in my room that kept coming back everyday. I do not smoke and it was definitely concerning to me. However, every time I called room service, they did a great job getting the smell out of the room. There was also trouble with making reservations at the restaurants. It was a little troubling because my family spent a lot of money to come to this resort and there were a few times were a simple ‘no’ was given instead of a solution. Luckily, the hostesses at the restaurants were very helpful. It was just a little frustrating seeing that we spent money as club members and were not always a priority. Despite this, most other experiences with the staff were very pleasant. The whole time, we had maybe one rude waiter, but again, the rest of the staff was absolutely amazing.

reviews.author: Finne Verstraeten
reviews.text: I had a wonderfull time at this beautifull resort with my friends. We would definitely recommend The Reserve. We would also like to thank Reynaldo aswell for his excellent service. He always welcomed us with a smile and made sure that everything was in order. We will be back very soon!

reviews.author: CyNaa Mitchell
reviews.text: If you stay here try The Nina Restaurant, it was amazing from the food to the service. Our server Reynaldo did a great job with our table making sure our food came out on time. Plus we had a big party of 12. They even surprised us with a cake and birthday song making the night extra special for my birthday.

reviews.author: Amber Morgan
reviews.text: We are at the tail end of our Mother/Daughter birthday trip to the DR. We had a great time. The rooms were trendy and updated and the facility was quite beautiful. Overall we had an excellent time and my 6 year old said it was the best trip ever! I did mark down on the service because we missed our concierge for the first day and were unable to get dinner reservations. The restaurants are delicious and unfortunately the buffet just could not compare.

reviews.author: Nesma Ansari
reviews.text:
Overall we had a great time at the resort. We were here for 5 nights and the location is perfect. Right on the beach with lots of pools around. Our personal concierge, Luis Cadet was amazing and always at our service. He was very helpful and made sure all our reservations for dinner and anything else we needed was all done!
I would recommend that there are more food options to cater to different people. We ate at Flora which was amazing; however, Mina steakhouse was a disappointment. Also the room service takes a long time to deliver so would recommend to speed that up.

reviews.author: Irene Canas
reviews.text: Great spot for vacation, service is amazing. Angelo in the beach treated us very nicely and was at his service for everything. The only thing is i recome eating at the restaurants. Personally i was not a fan of the buffet.

reviews.author: John D'Aversa
reviews.text:
The waiter was phenomenal. Bernarde thank you for the rest service
He was very attentive.
The meals were better than average.
And they came quickly.
Anyone staying at Paridisus in Punta Cana should plan to eat here.
Ginger bar is an excellent place for great coffee in the morning and even better drinks in the evening. The staff was ready to serve and make our drinks very quickly and tasty.
Luis, Antony, Ismael, Dominga, Olga.
I think they are all terrific

reviews.author: Shyla Rivera
reviews.text: I went to La Flora restaurant with my husband. It had a very nice ambiance. If you are looking for a traditional Dominican meal, this is not the place. However, they do put a creative spin on many Dominican dishes, making it seem more high end. The wait staff was lovely and I would recommend giving it a try!

reviews.author: Rachel Parent
reviews.text: Do not go unless you buy all of the upgrades.  Event then, you can do better at this price point. Resort is practically empty and cannot get a dinner reservation.  Food at the buffet is barely edible and staff cannot be bothered.  Room is in disrepair.  There was a fight outside of my room at 2 AM and nobody answered the phone to come break it up.

reviews.author: Elena Favorido
reviews.text:
Beautiful facility overall, pools, beach access, restaurants. The highlight of our vacation was the activities' team and the many activities offered. Big shout out to Soranyi, Carlito, Freilyn, Jholfry and Jairo, great energy! The Dominican night was fun, but prepare to negotiate the prices if you plan to buy any souvenir..
Our room wasn't ready at the time of check-in and when we finally got in, there were still the ladies finishing up the beds. Some details were not on point for a 5 star resort, like a broken toilet seat, reading lamps not working, the safe buttons needed to be pushed super hard, the cleaning could be improved, the door had a gap and you could see the light and hear every noise from outside. We had to call the room service a few times as they missed stuff, like they took the shower mat and didn't replace it, or the tissues box was empty and didn't refill.. The staff would just randomly barge in the room for cleaning without knocking or ringing the bell.
Some of the waiters could use a smile, especially at the buffet, not impressed with the service. The food was good at the restaurants a la cart, but even with the rsvp we had long waiting time and missed a couple of night shows because of that. Lot of variety at the buffet but after sitting at room temperature for a while, some food didn't look safe to eat, like sushi, cheese and even fruit.

reviews.author: Tyra Warner
reviews.text: Had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Kevin Fernandez, our concierge, was quick to offer assistance regarding anything we needed. He even picked up distilled water for my CPAP machine when there was none available on property. The adults-only pool was relaxing. The beach was beautiful and the water turquoise although rough because of the season. I didn’t enjoy all the people selling things on the beach, although they weren’t persistent and took “no” as an answer very gracefully. Blue Agave was our favorite restaurant. We also tried Flora and the Mediterranean restaurant. I ate breakfast and lunch in the Lunch Box, the buffet. It was okay.  Lots of choices but food and service quality were 4-star, not 5. Hence the rating.  On my last morning, one of the servers accidentally broke a glass and 20 minutes later when I left, it still wasn’t cleaned up. Seemed dangerous. Overall a good, low-key relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: Davin Lawton-Bryce
reviews.text: Hotel was really nice. Swim up room worked really well, and the pool connected to the main pool. Would say the rooms were a little dated. Staff were lovely but could have been a little more attentive at times. Stuff for the kids to do, but wouldn't say it a main focus for the hotel. But nothing to detract from the experience. Would recommend

reviews.author: Roger Geng
reviews.text:
Overall a great experience here definitely recommended. The beach and swimming pool were literally a 2 min walk from our room that made it absolutely amazing. The staff here were very friendly especially Ernesto that made an extra effort to welcome us here. The food at flora was very good, however I found the other restaurants and especially room service to have very bland food.
Room service was a little disappointing given that they were constantly out of any beverage on the menu. The drinks at the bar were a little light on the liquors. We were very satisfied with the room, it was very spacious and comfortable, with the exception that the hot water was not there 100% of the time.

Overall would recommend, but lower your standards for the food!

reviews.author: Jeanne McDougall
reviews.text: We had a great time. Your grounds are beautiful! We loved Luis  at the main swim up bar. He was so friendly and fun. Ruby at the Italian restaurant bar was so sweet. She went out of her way to find me the wine of my preference. Alvaro was a great concierge. He helped us with reservations and car pick up. So helpful and so nice.

reviews.author: Richa Dutta
reviews.text: We had a pleasant experience here. The beach views are gorgeous, the pools are well maintained but all services come for a price. Be ready to tip a lot to get your drinks, any food or even towels.

reviews.author: Ashley Lassis
reviews.text: Had the BEST meals at Flora restaurant. AUTHENTIC Dominican food, exactly what I was looking for. Lived every single meal. Cesar(our server) was great with recommendations and offered us multiple meals to try all they had to offer. LOVED IT!

reviews.author: Shelly Sharma
reviews.text:
Beautiful hotel! Views are amazing, hotel staff was equally amazing. Everyone was very attentive and provided great customer service. Our concierge Juan Carlos was amazing- he helped us out so much! Bartender Luis was the best! Jordania was amazing!

Cons- everything closes at 10pm.. we came here on a friends trip and this hotel isn’t a party hotel. We spent a lot of time off the resort doing excursions.

reviews.author: Anthony Chaloner
reviews.text:
I will start by saying that the property is beautiful, modern and high end feeling. The staff are very nice and helpful and when we arrived, Antonio made us feel welcome and appreciated and he did everything he could to get us the best room possible and we were very grateful to him.

That being said, there seems to be a major issue with staff communication at the resort between departments and the Melia call centre employees. We were told ahead of time when we called that there were no microwaves in any rooms, and when we arrived there was one in our room, which was quite frustrating as that would have changed how we packed with a newborn baby. We also only had one tiny garbage in our bathroom for the whole room and when we asked for a larger bin for the kitchenette we were told there were no other bins available. We also had to call multiple times every time we needed something because hours would go by and they would clearly forget about us. Their housekeeping was pretty bad and inconsistent with restocking water and drinks in the fridge and ignored our requests for extra garbage bags etc.

I thought the quality of the property and amenities was good value, but the issues we had this week were quite frustrating and would make it tough to want to come back.

reviews.author: Camin Cohen
reviews.text:
Came here to celebrate my boyfriend’s birthday.

Overall, it was a beautiful hotel. The rooms were clean and nice. The resorts is really big
There is a separate area for adults, only which was really nice
The staff are nice, welcoming, but I expected a little bit more nicer service .
Food and the drinks are all inclusive indeed, but we didn’t really eat there because the food was not so good
so we ended up going to a different restaurant outside of the hotel, but the food is decent .

The location of the hotel was good, but a little bit further away from the main beaches, but you can go for a walk throughout the beach and enjoy.

Recommend

reviews.author: Barbara Soogrim-Raghunandan
reviews.text: What can I say other than Rafael, our guy at the beach was the best experience here at the beach!!! Rafael is attentive and caring and always on point each and every day - he always gave the best service with a smile and great energy!!! If you’re here, ask for Rafael!!! His service is impeccable!

reviews.author: Andy Jimenez
reviews.text: Ricki and Georgi at the Buffett gave us excellent service. They were very attentive and accommodated us with our needs. The only negative about the resort is that the concierge kept promising us a reservation for my moms birthday at one of their restaurants, but they never came through. I know we where a big group, but they kept giving us false hope. Other than that, the place is very beautiful and the beach and pool were clean and nice.

reviews.author: Santiago Reta
reviews.text:
Nice hotel, but not worth the price (not value for money).

Based on service quality, it felt more like a 3-star hotel. It shouldn’t be rated as 5-star by today’s standards.

The hotel is beautiful and the beach is great, but they need major improvements—especially in service. We arrived at 10 a.m., checked in, but didn’t get our room until after 4 p.m. (even though check-in was at 3). It felt like if we didn’t insist multiple times, the room wouldn’t have been ready at all.

The rooms were nice and looked fairly new, but cleanliness was a major issue. There were grapes under the bed when we arrived. One day they didn’t clean at all, and the rest of the days we had to call to make sure they came. We asked them to come before 1 p.m. since we were traveling with two babies who nap around that time—only 2 days they followed through. They wouldn’t replace shampoo unless you asked, and only left a tiny trash bag. We requested room service trays to be picked up, and despite saying yes, no one came—so we spent nights with leftover food in the room.

In-room dining and all restaurants/bars (we tried them all) required repeating orders multiple times. In many cases, we gave up waiting. Most staff weren’t rude, but they didn’t seem interested in helping either. Very few asked if we needed anything, and some had a bad attitude. The general rule seemed to be: no big tip up front, no good service.

Hotel rules (zones, included services, etc.) were unclear and changed depending on the staff member—and whether they were hoping for a good tip. At check-in, they barely spoke to us, let alone explained how the hotel worked, what was included, or where to go. Everything was trial and error.

Food-wise, it was mostly average. The Asian restaurant was just bad—bland rice and chicken (think hospital food), and a very awkward show (a “chef” threw plates and glasses on a guest). In general, waiters made it feel like you were asking for a favor—not what you expect from an “all inclusive” or “premium” hotel. The steakhouse and Mexican restaurants were the best, followed by the Italian (we had to ask them to reheat the food though). Nothing was really memorable. The pre-dinner bar made great drinks though. The buffet was the most consistent, although service was also poor there. We had a great dinner at Brisas, a members-only restaurant they invited us to due to the check-in issues—but it’s not part of the usual guest experience.

Between 3–6 p.m. (when the buffet closes and restaurants open), only one snack bar is available, and with a very limited menu. Room service options were narrow. The minibar was restocked quickly, though.

Facilities and activities were below par. A yoga/stretching class lasted just 27 minutes and was led by someone scrolling on their phone. The gym had old, basic machines and no nice view—just a hallway. Activity offerings were limited and poorly communicated. The spa charged more than a walk-in at any local spa.

The hotel seems focused on events or members. During our stay, there were 3 weddings, a fashion show, and several corporate events. Nothing wrong with that, except these groups clearly had priority over regular guests. If you’re not a Meliá Circle member, I wouldn’t recommend staying here. They’ll treat you like you’re staying at a discounted 3-star hotel.

Some individual staff were kind and made an effort to improve our stay, but overall service was poor—hard to highlight the exceptions.

Lastly, third-party tour companies working with the hotel were unreliable. We booked a boat trip that turned out to be totally different from what was promised. They picked us up an hour late and didn’t allow our 6-month-old onboard (despite saying it would be fine). No refund offered.

In short: we had a very nice time because the place is beautiful, but unless you’re paying for the highest-tier experience, tipping at least $100 USD a day, and/or are a Meliá member, I wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.author: Chelsey Hendrickson
reviews.text: We have enjoyed our stay at Paradisus Palma Real. We had an issue with our room due to an issue with the timeshare exchange, but Carlos at the front desk was able to help us get it worked out. We have been a bit confused with the family buffet being closed a few nights, but our concierge has been helpful getting reservations at the restaurants. Wellington was super friendly as he refilled our wet bar and gave our kids their favorite juice boxes. Overall very friendly staff! Love the small pools near the rooms, which have been great for our kids. The staff at Kidsdom is phenomenal. Especially Marsiel, Susu, and Alexandria!

reviews.author: Mark Benjamin
reviews.text: We are dinner tonight at Flora Caribbean/Dominican at the Palma Real. What amazing flavors and presentations of the food! The creative menu is unique for a resort restaurant. We particular enjoyed being pampered by the always perfect Cesar. He ensured we were stuffed with the finest choices and personally wanted is to have the happiest night ever. Thanks Cesar.

reviews.author: Annie Kay
reviews.text:
This was our first time at an all-inclusive resort in the Dominican Republic with a child, but our travel companion was a very seasoned traveller who's stated at more than a dozen different DR hotels over the years. Our overall experience was on the positive side.

Kids club / Kidsdom 5 stars
The entire team was extremely kind, nurturing and attentive. Our daughter loved going in and asked to attend even more activities once she got a taste of the kids club. There are about half a dozen activities each day in addition to the free-play in the playroom. Thank you to Janilda, Jessica, Jesus, Joanna, Lizbet and Sujeiny - we look forward to seeing you again!

Rooms 5 stars
The hotel and rooms looked recently renovated and they were kept to an immaculate standard. Bed and bedding were comfortable, but not the sofa bed.

Beach / Pool 5 stars
Well Bavaro beach is breathless and the pools immaculate. We're glad we stayed here for the quick access to both throughout the day.

Restaurants 4 stars
Main buffet was excellent, especially since we're not "buffet people", as were the Dominican and Asian restaurants. Other restaurants were just about alright. Booking process every day for a meal out 2 days in advance was annoying.

Service 3 stars
On checkout, no one asked me how my stay was -- this is a real miss for a 5 star hotel. There were some smiley workers who made sure we were doing well throughout though; I'm very grateful for those.
Here's an example of the service: One night the cleaner attempted to deliver unsolicited towels at 10pm... we were all asleep from jetlag, had plenty of towels already, but nevertheless the doorbell rang, and after a moment the door opened. I was told to put on the do-not-disturb sign for future nights even though no one should be disturbing guests at that time of night anyway.

Entertainment 2 stars
Activities during the day were hit and miss, and evening entertainment often consisted of a solo musician with spectators scattered around the hotel. I'm told that most other hotels in the area have a proper and engaging shows.

reviews.author: Amy Parrish
reviews.text:
We recently got back from spending 10 nights at this hotel. This was our second visit, and our first visit with our child (18 months).

We had a swim up suite which was very spacious and well stocked, well decorated. The beach access was great, always a lot of space. The last time we were here, the beach was heavily impacted by the sargassum, so it was great to see this time they have taken more attention to prevent the build up.

The majority of the staff is just outstanding, and there were some key players that made our stay exceptional. Firstly, our conceirge, Yaleidi, catered to our every need. She really went above and beyond, and we would have been completely lost on many things without her. Antonio (Anthony?) and the rest of the team in the Ginger bar were the kindest, nicest people. They were so lovely with our daughter, Paloma, and on top of that made the best coffee/drinks. In the breakfast/lunch buffet, Yafreizy (I am probably butchering the spelling) was a delight. Everyday with such a great attitude. The last day of our trip, the hotel was totally overbooked with a conference, and Yafreizy helped us find plates/food as we were rushing to get our child fed, etc.
And how could we forget the amazing ladies at the kidsclub! Firstly, the kidsclub was pretty much our child's dream room so it was such an asset to have this for the hot afternoons for a little AC play break with baby and parents. In addition, we left our child for a few hours with the staff and they were so sweet with her. We used the babysitting service a few times in the evenings and they were very professional.

We only did a few of the evening activities and it was all very fun and well organized. We were massively impressed with the quality of the food in both the buffet and in the restaurants, which is not usely the case in all inclusives. We never had any issues getting reservations (but we also had an amazing concierge).

The only problem we had in this hotel was with the housekeeping department. It started with our first night at the hotel, waiting 2+ hours for someone to bring a crib to our room, which was requested at the time of booking, and confirmed the week before with the hotel. Additionally, we had some issues with mosquitos and asked repeatedly every day for them to come spray our room, which never happened until our last night. In a few instances, we had the issue that they never came to clean (or at least take out the trash), which ended up with my husband running around asking someone to contact housekeeping. There is clearly a communication/organization issue within this team that we hope can be resolved.

All in all, it was a great stay, with many cherished family memories. We will really miss the kind people we met during our stay.

reviews.author: Jackie Lee
reviews.text:
Luis & Rafael at the Asian Experience restaurant are amazing. Very energetic, friendly and helpful.

Restaurante Blue Agave was amazing. Jose was a great server even recommended a drinkat dinner. Santo the owner was attentive and ensured we were well taken care of.

Mascalzone Restaurant was great. The pesto shrimp linguini is amazing. Pizza tasted authentic and food was fresh and tasty.

The room we booked was the Master Suite Deluxe; it was big and spacious and very nice. The only thing missing was a hair dryer which it doesn't seem they offer. The downside was the room we stayed at was quite far from the main plaza but overall a very nice space.

We happened to be assigned a concierge which was very helpful at the beginning but seemed to be a little less responsive after we sat through their Melia program promotional talk and did not sign up as a member. We missed out on restaurant bookings as we relied on our concierge and by the time I went to schedule them myself, they were fully booked.

All in all it was a great experience. Tho kid friendly, it didn't have as many free activities for younger kids compared to other hotels. A nice spot for adults only.

reviews.author: Feroz Khan
reviews.text:
Beautiful Resort!
Amazing Beaches!
Great Staff!
Excellent Room!
Clean!

Food was subpar and my main complaint...  Reservations for dinner is the way to go.  It took a few days to figure out where had decent food.  I ordered popcorn chicken, got chicken nuggets?! sadly, it was better than a lot of the other food I ate during my visit.

reviews.author: Jenna MacPherson
reviews.text:
Our family had a fantastic stay at Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, with just a few minor drawbacks that, if improved, would make the experience even better.

The resort itself is stunning, set right on a beautiful, well-maintained beach. The main pool is massive, and each hotel building has its own quieter pool, which we appreciated for a more relaxing experience. However, the main pool is shared between the family-friendly and adults-only sections of the resort, and by late afternoon, it was overrun with spring break revelers. This led us to retreat to the quieter pools, which thankfully were excellent alternatives.

One issue with the main pool was the lack of shaded areas and umbrellas, which made it difficult to stay outside comfortably during the hottest parts of the day. More shade options would be a great addition.

The spa was excellent, and the adult activities throughout the day were well-organized and fun. The evening entertainment was also a highlight, with a great mix of performances and events.

The absolute standout of our trip was Kidsdom, the resort’s kids’ club. It was well-organized, engaging, and a true highlight for our children. They spent a few hours there each day, coming back thrilled about the crafts they had made and the friends they had met. The staff was incredibly welcoming—engaging our kids the moment they walked in—and even greeted them by name around the resort.

A couple of small notes for families considering this resort:

The pools are quite deep (most are nearly 5 feet), which was challenging for our younger kids and even for me as a shorter adult. This led to congestion around the pool stairs, as they were one of the few shallow spots.

Providing plastic cups and plates for kids at meals would be helpful, as the condensation on glassware made them slippery, and the ceramic plates were quite heavy for little ones.

Despite the minor inconveniences, our stay was wonderful, thanks to the beautiful resort, delicious food, and—above all—the exceptional staff. Huge thanks to Johlfrey (activities coordinator), Alexandra, Stefanie, and Sujeidi at Kidsdom, and Jamie and Alba at the spa for making our experience so special. A special recognition is also due for Maria at Rum Republic who is a fantastic bartender—kind, welcoming, and truly excellent at what she does.

We would recommend Paradisus Palma Real to families looking for a beautiful, relaxing getaway with top-notch service.

reviews.author: Luciana Domingues
reviews.text:
My family of 4 stayed for five days at this beautiful resort, we loved the accommodation and hospitality. The food could definitely use some improvement, especially in main area  ( buffet) . More air ventilation around the Buffett also would’ve been awesome as well.
Our room was absolutely beautiful and everything remained cleaned and well maintained, the weather and everything about DR is beautiful!
Starlin was our guide and he was absolutely awesome. We appreciated his kindness, attention, and time. We hope to see him again :)

reviews.author: Prall
reviews.text: We had such a great time for our honeymoon. We stayed in the reserve swim up suite and it was amazing. The service from our concierge, pool waiter and bartender, all restaurant hosts/waiters were fantastic. It was usually always pretty quiet on the adults only side which was nice and contributed to the relaxing atmosphere.

reviews.author: Laurie Putnam
reviews.text: The check in process was a breeze. We were given a tour of the property and shown to our room. Kelvin was our concierge and he was amazing! He made our dining reservations, answered our questions and checked on us daily. The swim out room is worth it! The rooms are nice, very updated. The only downside is the air conditioning can only go so low so I’d bring a fan. Housekeeping was on top of it. The food was excellent even though the resort was low occupancy, we were still able to eat at all of the restaurants. Overall, this spot is great to visit the DR.

reviews.author: Melissa Smith
reviews.text: We have just returned from a fantastic stay at the Paradisus Palma Real. The resort is stunning and well looked after. We stayed in the Reserve and had a great experience and were well looked after by Zenovia. The breakfast at Sante was excellent and the staff were friendly and efficient.  We ate at all the restaurants and generally the food quality and service was excellent. We had a few issues including our room not being cleaned one day which was eventually sorted and an issue with vouchers we were provided with as we were unaware we had to present them at the restaurant, not on check out and they refused to honour the voucher. All in all I would recommend staying at this hotel.

reviews.author: Sam Peters
reviews.text:
This was my second visit to this resort. The experience in both the visits was vastly different. Which this one not being the best.

It’s a decent resort and has great views and good activities in the resort and nearby

To experience their dinner specialties. You need to make reservations

All these restaurants were a disaster.  With Italian taking the crown to being disgusting.
I am not the only person who had a bad experience. Even a different table too was disappointed. They simply walked away. Which prompted me too to call it a day in this restaurant. Olive Garden has better Italian food and i give it 2 out of 5 stars

Not sure if anyone from the resort will read this review. The point is my holiday was not what I expected

Rooms - staff did a great job. Keeping the rooms neat and tidy. 5 stars here

The swimming pools were clean

Someone who architected this place didn’t know what he was doing.
Check out the stall in the men’s washroom next to lunchbox. It’s practically impossible for you to open the door without hitting something

Had to change my room due to a problem in the middle of my stay. The staff who helped me move was hanging around expecting a tip. And didn’t leave till I tipped him.
Its not that I don’t tip. But expecting a tip is not appreciative

Kudos to the staff in Ginger and Lunchbox. They really do a great job.

reviews.author: James Skelton
reviews.text:
Overall a nice hotel. The rooms have recently been refurbished and although the finish is a little scruffy (chipped floors, paint on skirting, wonky handles) they're nice and spacious. Our favourite part was the cafe stroke bar area where various musicians played in the evening. The sports bar is also very nice (however they were not showing any English Premier League matches). Also, for runners, there is a track around the complex which you can squeeze around 6km from. Saves being on a treadmill indoors whilst on holiday!

One major drawback is that they don't appear to monitor or control sales people on beaches like other hotels we have stayed in in the Dominican. This means you will be pestered constantly to buy things which meant we never once used the beach sunbeds. The beach, though, is amazing and you can swim in the sea. You can also walk for long distances in both directions so you don't feel trapped in the hotel.

The staff are all friendly but quite laid back so expect customer service levels to vary. For example, some of our drinks never arrived at breakfast. But overall we were satisfied by the service. We really appreciated the chocolate and crisp deliveries in the afternoons to our room!

The food is restaurant standard and really impressed us. The buffet is what you'd expect from a large hotel - Overall decent with a few exceptions. The restaurants however were superb and would highly recommend the Italian, Brazilian and Mexican. Unfortunately, we had a terrible meal at the Steakhouse. I'd go as far as saying the steak was inedible due to the amount of fat and how tough it was. Ironically it's the most popular but my advice would be to avoid and enjoy the others.

For those with allergies, beware of the online menu which isn't accurate. Some food, such as the brownies, arrived with walnuts however the online menu had indicated it was safe. The staff are not reassuring at all when it comes to allergies, and my wife has a severe nut allergy and carries an EpiPen. We're very cautious anyway when traveling but some may be easily caught out.

Beware also that this is a large commercial hotel, which contradicts all of the Melia advertisements and social media. I was expecting a quiet hotel however it's enormous, quite rowdy and also hosts many business conferences and events. Something to be aware of when booking as this is quite misleading. The overall finish and style of the hotel is very nice, however, just much larger than we envisaged.

reviews.author: Ken Cross
reviews.text: My wife and I are on resort now. We are staying 14 nights this time. Stayed at several Melia resorts. The food is always good and the service staff at the restaurants and bars are always amazing. The staff in general are very nice and typically say Hi or Hola ro you as you walk by them. My issue is why is there no adult beach. We booked an adult only room. The adult only buffet is closed I am assuming because not enough guest here this week or time of year. There is an adults only pool which is nice. But I do not want to have sand kicked in my face with uncontrolled kids running. I love kids. I have 4 adult kids but I raised mine and want to relax and not have to worry about someone else's little ones. Now I am not on the Reserve side but the adults only part. I was told to go to the Reserve front desk and speak to them. So I did and even spoke to their supervisor to of course be told the only thing we can do is charge you $150 more per night for the Reserve. So he took me over to the guest service concierge who just kept telling me about the Reserve restaurant which I do not care about. I just wanted to know if there was an adults only beach since I paid more for that. Was told no you would have to pay more to stay at the Reserve.  So very frustrated I left the guest service area with no clear answer except pay more money. I have no issues with the resort as a whole bit I paid more for certain things like adults only restaurants and beach. I have also been trying for 2 days to change a reservation from one restaurant to another and have been given the run around. Went to where you book the dining reservations and they said since guest service booked them you have to go through them. I said I sent a massage to him 2 days ago and nothing they said still have to go there. So we did and was told he did message them and waiting on an answer from the dining reservation people. Omg should not be this complicated to get something done. I feel like they just pass you around until you give up. We have been to Melia resorts like 6 times bought a5 year program to their Circle. Should not be this hard to get answers. So feeling very frustrated. I will post again at the end of my trip.

reviews.author: Tara Illiano
reviews.text: The restaurant Blue Agave at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf and Spa Resort had excellent food and service! The hostess Laura was so friendly and accommodating and our waiter Alexander Gonzales was very friendly, attentive and on top of things. I would definitely recommend adding this restaurant to your trip itinerary when visiting this all inclusive resort.

reviews.author: David J. Chammas
reviews.text: We had a great experience at Palma Real. Beautiful resort, nice amenities, nice staff. Only complaint is service - we were supposed to have a welcome bottle upon check in and we did not get it until our last evening despite calling the resort multiple times. Breakfasts were also a bit chaotic but other than that we had a great experience and definitely recommend the resort!

reviews.author: Emily Roberts
reviews.text: Blue Agave was delicious and Sandra was so kind and attentive! The manager Mardin was so helpful! We enjoyed it (4 stars only because it was a hassle to make food reservations) Yenifer A. delivered our room service for breakfast each morning and it was great!

reviews.author: Michael Davis
reviews.text:
We are on day two of our trip and so far the hotel has caused nothing but chaos. However one particular person who made it better, a feeling top tier was Juan. Juan was our server at the Santa restaurant. We ate there for breakfast and diner. He was really accommodating and doing above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed. All the way down to teaching us his home ritual during shot o clock. I would definitely come back just to see Juan.  This vacation was set to celebrate my husband an I 10th year wedding anniversary.

Thanks Juan for
All you do here.

reviews.author: Allie Wyman
reviews.text:
Raider was an excellent server on our Italian night out at mascalzone!

Overall, wait staff was very attentive to every need that we had.

Our concierge, Harry, was amazing & delightful to have for our stay here!

reviews.author: Jamie Saunders
reviews.text:
We just returned from a trip to Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. We used Best punta cana tours for our transportation to and from the airport. They were great. No issues.

We stayed at the Paradisius Palma Real - Reserve, the adult section. We booked the presidential suite that had two bedrooms and was right on the beach. We had a concierge, Alvaro, that helped us with everything from restaurant bookings, excursions, room stock customizations, even seats at the beach. He was always available and very quick to respond.

When we arrived, we went to the Reserve only reception area. While there, we received a bracelet that served as our room key. As for the room, the suite had 2 bedrooms, one with 2 full beds and one with a king. There was also a living room in between the rooms with an additional bathroom with a stand up shower. In the king sized room, the bathroom and closet were very spacious. There was also a living room type setup with a tv in there, which is where we spent the late nights watching football and playing games. The second room with the 2 beds was definitely smaller in the bathroom and the closet wasn't in the room, which was odd. You had to go out in the shared space to access the closet. The rooms were great but the bedding could be way better. The mattresses and pillows were hard. The balcony was huge. It had rocking chairs, lounge chairs and a shallow hot tub. The room was stocked with vodka, rum, whiskey, wine, beer, sodas, water and some snacks daily. The concierge made sure we had just what we wanted. We received a beach bag, robes and house shoes in our room which we all loved! The WiFi in our room was good. It worked in many areas of the resort as well. So, that was a plus. Also, I feel like the map is a bit deceiving. We were worried everything wasn’t within walking distance from the reserve but it is. We didn’t venture past the plaza where all of the restaurants are though. Beach, pools, restaurants, coffee, bars, towels are all relatively close.

We were able to have a palapa at the beach with the very comfy layout beds. The crew did a wonderful job at cleaning the seaweed at the resort. The swim area in the ocean was really big compared to other resorts I saw. The beach is definitely a huge win for this resort!
The pool is really big and has a swim up bar on one side. There is also a pool in the Reserve section. We didn't spend a lot of time at the pools though because the water was freezing!!!

If you want to shop, beware! The sales people at the markets are very aggressive. They will approach you on the beach and offer you cheapie cheapie. If you aren't a negotiator, expect to pay more. Likely more than the item is worth. I personally suck at this so I'd almost rather shop at the airport to avoid this.

Overall, it was a great vacation that went by way too fast. I'd book again at the Paradisius Palma Real Reserve. You can't go wrong with Alvaro. He was wonderful!

reviews.author: Faye
reviews.text:
I love the place and the staff are superb the food is also good. But the actual hotels needs much work done. From small details to some major health and safety works in the rooms.
I am more than happy to provide an extensive details if required as I feel the place has so much potential to be even better than what it is.
Our concierge Wily was super and worked well with us and made our stay even more enjoyable sorting all things for us.
Jorge Rafael our dance instructor was fantastic full of spirit and kind and patient,

reviews.author: Chris Scarff
reviews.text: Staff was very friendly and helpful. Food was excellante.

reviews.author: Daniela Silva
reviews.text: Our first night at diner, we went to a Habachi place and it was truly amazing! Not only was the food amazing but the service was even better! They were so kind and included us so well into the service. The service throughout the hotel has been amazing. The pools are also very amazing! They are so gorgeous and there is space for everyone. Some great workers here is HAIRON AND SAMUEL from activities! Other great workers who work at The Lunch box buffet is Roxana and Frank!! They are very kind and very attentive.

reviews.author: Amel B
reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant stay at the Paradisus Palma Real hotel. The staff is friendly, the room and pools are very clean. Swimming in the sea is also pleasant since the seaweed is picked up and doesn't accumulate on the sand. The room is cleaned twice a day.
The downside of the stay is that the air conditioner in the room made an intermittent noise, which woke us up during the night. The technician came to repair it several times, but the noise persisted until the end of our stay. We had a concierge at our disposal, but we saw no big advantage in it.
The buffet menu is very varied and the croissants are delicious. The quality of the food in the restaurants is equivalent to that of the buffet.
Special mention and a big thank you to Juan Torres and Dayhani who always welcomed us very well when we ate at the buffet, they are kind, accommodating, and cheerful.
All in all, we are delighted with our stay at this hotel.

reviews.author: Bobby Glidwell
reviews.text: Service here is amazing. Pedro at the beach welcomed me and my wife by name every morning and made sure we had fresh towels and drinks right away. They set us up with a concierge who was very quick to address our questions. Rooms were newly remodeled, but the matresses were a little stiff for my taste and the pillows lacking. Massages were great at the Yhi spa. They have bracelets as the room key which is nice, one less thing to remember.

reviews.author: Kingdom Focused
reviews.text: Resort is amazing!! Staff is very friendly! Brush up on your Spanish as the English is broken.food is so so earning it 4 stars instead of 5 but the grilled pineapple is Amazing! Ismael at the ginger bar is amazing making Oreo shakes and coffee drinks. Come enjoy the sun, beach, and relaxation in the Dominican.

reviews.author: Hasan Misiri
reviews.text: Ruined my first vacation day, I paid extra for the Reserve and was put in a room with no air conditioning, minibar/frig not working, safe deposit box not working. Took us 4 hours going back and forth from concierge to "managers" complaining and finally they decided to change the room. What a start of vacation, could have received much better treatment in resorts next door with half of price. Nobody is taking responsibility here, up to now horrible experience, hope next days will be better.

reviews.author: Daniel Blake
reviews.text:
The hotel itself has a fantastic ambience and scenery definitely displaying what a 5* hotel should look like. The service of the staff everywhere was great, not a single person let it down. We had a private concierge Eriol who looked after us throughout our stay. He went completely above and beyond and as we were here for our honeymoon he made so much effort to add romance and a personal touch throughout the stay.

The only issue I found with the hotel was the quality of the food in the other restaurants, other than Santé, and room service, with the use of salt being far too much. We unfortunately did order room service a couple of times and did receive raw chicken both times which put us off ordering from that point on.

Santé was definitely the highlight restaurant in the hotel. The food, service and ambience were definitely number 1.
Shout-out to their staff members, Misael and Norjandro.

The rooms are very comfortable and cleaned to a very high standard. With the shower being nice, powerful and hot.

reviews.author: Kelly Bauer
reviews.text: Would like to rank this at 4.5 stars if that was an option. The resort grounds are beautiful, well-maintained and clean. The beach was by far the best beach in the area. Buffet food was as expected and sometimes really good. All of the restaurants with reservations needed were very good and accommodating for a party of 2. We had some issues with our room and had to change, but Eduardo at the front desk was very helpful. We had the pleasure of having Adriel the butler assist us in our room issues and making reservation. He went above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay and my friend had a special birthday. The facial at the spa was heavenly and I wish I remembered the name of the woman who did it- she had amazing hands. We appreciated the adults only pool and the music played there every day. Pro tip- pack sunscreen or wander offsite to buy some. It is $30+ at the resort.

reviews.author: Karen Tesoriero
reviews.text: We came here for my 50th birthday as just a couple and we are having the best time.  The food at Restaurant Flora was sooooo good!  The resort was so nice we love our room.  The service is incredible…. We are here in the office season of Early October and there are so many service people here.  we will be coming back again and highly recommend to others!

reviews.author: bety jay
reviews.text: Everything is good about this hotel. But... except for daily activities and pool entertainment.  There is nothing= zero. And also there is an indian wedding. The wedding guests turned the pool into a private one. They play Indian music all the time. My advice is that have your own speaker. I have to be honest: staff are polite, room service is excellent, food is good. But the wedding really ruined everything.  I hope the hotel manager reads it and do something about it. I'm here right now if you have any questions ask me please.

reviews.author: Ermina Radoncic
reviews.text: My husband and I went to eat at the Italian restaurant in Paradisus Palma resort called Mascalzone. We we serviced by Yuleni who was so nice and attentive. Milton the manager came by to make sure everything was going well. Beautiful resort with beautiful staff. Would come back again and again.

reviews.author: Alper Logan Kaya
reviews.text:
Our stay at The Paradisus resort overall was average. The staff is pleasant but not on top of things. It is a huge complex and thus I understand organizational aspects can be complicated, but thats not an excuse. The open buffet was below mediocre except for the few items we were able to find. However,  The beach, and its location are phenomenal  and even with rainy weather we were able to enjoy it. The rooms were clean, and the beds were very comfy. And the kids play room, programs and staff were wonderful.

BlueAgave - the Mexican restaurant  was the best restaurant option available from the 3 other Child friendly restaurants (Asian - avoid if possible, steakhouse and Italian). The first time our meals were good, but during our  second visit every single item we ordered was amazing. And our waiter Edicto was attentive, efficient who overall made this a lovely experience for me and my family.

reviews.author: James Scott
reviews.text: We stayed for 9 nights - lovely, large hotel and beach location. Service from staff very friendly and happy to help. Great hotel for families with small children. Room overlooking the beach was great, a few minor issues were resolved in a day or two, such as broken furniture. Restaurants were nice, but we struggled to book tables at the times we wanted even though the hotel was not that busy.

reviews.author: Shaun Milmore
reviews.text: Buffet had great selections every day. Not sure if the ice or tap water was making us a little sick. Resort was gorgeous, staff was super friendly and spoke English really well. I could spend weeks there with the night life and activities they had at the resort. I would highly recommend if you want to eat at specific restaurants to book early. They are all delicious but book up really quick. If your going to do excursions, the better experience is with the top end attractions. Over all experience was excellent!!

reviews.author: Maryam Ahmad
reviews.text: The service was great. Alejandro (happy boy) provides great service and entertainment. Robert the bartender and Ivelisse the bartender were great, always happy with smiling faces and around to help always. The restaurants had bad food, not all of them were open and the quality of food was not good. The rooms are not cleaned regularly, we had to ask to clean them constantly. We arrived and had booked the reserve but got moved to a different hotel despite emailing and calling to confirm the hotel prior to arrival.

reviews.author: lydia meneses
reviews.text: Yamilet at Blue Agave,  was amazing very quick knows everything very well, friendly with kids, brought the dinner out. one of the best restraunts in the hotel.

reviews.author: Cassandra Howard, MD
reviews.text: Dinner tonight at Mina was amazing. The wait staff was prompt, professional and met our needs. The food was fresh, hot, and very well seasoned. This has been our best meal this week at the Paradisus Resort. Many thanks to Jose, Olvi, and Kevin for giving such excellent service.

reviews.author: Apryl Donato
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with stunningly clean pools.  Staff was incredibly helpful and friendly especially Hector.  He greeted with a smile every time he saw us and many times with our favorite drink in hand.   Our stay was very enjoyable!

reviews.author: Thiago Rodrigues
reviews.text:
Concierge: Excellent, good job Gustavo! Very polite and kind. Always tilted to help us anytime. Score = 100 for you!

Customer Service (Restaurants/Bars - on the beach) - Takes around 1 hour to get 1 drink on the beach, if they remember I gave up lot of times when they started to forget my drinks. Also the restaurant on the beach the food was served cold, I wouldn't recommend.

Customer Service (Restaurants - Close to the main pool) - They are good, the food is good. The plus I would say would go for the Sushi Place. Also The pool restaurant sometimes I had misunderstanding with my orders but nothing bad, the food there was good as well.

Customer Service (Bars - Main Area, Pool) - In general, very good. Premium drinks, bartenders very kind. Extra points for that!

Towels (Pool Area) - Very difficult to get a towel, I think you guys should improve this point.

In General: In general I was a good stay but could be better. I would recommend!

reviews.author: Nicole Cartee
reviews.text: Location is amazing. The beach is absolutely beautiful. The pools are well taken care of as well. The service is dependent on the situation and person. The food isn’t THAT amazing. If they could work on the food it would be a 4-5 star. Rina the bartender was great.

reviews.author: Larissa P. Inacio
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus Palma Real within The Reserve services for 1 week. My concierge was Basilio and he was great during the week, being helpful and available whenever needed. Stay was great with minor issues/difficulties but so minor that it's not even worth commenting. Hotel activities are amazing, a lot of yoga, volleyball, artisan classes that make you feel relaxed. But here is a warning about THE RESERVE services: the concierge Basilio was the only good part of it. He was really great. However, the Reserve is supposed to be an exclusive service but it is not exclusive at all. The worst part is their restaurant SANTÉ which is supposed to be an exclusive restaurant for The Reserve guests but it is a chaotic restaurant with terrible food and service. This was the first time I stayed in a resort that the exclusive service was worst than the not exclusive one. The other restaurant (not exclusive to The Reserve guests, called The Lunchbox) was way better than Santé, in both food quality and services. Important to say that in one of the days I tried to had lunch at Sante, they didn't let me in saying my clothes were wet. I showed that it wasn't, that they were already dry and it was just an impression, but they still wouldn't let me have lunch. I wore the same clothes to go to the Lunchbox and I was treated really well. There is no exclusive services at the beach as well, you won’t be served or well treated unless you pay extra tips to the hotel staff. But didn’t I pay extra to The Reserve services already? I mean, it is a good hotel but I would never choose The Reserve services again. It’s unnecessary since other guests are treated same way or even better. Once again, this has nothing to do with the concierge, he was pretty incredible, I just don’t believe that The Reserve it's worth the price.

reviews.author: Sandra Lovric
reviews.text:
We have had an amazing time so far.
This is our first time to this resort and have already recommended it to our friends and family. Very clean, great service and food has been great!!
Thank you!
Definitely visit the Restaurant Flora. Dominican tradicional meals. Fantastic!
Ana-the hostess and Minerva our serve a pleasure to be acquainted with!!!

reviews.author: Joyce R
reviews.text: Both my husband and I felt that the facility is beautiful and the staff are friendly and accommodating. Our room was large and comfortable, and kept clean daily. Our concierge Kevin was helpful and attentive. He got us into all our desired restaurants. Unfortunately, the food left a lot to be desired. We would have happily given a higher rating if the food had been on point. We will return and bring some friends, hopefully Kevin can oversee our next stay. We bought excursions from vendors on property. However, on our excursion to Saona island the bathrooms were in scarce supply and in bad condition. Since it was a 12-hour trip, we cannot recommend that one unless you have limitless bladder control. Further, don’t assume all the water on the excursion is filtered. We recommend the dolphin excursion, not too long and very fun!

reviews.author: Regina Gama
reviews.text:
Rooms were beautiful and spacious, and very, very, clean. The resort is beautiful!! Incredible views all around. Fabulous beach, comfortable loungers and never had a problem getting a palapa.
The water was so warm, both in the pools and the sea.
I was in the Reserve, but never received access to a concierge. We had face cloths on the first day only and never again. It took 2 days to get extra hangers. We only received turn down service twice in 7 days.
Restaurant service was hit and miss, depending on who your server was. Food was average at all restaurants except at Sante.
We liked the breakfast buffet and got the best service there.
Overall, the breads were terrible, but that's a good thing for carb-conscious people.
For an all-inclusive, it was acceptable.
We attended a wedding, and they had all the food outside, in the heat, 4+ hours before we sat to eat (not good for salads with mayo), and the white wine was warm. By the time we ate, the food was cold because the wind blow out all the candles heating the warm dishes. The good news is that the food was very tasty albeit on the cool side.

reviews.author: maria pinheiro
reviews.text:
Breakfast and lunch service was excellent our waitstaff lead by Yanira was always friendly and accommodating for our party of 8.
Second time at this resort. Getting seating at night for a party of 8 together was challenging. Our concierge tried his best but we never got into the steakhouse Mina. First trip to this resort two years ago there were 6 in the party same problem with night seating at certain restaurants. The concierge that was assigned to us first day never contacted us we wound up with our friends concierge . Which he did try his best.
First day no hot water and TV wasn’t working. That was addressed and we don’t know who had been in the room to repair these items.
This trip my luggage was broken into nothing was taken but lock on suitcase was tampered with, reported it to the manager and security never got a response to what happened with investigation.
Room was suppose to be an upgrade slider broke glass came loose from frame needed maintenance to repair, which my husband and another friend helped the guy repair.
Very disappointed with resort this time around
Probably won’t go back I will miss our waitstaff for breakfast and lunch.

reviews.author: James Bruce
reviews.text: At Paradisus Palma Real for 11 days with friends.  We love it by the Reserve pool close to ocean.  Fantastic service from Jeison, Pedro and Martin.  Very helpful with everything we ask for.  They are keepers.

reviews.author: Sean Carr
reviews.text: Rooms were really nice. Good location relative to the airport. Very good food for the most part. Buffet was a little hit or miss. A few restaurants were adult only so my family was limited to the same 4 dinner places. Wander at the steakhouse is so nice and works so hard, always made sure my table was ok and helped if we needed anything.

reviews.author: Caitlin Milbury
reviews.text:
This resort is very nice and I was glad I splurged on the swim up as it was quiet and relaxing.
The food is mediocre at best and it was inexplicably hard to get a reservation.
We had a great concierge, Ariel, who went above and beyond, our friend’s had one who didn’t ever meet them let alone help.
The best part of this resort is the KIDS CLUB. The women working there are fantastic. They made my kids feel comfortable and they kept them busy and engaged both indoors and outdoors. Sujeidy, Alexandra, Martha, Tania, Joana, Jesica, Sandila all had my kids dancing and laughing. They even made a cake and gave my daughter a Barbie for her birthday! I almost gave 3 stars for service, but went with 4 because these ladies were exceptional!

reviews.author: Cris Berwick
reviews.text: Amazing staff, beautiful beach, pool, rooms. Food was mediocre at best

reviews.author: Alberto Corral
reviews.text: Favorite part of the hotel were the rooms.  New and modern.  Beach was ok.  Pools very nice.  Food hit and miss with some high points like the steak house and the tepamyaki.  Especial mention to Jose de Rosario and Kendrick Suzuki who really took care of us at dinner.

reviews.author: Bambi Tran
reviews.text: Spent our honeymoon here, very beautiful hotel and location. The architecture is beautiful and very well curated, each restaurant has their own style and flair yet you still know it all belongs to the same hotel. I very much appreciate the design and work/attention put into each detail. Most of the staff was very attentive and sweet, many of them remembered our drink orders for breakfast, said hello and were very genuine. I appreciated their charisma and kindness! Our housekeeping always kept our rooms fresh and clean and room service was always great. Our concierge could’ve been more helpful (messed up a few of our reservations and lots of miscommunication, but surprised us with a cake and champagne for our honeymoon), but overall a great stay! Drinks here are on point and food is pretty good! Some staff I’d like to highlight as stars: Omar who helped us with our luggage, Bladimir from Flora, Frank from the buffet and Tokimekku, Maria from the buffet, bartenders at the Celsius bar, Jordania from the lobby.

reviews.author: Ernesto Reguan
reviews.text: Great stay at this hotel. Superb customer service at all the a la carte restaurants specially at Flora with Daiana  and Glenny and at Kanna with Luis Rodriguez y el chef Wander. We dined at Sante and Jose the waiter was awesome as well. We had an outstanding concierge named Irvin Nolasco that went above and beyond to make our stay unforgettable. Our housekeeper too, Ernestina, she was excellent and always kept our room spotless. I think everyone was excellent but definitely the buffet staff could use some training on customer service.

reviews.author: Sylvain Montminy
reviews.text: This resort is a solid 8 with the potential to easily be a 9. Although sometime inconsistent, the service is generally excellent with a few standout stars like our concierges Luis and Harry and Santo, Marie, Edito and Frank at the restaurants. The grounds and rooms are fantastic with some elements showing a bit of wear and tear! They accommodated our group of 16 very well and we had a fabulous time. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: David Houseward
reviews.text:
Very nice hotel and amenities.  Our room was not ready when we arrived and the food quality in the family concierge area was not as good as the beach front so we were constantly golf carting to the front.  That being said the food was incredible.   A few rolling power outages occurred but that didn't last too long.

Overall the beach was nice, weather fabulous, food excellent, and service was personal.  At other resorts we have been to the staff were more "scripted" so you get a more varied experience here.

There are golfing benefits but didn't take my clubs. Also the spa was very nice.  I think I went three times.

reviews.author: Steven Williams
reviews.text:
The service at Tokimeko was great. The food and chef (Roberto) was the best. The others supporting the service were great, too.  I would come back again.

The beach area at the Reserve was great. Marten was great he made sure I had a great location and my towel were out andready everyday. I would co.e back and ask for he again.

reviews.author: Aga Scott
reviews.text:
The hotel is nice but not everything is accessible for standard guests. Some parts are for Circle members some for reserved members so you can’t go everywhere.
Rooms are slightly outdated and need maintenance (which was actioned quickly).
Drinks are lovely and Mina restaurant was our favourite. Room service was quick but not the best.
Some members of staff are really nice, Arisleida was lovely at the beach and spoke superb English.

reviews.author: Aja
reviews.text: Visited this resort with my partner and another couple. We had a great experience. The property itself was beautiful and the rooms were nice, clean, and updated. This is a good choice if you are looking for a more chill vibe. Our concierges Ralphy and Deysi made sure we have everything we needed. They booked our dinner reservations each night. At the first restaurant (the steakhouse) we waited an hour for our food to come out and when it did it was not hot. The 2nd night, Milton at the italian restaurant (Mas Calzones) was great, him and our waitress took care of us. Overall, the food was subpar to me, I basically ate pizza and chicken the whole time. That was really my only complaint. They have multiple pools, some with swim up bars. Overall we had a good experience and would visit again.

reviews.author: Susie Kovass
reviews.text: The bar at the InBetween (between the Italian and Mexican restaurants) was a great bar. They really hussle w drink service.  They we super friendly and gave us service with a smile. Miguel is a sweet guy too ☺️ Ramon at the pool was spectaular server. He came over to check on us a lot and even made sure we had fresh drinks while we were in the pool. And saved us seats the following day. Maximo and Juan were the best at the wine bar. Very informational about wine. And super helpful when it came to dinner service. They really hustled on their service too. The rooms are very clean and the housekeeping service was amazing. The food in general is just “ok” the drinks are “ok” too. It is what it is but service was good all around

reviews.author: Ryan Chamberlain
reviews.text: We just wanted to compliment Luis and Eriol on the top notch service. Despite some issues with our room (and management), they have both been going above and beyond to help us and sort out the issues to help our vacation experience. Our family is very grateful. The location of the hotel is beautiful, and it has so much potential, but the lack of care on the management side gets in the way of what could be amazing.

reviews.author: Raquel Rubalcaba
reviews.text:
Great experience overall.
Some things to improve:
- Smelly room (constant sewage odor)
- Some basic things took forever (for example, we never had our last lunch after waiting for more than one hour to eat)
- A lot of plastics on the wonderful beach.

reviews.author: Shraddha Walker
reviews.text: The activities were a great diversion! We had such fun making soap with Brandol - he was so accommodating, even when I got distracted by the great conversation and messed up my soap! A thoroughly enjoyable experience and a lovely little keepsake! And making pizzas was a fun mid-afternoon activity.

reviews.author: Laurie Kreisberg
reviews.text:
Enjoyed the pizza 🍕 class with Brandol,, candle and soap making activity.

The hotel grounds are beautiful and immaculate. Our ocean view room
In the reserve is great

Food is just ok!  Lots of seaweed at beach.

Maria at the rum bar is so kind and makes amazing drinks.  For her it is an art that she takes quite seriously!  Outstanding barista

reviews.author: Vero S
reviews.text: The service at the Blueagave restaurant at Paradisus Palma Real hotel was excellent!! Marbin, the restaurant manager was awesome, very kind and helpful, he made sure we had everything we needed and then some. Also,  I want to mention Stefannie, the customer service manager was AWESOME!!!!! she was on top of every detail to guarantee a great culinary experience and a great stay. Thanks to these two wonderful and hard workers!!

reviews.author: Olga L
reviews.text: Loved dinner at Flora's. The food was delicious with big portions. Our waitress, Estefanía provided excellent service and made us feel right at home. Best meal at hotel.

reviews.author: Diana Wind
reviews.text:
Came for a company rewards trip, had ‘Reserve’ access.

Our room was beautiful, clean, and cold. Well appointed with multiple shower heads in shower, tub, and separate toilet room with its own sink. We were two women in the room so two sinks for getting ready was very convenient.

Loved the property, many beautiful sitting areas amongst the majestic courtyard lined with columns, upstairs in the Ginger bar area and really anywhere on the resort.

Because we had reserve access, we opted to eat at Sante for breakfast and lunch, they also have a small buffet inside the restaurant which we absolutely preferred over the Lunch Box options and environment. Sante also overlooks the main pool bar and you can see the beach and ocean while You dine. 10/10.

Some specific shout outs-Loved the bartenders at Mina - specifically Juan B and Maria. They made us a special smoking vodka cocktail that tasted like a sour patch kid-DELICIOUS! 10/10
Luis outside also made an incredible espresso martini very meticulously adorned.
Swim up bartenders made delicious Dirty Monkey frozen drinks.

reviews.author: Deonna Melton
reviews.text: Pleasantly surprised upon arrival. This was overall a great experience. I was a bit skeptical at first as the website doesn't offer a lot of pictures or information on what to expect which makes it hard to plan for your experience especially if yu are deciding on bringing children. I am here to tell yu, this resort is 100% kid friendly. The kids activities, clubs and attitude of staff are all top notch. They give the kids attention throughout the day with free trinkets, candy, and specialty drinks. We throughly enjoyed our experience. The views were breathtaking. The room layouts are designed well. The food unfortunately wasn't great but plenty of options to choose from. I have no other Dominican Republic resorts to compare this one to; however, I will say if yu opt for this place, it won't disappoint.

reviews.author: Daneisha Jones
reviews.text: Excellent service and food. Rooms were very clean and modern. Quick 15 minute drive from the airport. I will definitely be returning. Ask for Francisco and Broxni when you come!

reviews.author: Andrea Herschberger
reviews.text: Very nice grounds. Edgar was an attentive concierge. Even though we tried immediately upon our arrival, we were unable to get reservations at the restaurants which was very disappointing. The food at the buffets was good. The language barrier with much of the staff was frustrating. Our spa services were excellent.

reviews.author: Chloe M
reviews.text: Dinner at Sante was excellent! The service was very attentive, the food was freshly made and the ambience was lovely. Our meal and drinks came to our table very quickly and all correctly - we were served by manager José, Amanda, Misael and Nilza. Plan to come here again during our trip for breakfast and dinner.

reviews.author: Maricarmen Milan
reviews.text:
Excelente hotel. Magnificent staff. Great pool. Great service by chef Roberto and John at Tokimeku. Also by Melvin at the lobby 😊
Overall 9/10, but some thing I did not like: no drinks at the pool until 10am when the bar opens; no food at the pool area until 12pm when the snack bar opens, otherwise I would have to walk to the restaurant that closes at 11am, or the other restaurant for some hotdogs/hamburgers (not that great). Need more activities for the guests and more nights with life music
I was told at the counter I would get a room upgrade and that was a lie, ended up with the same room I paid for and the a/c stops working after midnight!!

reviews.author: David Carsley
reviews.text:
My wife, 11-month old daughter and I just spent a week at the Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed in a Nikte-Master Suite Swim-Up.

PROS:
1. The staff. Contrary to some of the other reviews, we were treated so well by everyone at this resort. They made our little one feel like royalty from the minute we arrived. A special shoutout to the following individuals who went above and beyond:

*Yamira, Yafreisy and Maria (Buffet staff): thank you for always bringing warm smiles to our table and for sneaking strawberries for the baby! She loves her fresas.
*Edito (Blue Agave Restaurant) was the best waiter we had during our stay. He went out of his way to suggest food options to accommodate the baby's needs.
*Mackenson (Concierge): for organizing our dinner reservations, massage and more. The Nikte upgrade was worth it because of you.
*Karina (massage therapist) was excellent.
*Antonio (Ginger Bar) made some great drinks for us everyday. He also was warm and friendly each time we saw him.

2. The grounds and room were beautiful. You can tell they put a lot of care in keeping the resort up. The Nikte suite was totally worth it. It was so nice having the pool just outside our balcony, along with the three minute walk to the beach.

CON
The area keeping this resort from a solid five is the food. It wasn't terrible but it wasn't anything special. Unfortunately, I got quite sick one day after eating at the buffet and Mexican restaurant. I don't know exactly what caused it, but I can't give a resort a full five star when I had food poisoning. Fortunately, there was a doctor at the resort who saw me right away, gave me a prescription and I started to feel better. Note: the doctor visit isn't free so you will need travel insurance.

reviews.author: Dave Hunt
reviews.text:
The people!  The staff at this place was absolutely incredible!  Guys like Reynaldo Monegro were constantly there with a smile on their face, and were truly happy to assist you with whatever it was you asked for.  The bar tenders were Johnny on the spot with the drinks! The rooms were spotless. The wait staff was on the ball. Even the grounds keeping crew was great.  All were incredibly friendly and happy to help!  If you go, get a young fellow named Joel Valdez to make you a whiskey sour.  He'll keep them flowing and he does them right!

Only 4 stars due to the food.  Most of which is served buffet style and room temp.  In the 7 days we spent there I had only one good meal!  They need to step up their game in this dept.

reviews.author: Clare Abdallah
reviews.text: Our experience at Tokimeku Restaurant was incredible! Besides the late start to our reservation, the chief Jovani was phenomenal. His energy was contagious in the room, making our dinner super fun. The food was absolutely phenomenal, cooked fresh right in front of us. Probably one of the best meals we had here so far! Muchas gracias!!!!

reviews.author: Karolann Drouin
reviews.text:
34 degre bar, jose best waiter ! He is so Nice with the kids and the familly

Buffet : Juan Tores, Maria and Betty. Good service too.

reviews.author: Janet Sutherland Dekom
reviews.text:
The activities staff are awesome. Brandol made sure all were comfortable and enjoying the activity.  When he would see us in passing always asked if all was good and did we need anything.
Edgar presentation on Rum Tasting & Mixology was wonderful and very educational. Thank you for a wonderful trip.

reviews.author: Tiffany Tran
reviews.text:
Editing my review because I was coerced into rating 5 stars by Jordania. she hovered over me while I was writing the review, repetitively touched my phone and removed me from airplane mode because of the poor internet in the lobby but luckily I was paying attention and reverted it before I charged with roaming fees.

However, I must mention a few staff members who were AMAZING and went above and beyond for us:
- Yiri from ginger bar showed us a beautiful spot for a group photo
- Yensy del Rosario and Jairo were so helpful and passionate in their work during each workshop. I wish we could’ve attended more!
- From malva, stormin capitan, franklin Diaz and Maria Santana made our last dinner very special

My honest review of the resort is as follows:

Pros:
- The resort and master suite was beautiful, they were true to the photos online. We got a great deal.
- My friends and I came for the girls trip and were not disappointed.
- The restaurant and bar staff were great and friendly. Although a bit slow at times
- room service is good and attentive. Probably one of their best services
- the free mixology and pizza/aperol spritz workshop were so fun and we’re one of the highlights of our trip. Highly recommend
- Fine white sand beaches

Cons:
- no nightlife whatsoever. Mainly families
- food is just ok. Almost everywhere you go, the meats will always be a bit over cooked but each restaurant has at least 1 good dish. (I enjoyed the steakhouse and flora the most in terms of service, quality and flavour)
- cocktails and drinks are ok. Inconsistent but would recommend the main pool and indoor bars
- I’ve been to cleaner beaches but at least Paradisus is more well maintained than it’s adjacent resorts
- body sunscreen is EXPENSIVE at least 38-58USD per bottle so bring your own
-buffet was good but it’s 1/3 the size of other resorts I’ve been to and the breakfast staff there were very slow

Another friendly couple we met shared the same sentiment towards the resort. This is a beautiful resort and I liked my experience enough that I would consider coming back all things considered, if the price is right.

reviews.author: Kenyatta McCan
