reviews.text: Absolutely the best, hands down bartender. Maria, mama cita! Rum Republic to check her out. Great experience with specialtie drinks.

reviews.author: Jaroline Ferreras
reviews.text: It was a really calm hotel, you could really really relax in here, I came here with my family and I can say that I definitely enjoyed my stay here. The rooms are really beautiful though the bathroom is a little bit too exposed for my liking. The staff was really nice and cordial to us and the restaurant we reserved at “flora” had some really good food, this is definitely a hotel to come if you want to relax.

reviews.author: K. Forrester
reviews.text: Our concierge, Jose, did a wonderful job of taking care of us.  He was in contact with us every day and booked all of our reservations at the restaurants we wanted to try as well as offering suggestions for daily activities.  Great service!!

reviews.author: Bridget Kardasz
reviews.text:
Great vacation had by our party of 12. Big plus, there were always chairs available at the pools and beach for our big group.
Eddy, Rosanna, and Mario gave us such great service at the 90 Degrees pool bar. Georgie and Marta always took care of us at the breakfast buffet.
Only downside was the dinner reservation process. It was next to impossible to get reservations. We were told reservations were not needed before we arrived. That is not accurate.

reviews.author: Joyce Eng
reviews.text:
Overall, our stay was very good. The resort is beautiful and elegant - loved the open main plaza where are the restaurants were located.  The beach was very nice - white sand & plenty of beds due to low season.  There are constant vendors though, but that seems to be the norm in the Dominican Republic.  There was seaweed - some days were better than others.

The Nikte 2 bedroom swim up was gorgeous - more than spacious for family of 4.  Plenty of amenities in the room - 2 bars, alcohol, slippers, sandals was a nice touch.

Our concierge Wily was fantastic, super helpful and super nice - organized our dinners at different restaurants for family of 13, was responsive to all our inquiries, organized bali beds, and made sure we were taken care of.   He truly knows how to provide amazing customer service.

The one area needing most improvement is the food - the buffet at breakfast and lunch got tiresome with the same items daily.  There was no other lunch choice except the buffet, which was disappointing. Also, there was no snack bar - we had to make sure to eat something within the buffet opening times or wait till dinner. Other resorts have a snack bar that you can grab a snack in between buffet/resto hours.  The best dinners was Sante, Flora, and the Winery (which was a special arranged by Wily). Unfortunately, half our group got sick with stomach issues during the stay and also some got sick upon the return home.   Please make improvements in this area!

Ginger bar/lounge has great drinks and capuccino and mixology class was fun. Tito's outdoor mini bar was great too.

Overall, we had a good time but would likely not return due to the food.

reviews.author: Sharon Fletcher
reviews.text: I had an amazing time as this was my first time in the Dominican Republic. The resort was amazing and beautiful. The staff were awesome and accommodating. I especially loved the activities group in particular Hairon Luis, Jairo , Brandelo and Danyelo, I had a great time learning dances and attending the different events. There’s so much I want to say - Thank you to the front desk staff - Ervia, Christopher and Wilmer. The final and last comment is that I wish that more of your staff knew basic English or at least conversational. It’s hard to communicate when they don’t understand you and you don’t understand them. You’re dealing with people from all over the world and not all of us speak fluent Spanish. Will return in the future.

reviews.author: ricardo hernandez
reviews.text: We just had dinner at tokimeko and the food and service was awesome we had Felix Mejia as our chef and we have Jose del Rosario as our waiter. And have to say that they took very good care of us and the food was awesome we definitely recommend this restaurant if you come to this resort you won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Antonietta Aprile
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, the activities are super fun, the food is good. Our favorite place was Mascalzone where the staff was super friendly and really spoiled us with a yummy cake for my son’s birthday. About the activities, Brandol helped us during the workshop and he was very kind. Thank you to all the people of Paradisus Hotel for making our week a real dream!

reviews.author: Anuj Sharma
reviews.text: Loved the resort, food and beach. Pedro guy at the beach bar was very kind and helpful , he got us fresh Pina colada everyday at beach.  Would also mention Willey who was our concierge, he is a nice guy, very helpful. Will return with my kids next time

reviews.author: Summer Elam
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful. Gorgeous resort. Huge. And activities for kids. Only issue is if you have picky kids with food it’s hard. Same buffet every day. My youngest lived on butter toast and apples. But…. She survived. Worth the trip.

reviews.author: Jodi Fontenard
reviews.text: The hotel is lovely and very well maintained. There is a good variety of restaurants to choose from. I wish that the pools did not close so early or close at all. And the snack bar needs should offer more lighter snacks daily like pizza, and finger foods. Our concierge Starlin was very helpful and pleasant.

reviews.author: Lany Guillen
reviews.text: Had a great time at the Paradisus Palma Real. Ariel Benzo was our concierge and he was extremely responsive to all of our needs. The swim up room was excellent - very comfortable and had no complaints there. I’ve stayed at a few Melia resorts and I find that the only thing lacking is the quality/selection of the food.

reviews.author: Leonora Edmond
reviews.text: My husband and I had a 5 day 4 night stay at the Royal Service Paradisus Palma Real.  They lived up to their name and gave us excellent royal treatment and services.   Our room was beautiful and extra spacious.    Comfortable and clean.   Stand up shower and large tub with jets for jacuzzi like experience in our bathroom. Room got cleaned and restocked morning and evening.   Our Butler Armando  Minier took excellent care of us and was always available for whatever needs we had.  He took time to make our reservations for dinner and made sure we had nothing to worry about. He was only a text message away.  Everyone in the resort was attentive and willing to help and very lively. Made sure our experience was always amazing.   Many areas to hang out and relax, both indoors and outdoors.  Pedro (beach front attendant)made sure to have our beachfront Cabana ready for us every day and kept our cold drinks coming. Would definitely come back to this spot if the opportunity presents.  Awesome resort. Amazing experience.

reviews.author: Jason Schoulte
reviews.text:
Great weather, drinks were great, food was good overall, and the employees were all very polite and provided great service.  Also had a number of adult activities in which we participated which were fun.

Only drawback is there was usually a few people walking around selling items and felt pressured to buy something, and the swim-up bar closed a bit earlier than we would have liked.  Some of the restaurants were also difficult to reserve due to lack of availability so we didn’t get to eat at one we hoped to.

reviews.author: Travis Townsend
reviews.text: It's an absolutely beautiful resort. The rooms are very open and comfortable. Makes for a nice relaxing experience even when you're not at the pool or beach. The service is good generally, but there were a few delays in response time for making dinner reservations. The food is also pretty average, but you can find a handful of staples that are delicious and will hold you over. They have all the amenities you need with a great spa and multiple workout facilities. Recommended.

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text: Kicks Sports Bar never disappoints!!! Luis the General Manager,  Fiore & Adriana have sheets treated us like family from our very first trip in 2023 which this is our third time. Love this group at Kicks!!! They are those individuals that leave long lasting imprints on our hearts 💕!!!!

reviews.author: Fiona Hsiung
reviews.text:
We just finished a trip to Paradisus Palma Real with our family.

Shoutouts to Yaleidi, our conceirge for her excellent service. She helped us book our a la cartes for us and our extended family. I know how tough it was to get spots for a big group.

Olivi, Jorgi, Alexander , Yeison, Milkian Jean, Rafael, Kendric, Yorgelys, Editos, at The Lunch Box, Blue Agave, and the Asian and Italian a la cartes ( sorry forgot the restaurant names) for their excellent service.

Last but not least shoutout to all the staff at Kidsdom for their wonderful care and thoughtfulness of activities for my daughter. Thank you Janilda, Martha, Sujeidy, Johanna, Tinia, just to name a few. You truly made my daughters first to Dominican unforgettable.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: The Reserve area is great for an adults-only trip! Sante is the best restaurant on the resort and exclusive to Reserve guests. Rafael was attentive and friendly, and made sure our preferred Balibeds and cabanas were ready every morning during our stay! 10/10 look out for him when you visit this property.

reviews.author: Kylee Spicer
reviews.text:
We stayed at this property for 6 nights in November of 2023.

Resort Grounds:
The property itself is stunning. Spacious grounds with beautiful landscaping. Clean, comfortable, updated rooms. Comfortable pool & beach loungers. The in-room mini bar with snacks was always kept restocked. Also, the light switch to notify housekeeping the room is available to be cleaned is so clever!

Eriol was our concierge and he went above and beyond for us. He made sure to help us celebrate some birthdays in our group in really special ways.

Food:
The food across all the restaurants is presented beautifully. They really try to make it look like 5 star quality. However the taste never matched the looks. We are not a group of picky eaters by any means, but something was almost always missing in terms of flavor. And often, the description of the menu items either gets lost in translation or is just completely wrong. We never quite figured that part out, so we usually just laughed it off and ate it regardless to not be wasteful. But it's worth noting because I think if you're someone with strict food allergies it could get tricky. Still, there were plenty of options so you could get the job done and enjoy the meal. None of us went hungry.

Flora was the best restaurant we had for dinner. Santé was only good at breakfast or lunch, somehow the dinner menu was not enjoyable.

Drinks:
Drinks were good, plenty of options and the bartenders are all friendly and willing to make you whatever you want. Definitely a noticeable quality difference from the Reserve bars compared to the non-reserve bars. So, we typically stuck to only the Reserve side of the property once we realized the difference. The only exception to that was the Ginger Bar in the hotel lobby. Far and away they were the most consistent and quality in their presentations. The only downside is they are so far from the pools and beach, that we only got those drinks before/after dinner.

Wanda at the Reserve bar by the pool closest to the beach made the best drinks. She is just lovely and was the gold standard for all the drinks we had that week. Yeison and Rafael at the beach were very attentive and helpful to keeping our drinks refreshed and getting towels if we needed them.

Overall Impressions:
It is clear the Melia management places HEAVY pressure on employees to get guests to write reviews, with specific mention of the employee name. I do not fault any of the employees for this pressure, but I do blame management and the obvious stress it puts the employees under. This stress is then passed (unintentionally) to the guest, as it was to us for most of our trip.

It was almost every dinner that a restaurant manager would ask us to scan their QR code to write a review, and this was while we were still eating our meal. They were polite, but regardless, it was off-putting. Especially when you have already spent all day being approached by vendors on the beach and around the hotel property. And I do mean, all day. It is constant. A constant barrage of vendors approaching you.

Thankfully the interactions can usually be kept brief, but it is no exaggeration to say we were approached a minimum of 8-10 times per hour by different people trying to sell us something. The beach is the worst, sure, but you only get a slight break while around the pools as the hotel management has their own group of employees asking if you want to go on an excursion. Yes, there are much fewer of them around the hotel than compared to the beach but it was seriously too much. It got to the point that it felt like we couldn't find peace anywhere around the property except for our room. What a bummer.

We will not return to any Melia property, or the Dominican Republic because of the amount of pressure and interruptions we faced. We prefer to be able to relax on our vacations. We have been to more than a dozen destinations all around the Caribbean, some high-end and luxury, some not. But never have we felt anything close to the pressure we faced while staying at the Paradisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Lisa Halloran
reviews.text:
The kids club ladies are the best thing about this resort! Sujeidy, Alexandra, Martha, Tania, Joana, Jesica and Janilda were so good with our kids and the only area of the resort that we felt provided 5 star service. They are phenomena and engaged our kids in a caring and fun way. My kids never wanted to leave kids club! They work so hard and put so much energy into their jobs. Can’t thank them enough.

The rest of the resort left alot to be desired. Front desk staff were inefficient and gave confusing and contradictory information. We had to fight for 5 hours to get the sofa bed made up, our concierge was absent and useless, you’d ask staff for something and they’d never follow through. We won’t be back and it’s such a shame cause the kids club is the best of any AI we’ve ever been to. The rest of the resort needs to get up to kids club standards.

reviews.author: Kerry-Ann Duberry
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful, My concierge Ariel was so helpful took care of everything for me down to my restaurant reservations. Hotel does need more entertainment at night especially it being a family resort, after awhile my kids were bored. Please check out the Steakhouse amazing food and my kids loved the buffet, so many options. Other restaurants were just blahh.

reviews.author: Alexandre Santos
reviews.text:
I had such a great experience at the hotel in the first 4 days.  All the employees are great, very courteous and super friendly.  Called my attention the services in the pool and specially by the beach, where they exceeded my expectations. In the 5 th day though the room was not cleaned.  On 6th day we were awake at 7:30 am with a loud music.  It was a group doing gym!  Hotel should have done better managing that.
I also think they need to work on the “adults only” section, where some parents keeps taking kids to be there, and if you chose that is cause you dont want it…

reviews.author: Donovan Charles
reviews.text: Our family of 8 enjoyed the experience at Palma Real. Concierge Miguelito and Bellman Jose were quick to address our every need. Our swim up suite felt like we had a corner of the resort all to ourselves. We loved the variety of the restaurants. Only wished the buffet was a little more consistent for some of the more finicky appetites in our group, but the Dominican style breakfast and lunches were a fun experience. I was able to golf, the wife visited the spa, the kids parasailed, and the in-laws enjoyed a memorable fishing trip, making this visit to Paradisus an easy, fun, weeklong set of unforgettable excursions. Thanks Palma Real staff for a great trip!

reviews.author: Binny Malik
reviews.text:
We are on Day 3 of our vacation and want to share our experience while we are still here. We booked this resort after a memorable experience at the beautiful Paradisus Cancun last year. Honestly we were expecting same level of premium experience.
The Good:
1. It’s a beautiful resort!! We had an ocean front room and best thing we could have asked for with gorgeous views.
2. The kids club. We have a 20 month old very active toddler. I will probably come back to vacation at the resort just for the awesome staff at the kids club!  Shout out to Joanna who even helped us out with private baby sitting for few hours.
3. Activities. We could not participate in much of the activities but whatever few we did, they were great. I personally loved the painting class! I hope to try out their yoga and stretch class just because of the location they are set up at! Instagram able for sure!
The evening program is a class apart. We witnessed circus yesterday. The lady who plays the instruments is just incredible. She seems to be constant every evening we have been here. I loved every single performance and it felt soul soothing!
4. The Food: pretty decent. The fact that our very picky eater toddler ate well makes it all worth it. They have a decent choice of restaurants but I can’t say much for we could not try them at all. The only other restaurant we tried was Blue Agave. Delvin Martinez was great host and food excellent.
5. Gorgeous beach with plenty of chairs and Bali beds available. There seems to be issue with seaweed but I think Hotel did a phenomenal job in keeping the beach vacation able!
6. We did not feel pressured for any excursions or add on experience. There is no photographer chasing us around and luring us into photo sessions or some one insisting we get a spa. It is refreshing!

The Not so good:
1. The resort seems to be catering to “Circle” members better and we felt like non priority customers with our Green bracelets. Not to mention, I hardly saw a soul in the areas reserved for circle members.
2. We are picky about quality of alcohol in our all inclusive vacations. One reason Paradisus was our choice for this vacation was the premium quality liquor experience we had in Cancun. But little did we know that our choice of liquor here was reserved for “Circle”
Members only. Like WTH!!!
Honestly it made us feel so second class even when we think we had paid premium to vacation at this resort.
3. We expect and were actually informed that the mini bar will be restocked daily. What a lie! Day 1, we got full bar as expected at the check in. Day 2…. We had to call twice just to get water. Day 3…. We ended up calling 4 times and frustrated to at least get water forget rest of the mini bar supplies. Our complaint to our concierge did not make any difference. We have 2 more days to go…. And I am not optimistic for a different experience.
4. The room: We loved the room with all its luxury thrown in (big spacious setting, there are two showers in the bathroom, Jacuzzi in the balcony (although we cannot figure out how to turn it on), premium toiletries, more than enough towels, the mattress). The room wasn’t toddler friendly; but then that’s not hotel problem. Our little one loved to just keep turning on the water in the tub which seemed to be placed right in the middle of the room. And then the color of the floor is such that it’s hard to see if the floor is wet making it risky for us to let our toddler be! And who places TV right in the middle of the room blocking your view???
5. Communication Problem: the staff hardly speaks or understands English especially in the buffet area (that’s where we ate the most). But I don’t want to hold this against them as we are in their country. Glad we have some elementary Spanish language skills.
6. The Credits advertised for in app booking as basically worthless and all smoke and mirror if we can say so. F&B coupon does not apply to liquor we want and we are in all inclusive resort with an upgraded room. That’s $100 of advertised coupons. I can’t recall what rest were for but worthless for sure.

reviews.author: Jose David Duran
reviews.text: Mascalzone reataurant: Ana was grateful with us, very nice service. In Blue Agave: Alquinio and Santo was definitely an awesome service.

reviews.author: Evelyn Allas
reviews.text: Experience was very nice lots of nice Dominican culture Marta gave us a tour of the Dominican day. We saw lots of beautiful art it was nice to experience my parents culture

reviews.author: Jessica Masciarelli
reviews.text: Great resort! Only downside I noticed was the amount of seaweed the beach had, besides that, the staff and the service is really good and the hotel is beautiful. Was here with my husband celebrating our 10th anniversary and stayed at the royal service. Definitely worth the upgrade! Moises was our butler and took care of all our reservations and made sure we were having a great time with champagne, chocolate strawberries, cake and fruit delivered to us in the swimming pool.

reviews.author: Sangmi Suh
reviews.text:
Overall the service was good. I appreciated Martin’s help at the beach by the reserve section.

Food was just average and the drinks too - meh nothing really stands out. The Japanese restaurant was just sad. I dont expect much from all inclusive but the quality of sashimi was just not there.

This property permits smoking inside and out.  Disappointed to see people smoking in close proximity to children. Wifi is pretty weak in the room and around the property. I also felt a bit pressured to be part of circle membership and sit on a presentation.

Compared to my first visit in 2016, the property has downgraded despite its renovations. The rooms are prettier but thats about it. I wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.author: Rajesh Gedela
reviews.text:
We had an amazing holiday
The resort(reserve) was fabulous
Our concierge Kelvin fernandez was very helpful. He looked after us through out our stay. He booked all our reservations in the restaurants very promptly. He was always only a message away for anything we needed
Special thanks to Kelvin
We are looking forward to visiting the new resort by the beach

reviews.author: bh1sg Goncalves
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from a week at Paradisus Palma Real. While the resort is stunning and the overall experience was excellent, our only issue was the room. We weren’t too impressed with the old TV / mattress, the 80’s outdated decor and also the very low pressure shower— all in rough conditions and in need of a complete revamp —, especially considering that we booked the Royal Service.
Aside from the room, entertainment / food were very good and staff very friendly, nice and helpful. We’d like to give special thanks to our butler Alberto and also to Mr. Pedro Ceclano, as both were always very kind in arranging our requests in a professional manner!

reviews.author: ozge sikican
reviews.text: Great hotel ! Loved all the pools and the beach , all the entertainment at night , the Italian restaurant was great . The buffet was so so but this is what you get at all inclusive hotels I guess . Aisleda who helped us by the pool bar”Celsius” was so nice . Recommend this hotel so much the only thing they should have US or English tv channels in the room. Our son wanted to watch espn or sports or kids stuff and there was nothing for him or for us to watch while we were relaxing in the room .

reviews.author: Mauricio Grigorievs
reviews.text: I was attending an event during five days and extended my reservation to one more day, it's crystal clear the difference of service during and after event, even paying the same price during all days. But the rooms and all resort infrastructure are amazing.

reviews.author: Madeline Bishop
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful, Hector, our bartender was great, attentive, and helped my husband with non alcoholic options. Though the food at this resort needs work, overall the place and service are great.

reviews.author: shawn sanderson
reviews.text: We had an absolute amazing dinner experience at the Asian restaurant that Frankie and Kevin provided!  They were excellent servers and made us laugh the entire time!  I highly recommend their excellent service!  Thank you Frankie and Kevin!!!

reviews.author: Linda Perez
reviews.text: Hotel was absolutely beautiful but the service was seriously lacking. There is 0 sense of urgency, everything takes far longer than it needs to. Staff are constantly dangling service in exchange for reviews. My luggage was basically held hostage for a review, and I asked for a bandaid because my son got a cut and was told she could give it to me if I left a review about how wonderful her service was… for giving me a bandaid. I wasn’t told reservations were required for the restaurants when I checked in, we tried to go at 6 when they opened and were denied from 2 restaurants, only to see empty tables for the next 3 hours, they could have accommodated us if they had wanted to.  I had a hotel credit that wasn’t honored, called on  multiple  occasions for a golf cart and it never arrived. Any review you see with someone’s name mentioned was likely coaxed and pressured. Dominical republic isn’t what it used to be, and the service left a lot to be desired for. Beautiful property but the service really left a bad taste, it felt like they always resorted to a “no” rather than trying to actually help find a solution.

reviews.author: Adam Eckert
reviews.text: We went to the Restaurante Sante this morning to try the breakfast. Franklin "our waiter" has been fantastic. He is very funny and cares about taking care of us. I asked his opinion on things to get and he never misses. Very genuine and makes the experience amazing.

reviews.author: Michelle Jones
reviews.text: Jensy was amazing with the aperol spritz cocktail making class. Friendly, helpful, spoke multiple languages and always smiling. Class ended with a very refreshing cocktail. Thank you Jensy. Michelle & Amy

reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: BLUE Agava is a lovely Mexican restaurant.  Really enjoyed the grilled lamb chops and tacos!  Our wonderful server Edito was extremely attentive.  Great food and cheers to the chef Engel and the team.

reviews.author: Chris MacDougall
reviews.text:
The hotel was beautiful, but the seaweed made the ocean unusable at all. 4 feet of seaweed the entire week we were there!!
The food was average at best.
The service was unbelievable, especially our butler Francis Newton.  He was always available, and made dinner reservations or pretty much anything we needed.  Francis was so great to us and made our experience much better!!

reviews.author: D Rodriguez
reviews.text: Had a wonderful anniversary trip. Our butler Kelvin was super helpful and attentive. He would often take care of accommodations without us even having to ask. For example, on our last day/night, he reserved a pool cabana for us to lounge and relax. And at night he arranged for a nice surprise waiting for us in our room, including a bubble bath, champagne, balloons and a cake. We had such a great time we are planning to bring the family next time

reviews.author: chad kastel
reviews.text:
This resort has a lot of 5 star features and some things that are not.

The rooms are very well done and spacious and great for a family.

The kids clubs is a 100/100 I can’t tell you how great the women are there. Sweet, attentive, attention to detail. It’s really hard to leave your children away but these ladies made it so easy. Our girls 2 and 4 had such a wonderful time.

Sujedi, yesmeily, Joanna, maths, alexdra are memorable. The hotel did a great job hiring and training

The location and closeness to the ocean is great.

The bad stuff:

Your concierge will try and upswell you on other locations. He told us he had a “surprise for us” wasted an hour of our vacation only to try to sell us on another property. This wasn’t his fault. Clearly the establishment is pushing this. Not something I’d expect from a 5 star resort

We had a very hard time getting dinner reservations. one of the ones we got was messed up internally.

When you’re on the beach you will be non stopped harassed by salesman who do NOT work for the resort.

There’s a lot of false advertisements by the staff. We originally on the beach resort. It was advertised as a 5 star but very clearly was not. We moved to the paradiso and were told it’s the nicest resort, that we could go to the falcon and use their facilities etc… lots of things ended up not being true.

Changing hotels isn’t ideal.

Overall good trip but likely won’t come back. I have a personal pet peeve with false advertisement and I don’t like being up sold constantly, especially by the hotel.

reviews.author: Ryan Thai
reviews.text: It was a good trip, aside from the weather when we went. Everything was accessible and it was okay. Slow on some restaurants for food but Ginger Bar was good. Jose Ramirez helped us out on the last day.

reviews.author: Stephen McDowell
reviews.text: Good quality hotel services in a densely touristed location of package holidays

reviews.author: Cheryl Pancoe
reviews.text: Just ate at Mina Steakhouse at Paradisus Palma Real.  The food was wonderful and I love our waiters Yuderqui and Frank Feliz! This is the second time we have had Frank he is wonderful. This is my third Paradisus resort and we are loving it!!

reviews.author: Mirta Tejada
reviews.text: Just had dinner at Sante and we were blown away from the service and food.  Jose Rosario, our waiter, was a delight and very accommodating.  Kudos to Eduardo Aquino, Saidy, and Franklin for their hospitality.

reviews.author: Melanie Kron
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus Palma Real for our annual family vacation and had Royal Service with Carlos, who was our butler for 7 days.  He was excellent! Carlos paid close attention to all of the details which made our experience a vacation to remember.  He checked in with us at the appropriate times during the day, and always followed through on any of the requests we made during the duration of our stay. Carlos definitely has a bright future in the hospitality industry. Also, thank you to Wanda, the bartender at the Royal Service pool, who was lovely, was an excellent mixologist - and always had a smile on her face.

reviews.author: Stephanie Langlois
reviews.text: The Palma Real is a nice hotel and the staff is very kind and helpful. Our butler Juan Castillo was very helpful. Patrick and Valentina at The Circle office informed and welcomed us to the Melia family. They all made our stay fantastic. The Palma Real hotel needs a a bit of maintenance as it is showing it’s age.

reviews.author: Kandy Houser
reviews.text: Resort is beautiful. We visited in the off season so it was not at all crowded. Great beach service - Mari Leicey was very attentive, checked in on us regularly and helped with whatever we needed. Lots of pools to choose from.

reviews.author: Alex Lopez
reviews.text: People are amazingly friendly, especially the crew at Brisa’s & the beach. Thank you to Jose, Rosanny & Fedelina. Will miss Joel, Raul, Hansel, Vanessa, Ivan, Movilessy & Odavey. Thanks & hopefully see you all again soon!

reviews.author: Steve S
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay. We had an issue with our first room smelling moldy but it was resolved satisfactorily. We would recommend getting the Royal Service, otherwise, you may be disappointed without it. Making dinner reservations is pretty much impossible without the concierge service you receive with the Royal Service. The staff here are incredible for the most part. They really hustle and try their best to keep you happy, satisfied and wanting nothing. These people run around in the heat all day. You don’t HAVE to tip, but you absolutely should. Yes, you paid to be there but you get more than your $s worth so a couple bucks here and there goes a long way and helps the staff. We didn’t take everyone’s names but a few people truly stood out. Boni and Jendry were the ones who never left us wanting anything while at the pool or beach. Really nice hardworking guys. Abraham, one of the restaurant workers was fantastic. He always took care of us and always went out of his way for our son. Another staff member we need to mention would be Jose Vargas who really stepped up to help and make our experience great. We really enjoyed the food. The buffet was always plentiful, clean and organized as well as the restaurants. The beach is great and you don’t ever have to leave your seat or cabana for a drink. Plus, unlike other resorts, you can walk right onto the beach. No need to take any taxis or golf carts. Same around any of the pools. Yes there are vendors but the property seems to have everything under control. There aren’t too many and when you say no thanks, they leave you alone. Great value for the money

reviews.author: Kate Johnson
reviews.text: Some of the best restaurants I have been to at a resort like this, not typically known for the food. Beach was beautiful, pool drinks were delicious! We went with a large group and had a great time at a friend's destination wedding.

reviews.author: Kasandra Moody
reviews.text: Randy is the BEST!!! 5 starssss! Find him and you will not be disappointed!! Drinks are great and he’s full of personality!

reviews.author: Gina Sch
reviews.text: I would give 3 stars but only because of stuff giving 4. Food is just ok maybe 3 star. Stuff really friendly and helpful- 5 stars for service. Grounds are clean and beautiful. Pool is also clean and nice. Very windy every day. Beach is not clean close to the water area. Again service and stuff really great. All friendly. BUT huge minus is rooms- very old furniture, needs a lot to be done in the rooms, remote control is not working, water stock in the shower, everything is like 1 star motel outdated, but clean. If you ask me if i sagest it to a friend - my answer is NO. Rooms, food and beach are not nice at all.

reviews.author: Nivea Ortiz
reviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful. The service wasn’t bad but only 3 employees stuck out during a 5 day trip. If you stay here please find Jholfry, Denyelo and Sosa. They were very professional and made my trip better than ever.

reviews.author: Juan David Garcia
reviews.text: Hotel is very pretty and modern, facilities are very well kept. Service varies from restaurant to restaurant, at some places it’s amazing and friendly and others not so much. Food is ok, what you would expect on an all inclusive. They do have cool activities all day around. We would come back.

reviews.author: Sarah Moulin
reviews.text: BEAUTIFUL RESORT! One of the best we have been to. Special shout out to our concierge Edgar who was always eager to help, whether it was booking reservations, spa, or helping with our luggage.

reviews.author: stacey simon
reviews.text: Very nice grounds and hotel rooms. That's what they do best. Food was so,so. I wouldn't go hungry. The steak restaurant, manju and Asian where the most enjoyable.  Lemon Fish was not our thing. We stayed at Paradisus Grand Cana which is the best of all the hotel at the circle, with a 10 min walk or 2 minuete golf cart ride your at the famous Bravaro Beach. We had a swim out room with a private butler so that was very nice to get away from the beggers on the beach. We also did the spa which was very relaxing.

reviews.author: Ryan Lee
reviews.text: Slight disadvantage due to speaking English and not Spanish. Details have been lost in translation when it comes to expectations from the personal concierge.  All dinner reservations have to be booked through the concierge regardless of how busy the restaurant is.  COVID has clearly impacted staffing levels.  Cleanliness is clearly a top priority and executed at a high level. Food at the restaurants that require a reservation are  high quality and satisfying. All other food is average at best.

reviews.author: Tyler Van Hensbergen
reviews.text:
Pros:
- Beautiful location
- Good amenities
- Nice pools
- Combination of lively beach environments and secluded pool escapes
- Spacious rooms
Lots of dining options

Cons:
- Resort is a little tired, could use some renovations
- More mosquitoes than expected
- Staff can be unfriendly at times
- Noisy in the rooms
- Restaurant reservations are an ordeal
- Food is so-so

All-in-all this has been a great trip and some of the cons can be attributed to visiting during spring break. My wife and I made the trip for our baby moon and so we were looking to relax and not to party. In general, the staff seems cold and distant. However, this could be due to the stress of the spring break crowd as well as the language barrier.

One notable exception was José Ramos at the Olio restaurant. He went above and beyond when there was a miscommunication about our reservation. We made our reservation for 7:30 but were told it had been moved to 9:00 when we arrived. As we were leaving, José waved us back and accommodated us at a table outside. My wife and I were especially grateful for the extra effort he put in waiting on us and making sure we were taken care of.

reviews.author: Mo E.
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, staff were friendly and helpful. Not very ADA easy, there was still a lot of walking and I have knee and hip issues. Had to wait almost 40 minutes to make a dinner reservation to then be told the place I wanted was closed on the day I needed it. The property was a bit dated, it leaked in the Japanese restaurant at the table we were at and we were given a hard time about needing to move. They put a bucket next to a chair at the hibachi tabke expected my sister to sit there and get rain splatters while the chef cooked. Other than that, it was a good experience.

reviews.author: bkm
reviews.text: I selected this resort without doing very much research.  I figured, an all-inclusive is an all-inclusive.  You pretty much know what you’re signing up for—cheaply made frozen drinks, mediocre food, an ok room, and a beautiful pool/beach.  Well, having stayed at a couple, this place is definitely in another rank.  I sprung for the Royal Service, not really knowing what it was.  Well, it was totally worth it.  You get a private pool area, private bar area with higher end liquor, private beach area, and best of all a butler to make all your reservations and inquires FOR you...which is key at a large resort like this.   The resort as a whole is not a super young party crowd resort, which was nice.  It does cater to families, but is very good about keeping the adults only areas that way.  Coming from NYC, i found the restaurants to be ok...nothing amazing, but not bad at all.  You will need dinner reservations to any of them every night, unless you plan to eat at the buffet every night.  The buffet is definitely one of the best as well...i could’ve eaten there every day and been fine.  Carlos, our butler, was amazing.  We were very easy going but Carlos checked in on us every day at least twice, made all our reservations, and made our scuba diving trip offsite happen.  I’m not sure how many people they manage at a time, but he was super responsive via Whatsapp.  Pedro the beach attendant was also great.  He & Wanda at the Royal Service pool bar were always smiling & happy to accommodate anyone.  We did not attend any of the nightly shows, for no other reason than it’s what i do for work, so i didn’t care to see any on vacation.  The beach and pool are gorgeous and well kept.  The only major negatives i have is that the folks around the resort trying to sell tours or excursions gets old, and it seems the staff aren’t empowered to do very much outside the “script” at all.  We were forced to stay in the DR an additional night because of a snowstorm in NYC and we’re told BY THE HOTEL CHECK IN STAFF that we’d have to go online to book another night...which was WAY above what we originally paid, so we left the resort and went to another one for one night.  That was a shame and put a bad taste in my mouth right at the end.

reviews.author: Kimolin Crutcher
reviews.text:
The scenery was beautiful! We had lovely views of the grounds and property was well-maintained. 👍🏽

The staff was very friendly and always helpful. There were so many kind people, our housekeepers—I’m sorry, I didn’t get any names, but each day when we returned to our rooms, it was clear someone had tidied up. After dinner, our beds were turned down, chocolates  and slippers were in place. Perfecto! 👍🏽

Our accommodations were comfortable, sheets, mattress, very nice—but I did NOT like there was no full privacy in the water closet (toilet). I prefer a full door, not frosted glass, given that there is a semi-open concept floor plan (separated by shutters) between the bath/shower area and the bedroom. (The toilet area was basically set up like a public bathroom stall—3 full walls, 1 glass “door”—no bueno 👎🏽) Couples do not need to share EVERY moment with each other.

I also did not appreciate the time share presentation, which I usually avoid at resorts. However, the lure of gift store credit for souvenirs hooked my husband in this time; it’s a hard NO for me. 👎🏽

We liked the options on food, but reservations to the restaurants were not easy to obtain. Scheduling was tight. The buffet had a little something to offer everyone, but needed more variety from day to day. Fresh fruits and breakfast items seemed to be our favorites along with Dominican café con leche. Bueno! 👍🏽

The entertainment was good—we didn’t feel a need to leave the resort for music or dancing. We just wanted to relax, so the shows were enjoyable. Dance classes were fun, pool activities were nice. There was always something to do, we were never hungry, bored, or thirsty. Bueno! 👍🏽

Lastly, we had no incidents with “missing” items in our rooms, or otherwise. Security maintained a comforting presence, especially on the beach—not threatening or menacing, but inconspicuously visible, and observant—assuring that vendors for parasailing, jewelry, cigars, or whatever, maintained their distance—which brings me to the final comments.

I would return, and I would like a different type of room, an upgrade, if you will, where less walking was required, and I had fewer stairs. Sometimes I just want to rest.

reviews.author: Ryan Welborn
reviews.text:
The beach is by far the most beautiful one I've ever seen.  We really enjoyed the scenery, however the service was not quite as good as the Paradisus La Perla we stayed in in Mexico.  The food was very good and the resort is beautiful but my only complaint was the friendliness of some of the staff.  It seemed like a few of them held a bit of disdain for anyone who wasn't fluent in spanish.

I will say that the bartender at "M-Bar" -Victor (can't remember his last time - Medina or something like that) was exceptional!  Me and my wife actually went to that bar almost every night because of him - his drinks were the best we had down there and he made it impossible not to enjoy ourselves!  When you go make sure and have one of his margaritas or mojitos!  Excelente'!

reviews.author: Ken Liss
reviews.text: The renovations are almost complete (landscaping not done), but the place is fantastic. Modern, clean and beautiful.  They need to work on their service and the food could be a little better, but still a perfect place to vacation

reviews.author: Carl-Ulfert Stegmann
reviews.text: It was Great !! The whole team is good , exspecially Ismael made it through his positive  emotional welcome to quality time..;)!

reviews.author: Shadrack Osewe Ochola
reviews.text: All staff were excellent. Pedro, Juannly and the bellstaff team were excellent. Hope to work with the hotel again soon!

reviews.author: Bernardo Huyke
reviews.text:
Overall, the hotel is a luxurious, beautiful resort with very good facilities. The beaches and pools are also very good for those who want to relax and enjoy the sun and heat. The spa is excellent for relaxation with very professional service.

Now, what really leaves something to be desired is the food:

1) Breakfast: Score 9/10
Overall, everything was very good and there were good options. However, I believe that the items prepared for consumption should be changed more frequently (fresher) due to the heat and possible contact with insects. The coffee could also be left in a specific place where people can serve themselves without having to wait for the waiter to bring it. Many times it took a long time or the coffee even arrived cold.

2) Buffet Lunch: Score 2/10

Lunch was, I believe, the weakest point of our entire experience. Considering that we were in a 5-star resort, the minimum expected was well-seasoned, fresh food with healthy options as well. However, it was the opposite. The food, after a certain time, isn't replaced until it runs out. If it doesn't run out, they won't replace it. The taste is that of a regular restaurant, something you could eat anywhere, not at a resort. Finally, the options tended to be more fried and junk food than a healthy option if you wanted one.

3) Dinner at the themed restaurants: Score 8/10

Overall, the food is very good. However, the service could be more consistent. Sometimes we had a very helpful and kind waiter, other times it seemed like the person was lazy or unwilling to serve. Another suggestion: the Dominican restaurant (local food) needs to improve its menu; the food was bland. As for the steakhouse, the seasoning was very good, but the meat arrived extremely cold. The question that needs to be answered is: why do they leave the meat waiting so long after it's cooked? It's unacceptable to eat cold roast beef…

4) Room Service: Rating 0/10

Speechless. Besides waiting for more than 2 hours, the food arrived extremely cold and inedible. This is unacceptable for a resort.

5) Snacks and Lunch Food

There was the Kicks bar which was very good, but it was the only place where you could find smaller meals or appetizers. I believe they should have more of this type spread throughout the resort. Sometimes people don't want to eat at the buffet. They simply want to order some fries and chicken wings, something small and not far from the pools or the beach.

Once I asked near the beach, they told me I had to call room service or go to the buffet. Which also doesn't make much sense.

reviews.author: Valeria Tirado A.
reviews.text:
The hotel is very good; the facilities and architecture are beautiful, and the staff is very friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The service is excellent throughout the hotel.

The only downside is the food at night when the buffet is open at "Kanna." The open-air setting means the food gets cold quickly, and there aren't many options.
There are several restaurants where you can make reservations, but they fill up fast. However, Mrs. Marta from "The Lunch Box" approached us one day at breakfast, and when we explained the situation, she immediately helped us secure a reservation for the following days.

reviews.author: Veronica Andreoli
reviews.text:
The resort is very nice, and the beach is gorgeous.
There are several restaurants, but they all require reservations.
The buffet is okay, but you'd expect more for a hotel of this category.
The kids' club is great; they have a play area with stuffed animals for the little ones and another area with board games and crafts.
The staff are very friendly and attentive.
There were outdoor activities; they lent us toys for the pool and even took us to feed the turtles.
We especially enjoyed interacting with Sujeidy throughout our stay, who suggested fun and easy activities that we could easily recreate at home.
They definitely made our stay better!

reviews.author: Mauro Maresca
reviews.text: I appreciate the attentive and friendly service provided by María Ortiz, Yanira, and Rosanna at the breakfast bar in the morning. Luis and Víctor at the pool bar serve excellent drinks. I also want to commend the service provided by Hairo and Gregori at The Lunch Box. Finally, I'm grateful for the helpfulness of Mina, Wander, and Estebanni at the restaurant. I would definitely choose this hotel again, but they could improve some basic aspects of room service. I loved the entertainment provided by Dana, Alfredo, and Johan, both at the pool and in the evenings, who brought the hotel to life with their bachata, merengue, and salsa classes.

reviews.author: Vicky Ferrando
reviews.text:
The hotel is large and very nice. Perhaps it could use a bit more cleanliness in both the rooms and the main pool.
The lounge is too small for the number of guests, and it's not easy to find a seat.
Many of the employees argue amongst themselves; you can see a certain annoyance, and this is reflected in the service.
The evening activities are very quiet and family-oriented, a bit boring, perhaps if you're young.
The themed nights are good, but the service is somewhat lacking.
Access to the beach is very good; you can walk there in about 10 minutes or take a shuttle.
There's a restaurant on the beach. The umbrellas and lounge chairs are comfortable.
The breakfast is very good and varied. It's best to make restaurant reservations for the whole week in advance, as it will be difficult to find a table later. However, if you can't find a table, there's the general buffet.

reviews.author: María LS
reviews.text:
The HOTEL is beautiful and its facilities are spectacular.
ROOM: Swim Up, a complete success and incredibly comfortable for families with children. While they sleep, you can be in the pool since it's literally right outside the door. FUN REPUBLIK: wonderful for fun for both children and adults. BEACH: very well maintained, and the nets keep seaweed to a minimum in the water. It's also clear that they clean the sand every morning.

From the STAFF, I'd like to highlight:
- Laura, the dining room manager in the blue dress. A sweetheart, super attentive. We were traveling with four children, and she took care of every detail in all the services she provided. FANTASTIC.

- Rocio, the buffet waitress. Very helpful and friendly. She made our breakfasts and lunches very comfortable.

- Jean Carlos, the waiter who served us at Kanna and Mina. A true professional, one of the few you'll find at the hotel. He manages the dining room service with superior quality. GREAT.

- Juan, the tortilla chef. A true delight and very focused on service excellence. My nephew was allergic to fish, and every morning he had a special pan to ensure his omelet wasn't contaminated. Always with a smile, he's the epitome of PASSION FOR SERVICE.

reviews.author: Dimanche Lucero
reviews.text: The Paradisus Palma resort is the best of the best. The food and service were incredible; the adults-only pool is spectacular, with impeccable service. We were treated wonderfully all week, served the best drinks, and created a fantastic atmosphere. The experience was excellent from beginning to end, and special mention must be made of Fernando Chispa for his excellent service, his ability to connect with people, and the way he contributes to the resort's ambiance.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Sierra Ocampo
reviews.text:
The service was excellent, and the food was high quality. The specialty restaurants were very good. The rooms were spotless.
The only thing I would change, and request (because I intend to return), is that the pool water is freezing cold. We had a problem with the air conditioning; we wanted to lower the temperature, and it took them three days to address the issue. Our room phone never worked. I understand that I went during peak season, and they must be extremely busy with so many guests.
The Christmas dinner was lovely, and they completely change the buffet menu. Some of the waiters are very cheerful, energetic, and eager to work, but there are also many waiters who aren't very friendly or available, especially at the buffet.

reviews.author: Gevorg Khachatrian
reviews.text: Great hotel, everything was great except for the fact that they took a little money from me. The safe wasn't working when we checked in, I called support three times, they answered very quickly, but didn't do anything. Maybe the maids really needed it, thank goodness they didn't charge too much. Otherwise, everything was fine.

reviews.author: Martin Veron
reviews.text: Very nice atmosphere. Breakfast is a bit chaotic, lunchtime is quieter, but Jimbert and his colleagues always rose to the occasion. Very polite people!

reviews.author: laura gutierrez linero
reviews.text: Excellent experience thanks to Ericson, the best bartender at the Paradisus Palma Real. His service was friendly and professional, but the best thing, without a doubt, is that he makes the best margaritas in the hotel!

reviews.author: ALBERTO CARO BENADO
reviews.text:
Overall very good, but unfortunately the room service doesn't work well. I had problems with orders that didn't arrive, then the kitchens closed, and the worst part was that there was never any notification from management; the orders simply didn't arrive, or when I called they said they wouldn't.
The rest was fine.

reviews.author: Alejandra Campos Flores
reviews.text: Restaurant Flora has excellent service and exquisite Dominican food. We enjoyed it very much; for us, it was the best restaurant in the hotel, which is why we returned for a second visit. The people who served us—Raider, Santos, and others whose names I don't recall—were very kind and friendly. Our dinner was a pleasure from beginning to end. Thank you.

reviews.author: Camila Zuleta
reviews.text:
Beautiful and large hotel, although it has some maintenance issues.

Pools: Excellent. Super large and spacious for comfortable swimming. We used the main pool and the one behind our room in building 20. The only issue is that over time the tiles in the main pool are coming loose, and you risk getting hurt.

Common areas: Excellent decor and cleanliness.

Room: Very good. The bathtub in our room was beautiful, ideal for a soak after a day at the beach. Regarding cleaning, we don't know why, but the cleaning person took the hair conditioner on the second-to-last day, but luckily I had brought some from home. Also, one of the first days we found the nightstand on the floor after cleaning and the balcony door open. Room 2037 has some electrical problems, for example, with the air conditioner by the bed, which sometimes displays an error and requires a tap.

Food: Generally very good, especially if you don't have dietary restrictions like me, as I can't eat gluten due to my celiac disease. They should offer more gluten-free options and place indicators on each food item to show whether it's safe to eat or not, so you don't have to ask every two seconds. At breakfast, there were only rice cakes that were like cardboard, and dry bread. Only the first morning we were there were chocolate chip muffins, which were delicious. The next morning they were all gone, and I had to politely ask if they could get me some, and they gave me the last two they had. There's a real lack of information and training about gluten-free options. At the Flora restaurant, I was disappointed. Despite having indicated the day before when we made the reservation that I couldn't eat gluten, when we arrived and reminded them again, I was served toast with regular bread containing gluten, which my husband had to eat. Then, at dessert, I had no choice but to watch my husband eat his. On the other hand, at the MINA restaurant, there was a situation I noticed where the waiter brought my gluten-free bread on the same plate as the regular bread, and the maître d' stopped him, although I realized the mistake. When they brought it "correctly," I didn't eat it because I was suspicious. Otherwise, everything was fine.

They should add more natural juices to the bar. Not everyone drinks alcohol, nor do we all want to drink artificial juices or just water.

The workshop activities are wonderful and highly recommended.

Another thing they should add is bicycles so people can get around the large grounds; it would be a great activity.

Even though we mentioned we were on our honeymoon, we didn't receive any special attention from the hotel, even though we had just stayed at another hotel where they did provide us with thoughtful touches.

I recommend this hotel for couples or groups of friends.

reviews.author: Ayrton Marte
reviews.text: The coffee shop has excellent service, superior to all other areas. Altagracia and Chantal are very kind and attentive. 10/10

reviews.author: MIGUEL ANGEL TAGLIAPIETRA
reviews.text:
The service I received upon check-in was extremely unpleasant. The person who helped me wanted to charge me for an extra day's stay, given that our return flight was in the afternoon, and if I stayed until noon, I would have to pay for a new room. We argued for over half an hour until I asked someone else to help me. It was a terrible introduction to my vacation. Furthermore, I wanted to use my membership credits to cancel the All-Inclusive package, which they refused to accept, and I canceled with USD.
The saddest thing was that in a later conversation with another member of the staff, they asked me why I didn't use my points to cancel.
As for the service at the apartment, it left a lot to be desired.
They provided a complimentary coffee maker with very good coffee capsules, but they didn't even leave a teaspoon; in fact, they didn't leave any items at all. And finally, this happened on the third or fourth day of my stay. Upon leaving the apartment, I ran into the room service person and politely asked if I could leave the door open, to which she indicated it wasn't necessary and would take care of it in a moment. Conclusion: the room wasn't made up. When I complained about the unfinished service, they sent me a photo of a red sensor outside the apartment indicating do not disturb. (Speechless)
I still love the place and the attention most of the staff provides. I'll definitely return to this place again, since I have four weeks a year.

reviews.author: Katherine Cabrera
reviews.text: I stayed at this resort for two nights and three days. My friends and I had a fantastic time. The pool bar staff were excellent, especially Victor and Eddy. They are the epitome of excellent customer service. They were incredibly attentive and made sure we had a great time at the pool bar. We also received excellent service from Johlfrey. That guy has such a cool energy that it makes the resort activities so much fun. He really knows how to liven up the music and enjoys it immensely, which makes you feel like you're experiencing the party atmosphere to the fullest. Thank you to these excellent staff members at the Paradisus Meliá for the wonderful experience and their attentive service.

reviews.author: beatriz Salgueiros
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, the experience wasn't comparable to a 5-star hotel.
Restaurant reservations required a specific time slot, with long lines, unlike other hotels with a booking app.
The Flora restaurant was the worst in terms of food, reheated. It's worth noting that both the waiters and the rest of the staff were excellent.
The restaurants were always noisy, where it should have been a warm and relaxed atmosphere.

Full of drunken graduates shouting all over the hotel.

Based on several trips to Punta Cana to different hotels of the same category, I would never choose this hotel again.

reviews.author: Karina Laredo
reviews.text: The hotel is really nice, but there are several things that need improvement. First, the privacy of the shower area compared to the rest of the room (I think they assume only couples stay there). But I went with a friend, and it was a bit uncomfortable. Also, everything in the bar and throughout the hotel closes at 1 a.m., which is very early.

reviews.author: Yesica Fernández
reviews.text: I loved Jairo's class, it was really cool and especially fun 🫶🏼🫶🏼

reviews.author: Igor Alencar
reviews.text: Excellent rooms and service, diverse restaurant options. It's very far from the airport.

reviews.author: Charina De la Cruz
reviews.text: A very good experience. I'd like to highlight César's service at the Flora restaurant and his recommendations, which were spectacular!

reviews.author: Elianet Castillo
reviews.text: Overall, the service from the moment we arrived was excellent. We were assigned a person (Andres) to assist us with our dinner reservations, and thanks to him, we were able to get them. The entire staff provided excellent service. We had two issues with the room: the refrigerator wasn't cooling, and there was no hot water in the bathtub, but these were resolved promptly after we reported them. The food and drinks were fine. The beers at the sports bar were good. The pool was very nice, though it would benefit from some shaded areas. The beach had a lot of sargassum, so we couldn't swim.

reviews.author: Rafael Pacheco
reviews.text: The room was simply spectacular, I've never stayed anywhere like it. The beach was wonderful, and the hotel facilities were very good. The service was quite reasonable; practically 100% of the staff stared at you, expecting a tip. I believe it's a cultural thing, but I don't think that kind of attitude is right in a resort of this standard. They kept pressuring us to drink a local beer, probably a cheaper one. They made it difficult to serve Heineken or Corona.

reviews.author: Felipe Gallo
reviews.text: It's difficult to rate this hotel because if you compare it to other famous chains like Riu, Iberostar, or Wyndham, this one is far superior. But to truly compare it, you have to do so with an ultra-luxury hotel, and I don't think it even comes close. However, if you're considering it over one of those, don't hesitate. This is the one. The rooms are modern, enormous, and the amenities are luxurious. The food at the à la carte restaurants is very good, and the buffet is average. The cocktails and the staff's service in general are outstanding. They treat you very well. The kids' club is also fantastic. My 4-year-old daughter didn't want to leave. The staff are very attentive, and there are many activities for children. As for the beach, if you go during sargassum season, this is the best because they have a barrier that protects against the seaweed. I'm not saying it leaves a decent beach or a beautiful color, but you can swim without too much seaweed. I must highlight the staff's service in general. Very nice people and very helpful. It's definitely worth the price. You'll have a good time.

reviews.author: Vany Yoon
reviews.text: Mascalzone Italian Restaurant is truly outstanding. During our stay, we visited twice because the food was excellent, but the service was also superb. The restaurant is suitable for couples and large families with young children. The very helpful waiters (Braily and Ana) took all our preferences into account. Chef Tojeilin put his personal touch on the entire menu, which is highly recommended, from the calzones to the pasta and desserts.

reviews.author: Angelica Angulo
reviews.text: Incredible experience at Bar Run Republic! Miguel and Melvin are simply the best: super friendly, attentive, and with such great energy that you want to stay all night. The martinis they make are next level, definitely the best I've ever had. If you're looking for good vibes, excellent service, and spectacular drinks, this is the place. Thanks, Miguel and Melvin, for a perfect night!

reviews.author: Ovahe Tepano
reviews.text:
Congratulations to Melvin and Pablo – the best bartenders in Paradise ✨
I want to sincerely thank and congratulate Melvin and Pablo for their kindness, professionalism, and charisma. Every cocktail was prepared with attention to detail, but what truly made the difference was their positive energy, constant smiles, and exceptional service.
They make any afternoon unforgettable. Thank you for being part of this perfect experience in Punta Cana!

reviews.author: Joaquim Mentor de Souza Couto Júnior
reviews.text:
Tokimeku - Great experience at Paradisus Palma Real! Well-executed cuisine and standard Meliá service. María and Franklin masterfully embody Dominican hospitality! Bravo!

Normally, the service at the Meliá resort is impeccable. However, at this resort, the service is far below expectations. Poorly managed member service, rude waiters, serious errors, completely non-existent beach service – errors that are uncommon for Meliá hotels. I imagine that if the service is this bad for Circle Black members, how much more must regular guests or new members suffer. In this scenario of disinterest, laziness, and terrible management that plagues the service at Paradisus, Franklin and Maria remind me why I chose the Meliá chain. Congratulations on keeping alive the tradition of hospitality and joy of the Meliá chain and Punta Cana.

reviews.author: Natascia Trocciolone
reviews.text: We had the privilege of staying at the Melia Paradisus Palma Real Resort (Adults Only). It was a pleasant stay that allowed us to relax and unwind from the demands of everyday life. We would like to express our appreciation to the staff, including our concierge, Basilio. His daily inquiries about our well-being and impressions were a welcome opportunity to give and receive feedback. As in most resorts, even the best resorts occasionally experience unfortunate incidents. Unfortunately, the internet connection was unavailable at the beginning of our stay. However, our concierge addressed this immediately and had the problem resolved within two days. Sadly, the weather didn't cooperate, and the romantic dinner we had booked at considerable expense had to be moved indoors. I wish we had been asked if we would prefer to reschedule. The staff always did their best, although there were occasional instances of a lack of communication. The restaurant staff were consistently attentive and friendly. I always enjoyed chatting and talking with you. The staff always introduced themselves by name and took great care of the guests. The activities group also did a fantastic job and kept the guests motivated. I especially enjoyed the dancing. Unfortunately, I don't remember everyone's names, so I'd like to thank the entire team who contributed to my feeling so comfortable and able to relax.

reviews.author: Christine Lizotte
reviews.text: A very, very nice room with friendly staff. The buffet was also very good, but acceptable for a 5-star hotel. What I appreciated most was the beach with its super comfy cushions. And above all, there was always space available at any time of day. Overall, we had an excellent holiday.

reviews.author: Layanne Silva
reviews.text: The activities team is fantastic. Freilyn and Carlos made all the difference during our stay. The shows are incredible too, very well produced.

reviews.author: MANUEL GONZÁLEZ
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, very new, and the rooms are beautiful and spacious. They have a good range of activities, both day and night, including tastings, dance classes, and evening entertainment. Brandol was a standout on the entertainment team; he made sure we had a great time.

The food, however, is another story. It leaves much to be desired. If you're expecting a 5-star hotel where you expect the same level of service, this isn't the place for you. It really spoiled our stay, as we spent the whole week hoping one of their restaurants would be even remotely appealing, only to find that each one was worse than the last… In short, it was the worst Meliá hotel we've stayed at in terms of service. The facilities, on the other hand, are wonderful.

reviews.author: Constantino Quero
reviews.text:
Spectacular 5-star luxury all-inclusive hotel with 11 pools and super attentive staff who go the extra mile to ensure you have an incredible time. Special mention to Flora, Samaria, and, of course, Laura, the hostess at the Blue Agave restaurant. All of them were very attentive and definitely enhanced our experience.

The food in the restaurants is exquisite, although you should book in advance or you won't be left without a spot. The relaxation areas are dreamy, and the rooms have beautiful views. There's so much to do that sometimes you can't decide; it's huge.

I recommend going between September and October when there are fewer people and you can enjoy it more.

We really loved it. I'm giving it 4 stars, not 5, because the beaches aren't really that great, but if you like pools, good food, and drinks, you'll feel like royalty.

Rooms are around 500 euros (approx.) per night with breakfast.

reviews.author: Gustavo De oleo
reviews.text: We went to the Mexican restaurant, where service was excellent, especially from Santos and José. The service was exquisite, the food delivered on time, and the live music was very enjoyable. Highly recommended. The rooms were spotless. The only complaint would be more dining options during the day.

reviews.author: Dra. Doris Ramirez
reviews.text: Excellent facilities. Excellent experience. Suggestions: improve the quality of the wines and the coffee (I didn't even have a moderate cup), and improve the service at breakfast. Otherwise, an excellent option.

reviews.author: Rodrigo Ramos
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed for 8 days at The Reserve, at the Paradisus Palma Real. Well, I will list the positive and negative aspects of the stay. This was the third time we have stayed at a Melia resort, and the second time in Punta Cana. As positive aspects, I mention the hotel's structure, with large and clean pools, impeccable gardens, everything clean and well maintained. The accommodations are very close to the beach and other areas (pools, restaurants, etc.). I really liked the architecture of the place, reminiscent of a colonial building. The "All Inclusive" worked perfectly, with unlimited food, good drinks and restocking of the minibar.

During the stay, we had the support of Ralphy, as concierge.

The service was reasonable. However, we highlight the service of Luz, at the Santè restaurant, the staff at the "adults only" beach kiosk (96 Fahrenheit), especially Gilberto, and the chambermaids. We recommend the Santé, Flora and Mina restaurants.
Regarding the negative aspects, I would like to point out that the hotel falls short in some details, such as the last renovation, which was insufficient, with poorly executed touch-ups being noticeable, a fact that is striking in a hotel of this category. I felt that there are few restaurant options compared to other hotels in the same category and even within the Meliá chain itself. We did not like the Tokimeku restaurant.
A very bad thing happened during the weekend we were staying there. A large group of guests, mostly young people, stayed over the weekend, making a lot of noise and commotion, especially during the early morning hours. Part of the group stayed in the room opposite ours, and during the early morning hours we heard shouting, doors slamming, music, and loud conversations. This group made a lot of noise, even carrying speakers, and smoked strong-smelling cigarettes during the day by the pools, visibly bothering other guests. At that moment, I regretted staying in the "Adults Only" area. I informed the concierge, and he advised me to contact security. It wasn't necessary, as the group left on Monday. However, we were left with the impression that the hotel didn't enforce its rules (or that it didn't have any rules).
Overall, considering all aspects, I rated the accommodation as very good, worth the price paid, but I probably won't stay at the Paradisus Palma Real again, although I will certainly stay at other hotels in the Meliá chain.

reviews.author: Daniela Miranda
reviews.text:
We went to Mascalzone, and I want to highlight the attention and care that Milton and Jessica showed us during our stay. It's definitely a place you should visit and follow the staff's recommendations.
Also, if you have the chance to go to Sante and be served by Rosa, don't miss it. The staff's service at the hotel is the best.

reviews.author: GALY REYES
reviews.text: In my experience, the hotel service was terrible. However, at Flora Restaurant, the dishes were exquisite, and Raider's service exceeded my expectations. Raider clearly loves what he does. Thank you, Raider, for your service!

reviews.author: Gabriela Esposito Herter
reviews.text: The hotel's structure is great. Beautiful beach view, really nice pools, and the rooms are very good. But it's not worth the price; I would choose another hotel on my next trip to Punta Cana. The food is okay, only the breakfast is really good. The desserts look like they were 3D printed, beautiful but tasteless, terrible. Dinners can be booked at the "nicer" restaurants, but they are set experiences where you don't choose what you're going to eat. It's better than the buffet, but still only okay. The open bar is also okay, drinks are kind of watered down and vary quite a bit in quality from bar to bar. In short, it's very beautiful, the room is very good, food and drinks are okay. Oh, we went on the traditional package; the experience can be completely different if you stay at "The Reserve" or are part of the Circle Club.

reviews.author: Carlos Riboldi - RS Pneus | Curitiba - PR
reviews.text:
The hotel's facilities are very good; it's an excellent option for a great vacation.

Some of the staff aren't great, but some are excellent, such as the bartenders at the main pool, Jorge Jhonatan, Luiz, and Edi, who work with enthusiasm and quality.

reviews.author: Amara Cf
reviews.text:
We've known this hotel since it opened, and over the years it's only gotten worse.
The service and customer service have nothing to do with the exclusivity, luxury, and personalization of the past. Some staff members are rude and disrespectful, like Andino Jiménez and the hostess who accompanied him, who tried to make fun of us by not assigning us our reserved table because we arrived 10 minutes early.
Overall, the food is quite poor for a hotel of this category, but the chefs at Santé Restaurant always try their best to achieve their goals. Thanks to Sántos for his delicious paellas, to Roberto for his kindness and wonderful cuisine, and to Rafa, who, in addition to being a tremendous professional, is an excellent person.
The team at Santé Restaurant is among the best. From Barnelis, who greets you at the entrance, to Franklin, to Manuel... and of course, I'd like to highlight the work of Norjandro, who pays attention to every detail and is an excellent professional.
The Flora restaurant is one of the most recommended, and the manager, Eduardo, is one of the best people at the hotel, distinguished by his professionalism and dedication. Thanks to him and his team for making us feel at home and introducing us to typical Dominican dishes.
The exclusive beach area is spectacular, and the service from Martín and Rafael is incredible. Pedro is always on top of everything, and after so many years, we already consider him part of the family.
Gilberto is the bartender, and we'd like to thank him for his lemonades.
A negative point is the lack of security in the area, as people from outside The Reserve sometimes enter. We also had a problem with harassment from individuals walking with animals on the beach, offering photos, although, thanks to Alvaro Fernández and the rest of the team, it was finally resolved by increasing security.
The concierges help you with reservations and other arrangements, so you don't have to worry about a thing. Thanks to Nicolás for his "old-school" attention and to Félix for his patience.
Meliá should pay more attention to these small details so the hotel can regain its former splendor.

reviews.author: Felipe A. Durán Rodríguez
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, but Carolina at the lobby bar is incredibly helpful and cheerful. If you're feeling down, she knows how to cheer you up, even the most listless person. The staff at the Paradisus Palma Real Hotel are excellent.

reviews.author: Ruben Díaz
reviews.text:
A great experience.
We stayed at this resort from June 24th and overall it was very comfortable. The staff is amazing, and although it's a quiet resort, it's not boring at all 😒. There's a very family-friendly atmosphere. The sports bar 🍸 is the liveliest place at night. I must mention two people who deserve special recognition for their professional work and top-notch service: Yafreysi and Ricki from the breakfast buffet. Thank you for your attention. The shows are good, the lobby bar is very welcoming for a pleasant time, the room was perfect with a view of the adults-only pool, and the food was good, although we had a bad experience at dinner at the buffet. The large baked fish was cold and tough, as if it had been sitting there since lunchtime. I mentioned it to the person there, and they replied that it would be good with lemon. Overall, it was a great experience!!

reviews.author: Ignacio Andregnette
reviews.text: Rocío was very kind at the buffet.

reviews.author: Livia García Santiago
reviews.text: Excellent service for our son Alfonso. Friendly and kind staff. Our son had a wonderful experience at the kids' club. I especially want to thank Alexandra, Martha, Sujeidy, and Yessica for making my son's birthday an unforgettable experience.

reviews.author: IVAN G G
reviews.text: The truth is the hotel is beautiful, the service from the employees leaves a little to be desired because they only cater to the Americans, the drinks only taste good at the sports bar because the pool bars are bad, the food at the different restaurants is really good.

reviews.author: Enzo Pinchetti
reviews.text:
Stephania provided incredible service at Flora Restaurant.
Dauris from the minibar service was very attentive.
At Ginger Bar, Yirl and her team gave us excellent service throughout our stay.
Rafael and José provided excellent service at Tokimeku Restaurant during our dinner.
Jean Carlos at Mina Restaurant was outstanding, and the food was incredible. Thank you so much for such great service!

reviews.author: Camila Borrero
reviews.text: The hotel is very good. If you want to relax and have a luxurious experience, this is the place. When I arrived, it took quite a while to assign me a room—around four hours—which doesn't exactly help to start a great vacation. The hotel is currently experiencing low occupancy, so not all services are available, such as access to all the restaurants. The Flora restaurant is excellent, and the service is outstanding.

reviews.author: Anthea Domnas
reviews.text:
The staff here made a difference.

#1. Dana, Activities
#1. Pedro, Beach
#1. Estabania, Hostess Mina
#1. Franklin, Sante, Manager
#1. Santos, Sante
#1. Barnelis, Hostess Sante
#1. Melqui

reviews.author: Gonzalo
reviews.text: The concierge service is a 10; I've noticed that some restaurants are overwhelmed with the number of waiters.

reviews.author: Loïc Lemarier
reviews.text:
It was our first time at the Hotel Paradisus.

We had a comfortable and spacious room for the four of us with our two children.

The hotel is well located with beach access.
The atmosphere and service were truly excellent, especially our concierge who answered all our requests—we thank him (Emmanuel).
The Swim-Up room is a real treat; you can enjoy it at any time of day—pure bliss for the children!

The only downside was the buffet! There wasn't much choice for a hotel at this price.

reviews.author: Ana Berbel
reviews.text:
