A month ago, we celebrated our 55th wedding anniversary with a 9-night stay at The Reserve, in a suite with direct pool access. It was an excellent choice, as we were truly able to enjoy the peace and comfort we had been longing for. The resort delivered on all the amenities offered, and we loved being just steps from the beach to watch the sunrise.
Regarding the food, I must highlight two restaurants: Flora, dedicated to traditional Dominican cuisine, and Santé, focused on Mediterranean gastronomy. In both places, the staff was incredibly friendly. At Flora, the freshness of the ingredients and the personalized attention in helping us choose our dishes were particularly noteworthy. In fact, I highly recommend trying the delicious Sancocho and the traditional Mofongos.
As for Santé, it deserves special mention, as it became our favorite spot for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. The atmosphere is inviting thanks to its decor and location; The waiters, true professionals, stand out for their friendliness, and the chef creates dishes that are captivating at first sight and then won over with their flavor.

At this point, my husband and I wish to express our sincere gratitude to Zenovia, our concierge, for her excellent work and for making our stay at Paradisus wonderful and unforgettable.

Although we arrived at the hotel at ten o'clock at night, she was waiting for us at reception. From the very first moment, she stood out for her kindness and willingness to make us feel welcome. What impressed us most about her was her dedication to ensuring that every aspect of our stay was perfect. Beyond her usual responsibilities, she constantly went out of her way to anticipate our needs. The memory of her hospitality and warmth will stay with us forever. Thank you, Zenovia!

reviews.author: Amanda Carvalho
reviews.text: We had a wonderful few days at The Reserve in Paradisus Palma Real. We stayed at the 90 Degrees bar and received spectacular service from the bartender Alberto and Raissa, who were super helpful and attentive.

reviews.author: Arturo Paz
reviews.text:
Maira and Georgina took excellent care of us during our stay. They provided outstanding service during breakfast.
It's so nice to start the day with a smile and good food.

The hotel isn't very big, but it's very welcoming, and the facilities are top-notch. We had three rooms (for six people), all luxurious and different. For us (my wife and daughter), we requested a suite with access to the pool, which we thought was excellent. My daughter loved it because it had a private floor and she felt comfortable.

The concierge service is ridiculous. Its only function is to reserve dinners, but they have no priority, and therefore, if you come in a group or with a large family, the possibility of getting reservations at the most popular restaurants is minimal or nonexistent.

Fortunately, after complaining to management, this whole problem was resolved.

The beach is wonderful, and the bar service is excellent.

Overall, I recommend it 90%, but don't request concierge service, at least until they are given more authority.

reviews.author: Maria Belen Herrera
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, the rooms spacious and comfortable for both rest and work. It was a lovely experience with the staff very helpful.
The food was delicious and varied, although we found some restaurants to be less attentive than they used to be.
I'd like to highlight the magnificent María, who made us the best cocktails of our stay, at the bar, which is located between the Japanese and steak houses. Very professional, friendly, and helpful. Thank you!

reviews.author: Carla Pérez
reviews.text: It was a great experience, with excellent service, snacks, and drinks. Some of the staff who helped make this experience magical were Andreina, Antonio, Altagracia, Dominga, Jorge, and Clari.

reviews.author: Jorge Salibe
reviews.text:
The hotel is very good. The people in the restaurant, pool area, and beach are very attentive.
Special thanks to Arisleida who treated us very well every day, helping a lot with our baby and with drinks on the beach.

The reception staff weren't very helpful, which spoiled the experience. The room wasn't cleaned for 2 days, even after we asked 3 times for it to be done.

Luckily, Arisleida made up for all of that with her good humor and cheerfulness with us.

reviews.author: maria leon
reviews.text:
The resort is stunning, exquisitely decorated, and very clean. The room was very nice; we had every luxury. The dining experience at the themed restaurants isn't great, but the buffet offers a wide variety and delicious food. On the other hand, the waiter service is a bit terrible, despite the large staff. When you ask for something, they sometimes get annoyed and take ages to bring it to you.
The children's activities staff are pure love with the little ones, very attentive and caring. The children's activities area is spotless.
The pool area is very well maintained, with the lifeguard always on duty, although the pool is a bit run down, and the interior lights were out with the wires in the water, which didn't give me a very good feeling about having electricity and water together.
The beach was very nice, with hardly any seaweed, and we also had waiter service. The only annoying thing is the "vendors" who walk along the beach looking for customers, as several pass by constantly and annoy you with their insistence.

The only downside is that they steal from the rooms. We had the misfortune of leaving our wallet on the table in our room for two hours on the day of our departure while we went down to breakfast, and when we returned to collect our things, €100 was missing. Fortunately, the security system was very effective, as was the staff's response to the situation, doing everything they could to resolve it. In less than two hours, they found who stole the money and took action. I am eternally grateful to the guy who helped me at the front desk (I don't remember his name) as well as to the security guard. Thank you!

reviews.author: chula Robino
reviews.text:
We loved the Italian restaurant. The food was excellent, and the service and attention were outstanding.
Our waiter, Yennsen, served us impeccably, and Milton's recommendations were invaluable in helping us choose our dishes. Highly recommended, mainly because of the staff's helpfulness and friendliness.

reviews.author: Scarlett Diaz
reviews.text:
We spent a weekend at the hotel and everything was excellent. The staff we interacted with was very friendly throughout, the food was delicious, and there were always varied activities throughout the day.

Special thanks to our concierge, Nathanael Montilla, who was very attentive to us at all times and assisted us on more than one occasion during our stay.

I highly recommend it for a couple's vacation. We hope to return soon.

reviews.author: Juan Cruz
reviews.text:
The stay was incredible and the service was excellent. The guys at the Celsius pool bar were great, especially Victor and Luis.
And what can I say about the service from Arisleida and Jesús in the pool area? We loved everything; they were fantastic. I would come back a thousand times over.

reviews.author: Benjamín Díaz Villarreal
reviews.text:
The hotel is comfortable and beautiful, with spacious rooms full of amenities. The beach is clean and has plenty of lounge chairs for spending the day. The sea has dreamy colors.

The food in any of the restaurants is one-dimensional. There are no surprises in the dishes. They lack care in their preparation. The plating is simple, without artistry.

The service is very good. At Malva, Sandra, Manuel, and Jon are always attentive to your needs. At Blue Agave, Virtudes will make sure you have everything you need.

The Lunch Box buffet is varied and full of options, although bland.

The entire hotel is extremely clean and spotless, and the staff is very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Francisco Baptista22
reviews.text:
We were treated extremely well. The food, the best restaurant was Palazzo, wonderful, very good service. Our concierge Eliezer was very attentive and helped us with all the tours and things we wanted. I loved trying the drinks at the resort bars, Victor from Gabi Beach made some incredible ones. But Luis Desa from the bar in front of the Vento restaurant was the best. He invented a drink with mamajuana (a typical drink) for me.
The entertainers were super fun, Alejandro (Happy Boy) and Jairo were always cheering everyone up. And they dance very well! I learned a few things from them. Every night there is a different event at the resort, with parties and dances. But my favorite was the circus show. I was fascinated. They were really very good.

reviews.author: Andres Nieme
reviews.text: I had dinner at Mascalzone and everything was very good; the service from Milton and the team was by far the best; it makes the experience unique.

reviews.author: Diego González
reviews.text:
A high-end resort-style hotel. The room was pleasant. There are plenty of pools, so you can easily switch them up. It doesn't make sense to close the pool bar at 6 pm; it's too early, especially if you're attending an event. The buffet food could be improved.
One downside is the sargassum seaweed, which isn't their fault, but the Caribbean isn't right in front of the hotel anymore. That's a shame.

reviews.author: Ainhoa Azqueta
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, clean, and well-maintained. The room was perfect; we were in the adults-only area with direct access to the garden and a view of the pool. The service was often very slow. The food was very good.
We did miss having more entertainment, both during the day and in the evenings. On weekdays, the show ended around 9:30 pm, and only one of the bars remained open, closing at 12:30 am.
We appreciate the service provided by Ernesto, who was attentive from the very beginning to ensure our stay was perfect. We also want to mention the bartenders at the 90 Degrees bar, Teofilo and Eddie, who always served us with a smile, were very attentive, and provided pleasant conversation.

reviews.author: Pamela Reynoso
reviews.text:
Breakfast was lovely; my family and I felt very well taken care of, with genuine attention and smiles. I remember the first breakfast, Martha and Hilda.

Yaneiri joined us later and also added to the excellent service.

Thank you!

reviews.author: Paloma Alameda
reviews.text: The best part was the wonderful service at the Kana Paradisus restaurant. Felix was attentive to our needs the whole time. A truly charming man. We'll be back tomorrow.

reviews.author: Karla Alcántara
reviews.text:
Waking up early to enjoy a colorful, vibrant sunrise that illuminates the visitor's skin. This time, the Paradisus Palma Real is a hotel with a concept of well-being, tranquility, and relaxation.

In short, it's a hotel complex that offers peace and quiet as guests stroll between their rooms and attractions like the spa, pools, restaurants, or the beach.

Here, I spend my days by the pool, chatting and enjoying drinks at the bar; and in the afternoon, I'm on the beach, enjoying the waves and watching the sunset.

reviews.author: Andres Palacio
reviews.text: Jesús P. from customer service made our stay incredible. He brightened our day with his energy and charisma; he's a very attentive and friendly person. People like him make it worth coming back. As for the hotel, it has very elegant, cool, and varied facilities, along with the activities organized every day. It's a great place to have a vacation. However, they should replace the sofa beds in the rooms, as they are very uncomfortable to sleep on.

reviews.author: El Canal De Thiago
reviews.text: A very nice hotel, the food here is exceptional; the buffet rivals any à la carte restaurant. The hotel has a beautiful view; however, the service needs improvement. It's very slow, and some waiters are rude. There's clearly a service deficit, as many subcontracted staff seemed clueless about what they were doing. One day at breakfast, two waitresses were arguing in front of all the guests. The reception staff is very friendly, and the best service comes from the bellhops: kind, attentive, and very efficient. If they improve their food and beverage service, this hotel will be one of the best in the area.

reviews.author: Ellen Barends
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach, hotel in decline, but they have a new general manager, transferred from the Meliá in Palma de Mallorca, to revive it. The Royal Service restaurant is the best of all: excellent service, especially from Juan De Aza and his staff: Miguel Jimenez, Richard Ortiz, Osvaldo Acosta, Felix Garcia, and the receptionist, Alicia Direché. The chef is fantastic! We ended up having dinner there one week of our 12-day stay!

I appreciate the excellent service from Santé, Juan, Franklin, Gustavo, the receptionists, and the exceptional chef Rafael. I am very grateful to everyone who works here.

reviews.author: Fernando Alvarez
reviews.text: Very friendly staff with a great attitude.

reviews.author: Natalia Monteverde
reviews.text: The place was lovely and the service was excellent; everyone was very friendly and attentive. However, the buffet food could have offered more variety and flavor. A very good hotel overall, and I hope to return soon!

reviews.author: Mar Freniche
reviews.text: All the staff are very friendly and helpful, always with a big smile on their face. The rooms are perfect. The only problem was that at the Mina restaurant, the waiters weren't very attentive; we had to ask for the same drink several times. But overall, very good.

reviews.author: Natalia De Los Ángeles Parada Acuña
reviews.text:
The hotel is very nice, and the Circle staff is very friendly.
Especially at Ginger Bar, the staff was excellent, offering warmth, good service, cheerfulness, friendliness, and dedication to every detail. I would especially like to mention Luis Desa and Ismael Lizardo, who made us feel very welcome with every attention they received.
However, overall service could be improved, as not all staff provide excellent service, including information about meals and schedules, room cleaning, and water refills.

reviews.author: Giovana Perlin
reviews.text:
The hotel has a wonderful space, very well maintained and decorated. The room is even more beautiful than in the photos, everything is very comfortable. The beach is very beautiful and you can walk to the left and right. To the right, about 3 km walking, even more beautiful beaches.
Food and drinks OK. Highlights for the Japanese restaurant and for Sal, for meats.
I do not recommend the group tour to Saona Island. Very tiring and with many people. But since the island is beautiful, I imagine that renting a speedboat is the solution.

reviews.author: pamela gil
reviews.text:
What I liked most about the hotel is the excellent cocktail menu. Pop-up bars are everywhere. They offer variety and are always innovating, like the guys at Ginger Bar in the lobby. Especially Ismael and Antonio, who do a very, very good job.
Congratulations.

reviews.author: Ricardo Carmona
reviews.text: Flora restaurant has a good selection of Dominican food; we were served by a young man named Cesar who was very friendly.

reviews.author: Vania Ramirez
reviews.text:
The hotel had lovely facilities; my room had a pool since it was on the first floor.
There was a variety of restaurants, not just the typical resort fare. Our favorite was Mina de Carnes, where Kendal always provided excellent service. We also enjoyed Kao, an Asian restaurant with a wide selection of proteins.
Our concierge, Cristian Santana, was always very attentive and helpful in addressing our needs, even after hours or late in the day. He was a great help during our week-long stay and an excellent employee.
The service at Mangu and Agua Marina was quite slow.
Zamil at Mangu always gave us the best service, and Angel at Agua Marina also helped us with some special requests. Everyone at the main pool bar was very friendly, especially Osvaldo, who was always very kind and attentive. Michael delivered drinks to the lounge chairs by the main pool and the private pools in the rooms, always in a great mood and eager to make sure we had everything we needed. It's a new hotel, always clean; however, there were no trash cans in the common areas or gardens.
To get to the beach, you have to take a golf cart since the hotel is set back from the beach.
There are quite a few unusual activities, such as cocktail making, painting, tennis lessons, water aerobics, and yoga on the beach, among others. The buffet always has everything fresh and a great variety of food, and the waiters and waitresses are always attentive in serving drinks, clearing dirty dishes, etc. What I didn't like is that I didn't find the Caribbean or the country's culture represented in the hotel, since I personally love Dominican coffee, which I can only find in this country. At the hotel, they only offer it in the mornings at the buffet. The other coffees they offer in the restaurants and bars are Nespresso brand, which can be found in many parts of the world. There are also no coconuts, which are so characteristic of the Caribbean. The music is mostly in English, with little merengue, bachata, or salsa, which are typical of the Dominican Republic. The shows are boring, in my personal opinion.
As a suggestion, the shows could be improved. They should also install non-slip mats in the restrooms next to the main pool, as I had a fall that, being seven months pregnant, could have been serious. The wet floor in that area is normal since guests arrive wet from the pool.
However, as the days went by, everything was fine. It's appreciated that guests are given mosquito repellent. It's a great help for those of us with allergies.
It was a pleasant stay, but it could have been better.

reviews.author: Moni Reyes
reviews.text:
To enjoy the world's best beaches during the off-season...
Personalized service, themed restaurants...
On one downside, the buffet food wasn't fantastic, and the other restaurants were sometimes a bit crowded, making it difficult to make reservations.
The rooms were spacious and very clean, with striking bathrooms...including a Jacuzzi.

reviews.author: Francesco G. Caolo (frac78)
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real for over a week for a convention.
During my stay, I was able to appreciate all the hotel's amenities.
Let's start with the room, which was actually a mini-apartment equipped with every comfort: a huge shower with hydromassage jets, a spacious bathroom, a whirlpool tub, a very comfortable double bed, a kitchen, and a small terrace.

Let's move on to the food: the "problem" with these facilities is that you always have food! And at the Paradisus, the food is good. There are numerous restaurants, each with different specialties. I ate often at Naos, both for breakfast and lunch. It's a self-service restaurant with international cuisine, always fresh and prepared to order.
The Italian restaurant Palazzo is worth a mention. Despite my skepticism, I found the quality excellent, especially the meat.
The Gabi Beach restaurant was very good, where I ate excellent grilled lobster.
Finally, let's not forget the Market Grill, with grilled burgers and all kinds of sauces.
And then there are the many bars, where you can drink excellent rum and cocktails of all kinds.

The Yhi Spa is very beautiful. It feels like entering another world of relaxation, with a very hot pool, a whirlpool, and the option of all kinds of massages (extra).

The beach is fantastic, enormous, with fine sand. The sea is a little less beautiful, always choppy and full of seaweed.

The offices are good, spacious and with very fast wireless internet.
The conference rooms are even better, with attentive staff and high-quality technical equipment.

The facility, in short, is enormous. Given my work commitments, I wasn't able to fully experience it, but I still appreciated many of the services.

Before concluding, I must applaud Marta Cabrera, of the Paradisus staff, who looked after us throughout our stay, helping and supporting us at all hours, and accommodating all our requests.

reviews.author: Ingrid Elizabeth Basualto Muller
reviews.text:
I truly had a wonderful vacation and made excellent memories at this hotel!

I want to thank Alejandro (Happy Boy) and Darlin for all the activities we were able to do!

At the beach bar, Wanda and Pedro stood out; they were incredibly attentive to everything we asked for and even recommended dishes we could try.

However, there are areas for improvement in terms of staff service. We had previously stayed at The Reserve in Playa del Carmen and expected something similar, but it fell far short of the level of attention and concern shown to guests.

Also, the availability of wines and sparkling wines in the restaurants could be improved (when they run out, you have to go to the central kitchen to get them). Each restaurant could have a larger selection. Similarly, the service times in the restaurants could be improved; on many occasions, our dishes arrived late.

Finally, we were invited to The Circle's talk, which was supposed to last 40 minutes. Despite saying we weren't interested several times, they kept insisting, and it lasted around 1.5 hours. This was very annoying.

reviews.author: Jose Daniel Diaz Quińones
reviews.text: We had dinner at Flora tonight, and we were lucky enough to have Melina serve us again on our second vacation. Needless to say, as always, she went out of her way to please us and guide us to ensure we had a wonderful experience. Flora is our favorite restaurant in Palma Real.

reviews.author: Alessandra Stanzione
reviews.text: Our trip was a family one; we had a three-bedroom apartment, and the best part of our stay was Juan, who helped us throughout the entire trip! Always efficient, friendly, and smiling, he was the highlight of the trip. We had several issues at the hotel, such as a very rude trainer at the gym, not-so-great food at the restaurant, and less-than-ideal service, but Juan was always ready to help us and fix things. We really liked the hotel overall, but the service could be improved because it's not a five-star hotel. We used all the amenities and ate at almost all the restaurants. A truly unforgettable vacation! A special greeting to Juan from the Briceno/Stanzione family.

reviews.author: Yazmin Rivera
reviews.text: This place is beautiful and perfect for a relaxing few days. The room is very cozy and the staff service is excellent. The only negative experience was at dinnertime; without a reservation, there's no possibility of dining at the à la carte restaurants. We confirmed our reservation through a young man assigned to us as our "concierge," and when we arrived at the restaurant, there was no table reserved for us. Thanks to Jafreisy López, the young woman who greeted us, and to the manager on duty who accommodated us and allowed us to enter.

reviews.author: Joao e Aninha -joaninha Queiroz
reviews.text:
We were very well received.

The concierge service from CLARITZEL OTONEZ was excellent and kind to the guests.

We also want to thank Luiz Rodriguez, Santo Avila, Vivianny Reys, Abraham acompachano, and all the other staff who were ready to assist us at The Reserve for their attention and care.

reviews.author: Katherine Rodriguez
reviews.text:
Among all the staff at the resort, she stands out primarily for her attentive, patient, and informative service. She created a welcoming atmosphere that made us reluctant to leave. When you visit, be sure to ask for Fanni; she knows how to make your experience truly special, making our trip the best it could be.

Among all the staff at the resort, she stands out the most for her caring, patient, and informative service. She created a homey atmosphere, making us reluctant to leave. When you visit, be sure to ask for Fanni—she knows how to make your experience truly special, adding meaning to our trip.

reviews.author: Alexandra Iversen
reviews.text:
Tokimeku Restaurant has a very entertaining and engaging cooking show. Chef Victor prepares special dishes for people with dietary restrictions.
Santo was very kind to bring me a birthday cake.

I recommend making a reservation for dinner at this wonderful place when you check in.

reviews.author: Priscilla Bencke
reviews.text:
I stayed at the hotel for a week, we had problems with the room, as we booked a double bed and ended up receiving a room with two beds. They said they would resolve it, but nothing changed.
On the other hand, the hotel's infrastructure is very good and the service at the Malcazone restaurant is very good, especially the service from Milton and Alquenio.

reviews.author: Jeancarlos Santana
reviews.text:
Only the ginger bar offers excellent customer service; they truly enhance the experience with their friendly and welcoming approach.

Regarding the food, my congratulations to Chef Paula Esmirna for her pasta dishes. The rest leaves much to be desired, with a lack of attention and a general lack of concern from the staff.

Courtesy is a simple word, but when put into practice, it yields great results. We sincerely recommend prioritizing customer service.

In my case, I would NOT recommend Paridisus Palma Real.

reviews.author: Ari Morales
reviews.text: My first time in Punta Cana was a beautiful vacation. First of all, thank you so much for the extraordinary service, especially the waiter named Fausto, a boy worthy of admiration for his kind attention. Many blessings. Everything was spectacular.

reviews.author: Francisco Javier Thevenin Alvarez
reviews.text:
The hotel, in general, has very nice facilities. The customer service at the front desk wasn't very good during check-in. And at check-in, it was slow (but good service).

Good restaurants, a wide variety of good-quality food.

The Kids' Area was very good (apart from the air conditioning, which didn't work, but the kids didn't mind much).

reviews.author: Frank Garduño Sánchez
reviews.text: The facilities are good, but the food leaves much to be desired. The staff's attention is excellent; they are all very friendly. If they had more variety of food, it would be perfect.

reviews.author: amelie cereijo
reviews.text: The experience was quite nice. The hotel is very well located and the beach is quite beautiful. The only thing I noticed is that the beach has sargassum, not much, but it still has a large pool. It includes pool games for children and inflatable games. I came with my family and I have a little sister and I loved, not loved, the entire experience. The only bad thing about this hotel is that they ask you, or rather, force you to write a review and give them five stars for everything. Personally, I think the hotel overall is 3.7 stars.

reviews.author: Nacho De Haro
reviews.text:
It's a shame they closed the disco; it really brought the hotel to life.
The entertainment staff are asleep all day; I didn't see them "recruiting" anyone to form a youth group.
As for the waiters, some clearly lack training and respect; they look away when you speak to them. But there are also some very competent waiters, a prime example being Gustavo (Santé) and another quite tall, Black waiter (I can't remember his name, it was something like Norberto, Roberto, or something like that).

Regarding the night bartenders, they're generally good, but there's one person who stands out from the rest. You see her everywhere; you can always tell she's the one managing things, day and night. I wish they had ten like her. I think her name is Lucia; I seem to recall her mentioning that her last name was Diaz. If anyone deserves my congratulations, it would definitely be her.

Thanks!

reviews.author: José R. Luciano S.
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at Paradisus Punta Cana in mid-July 2013 for a surgeons' conference and were in an exclusive area. The halls where the academic activities took place were very nice. The rooms were great, the service and management were very good, and the food and attention were excellent in all the restaurants we visited.
The pools were nice. We went to the disco and found it a bit small.
We weren't aware of the daytime entertainment activities since we didn't have time for them. The nighttime entertainment was varied, simple, and lively.
The beach was beautiful, with white sand, calm blue waters, and a shallow bottom. We didn't visit the gym, the spa, or the sports areas.
We saw many children with their parents, and when we asked them, they assured us they were having a great time.
The resort is suitable for the enjoyment and relaxation of older adults. It's also suitable for the whole family, without requiring any special entertainment. It's a great location for professional meetings of up to 500 attendees.
Would we return? Absolutely!

reviews.author: Javier Cabanes
reviews.text:
The service was excellent. Our concierge, Yasleidy Lims, was magnificent, very attentive to everything… she prepared a tremendous surprise for my daughter for her birthday—actually, two surprises.
At the end of the trip, we left something at the hotel, and we were lucky enough to have it delivered to the airport. Everyone's service was excellent!
Thank you so much.
The staff at Gaby, the pool staff, and the beach staff.
Thank you so much.

reviews.author: Stefano Vittorietti
reviews.text: The place is amazing and there's no shortage of activities for all ages. They need to improve their service and customer care, especially in the restaurants. The only exception was excellent service from waiter Ulise Pacheco: 5 stars. The rooms are good, but not up to the price.

reviews.author: Blanca Pérez
reviews.text:
I've been staying at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana for several days now, in the VIP section. Most of the hotel is excellent, except for the beach service, which is terrible. For the past four days, I've been complaining that no one is attending to us, that they don't bring towels or set up the lounge chairs, and that they don't come around offering drinks; only street vendors come by. One of the managers told me that they come by every 20 minutes, and throughout the entire morning and afternoon, they're lucky if they come by even once.
The staff are standing in the shade of the bar, leaning against it, resting, talking loudly, and yelling like animals, but no one comes to ask if we need anything. Four days ago, I filed a complaint with the concierge, and on Sunday with someone conducting a survey about the hotel's service, as well as with customer service, the staff supervisor, and the butler manager (Francisco). So far, I've only received apologies, but everything remains the same.

Four days ago, I also requested a light be installed on the staircase that crosses the pool, in front of the adults-only restaurant on the ocean side. The steps are invisible at night, and any hotel guest could easily fall. Another issue I want to address is the poor quality of the Wi-Fi.
I also want to mention that the music in the central courtyard and most of the restaurants is so loud that it's impossible to have a conversation. They used to have a place where they held shows and dances, a place where people went to listen to loud music. Now, knowing that loud music damages hearing, and that most of the people who frequent that area are middle-aged and older, they should pay attention to that detail. Yesterday we had a reservation at the Mexican restaurant. We arrived, and the music was so loud that the waiters couldn't hear us, nor could we hear them. We asked them to turn the music down a bit, and they told us the manager said no. We got up and left. I want to emphasize that the rest of the staff who served us were excellent.

I would like an explanation as to why restaurants play music at maximum volume, in addition to the music from outside. People have to shout to hear each other, making it sound more like a chicken coop than a restaurant. In my opinion, as someone who loves music, it should be pleasant to the ears to be appreciated, not an unbearable noise that makes it impossible to speak or hear.
I would appreciate an explanation for the extremely high volume of the music. Thank you.

reviews.author: Agustín Tejada
reviews.text:
What I liked most was the amount of food, especially at lunch.
The rooms are comfortable, although I didn't get very good air conditioning. The staff were generally attentive and friendly. I didn't like the color of the beach and the sargassum seaweed that accumulates all along the coast.

reviews.author: Alvaro Morales
reviews.text: The rooms were very comfortable, and the service was excellent, especially from Abraham, who was always very friendly and attentive. The food was very good and varied, and the drinks were always delicious. I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 because the rooms were often cleaned very late and the minibar wasn't always restocked.

reviews.author: Jorge Soto
reviews.text:
Very good facilities and excellent service. The staff is very friendly and always attentive to guests' needs. We really enjoyed the Sante restaurant (Franklin was exceptional), and Flora (excellent service from Santo and his team). We also thoroughly enjoyed the food and service at The Winery.
This is an all-inclusive hotel that we highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ivanoi Peña
reviews.text: Fernando Chipa from Animación is the best! I love his work; he dedicates time to all his clients. We need two more like him!

reviews.author: Ashley Bautista
reviews.text: Lucia and all the girls were excellent. Joan Castillo was excellent, and Pedro was awful. He told the DJ to stop the music when we stopped, and he gave us money for more music for another 10 minutes. Everyone was great, including Heraldo at the pool bar. I RECOMMEND YOU DON'T COME BECAUSE PEDRO WAS VERY BAD.

reviews.author: Alex Alevy
reviews.text:
Very good value for the price, I recommend it. The only thing missing is a theater with more produced shows.
If you come in large groups, the restaurants aren't à la carte. They offer a set menu.
Special thanks to Alquenio, Riley, Milton, and the entire team at Mascalzone (Italian Restaurant).

reviews.author: Мария Мария
reviews.text: The buffet is spectacularly unappetizing. Three meals a day. Especially compared to Paradisus Punta Cana. But at least you won't gain weight. The beach chairs stretch all the way to the ground, there are four sections on the beach, but only one is accessible. And it's overcrowded. The others are Royal Service, Family Concierge, and the Resort Hotel. And they're half empty. But there's plenty of greenery and the ocean is beautiful.

reviews.author: Agustina Arizu
reviews.text: A wonderful experience at the hotel. The service from our concierges, Bladimir and Miguelito, was exceptional. They were very attentive to our requests and always willing to help with any problems. Honestly, our stay was much more enjoyable thanks to them. We hope to return!

reviews.author: Vìvi Càstro
reviews.text: The hotel has excellent service and location, but the internet needs improvement. It doesn't work perfectly like in other hotels I've stayed at in Mexico! Also, children don't have access to all the restaurants, which is quite annoying for those with young children... however, there is a kids' area that the children loved, the staff were very attentive... the food was also very good. Excellent service in the restaurants. Very hospitable, 10 out of 10 for them...

reviews.author: Pedrow Cuba
reviews.text: Everything is fine as long as it's not dinnertime. The buffet is definitely not five-star; none of the food tastes good. The specialty restaurants are a different story (the food tastes better). I wanted to highlight the excellent service provided by Rosanna Aquino, Carolin Castillo, and Yordania; they lived up to my expectations!

reviews.author: Noe Alvarez
reviews.text: Many thanks to Flanklin, Gustavo, and the entire team at Sante Restaurant. You deserve the 5 stars. Juan and Osvaldo, excellent butlers. You are appreciated. See you next time 😉

reviews.author: Nicole Maldonado
reviews.text: Excellent service at Mascalzone restaurant; our waitress Yuleni and supervisor Milton were outstanding. The food was delicious, everything perfectly prepared, both on the traditional menu and the chef's menu.

reviews.author: Kim y Martin
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort with all the amenities a tourist expects. The common areas are in excellent condition and well-maintained; however, this isn't the case in all rooms. We had to stay in three different rooms before settling on our final one.

The service was good in some areas and bad in others, but I think it also depends on the staff.

The food was very good, with plenty of variety, although it was a bit repetitive. The drinks, on the other hand, weren't as good. They only had juice at breakfast, the wine selection was limited, and the beer was only available locally brewed. The bar's liquor selection was more traditional, featuring world-renowned brands like Jack Daniel's, Johnny Walker, etc.

reviews.author: Gi Impe
reviews.text:
Beautiful beach. Very large hotel with many restaurants and very long rooms.

What could be improved is the organization, which seems different than before, and there were sometimes organizational problems.

A special thanks to Juan Castillo for his courtesy; he was always there to help us during our vacation.

reviews.author: Claudio Berndt
reviews.text:
During our stay, we received excellent service at all the restaurants we visited, and the hotel in general is very pleasant with attentive and helpful staff.
The staff at breakfast in the Palazzo are friendly and helpful, but no one seems concerned about replenishing the buffet, which always appears to be empty after a party.
The room is fine, except that in addition to coffee, there should be a way to make hot tea without having to wait for room service.
At the Royal Beach, we were well taken care of by Martin, who did his best to secure a palapa for us daily, even though reservations weren't always successful.
Carlos Hinostroza, our butler, went out of his way to fulfill our restaurant and spa reservation requests, and he did a great job.
Sincerely, Claudio Berndt and Carmen Alzerreca

reviews.author: Dr. Tejada Canela
reviews.text: I loved the BlueAgave restaurant, where the staff who served us were very friendly and always available to our requests.

reviews.author: Marcello Tarallos
reviews.text: Recovery has been difficult due to the pandemic, and some employees aren't focused on customer service, which detracts from the overall experience. The facilities are well-maintained, 5 stars. I think they need support; they should continue their continuous improvement plan and implement a staff selection process focused on customer interests. The food deserves about 4 stars.

reviews.author: Lauti
reviews.text: This hotel is luxurious, etc. It's very good for families, and the food is high quality, especially the seafood and fresh fish. The beach is also very nice. Reservations for the hotel are very good, and everything is lovely. There are also food options on the beach. One downside is that the à la carte restaurants only open at night, but otherwise, everything is excellent. Something I love about Paradisus is its all-inclusive package (although some meals are extra), its activities, and the attention to detail, both upon arrival and throughout your stay. The staff is very attentive. The rooms are fantastic; they are large and spacious with very comfortable beds and a minibar included. In short, excellent. It's a shame the restaurants only open at night, but otherwise, everything is a 10/10 (I highly recommend the hotel). Here are some photos.

reviews.author: julissa Castillo Regalado
reviews.text: Everything was great, except for the room service, which was included. They asked me to pay $20 to send a bottle of sparkling wine that was also included... and that was the only thing I requested. After I complained, they told me it was included by the glass. They should have said from the beginning that it would be sent by the glass.

reviews.author: Christofer
reviews.text:
Very nice all-inclusive resort with beautiful pools and great location by the sea. The resort offers several pool areas, including an adults only section, several restaurants, coffee shop, a small store, evening entertainment, etc

Modern and clean rooms providing most amenities you need during the stay. The rooms has a complimentary mini-bar which is supposed to be refilled every day but at least during our stay it was not. Wine bottle part of the minibar, but no opener available in the room.

Pool towels provided and the pool bar has a good selection of drinks.

The buffe restaurant is excellent providing a large variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Some difficulties to get cutleries and coffee gives a lower score on services.

The mexican BlueAgave restaurant provides great service however we expected the food to be more spicy or having more flavors.

The rock bottom is the Flora restaurant offering traditional dominican food. It was extremely difficult to get a reservation at this restaurant, still it was not half full when eating there and despite many empty tables we were placed at the ”worst” location. We asked to change table and were allowed to do so but with very grumpy staff as a result. Food was average, service almost acceptable although the waiter looked like she just wanted to end her shift, and after finishing main course we were told they did only have one dessert left.

The location and facilities are top class but there are many annoying small things missing or areas with low quality services which gives the lower overall grade.

reviews.author: Tomie Gibson
reviews.text: Our room was absolutely beautiful. Harry our butler was so kind, attentive and made sure we had everything we needed. The food on the buffet and for breakfast and lunch was not very good. However the dinners we had were great. We didn’t love that you had to sit down to eat lunch. There was no where to go and grab a snack for around the pool. Overall we loved our visit other then the food. My husband golfed and said the course was beautiful and I got a massage and that was also great.

reviews.author: Tee Keita
reviews.text:
The personal is RUDE.

I have to say my experience was so/so. The check-in process was awful. Jean was lost and Gheiddy was rude. They weren't helpful and made us ready to leave the hotel. Furthermore, it was 3:05pm and we were told we had to wait longer to get the room. Our room didn't get ready until 4.30pm when the check-in time is supposed to be at 3. We were provided a room and before we checked in, it was changed. Then, the key wasn't working. We had to go back to get it activated. They mixed up our personal information during check-in and my Melia information is attached to my sister's information. The bell boy that we had was acting like he didn't want to help us at all and that he was bothered.

The fridge wasn't working, we called multiple times for the issue and no one addressed it (even when we were told that someone was on the way), we had the green button on to receive room service and we didn't. It was my birthday and I spoke to several people at the concierge desk  (Franklin and Andres) and I was told that the hotel doesn't celebrate birthdays anymore. I even requested to receive the information for their outside vendor which I've never received so I was unable to have something done for my birthday. I ended up getting a cake from outside myself Angela was helpful and had them sing happy birthday to me at my dinner reservation and she sent me a bottle of champagne in my room.

I travel alot and I take the time to review hotels for future travelers.

The hotel is very beautiful and clean but for the service alone that I've receive, I would never recommend someone to stay at this property,

The ONLY great part of my experience was the ladies at the buffet. They were always smiling, ready to help and genuinely cared. Yafreisy deserves ALL her flowers and the 3 ladies working with her. Yafreisy always greeted us with a smile, made sure we were all set and she even had them sing happy birthday to me a desert. She is AMAZING and they truly deserve all their flowers! She is the only reason why I even considered giving my review 3 stars. She deserves 10 stars.

reviews.author: Florencia Ayelen Ciro
reviews.text:
Great instalations, people are well distributed so the pools and bars are not super crowded, and the Only adults section is chill and relaxing.
Also Good food and beach area is long and broad, lots of space. Loved the place!

Update after stay:
I had to reduce the rating because even if the place is beautiful, the service is so lacking and unresponsive that is not what you would expect for a hotel of this category.
Coffee during breakfast takes 40min, room service and replenishments take 3 hours, there is no non-alcoholic beverages in any bar.

reviews.author: Emma Cameron
reviews.text:
We stayed in the reserve which is the adult only part of this hotel. The room was super clean and the beach was great.  Our concierge was very helpful.  Service was a bit hit and miss and the food was mostly good.  I am a vegetarian and there were occasions where there was no vegetarian option but I mostly managed to find something to eat.

We came for our 25th wedding anniversary and the staff made a deal effort to make us feel special on the day.

reviews.author: Pa Girl
reviews.text: Amazing space great rooms phenomenal food however service is slow and you can barely get a smile out of most of the staff. We were fortunate enough to have met some nice servers but most were lacking training and hospitality. Had two dinners that took over 2 hours to receive our food. That said I can only hope the management takes this review and seeks additional training it could most definitely be a 5 star resort

reviews.author: Jake Schuldt
reviews.text:
We stayed at the resort for 3 nights in late November. The airport is only about 25 minutes away, so the ride in is fairly short. The resort is clean, beautiful, and quite large, but once you familiarize yourself with the main areas it's easily walkable. The staff was okay, definitely not as friendly as most other places I've been, but not bad. The basic room we got was plenty spacious, very nice, clean, and had some extra toiletries and stuff that made it on the higher end of rooms I've stayed in. Surprisingly nice and decently spacious gym.

A major disappointment for us was the food. The buffet food was mostly all cold. We tried the Dominican restaurant for a reserved dinner one night, the steak was horrible. It tasted like the cheapest cut of meat boiled. By the end of the stay, all I could really eat was omelettes and fruit. The coffee was burnt and gross everywhere. There isn't any quick dining places like many resorts for safe options, and being a bit far from the downtown area, it left us filling up on drinks.

The drink selection was impressive for an all-inclusive resort, having some mid-tier options, like Jameson, Tito's, etc at many bars. The bars were spread out well, except for the beach (none we saw). The beach is very spacious but full of salesmen for off-site excursions. I had some drinks and got suckered into one for a buggy ride, and it was more than the asking price and not worth it. Avoid them at all costs.

Top gotchas:
- the "club" they mention is just the sports bar where they move the DJ inside.
- there is no 24/7 bar. The main lobby bar is advertised as such and wasn't open late.
- the time of year we went, everything was eerily empty. It was nice for getting drinks, but I feel like that affected the food quality.
- don't buy anything from people going around with flyers. Go through Viator or the front desk.
- only one small convenience store in side.
- no hot tubs
- signage is non-existent, so it's hard to know where and when you can eat
- cabanas on the beach were all empty but we got asked to move as they were reservation only (again no signage)

reviews.author: Trenton Sullivan
reviews.text: This was not my favorite resort.  Nothing blew me away.  Service in the DR is... different.  Staff is not mean butt they aren't overly helpful.  I don't need someone doting on me every moment. At the same time there were several times I'd have an empty water glass or no coffee and several stag would just walk on past. Our concierge was fine but not a helpful or attentive as others in our area.  Our fridge never worked and they never came to address it. Food was above average for an all inclusive and the drinks were really really good.

reviews.author: Sir_ Crabby (Sir_Crabby)
reviews.text:
Our visit was from 3/30-4/6. This makes our 3rd visit to DR. Unfortunately this resort was not a great stay. The food, quality, choices, and resort service was very disappointing.

Attention to detail and cleanliness needs addressed.

reviews.author: Tarah Fenn
reviews.text:
This one is going to hurt a little bit. I have several reviews to fill out including Delta Vacations. This was not an inexpensive vacation. We booked through Delta Vacations and flew from Phoenix to Atlanta to Punta Cana. Not a quick trip either.

Upon arrival, room was not ready. Took 2 hours for room to be ready. Front desk said we would get an email. We never got an email. Just hovered until they were tired of seeing us. NOTE: Your band on your wrist is an indicator of what you are getting there.

Rooms are decent. Although you will never get me to understand why a thin curtain is a good use of privacy over a wall or door. Doesn't matter who you are traveling with, you want privacy!

When you arrive at the hotel, you should be pulled aside by a concierge that you DO NOT HAVE TO PAY FOR to be informed about what your activities are and how to make dinner reservations. Don't get me started on that process. If you are a commoner---you will need to get in line at 8AM promptly by the buffet to TRY (operative word) to nab a dinner reservation. If you are unlucky at nailing a reservation, you win the BUFFET only. It's NOT ok to only have that option BUT that is the option. Food is MEH. The Italian place was my favorite. Tipping is weird. Some people leave a dollar; other people leave 20. I tried not to be a douche, but I did spend over $8K for this vacation so sometimes you get $5 and have to deal with it.

You should get a calendar of events, things that are available to use, marked areas where you can and can't go (trust me it matters)! The hospitality at this hotel is lacking. I can't tell you how many times people looked me dead in the eyes and ignored my question or request. I had to scour the entire hotel for 9 beach towels before my excursion and then I told the manager, keep an entire cart of them at the front of the bell desk for others. Cleaning services were amazing, bar tenders were subpar and often forgot drinks (even if you tipped them ahead of time). Buffet service was the WORST. Numerous requests for coffee go unnoticed. Trust me, I was nice and polite, and it did not matter. So I just stopped tipping at the buffet.

Also, I honestly don't believe the Dominican Republic understands the value of the American dollar whatsoever. It's one thing to pay $6 for a bag of skittles at the gift shop. It is another thing entirely to price a sweatshirt at $60 that is literally the same one on Amazon for $22.99 on prime. MANY of the places we visited were dramatically overpriced. They see you as a sucker and take advantage. They also expect your tips. They are TRAINED to not have change. I watched it happen and I also watched a taxi driver deliver money to a hotel and clearly was in cahoots with the souvenir shop. DO NOT GO TO THEIR SHOPS.

The major plus is the beaches! Of course they are stunning! The pools are great, the swim up bars and the liquor are great! Make sure to check out Fun Republic on property. No one told us about it until the last day but was fun for mini golf. Cabanas cost $160 a day and that is why they are always empty. No one is paying that (again an overpriced dollar thing). Another thing the resort should do is have a FREE cabana day. I mean they sit there and do nothing. It's literally crazy that they block the beach to make you PAY!! LOL.

Overall, I would not come back to this resort. This was NOT a 5-star experience!

I had a wonderful time because of the people that I was with. My family and friends are what made this trip spectacular. Even if my expectations were not met, my family created memories and enjoyed each other.

Signed---a green band girl in a brown band world (IYKYK). :)

reviews.author: Luke
reviews.text: Nice, but definitely not a five star resort. Food, pool and cleanliness were all good. Service was rough, most of the staff just doesn’t care or they dislike Americans. Noise in the hallways early in the morning made it impossible to sleep in. Beach area was cramped, lots of garbage in beach area, no beach drink service. Many better options for your vacation.

reviews.author: Kyrylo Gryshchenko
reviews.text:
Overall, the hotel is good. The rooms are great and very clean, the beach is nice, and the entertainment staff is excellent.

However, the buffet and bar service could be much better — the staff there is not friendly at all.

For the price, the hotel offers good value, but they definitely need to work on improving staff attitude and service in the buffet and bars

reviews.author: Arnaldo Santana
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Exceptional Service from Raya at Paradisus Palma Real

During my stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort, I had the absolute pleasure of being assisted by Teofilo and Raya and Olga and Rosanna at the bar. She is truly a beautiful soul with an incredible spirit. From the moment we met her, she made us feel welcomed, cared for, and fully taken care of.

Raya was always attentive, helpful, and in the best mood. She consistently went above and beyond to make sure we were hydrated, comfortable, and enjoying ourselves, even before we asked for anything. Her kindness, professionalism, and genuine warmth made every interaction a pleasure.

It is rare to meet someone who serves with both excellence and heart, and Raya is one of those special people. She made a huge difference in our experience, and we are truly grateful for her.

If you visit this resort, make sure you stop by and meet Raya. She is one of the reasons we will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: ewelka37
reviews.text:
We visited this place for 7 days.
Location is great,leved the beach. ROOMS are new,we stayed at adult section.
Food is ok ,the worse was Japanese restaurant.
LOved the antartaiment,the RoCk girl and her band.
Serive horrible, KICKS bar,AnThony and Miguel you should train this people ,very rude and disrespectful,this people are unhappy to be there ,I was standing waiting to order the were serving everyone else ,except me ,they ha e attitude.
GInger coffee AnThony was also serving there pls hire people they are happy to serve not someone is there being forced fo work and waiting for tips .
TERIBLE service and kicks bar and ginger.

reviews.author: Softwave
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful result however corners are cut. Some staff were incredibly friendly and other staff completely rude. You ask for the most simplest requests and are told “yes” and it never comes.The food is insanely basic. A for effort F in execution. BE VERY CAUTIOUS when people at the result approach you for excursions. We signed up with “otium” to do 4 wheeling/ATV and arrived in a complete scam. We’re told “cave” and “waterfall” excursion and arrived to a tiny man made “park”: it was comically terrible. When I arrived to my original room it reeked of mold. The toilet paper is horrible.
The pools are lovely. The room service and stocking were. Consistent. Would not recommend.

reviews.author: Michael Anderson
reviews.text:
First I like to say we had a great time! And their were certain resort staff that made our visit most enjoyable like Jaime! But there are vendors everywhere coming up to you trying to sell you any and everything. From vacation packages to feel good medicine. The folks off the resort are selling the medicines, haha. But it's exhausting. Going to the buffets were cool. The food was okay. Not the greatest and not the worst. You could always find something.

What I didn't like was that once you got that they tried to upsell you more expensive packages. It was kind of rude because I spent all this money to get there on this awesome package but then they try to sell me more. On top of that, the room wasn't the greatest. I seen and killed two roaches in the bathroom. Only seen the two and only seen them in the bathroom!

reviews.author: Arezoo Ghashghaie
reviews.text: All I can say about this resort is that it’s very beautiful and clean. The food is average, but the service is really bad. The staff seem unhappy and have a poor attitude. It might be due to overwhelming work hours and being short-staffed, but overall they all look frustrated.

reviews.author: David Smith
reviews.text:
Here’s a good bad and ugly!
If you want to leave anyone a tip, make sure you bring the right change because if you try to break a 20 it’s impossible good luck breaking $100 bill. They will only give you more 20s.
The showerhead in the shower is so low then if you’re over 5 foot seven you have to duck down.
The food can be explained with one word TERRIBLE
THIS PLACE IS NOT DESIGNED FOR PEOPLE THAT CAN’T WALK ANY LONG DISTANCE. TO LEAVE YOUR ROOM AND GO ANYWHERE IT IS GOING TO BE AN EXTREMELY LONG WALK AND YES, LOTS AND LOTS OF STAIRS. THE ELEVATOR IS SO FAR AWAY FROM EVERYTHING MIGHT AS WELL NOT HAVE ONE.
I will say the rooms and the resort are gorgeous maybe even breathtaking.
The staff is very friendly and very helpful

reviews.author: Ro Indy Realtor
reviews.text: I booked a junior suite on the adults only side as I was traveling for my birthday. When I arrived, I was advised that my room had been upgraded and I was put on the family side. There was a screaming baby next to my room. I opted for this room so that I didnt have to be around kids while traveling. They switched my room. I opened the door to a man walking with food in his hand. He yelled, ummm hello. I freaked out and closed the door so fast. They then put me in a 3rd room. The room was nice but I was smacked in the face with a mildew smell when I opened the door. At this point, I was exhausted and wanted to find food. I did make them aware kf the smell and they said housekeeping would check it out. I also let them know the hot water in the shower, tv, and fridge wasn't working. At this point, I was over it and my birthday trip was not pleasant. I made the best out of a bad situation. I wouldnt agree that it's a 5 star resort. They didnt offer a turn down service. The room came with a loofah, robes, slippers, toothbrush/toothpaste, shaving cream and razors. The room was nice outside of the mildew smell. It was amount 30 minutes away from the airport. I've been to plenty of resorts, and this by far had the best food. I was thoroughly impressed. The view was so beautiful. Everyone was so nice and helpful. I'd definitely want to visit the DR again. I also had an amazing massage. They have a company on-site that can help you with excursions. I didnt receive a welcome drink as advertised in my reservation. I put in the reservation when I booked that I was coming for my birthday. They didnt make me feel special at all. The last night, I walked in to a treat. At the restaurants, they sang hbd for other guests and when I asked if they could do the same for me bc it was my birthday, I was brushed off. I was able to get some beautiful pictures.

reviews.author: Flelecia Mcmillan
reviews.text: Today I ate at Flora restaurant in Dr. Our wait staff Andrea was awesome. Very knowledgeable about the food we ordered. Her recommendation was the best I had since arriving. I would recommend everyone to eat here, ask for Andrea. So nice service with a smile 😃

reviews.author: Irena CB
reviews.text:
I feel like a lot of reviews here are not from real people so I’ll add mine. We stayed here for free on a company trip so we came with no expectations. Would we return if we had to pay? Probably not. Here are our honest impressions.

This is not a 5-star resort in American sense. We stayed in the “reserve” adults-only side. The rooms were nicely appointed but smelled somewhat musty. This side does have a decent restaurant for breakfast which is a perk because the food everywhere else is almost inedible. The pools and beach loungers are also somewhat nicer here and with somewhat better service. Nowhere close to 5-star but acceptable.

Unfortunately, the food and service are pretty poor all around. I don’t expect much from an all-inclusive but here everyone does the bare minimum and food is mediocre to inedible. They also force you to book days ahead for every dinner meal which is both inconvenient and annoying. The good thing is that Uber is easy and only a couple dollars to get to the downtown area with normal restaurants. We ended up doing that a couple times.

reviews.author: Joelly Belman
reviews.text: Beautiful pool areas and nice wide beachfront. Wonderful breeze and pleasant atmosphere. Maria at Rum Republic made us a delicious passionfruit drink and a fantastic martini. Excellent service from her! Daniela at reception was helpful. Our concierge, Gustavo, was attentive and handled all of our arrangements.

reviews.author: Mike Reeves
reviews.text: Was greeted with open arms and kindness as the concierge tagged our bags and walked us to check in. Since check in is at 2pm we went to restaurant and sat for about an hour to eat lunch. Our concierge contacted us and we sinked on what’s app to make it easier to communicate. Our room was ready and we walked to building 3 and climbed 3 flights of stairs. I don’t mind stairs but I really don’t want to climb 3 flights up and down every time I leave my room. Which come to find out they use this technique to sell you upgrades. As I requested something on a lower floor. It became available for an upgraded fee. An additional $1200.00 for the week.  We finally heard from our concierge and we have to spend one night in our 3rd story room with stairs. To be moved across the courtyard to a room with an elevator. The elusive 1st floor room is still being used as an upgrade. Stay tuned till tomorrow as I will update on the elusive 1st floor room.

reviews.author: Yameen Rashid.
reviews.text:
Just returned from our family vacation. Positives: The rooms were updated and clean. The beach was beautiful with plenty of chairs for everyone. The pools were fun for our kids. The massages at the spa were amazing.
Negatives: service was poor. We were pretty much ignored our whole trip. We were told a personal concierge would meet us and check in with us. We never met any personal concierge. Nobody to help us book restaurants we had to figure it out as the days went on. Staff wasn’t happy friendly or helpful. When we asked people for something at the restaurant we were ignored a lot of workers pretended not to understand us and pointed to other people “go ask them instead”. Also food was not great. Breakfast and lunch were not good. Dinner options were better. Also no privacy for the bathrooms just a curtain.

reviews.author: Camille R
reviews.text: The food and drinks were average. Blue Agave was the best place. The alcoholic drinks were very watered down and if you don’t drink alcohol, just stick to the soft drinks. Everyone was very pleasant but if you needed anything it took years for them to follow through with the request. Our personal “concierge” was nonexistent until he wanted us to sit through a timeshare so that he could get $100. When we said no, he disappeared again. Overall the people are pleasant as we’ve been to the DR before and I can communicate with the locals, but this hotel is definitely NOT a 5 star in any category.

reviews.author: Jessica Picon
reviews.text: My family and I stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort in Punta Cana, but our experience was overshadowed by several frustrating issues, particularly with check-in, concierge service, and communication. We were told we could check in early, but our room was not ready upon arrival. Despite being assured it would be ready within an hour with a promised upgrade, we were given a smaller room than what I reserved. This led to a frustrating process of room changes. The second room only had one king bed, unsuitable for our family of four. The third room was spacious and met our needs, but it wasn’t immediately available. After waiting over two hours, I had to escalate to the manager before finally receiving the correct room at 5:00 PM—hours after we arrived, wasting much of our first day. Our assigned concierge, Jose, also caused multiple issues. He failed to secure dinner reservations twice, leaving us embarrassed at the restaurants. Later, Antonio replaced him, and the service improved. Unfortunately, when Jose was reassigned, the quality of service declined again. Daily minibar restocking, which was supposed to be standard, never occurred despite repeated requests. Our room also lacked an iron or ironing board upon arrival, and it took over a day and multiple complaints to receive one. On a positive note, the food was delicious, and the restaurant and beach staff were friendly and welcoming. The grounds were beautiful and well-maintained. However, the poor organization and communication overshadowed these positives. The resort has potential but needs significant improvements in service to provide a more seamless experience.

reviews.author: Kazi Hassan
reviews.text:
My wife, our 17-month-old daughter, and I stayed at Palma Real from June 8–14 in a Junior Suite Swim-Up. I’d like to share an honest review of our experience.

Check-In: Upon arrival, we were warmly greeted by the front desk staff and assisted with our check-in. We had upgraded to a Junior Suite Swim-Up with a king-size bed, but were initially
given a room with two smaller beds. After a long day of travel, we had to request a room change, which was inconvenient but ultimately resolved. For reference, this resort is operated
by Meliá, a Spanish hotel group.

The Room: The room itself was spacious, well-maintained, and well-suited for a family. Housekeeping did a great job keeping it clean. Room service was slower than what we experienced at other resorts (usually 30–45 minutes), but still acceptable. The biggest issue was the air conditioning—it consistently felt warm despite being set to 69°F. It seemed as though the thermostat or AC unit wasn’t functioning properly, and at times the room became uncomfortably hot. The bathroom also had drainage issues; whenever we showered, water would leak into other areas, requiring extra towels to manage the mess. Additionally, although we had mentioned we were celebrating our anniversary, there were no acknowledgments or gestures from the resort, which was disappointing.

The Concierge and Timeshare Experience: Unfortunately, our experience with the concierge was the most upsetting part of our trip. From the beginning, we were persistently approached about attending a Meliá membership presentation. Despite repeatedly declining, we eventually agreed to attend out of courtesy—this turned out to be a major regret. The sales pitch was aggressive and pushy. We made it clear we were not interested in purchasing a $15,000 membership, yet the salespeople continued to pressure us, citing their quotas. During this
presentation, our daughter fell from a chair and injured her forehead, which required attention and has since left a scar. The concierge assured us he would speak with his manager regarding compensation. However, we received no follow-up or support despite repeated communication (we have messages and photos documenting this). After returning home, the concierge reached out, but gave conflicting explanations about the manager’s availability. Ultimately, no compensation or real acknowledgment was provided. We plan to file a formal complaint with Costco, through whom we booked.

The Resort Grounds: The resort itself is beautiful and well-maintained, with plenty of available lounge chairs at the beach and pool, even on busy days. The swim-up suite was a great option for convenience and privacy. That said, there isn’t much catered to young children, and the spa was minimal—more of a massage cabana setup than a full-service spa.

Food and Dining: The dining experience was mixed. The buffet and most restaurants were average—decent, but nothing exceptional. The steakhouse stood out as excellent, and the Japanese à la carte option was also very enjoyable. The coffee shop, Ginger, was fantastic. For contrast, we had an incredible meal off-site at a local Dominican chain, Doña Pula, which we
highly recommend. One frustration was having to make all reservations through the concierge, rather than using an
app or streamlined system.

Wi-Fi: The wi-fi was terrible at this location, if you are planning on using anything please buy your own data.

Summary: While we appreciated some relaxing moments during our stay, there were several shortcomings that left us disappointed. Between the room issues, unfulfilled promises, and especially the negative experience with the sales presentation and lack of follow-up regarding our daughter’s injury, we do not plan to return to this property. We hope our feedback helps future travelers make informed decisions.

reviews.author: Alyssa Neubauer
reviews.text: This resort is great & the grounds are beautiful but a few things to improve on: we kept asking for room service, specifically more towels & water daily & it took them days to provide us with more. Room service cleaning was very limited what they did. The room we had was fantastic but our friends who paid the same for the same type of room ended up with a room with two full beds which was concerning. Restaurants/bars opened very late & were closed during the day which is a minus when you pay for all inclusive. With all inclusive you barely get any options of where to eat/drink & the selection of what you can drink is very limited. Food at the restaurants is pretty good. All in all we had a fun time.

reviews.author: kent vanderheyden
reviews.text: My family and I just returned from our trip to the Paradisus Palma real. The resort is very nice. The food was very good. We had upgraded to the Reserve section that comes with a concierge which is supposed to help you out with your restaurant reservations and other questions. We had 2 because we had 3 rooms. Our were Yaleidi and Christian. From the start it seemed that it was going to be very good as they came and met us and said they would look after everything, "no problem ". Well that definitely wasn't the case.  I had made a dinner reservation for our first evening from home by emailing a week before. They made the next two but the resort was empty. One of the evenings there was only 1 other table in the restaurant.  Christmas day and on was a different story. They didn't get any of our reservations the times we asked for. After complaining to the manager we had a little success but not alot. The resort is nice but I wouldn't suggest upgrading to the Reserve as there aren't much benefits.  We spoke with others and they had similar issues with their concierge. Also if you are going for golf i wouldn't suggest this resort either. The course was in horrible condition. Of the 27 holes only 9 were playable and the golf course conviently changed their prices a week earlier without notifying the hotel bit nothing was done about that either. We still had a good vacation but the extra cost of approx $600 per person was a waste.

reviews.author: Matt Karkula
reviews.text: I would say the price for this resort is on the upper end and visually it feels great but some issues with service and rooms. Rooms are remodeled and feel new and great however mine had broken hair dryer and it took 3 days to get new one. Jacuzzi also didn't work. Was fixed the next day but broke again another day. Also there was to cockroaches in the room I know they are common in tropical climate and maybe because it was ground floor room. Service in the buffet was decent. Sometimes u had to wait long for your drinks. Service at the kick sports bar is slow  there was a lot of waitresses standing around. Waited one hour for my food. Worst part is making reservations for restaurants. It is a nightmare. U need to see the lady and she tells u system doesn't work or doesn't open until certain hours. Its horrible. They have an app where u can order room amenities but can't do restaurant reservations just plain wrong, for additional $107 a night u will get concierge and be able to just delegate reservation making process. I was able to get to all the restaurants but the process was painful and unpleasant. Especially most of the time restaurants are half empty anyway. They do offer a lot of activities for kids and adults. Highlight of the trip is their kidsdom kids club. My kids had great time there. Staff there is super nice and they always have fun activities for the little ones honestly that place is 5 plus stars. Other than that I probably won't be coming back and if you get a cheap deal on this hotel i would go for it but at regular rate is kind of overpriced.

reviews.author: Jacob Cevallos
reviews.text:
Hello, I thought I’d share our recent stay here. I would rate it **6 out of 10**. Here are our reasons:

**Food:**
The breakfast and lunch options were limited to a buffet, unless you opted for a $150 nightly upgrade for an additional restaurant choice. Unfortunately, the buffet served low-quality food with little flavor, which was quite disappointing. However, dinner options redeemed the culinary experience; the steakhouse offered a delicious steak, and Flora, the Dominican restaurant, provided a standout meal. These were the highlights of our daily dining.

**Beach and Beach Service:**
If your idea of a perfect vacation involves lounging on pristine beaches, this might not be your best choice. The water quality was compromised by boat pollution, making it less appealing. Additionally, we were approached by vendors every few minutes, which disrupted our relaxation. The beach service itself was minimal; we received barely any attention from hotel staff for drink orders, and the beverages available were subpar in quality.

**Service:**
Service varied during our stay. Many employees seemed overworked or disinterested, which might be attributed to the demanding environment and perhaps unappreciative guests. A tip here and there can make a significant difference, folks! The standout was Melina at Flora, who offered exemplary service, making our dining experience pleasant.

**Pros:**
- The property is beautifully maintained with a spacious, inviting pool area.
- Our room was comfortable, spacious, and equipped with excellent air conditioning.
- Dinner options, as previously mentioned, were the culinary highlight of our stay.

Overall, while the property itself is lovely and the accommodations comfortable, the beach and dining options for most of the day could use significant improvement. I’d probably not return due to the negatives outweighing the pros. We stayed in Cap Cana at another resort and honestly enjoyed the privacy on that side of the island, and would recommended a stay in that area if you are seeking a better beach and more privacy away from the craziness on Punta Cana. Good luck and I hope I provided some good insight!

reviews.author: Heidi Ripka
reviews.text:
Mixed Experience at Paradisus Palma Real

As a repeat guest who’s visited this property multiple times, I was excited for another relaxing getaway. Sadly, this trip left me questioning whether I’ll return.

The Good
The resort remains as stunning as ever, with lush, tropical grounds perfect for morning walks or lounging by the pools. The new coffee bar was a highlight, where an espresso martini paired with a violinist playing pop covers made for an enjoyable evening.

The Disappointing
Check-In & Room Issues
Despite being a loyal guest and noting both my birthday (the day before arrival) and my daughter’s birthday (shortly after departure), there was no acknowledgment. I requested a room closer to the beach but was placed far away, as most prime rooms seemed reserved for Circle members.

On arrival, the bed was made with damp, incorrectly placed sheets. The thermostat wouldn’t cool below 70°F, the safe was broken and never fixed despite requests for have resolved, and snacks in the room were sparingly replenished.

Dining & Shortages
Restaurant reservation system was awful. Upon check-in, we found the system closed, and by the next morning, all options we were told were fully booked, leaving only one late-night slot the day before our departure. While a manager eventually helped, the process was unnecessarily stressful, and the restaurants often appeared half-empty despite the supposed lack of availability.

The food was inconsistent. Mascalzone (Italian) and Blue Agave (Mexican) offered the best meals with attentive service, but others fell short. Tokimeku (Hibachi) was underwhelming, with rubbery chicken and tough steak, and the buffet often had unappetizing options. Worse, staple items like spinach, tomatoes, and grilled chicken breast were at times unavailable.

Shortages extended to basic beverages: I couldn’t get a Dirty Monkey drink because bananas and chocolate syrup were unavailable throughout my stay, same with a Mochachino at the coffee bar (hey, I love chocolate - don't judge ;) ). These recurring issues, coupled with the already limited dining options, significantly detracted from the experience.

Final Thoughts
While Circle members and upgraded guests enjoy a better experience, regular guests are treated as an afterthought. The inconsistent service, dining chaos, and supply shortages made it difficult to fully relax.

The property itself is gorgeous, and I’ve had wonderful experiences here in the past. However, this visit has me considering other options for my next trip to Punta Cana.

Melia, please take action—this beautiful resort deserves better.

reviews.author: Jalah Blackmon
reviews.text: Emmanuel and Jose were excellent bellboys! Very professional and nice! The bellhops, registration and food staff were all generally very kind and helpful. Housekeeping was not consistent in cleaning the room/offering new towels and washrags. Additionally the room service food was just okay, and we were unable to get reservations for dinner at the restaurants most night, which I didn’t really understand because it seemed they had the availability. Overall a great stay, but there were multiple instances were overall service quality could have been better.

reviews.author: Kermen Bembeeva
reviews.text: I wouldn't recommend book a room on the first floor.  I saw bugs crawling all the time. They didn't prepare our room, there was water all over the bathroom and it was really humid in the room. AC didn't work properly, but they fixed it. Another thing is that we were told by concierge that we don't need to make a reservation to a restaurant, turns out that you have to. Food was okay but service is good

reviews.author: snsr sa
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at this resort and were left disappointed by various aspects of the experience. The corridors were dark, and smelled like mold. Even the
