reviews.text: The food is good and varied. The staff is very friendly. But overall, there are better hotels in the area for better prices. In the beach area, the lounge chairs are reserved, but this isn't mentioned at check-in, and you only realize it when you go to the beach, and it's very unpleasant to be told to get up. Room service costs five dollars, which is free at other hotels in the area. At the pool, if you want a drink, you have to get up and go get it, whereas at other hotels, they make rounds to bring them to you. To make a restaurant reservation, you have to go several hours in advance and have staff help you, whereas at other hotels, a simple phone call is all it takes. The green areas are poorly lit, and it's scary to walk around at night. There are hardly any elevators; to get your luggage up in one, you have to walk a long way. The double and triple rooms have the bathroom right in front of the beds, offering no privacy. In short, it's not a bad hotel, the palatial decor is nice, but there are better ones for the same or better price in that area.

reviews.author: YON OCERIN
reviews.text:
MINA Restaurant.
We had dinner at MINA Restaurant and received excellent service. They were the most attentive compared to the other restaurants. Congratulations to Milton and his entire team.

reviews.author: maria flores
reviews.text: A very bad experience. On my second day at the hotel, my sunglasses went missing from my room. The only person who checked them was the housekeeper, and when I called to report it, as always, the guest was the one who lost out. They told me that since there was no proof, they couldn't do anything. The staff was unfriendly. The food at the buffet was terrible, the same thing every day, and the snacks were awful. The rooms were very old, and when they came to clean, they didn't leave towels. The restaurant I wanted to go to for dinner was never available. The beach was very dirty. I called at night to have something brought to my room, and they told me it would take an hour and a half. Very bad service. What I did like was the atmosphere they created at night with the music and dancing.

reviews.author: Abraham Isaac Sanchez Garcia
reviews.text:
This is a perfect hotel for meditation. If you're looking to relax, this isn't the hotel for you, as it's incredibly boring. There are no activities offered within the hotel, the nightclub closes at 1 a.m., and there's basically no entertainment during the day because there's no atmosphere.

The food is varied and I'd say quite good.

The rooms are so-so; they have an old-fashioned look, the beds are fine, but there's absolutely no privacy. If you go to the bathroom and someone else is outside, they can see you perfectly, and there's no way to block the view.

The service and the bar are very good, and the staff are very friendly.

Personally, I give this little hotel 3.5 out of 5 stars.

reviews.author: Fabrizio Ruoti V
reviews.text: The service in some places was terrible. But the service at the Lobby Bar saved the day: the best drinks and the best vibe. Luis Desa and Lucia Diaz stood out every night, providing the best service possible, thanks to more people like them!

reviews.author: Federico Minotti
reviews.text: The place is very beautiful, very eye-catching. The service leaves much to be desired. And the buffet service, both for breakfast and lunch, is deplorable. I arrived for lunch without even a glass of water; I had to arm myself for the table and ask for things more than three times. It's far too expensive to receive such treatment. For this reason, it shouldn't be rated 4 diamonds. Quite disappointed with the place.

reviews.author: Carlos Capurro A.
reviews.text: Good food; good facilities; terrible service. Management is dysfunctional, even though the staff is very friendly. You have to beg to get a reservation at the hotel restaurants, even though they're supposed to be included. Once you've made a reservation at the restaurants, everything is fine.

reviews.author: Carlos Govea
reviews.text:
The facilities are spectacular, the drinks are great, and the view is incredible. Perhaps because I'm from Mexico, I found the service incredibly cold, distant, and slow.

The reception was also slow, and the food... Mñe.

reviews.author: Sivane
reviews.text:
For the price that positions this hotel as high-end, the service was 90% terrible.
I don't know if it was due to a lack of staff, but there was never anyone to help us sit at the buffet restaurant, and every order took a long time.
The service inside the hotel wasn't very pleasant, at the pool bars, for example.
The spa had good service, but in the end, it was dependent on just one or two people.
I would recommend this hotel for having childcare and easy access to everything.
I wouldn't recommend it because of the customer service and the food, which wasn't very diverse or fresh (the cheeses and cold cuts didn't look fresh).

reviews.author: Dra. Yudelquis Guzman
reviews.text: The location, rooms, and facilities were all very nice. The staff was very friendly and helpful; Anyee's service was exceptional—she was the best employee. However, the food was very bad and there was little variety.

reviews.author: Natividad Jimenez Otaño
reviews.text: Most of the amenities were very good, the food not so much; the buffet lacked variety, and apparently the evening restaurants aren't meant for large crowds, which explains why they're almost always full. I'd give it a 3 for value. However, all the staff were very friendly and always willing to help.

reviews.author: Katherine Slater Greve
reviews.text:
The best part was the constant attention from our concierges, Osvaldo and Edgard. They were always concerned and attentive to all our questions.
The rest of the staff seemed unhappy and unfriendly.

reviews.author: Stefany Boscan
reviews.text: I only stayed one night and the rooms are very outdated, with old wood that smells musty, old TVs, and terrible TV reception—I couldn't get any channels. The view from my balcony overlooked a construction site belonging to the hotel, which was annoying. The food and pool were good.

reviews.author: Kamaleon Zynthoma
reviews.text: Very nice hotel but few entertainment options compared to other resorts

reviews.author: Aurelia Disla
reviews.text: Very beautiful hotel. The service was very good, especially Jordan's customer service. There were few restaurant options, supposedly due to the low number of guests. The massage was awful and the most expensive I've ever paid. But the hotel, the beach, and everything else were good.

reviews.author: Wendy Cruz
reviews.text: Much to be desired regarding the service, food, and facilities. A very bad experience: two hours waiting for room service, the buffet food not fresh, and the staff inattentive, although there are exceptions.

reviews.author: Kikue Tessy Tsumura Noda
reviews.text: Reynaldo, Frank, and Félix at Tokimeku Hibachi gave us the best experience. Very kind and helpful (unlike the other places).

reviews.author: Renee Jean Todeschini Suana
reviews.text: Flora Restaurant. The waiter Cesar was very attentive and his opinions on the dishes we chose were very helpful. Thank you.

reviews.author: claudia voigt
reviews.text: We went to Flora restaurant, Dominican food, a very nice place, the service was very good and the food was of very good quality and very tasty.

reviews.author: François Mongin
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with attentive and high-quality service, shared with The Reserve, another hotel located within the same resort, for which there is a marked preference: quieter, more chic, better quality clientele.

reviews.author: eduardo lorenzo maltes reyes
reviews.text: I was recently at a medical conference, there is not enough parking, the auditorium is on the ground floor, and there is no elevator to get there, so if you have a disability it is very difficult to get there by stairs.9

reviews.author: OMAR LIÑAN
reviews.text: My rating regarding the services, attention, cleanliness, and room is excellent, but I am celiac and breakfast and lunch are very difficult for people with this condition; they have almost nothing or nothing at all.

reviews.author: Cesarina Polanco
reviews.text: It's very luxurious and beautiful, but there are restricted areas for customers, which I didn't like. They offer customer rewards, but you don't get any privileges. The air conditioning isn't good; they have it under control. The food is excellent, and the staff is too.

reviews.author: David D
reviews.text: A very nice place, but the food isn't that great, because with such a variety of restaurants, you'd expect quality food, not quantity. As a member, I'm truly disappointed with the attention and consideration we receive.

reviews.author: fernando ureña
reviews.text: Bad, very bad, lack of attention, heat only in the bathrooms, and a nightclub is like there's no air conditioning! They ran out of food and now it's gone, there's nothing, absolutely no activities for children!

reviews.author: Alvaro Carnot
reviews.text: Starlin, the waiter at Kanna restaurant, gave us excellent, very attentive and friendly service.

reviews.author: Katerin Ubiera
reviews.text: Very good service, especially Milton, Daniela, and Rainer. Keep it up, guys. You're the best. The food is so good.

reviews.author: Minoska Benitez mojica
reviews.text: Excellent service, delicious food, and a pleasant atmosphere

reviews.author: Maria Andreu
reviews.text:
The best thing was the waiters at the pool bar. The restaurants and buffet lack coordination and a desire to work.
But it was a great vacation.

reviews.author: Екатерина Мазур
reviews.text: It's a beautiful hotel and that's it. The service is terrible, the food is absolutely terrible, and breakfast, lunch, dinner, and all the restaurants are so tasteless that I've never seen anything like it.

reviews.author: Łukasz Górnicki
reviews.text: The restaurants and service were wonderful. The hostess, Jafreisy Lopez, gave me a warm welcome; she's a very nice person. And the waiter, Georgi, is excellent at providing service. They both provide the best service.

reviews.author: Katy Sanches
reviews.text: Very good experience, excellent hotel and very good customer service

reviews.author: Karina Espinosa
reviews.text: The service was decent, but there were a lot of flies at the buffet and it looked a bit neglected.

reviews.author: Sarahi Villanueva
reviews.text: Thank you, the facilities are very nice, but the service was sometimes not good, and there was a noticeable difference in treatment between us as Latinos and the Europeans or Americans, which I consider to be in bad taste.

reviews.author: Fernando Oviedo
reviews.text: Hidrogrill has the best Dominican beef, but the hotel still has a long way to go to match the cost of service.

reviews.author: Marite Nieto
reviews.text: I want to congratulate Darwin Santos, Roberto, and Antonio at H2O bar for their excellent service. The best service I've ever received.

reviews.author: Jose Sosa
reviews.text: It's good, but they're neglecting the hotel's maintenance; for example, the fountains don't even turn on anymore, and there are many defects in the rooms that could be improved.

reviews.author: juani infante
reviews.text: Everything was fine at the Hydro Grill restaurant, except the fan wasn't working because there was no electricity.

reviews.author: Vanessa Sanchez
reviews.text: Excellent activities for children, all-day entertainment. The rooms could be a little cleaner.

reviews.author: Juan Adolfo
reviews.text:
TV malfunction.

No complimentary gift.

Children's games only in The Reserve.
Otherwise excellent.

reviews.author: Emmanuel Martinez
reviews.text: Very good, and Ana's service was excellent. 100% recommended.

reviews.author: Luis Espinal
reviews.text:
Terrible service, the room isn't ready when indicated.
The food was good, the shows were good, but the customer service left a lot to be desired.

reviews.author: Tania
reviews.text: The hotel is too noisy, with poorly soundproofed rooms. The beach has a lot of seaweed. The food is very good.

reviews.author: ximena ochoa
reviews.text: Flora restaurant is the best in the hotel, the food is very authentic and the service is the best of all.

reviews.author: José Gañán
reviews.text: Excellent service from Maira and Betty at the buffet. A++

reviews.author: Alberto FelizCamarena
reviews.text:
The food and breakfast were horrible, and the beach was very far away.
Very friendly staff, which saved the experience a bit.

reviews.author: Hans Lange
reviews.text: Many untrained staff members provide poor service. Tremendous internal bureaucracy.

reviews.author: Mike Fraser
reviews.text: The place is nice. The service is a disaster. Nobody helps you and everyone has a sour face.

reviews.author: Delia Rivas Khouri
reviews.text: The food wasn't good, and it was very expensive for what they offered. I wasn't surprised.

reviews.author: jorge degiorgis
reviews.text: Very nice hotel but the food is mediocre and the service is very poor.

reviews.author: France Grenier
reviews.text: Part of the hotel near the sea was completely closed for construction, but it was very nice.

reviews.author: helena almeida xavier
reviews.text: Makati was a very good waiter and very attentive!!

reviews.author: Alicja Kowalska
reviews.text: We're unlucky, it's algae bloom season now. Only Russians and Americans are on the beaches.

reviews.author: Nelson Andrés Dominguez
reviews.text: The hotel is very well maintained but the service is clumsy.

reviews.author: Bruna Galvão
reviews.text: Because I received poor service from some waiters at restaurants.

reviews.author: Enrique Mejia
reviews.text: The quality has gone down a lot; the food isn't the same as it was 4 years ago when I was there for the first time.

reviews.author: Juan De Lorenzo
reviews.text: It's a good hotel, I don't like all-inclusive resorts

reviews.author: LUIS VELAZQUEZ
reviews.text: With the quality of Melia but not as cool as the one in Riviera Maya

reviews.author: Santa Alejandra Rodriguez Morales
reviews.text: It's good, but it doesn't meet my expectations for a 5-star rating.

reviews.author: Alex David Cueto Santillan
reviews.text: Little variety of activities and the same dishes are repeated in every restaurant

reviews.author: Mayorista Pinto
reviews.text: Lunch box, good service.

reviews.author: Mauricio Cortes
reviews.text: The hotel rooms are a bit run down and the service is not great.

reviews.author: José Montero J.M.M.H
reviews.text: I didn't like their rooms or the disco hours.

reviews.author: Richard Cammarano
reviews.text: Excellent atmosphere and service.

reviews.author: Ceoany Romero
reviews.text: It's an old hotel and they oversell it only to then not provide 5-STAR service! 😩

reviews.author: Joan Muñoz (andanzastoursrd)
reviews.text: At the time of my visit it was closed for renovations

reviews.author: Евгений Перфильев
reviews.text: The hotel did not live up to expectations for the money.

reviews.author: Mercedes Pérez Castillo
reviews.text: Neglected, terrible and little variety in the food.

reviews.author: Carlos Alfredo Pimentel Bernal
reviews.text: Flora restaurant is very good

reviews.author: Carlos bisson
reviews.text: The level of service is decreasing due to many changes.

reviews.author: Leiva Rosa
reviews.text: Great facilities. But poor service.

reviews.author: Giselle Tufaro
reviews.text: The quality of everything has dropped considerably. It's a shame.

reviews.author: Sebastián C.
reviews.text: Outstanding facilities that contrast sharply with the limited capacity of the staff.

reviews.author: chris espelien
reviews.text:
This place is beautiful. The plaza, the beach, the pools.. all beautiful and clean. The rooms were acceptable: decent size and nice enough, with visible signs of poor workmanship on repairs. The food was mediocre to bad, and was a general disappointment. The coffee was good. Majority of employees speak only Spanish.

For my money, there are better options. I will not return here.

reviews.author: Bob Blevins
reviews.text:
This is our fourth time coming to this resort and I’ve always had a great experience with the exception of this time. 90% of the staff is extremely rude and will not engage you in any conversation. The buffet workers avoid making eye contact with you because they don’t want to bring you any water and if you ask for some they make you feel like it is a bother. We were at the pool and they ran out of towels to use, there were four workers at a bar that was not busy at all. I asked one of them if I could call someone and get some more towels so my wife and I could lay out. This particular pool was very close to the sister property next-door, the worker pointed to a White hut and said go over there and get a towel, so I did and the gentleman that were there argued with me and said I could not have one because my wristband was from next-door. Ultimately, they ended up giving me two towels. I went back to my chairs and the lady that I asked for the towels did nothing to replenish the towels at that station. She was more concerned with playing on her phone than helping any vacationer.

This is one example of many experiences. I was paying for A total of three rooms which equates to just under $15,000 for this vacation, including airfare. Next year, I will take that money and go to Resort that welcomes me.

This is very sad because this was our favorite place to vacation.

I strongly encourage everyone to read the reviews before you spend your money here. If service is important to you, this is not the place to come.

reviews.author: Cecilia Osimanti
reviews.text:
We booked Paradisus as a family trip to celebrate a birthday.  Overall, the resort gets 2 stars from me, which I really wish I  could give more. My breakdown is below:

The Food:  for being a 5-star resort, I was expecting better food. The best food we had while on our trip was off the resort on an excursion (which wasn't even food based).  It was a real let down that we are more rice and beans at Paradisus Palma Real than anything else. The room service was below sub-par, and very inconsistent with quality and even ingredients.

The Atmosphere:  the pools were fine. Many options to choose from. The point where the atmosphere really diminished my enjoyment of a beach vacation was the bar tender on the Reserve side of the beach who consistently yipped to get attention and customers. This started the moment he got into the bar to the second he left. Non-stop. Every day. Consierge doesn't care about it, either.

Consierge:  there's a number of restaurants that are on property that I would have loved to try, but was unable to due to "no reservations" available. We got "the last reservation available on property" on Sunday, to find out that we were one of two couples in the restaurant. While I could understand limited reservations due to being packed, this resort was short of full and the demand for the restaurants was equally low.

The Spa:  I had a wonderful time at the spa, which I would like to give 5-stars to. This is the only thing saving my review from being a 1-star review.

Farming Reviews:  while dining, we were asked by waitstaff to complete a review of her services. When the QR code was scanned, it brought you to a document to review the entire resort. This felt scammy and left an overall bad taste in my mouth.

I will not return here, nor can I recommend others stay here.

reviews.author: Alexis Wafford
reviews.text:
Giving two starts because the property is so beautiful and in most cases the service was good. However the experience here was disappointing.

Let’s start with check in, I have the Amex platinum so I requested the room upgrade and the lady at the front told me they had upgraded my room, cool so I’m passed off to my concierge and then he looks at the room number and is confused and runs back to the desk to ask why I didn’t get an upgraded room and the same lady that informed me I had a upgrade told the concierge there were none available. So the lady just flat out lied to me.

Next the concierge. I stayed a total of 4 nights and was only able to reserve a restaurant on one night (reservation only restaurants) and it was horrible. He was supposed to follow up on multiple nights with our reservations and didn’t, so we ended up having to eat at the buffet just about every night, which was just decent, a lot of the food was cold but the desserts/fruit were good, omelet station and meat grill was about the best thing going since it’s freshly made. Service is good in the buffet and at Ginger though but unfortunately I didn’t get to experience many restaurants to provide any reviews on those.

Also they send this pre arrival form, that I don’t understand the point of. I informed them of my birthday and they told me I’d get a cake, never received that.. and also requested extra water in my room which they completely ignored and continuously had to request water.

What else, housekeeping was pretty good except for like one day where we didn’t get our room cleaned until 6pm which was annoying. Bell boys were great.

The only other issue I had was late check out, my Amex portal has guaranteed late checkout for THC AND FHR, however they informed me that it was not available for our room? I’ll definitely be reviewing through the Amex portal as well because this was not the best experience. I would love to give this property another chance when I return but not so sure about that.

reviews.author: Polina Lemberg
reviews.text:
Would like to share my recent experience  about Paradisus Palma Real hotel in DR.
I can only say that beach was beautiful  and very comfortable beach chairs.
The reservation to restaurants is not good.
It is hard to get a spot for time you are prefer.
We lived in the first room at building number 2.
One day I saw roaches in the rest room.
First time I ask the front desk receptionist and informed him about the issue, the result was zero.
I asked again a different person at the front desk, and was informed that nobody took care about roaches.
The most upsetting for me was that the last day of vacation I saw roach at headboard in the bed.
It is really disgusting.
In few restaurants the service was bed.
The waitress messed up with order and bring different fishes which we not ordered.
The restaurant we visit once Olio,  make me more upset ever.
Lady who serves us was very slow and not polite.
We was waiting to get appetizers 40 minutes,
Main course we also waited for half in our.
Different waiters served people who came much later us  quickly.
When we ordered the dessert and waiting 20 minutes, I decided to leave.
I can’t believe that such a famous hotel had been served quest with very lousy, unprofessional and  not pleasant attitude.
Not recommended to choose Paradisus Palma Real hotel in DR.

reviews.author: Lidiya Vynnytska
reviews.text:
Location and beach is the only nice thing about this place. They must have paid to people for the review here, otherwise I am not sure how someone would enjoy this place.
After 16 hours door to door travel from the UK we came here on 4th of April with the hope to finally have some rest. Instead I spent 3 hours back and forth with the front manager in duty trying to fit our family of 4 into room that has only one bed. She was absolutely unprofessional and lied to my face that they have no other rooms and that BA had sold us room with wrong description and we should deal with travel agent as they can’t do anything about it since their hotel in 100% capacity. Apparently junior suit with the separate living room and sofa bed meant to be in 1 room with the bench to sleep on as a sofa bed.
In addition we spent 2 days trying to have extra bed delivered to our room for my child.
Service in the main restaurant is appalling, they are lucking on all basic items every day, takes forever to get any drinks. (I would say there is no service). Rooms are generally not looked after.
We came to this hotel as they had golf and tennis, just so you know none is within the hotel and you need to pay extra to play it.
And highlight of the first day was when I came to the beach and they said they do not have any towels left🤬. Seriously, I had better service received in the 3 star hotels. This hotel charge you $550 per night as a 5*, however the place is generally mismanaged in every possible place. Would not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Visa El
reviews.text: This place is a beautiful place. But definitely need better service. Apart from maybe 4 servers that were pretty awesome. They didn't have the room we wanted. Food was mediocre at best. Manager put our family of 4 n a double double room instead the 2 bedroom master suite.. With King? A little disappointed with the service. But shout outs to Guillermo, Martha from lunch box and the 4 or 5 special ones who understands and know what customer service is all about.I don't blame the workers at all. Most of them work really hard.. It's leadership n management that should make adjustments, pay attention to details when it comes to first time family guests and train their staff better. Not a fan of nickel n dimen of non premium members. They wanted to sell us on membership/subscription? They need to treat first time guests and families with the best experience as a first impression, if they want to win family subscription? Make first time guest feel like they already a premium patron. You will probably have a member for life? Adios!

reviews.author: Matthew Kan
reviews.text:
Avoid this hotel if you always speak English, but not Spanish. Most of the stuff here only speak Spanish they don’t even speak minimum English. It is very hard for me to communicate what I need to them.

Check in process was difficult. You have to pausing the check-in time 3 pm. My room is still not ready. It was ready until 4 pm.

Food is okay they didn’t really chip out on the selections of ingredients however it is not tasty compared to its competitor.

The beach is nice, however, it is always lacking towel provided to you.

Poor service: as I’ve mentioned previously language is an issues. However, I also find that they are very eager of tips if you don’t pay tips you don’t get good service which I think is a big no-no in this all-inclusive hotel that’s unprofessional. Plus, even when I put on the do not disturb light or one of the staff still knocks our door to ask if we need to refill our mini bar. Really unprofessional.

Overall, as a Hilton Gold member and Marriott Bonvoy Diamond member. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone even if they have discount.

I have no idea why it has 4.8 stars on google review actually. Tell me if you have a different opinion.

reviews.author: Jen Flory
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at Paradisus Palma Real – The Reserve, and while the property itself is beautiful, our overall experience didn’t quite live up to expectations.
The grounds are absolutely gorgeous and very well maintained—no complaints there. However, the service was inconsistent. Some staff members were warm, pleasant, and helpful, while others seemed inconvenienced and uninterested in assisting guests.
Dining was one of the biggest disappointments. Upon arrival, we were asked for our preferred restaurants, but when it came time to confirm reservations, none of our requests were available. We were left choosing between limited openings or the buffet. Food quality overall was underwhelming, including room service. The one highlight was the omelette bar, which was consistently good.
One bright spot of the trip was the main pool swim-up bar. The bartenders—Eddy, Jorge, and Dalania—were fantastic and truly made our last day enjoyable.
The room itself was another letdown. It felt very humid and never fully cooled, which made it uncomfortable at times. Additionally, our room wasn’t ready at check-in, and when we finally got access, the minibar hadn’t been stocked. While not a major issue on its own, it added to the overall feeling that the experience didn’t match the resort’s reputation.
We were honestly surprised by the high ratings, as we’ve had much better experiences at other Caribbean resorts. While the property looks incredible on paper, it didn’t deliver in several key areas.
Overall, not worth the hype.

reviews.author: Ryan Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: This hotel was very disappointing. The food was subpar at best, and not edible at worst. The staff were mostly friendly but the service at the restaurants was slow, illogical and disorganized. Many of them didn’t seem to care.  The hot water in our room rarely worked and the shower pressure was pathetic. Lastly there was very little to do for kids. The pools were cold but there were very few shallow areas and nothing substantial to help entertain kids for a week. After reading the reviews I was very excited that we had found a gem but I will not be coming back

reviews.author: Ryan Taft
reviews.text:
Staff friendliness was at the bottom end of acceptable, but did not meet my expectations at all. English ability enough to get by but difficult too often for me. Food was ok, rooms were very nice. Trash in bushes. Pool bar had 1x3' chunk of the top broken off with a giant rusty chunk of steel sticking out (right where people get in and out, very dangerous). We were there 5 days, it never got covered/roped off/fixed, nothing. The broken chunk was laying in the bushes behind the nearby bathroom. Solicitors on the beach very aggressive. One of them FREAKED OUT when I told him to leave us alone, started cursing at top of his lungs and even took steps towards me. For a few seconds we thought he was going to attack us. Totally ruined the beach for us. On checkout we told the staff that an overgrown palm tree was completely blocking the view from our balcony and suggested trimming it slightly. The staff did not thank me for letting them know, didn't care, and I'm positive that tree is not getting trimmed.

Comparing to prior experience in Mexico, I was disappointed and would not go back.

reviews.author: Livia Cruz
reviews.text: We stayed at the resort for 4 nights for my husband's birthday. We booked The Reserve section for reference. We arrived and had to wait for over an hour for our room, I believe it was close to 5 pm when it was ready. The room was nice enough. The biggest issue for us was the food. The Mexican restaurant served food that should not be for human consumption to be honest. The pork dish was all fat, we left mid-dinner because it was so bad. Most of the staff were not welcoming. Service was super slow at the beach, we actually had to get up and just go to the bar. I went to the coffee bar near the entrance for a drink and there were 3 women behind the counter and not one tried to help me..and when I left one yelled asking me to go back but I ignored it. Entertaining was okay but the DJ played the same songs every night...overall it was a very disappointing experience and we will not be back. If you are a foodie, avoid this place at all cost. Oh, and they will try to convince you to join presentation to become a Circle member...glad we did not go because we don't plan on staying at any other property of this group!

reviews.author: mike d
reviews.text:
There are pros and cons to this place, and I will list them accurately so that everyone can judge for themselves -
Pros - the place is located in a very beautiful area, the entire resort looks and feels like you're on vacation, and many of the pics you take will show very well, if its for social media posting or basic family pics,
The weather - depending on the time of year is usually great, you should be careful for excessive sun, the uv rating is extremely high, but understandably so,
Cons - I have been to this place 3 times over the past 20 years, and I remember when it 1st opened they had celebrities promoting it (JLo and the likes), and the service was absolutely amazing, where I had never experienced anything great like it before, that is why I chose to revisit more times, had a few family and friends do destination weddings here, and always highly recommend to everyone, but this last time I recently visited, I was let down and disappointed on so many levels that I don't see myself recovering from it, namely for these reasons -
I initially booked 5 rooms for a large family party, where their initial reservations told me I have to contact their corporate office because it was too much for them to handle, ok fine I did contact them, but trying to give them the down payment on my cc was a hassle because their company is based in Mexico and for some reason I had to reach out to my cc company where it still took 5 days to finally process, ok fine I received an email confirmation for the reservation booking,
Come to the arrival day, I come there with my family, coming off the bus and all ready to start our vacation, where I end up stuck at the front reception desk for 2 and half hours because they cannot locate or find my reservation, and they're looking at me like I’m from another planet, thankfully I showed them the email confirmation, to which they still had to locate us 5 rooms, to which I originally requested that we all be together within the same building area, but no, we ended up being spread all over the place separately, and they charged me for the entire cost without deducting the down payment, to which they kept telling me they could not locate it in their system, to which I kept showing them my email and cc statement where it showed that it was charged, starting off my vacation on this foot made me severely agitated and only further annoyed my entire time spent there,
I spent everyday at the front reception for a minimum of an hour trying to resolve and have the hotel locate and credit my deposit back to my card, only to be met with everyone ‘deeply apologizing’ to me and giving me their whatsapp phone numbers, but even when I texted anyone on their whatsapp, no one ever replied or answered me back the entire time, I demanded a meeting with the head person/manager/boss/whatever, where I got a phone call on the room phone only to have them keep saying “hello – hello, can you hear me?  Are you there?” and then only hung up.  Told this to the front desk and they said they would send someone immediately to change the phone in the room – which was not the problem.  I had to threaten them on the last day that I was going to dispute the entire charge on my credit card, to which then they miraculously found the down payment, and then proceeded to deduct it from the total amount charged.

reviews.author: Shubhendu Tripathi
reviews.text:
I enjoyed the location but service wise - it’s kind of garbage . If you have been to any 5-7 star resorts in SE Asia, prepare to be underwhelmed. Other than a few good staff, most of the staff do not have a sense of what a good hospitality should be like. Better to go to Bahamas. And I say with full humility and keeping the bias out of it - for the money, this resort isn’t worth it .
For example - you get 24 hour in room dining - but the menu is only fries and soup.
Another example is - you pay for an all
Inclusive resort but most of the beaches - you have to pay in some kind of purchase to access .

reviews.author: Linda Moran
reviews.text: A Ivelicce and Rocio were very attentive and helpful. Great service!👍🏻

reviews.author: Mike Kohn
reviews.text:
The service was very poor, the food was average at best to poor. Room service is an absolute mess they would either take forever or not answer (suppose to be 24hrs)

There are people trying to sell you stuff non stop, some of which are employees of the resort feigning friendly conversation  to upsell you excursions while you’re trying to eat breakfast.

I booked two rooms I was told would be adjoining they were next to each other but not adjoining. There is a bit of a language barrier, some employees spoke English fairly well and some seemed to not understand a single thing I said and would need to ask another employee. They’re all nice but this makes even simple things like ordering coffee a pain at times.

There are other things but I think I made my point. Would not recommend and def not coming back.

reviews.author: H
reviews.text:
Would not recommend this resort.

Pros: Beautiful location. Look at the photos for how surreal the location and architecture is. The facilities are aesthetically beautiful.

There’s always some sort of entertainment in the square of the resort every night - eg acrobats, bands, DJ, etc. Pretty chill. And it changes daily.

Cons:
1) When we first arrived, we were told to leave our luggage at the entrance to the lobby for it to be taken to our room…It was never taken to our room. We waited in the room for hours until the evening and still our baggage hadn’t arrived despite contacting the concierge regarding such and being told someone will be by to drop the bags. We had to go and get our bags that were sitting where we left them. Because at a certain point we really just wanted to change clothes.
2) There aren’t many activities offered. Would have been nice to have more options offered. Some of the activities like the sports or dancing - no other guest tended to show up for which is not the resorts fault. But when we were there for one of the activities, the activities coordinator indicated they were leaving to get something and would be back (they never came back). Also ensure to get to activities somewhat on time because they can run out of materials. There are activities like painting certain objects which they can run out of said object. Spa is good but very expensive.
3) The safe and the room phone were not working. Someone came to try to fix the safe but not the room phone. The safe still had issues but was usable. Would recommend ordering breakfast room service the day before. It was nice sitting on the balcony and eating in the morning. But ended up having to order the food through the concierge since the phone to call room service didn’t work. Also had to ask the concierge for the room service menu since the QR code in the room that we were told was the menu didn’t include breakfast options.
4) Restaurants are not great. There are only about 2 places open for breakfast and lunch while there are more options for dinner. You do need to make reservations for dinner or else you cannot dine there. It was difficult to make a reservation prior to getting to the resort but if you do contact them you should be able to. There is a limited number of reservations but some places can be closed so either way you may not get the place you want to dine. Just give the resort a few options of the places you would want to dine at. Anyway, the food was ehhh. Not great. Not amazing. Mediocre. And most guests we spoke to had the same sentiment. If you are a foodie, would 100% say do not come here. Go to a resort in Mexico or somewhere else because this is not the place for you. Hibachi didn’t have much of a show (there wasn’t any egg juggling, no volcano onion fun, etc), the food was mostly cooked with some sort of sauce that made it all taste the same (sauce was not great tasting).  Steak house was somewhat better than the other places we went but still not amazing. Would recommend the ice cream - it was pretty good. Would recommend the lunch box as a slightly better lunch spot. Be mindful that some places don’t allow you to eat at the restaurant in swim suits so bring a coverup/other clothes unless you want to go back to the room following swimming.
5) Can get drinks by the pool. You can ask for a coconut to drink coconut water out of. But drinks like Coke tasted off and flat despite coming straight from the bottle and the bottle wasn’t expired. They do have a premixed pina colada which was ehh not amazing.

6) There is a casino and sauna that you are allowed to access but it’s at a different property “nearby” which you need to ask the front desk to have a golf cart take you over there. We did not try to check it out.

The sun was baking us for most of the day. Make sure to wear lots of sun screen.

If you have someone in your party who speaks Spanish, that’s ideal. Most staff knew at least a small amount of English but with most it was difficult to communicate without someone who can speak Spanish in the party.

reviews.author: Rebecca Stephens
reviews.text:
Consistently pressurised to write a review with team members looking over your shoulder whilst you completed. Unsurprising there are so many 5 star reviews when it forms part of competition winning…
We have a lot of feedback on this resort where we found the service to be quite poor overall but a longer review will take time

reviews.author: Kristina khol
reviews.text:
2nd time here unfortunately my last.
Few years back I stayed as a reserve member
This time I had my reservation pre booked for me and was just at the adults only section without any reserve upgrades . Upon checkin we asked what kind of room it was I mentioned I’m here on holiday with my father .
My room was not cleaned daily till 3 pm. On first night I showed the lady the bed came without a blanket to please bring one .
I called and asked for a blanket 3 times and never got one.
The arrangement of the rooms is very unusual. There is a see through curtain with minimal to no privacy to change or while using the shower /bathroom . The see through Curtain  leaves you no privacy to change with another person in the same room accept for the tiny toilet . The shower doors are clear again no privacy . I had to hang a towel off the shower door.the coffee machine did not work.
The light stand beside the mini bar was standing for props the plug didn’t even fit into the wall socket. Strange thing to have knowing it doesn’t fit there .

They used to have a very nice spa maybe it’s on the reserve side not sure . Now the yihi spa is a hut it’s just a space for massage that they up charge $200 .

The food was a bust!
Every restaurant we went to was worse than the the last.  The sushi at Asian was terrible.
Italian was a complete fail. Served us spaghetti with clams minus the clams .
The buffet was very good . We should have stuck to that one for dinner  . We had buffet for breakfast and lunch and everything was pretty good. Not sure why the restaurants were not. The service at the restaurants was good . Same for the buffet . Water plenty of it . And the snack bar was a nice touch in the room .

The night time was weak and boring. 3 nights in a row they had some sort of meticore band playing in the lobby . Put me to sleep that I couldn’t stand to see if anything else was going on past 9:30.
Some entertainment or show would have been good but they had nothing going on.
At the beach we layed out under the umbrella had a nice relaxing time
The second day we walked out a bit and found a much more comfortable bed with mattress padding just 2 feet over from where we were yesterday. I had 3 people come to attack us that my bracelet was not Reserve and I couldn’t be there . I get the reserve privileges but did i really need the attitude to tell me to move off the mattress padded lounge chair because my bracelt was of the different color.  I paid to be on that beach too.
Anyway not sure if I lost out by not getting reserve or they just added on stupid perks for reserve members I certainly didn’t appreciate and would not come back just to get a comfier lounge chair.
Otherwise the place is beautiful has a lot of changes since I’ve been there first time . WiFi works well. Totally lacks evening entertainment.

reviews.author: Willie Harrington
reviews.text: There were many reasons for my dislike of the resort. First, when trying to upgrade my room online, it kept denying my card despite it being the same card I used for the initial reservations with AND. When I arrived at the resort, I used the very same card, but now additional steps were needed. Additionally, the service was poor. Some staff members were okay, but many made me feel as though I was irritating them. Third, the beach could not be accessed. The brown seaweed and its smell made going to the beach pointless. Lastly, the food was HORRIBLE. Many items, such as fries, hashbrowns, and cooked meats like the breakfast sausage, were reused the next day. They were cold, dry, and clearly old. The charcuterie section had all the proteins and cheeses out in the open, but they were not kept on cold displays or on ice. The meats were hot and sweaty, and the cheeses were melting. The bartenders at certain pools were not welcoming. No poolside food service, which I have never experienced at other resorts, was also a disappointment. Overall, I cannot recommend this resort, and I will never visit again.

reviews.author: Ent
reviews.text: honestly the hotel itself is pretty nice, the food is just ok, but the service here is horrible. i don’t think i’ve ever been treated as bad anywhere else. not all employees are mean but some of them don’t even acknowledge you are there, they don’t say hi or talk to you at all, there’s this one employee who looked at me in a condescending way and overall was really mean. also i was obligated to leave a good review because a girl working here would not leave me alone until she saw i posted a 5 star review so probably all good reviews containing employees names are just fake and forced. she was way too pushy and all over my personal space almost grabbing my phone which i didn’t like. The service here is so bad it honestly kinda ruined my vacation.

reviews.author: Zoya Yeprem
reviews.text:
Despite the resort's five-star rating, our recent experience fell far short of expectations.

Firstly, the service was virtually non-existent. We requested extra blankets almost daily during our stay, but they never arrived. Room service was equally disappointing; a simple request for milk for our coffee was ignored. In fact, most requests made from our room were met with indifference or simply ignored.

Secondly, the quality of the food was mediocre. While the a la carte restaurants offered better dining experiences, the buffet was underwhelming.

Finally, the condition of the room was concerning. The furnishings seemed to be held together with glue, with a wobbly sink and an outlet socket that came loose from the wall. The sink drain was clogged, causing water to back up quickly.

Furthermore, while the gift shop offers some over-the-counter medicine for cold or stomach aches, I recommend to check the box before you pay for it. They often sell individual pills out of the box, and you may end up with an empty box if you don't check. The gift shop manager is extremely rude and would out right accuse you of stealing before checking their own records. This is not an acceptable behavior from a five-star resort.

While the resort was immaculately clean and the outdoor pool area was lovely, these positives were overshadowed by the poor service and subpar amenities. Given these significant shortcomings, I can only give this resort two stars. Unfortunately after this bitter experience we won’t be staying at another Paradisus hotel.

reviews.author: Daniel Jung
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort has been one of my favorite all-inclusive resorts in the world, and this was my second time staying here. My first trip was during the pandemic, and despite the restrictions, I had an absolutely amazing experience. The resort is beautiful, the food is top-notch, and the service is generally fantastic.

However, I have to say that my most recent experience was marred by one major issue: the resort's strict policy on outside excursions. For over a decade, I’ve been using Viator and booking excursions all around the world without issue. I arrived in the Dominican Republic with a list of pre-booked activities, only to find out that the resort doesn’t allow any outside companies to pick up guests for excursions. This was incredibly frustrating, especially since I had already paid for the excursions in advance.

To make matters worse, when I asked about arranging a car service to the airport (since outside services aren't allowed), I was quoted an outrageous $300 for a simple transfer. Meanwhile, my group's airport transportation to the resort in a suburban was only $70. This felt like a blatant attempt to funnel guests into the resort's own overpriced excursions and transportation services, which seemed like a monopoly and left a very bad taste in my mouth.

It’s disappointing to see a resort with such a strong reputation engage in practices like this that feel exploitative. While the resort itself is still beautiful and offers a great all-inclusive experience, I really hope they reconsider their policies to allow outside excursion services. It’s a shame that such a wonderful place is tarnished by this unnecessary and frustrating issue.

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.text:
We arrived and waited several hours for our room to be ready. When we arrived in the room the couch was stained orange with an unknown orange substance.

On our second day of the stay we received 3 calls within 45 minutes asking us to confirm our last name and when we checked in. I went to the front desk to ask them to stop calling my room and when I went back they had deactivated all of the wristbands of my party and would not tell me why. They reactivated the wristbands, but would not explain what happened, why we kept being called or why they deactivated our access. No apologies, restitution or comps were offered.

The service was otherwise good and aside from the weird stain on the couch the rooms were nice, but the entire experience has been bizarre.

reviews.author: Ralphy D.
reviews.text: The room was really nice. The staff was very friendly and helpful but at a price. Bring tip money. The food at the buffet was terrible. They over cook everything. The steak, the pork, and the chicken were all cooked to death. The only restaurant that was remotely palatable was the Italian pizza place. The guy walking around the pool selling excursions (last name Smith) was terrible. He was very pushy and intrusive. He had zero regard for personal space and was very insistent. I ended up buying a dune buggy excursion for my 10 year old son and I and I learned from the other people on the excursion that I overpaid. The transportation to and from the excursion was atrocious. I will not be back. I was ambushed and pressured by three female servers at the buffet to post a positive review on Google. That was very unprofessional and a very uncomfortable experience. My family and I will not be back.

reviews.author: Autry Tysinger Jr
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and our first (and last) stay at a Melia Resort.
First off, the property and beach were beautiful, however that beauty was overshadowed by issue after issue.
Good experiences...Gustavo in Sante is wonderful. Wanda at the Fahrenheit pool bar is fabulous! The 80-minute couples massage that we paid for was excellent. Out therapists Alba and Maria gave us great deep tissue massages.
Issues that occurred during our stay:
•	We had no concierge on Day 1 and part of Day 2. We were told upon check-in that Adriel would be our concierge, and that our luggage would be delivered within the hour.  I had to call the front desk after 2 hours to have them find our luggage. This caused us to miss dinner on Day 1 . The room service food was terrible. How do you mess up a cheeseburger? Melia can do it! Adriel finally contacted us at 9:30pm via WhatsApp on Day 1. We found out he had left at 5:00pm, so there was no way we would have gotten our luggage without me calling and complaining.
•	On Day 1, The shower was not draining.  I messaged Adrial and also called the front desk. This issue was fixed on Day 4. The water flowed out of the shower into our room and into the water closet.  We had to make a dam out of towels when we used the shower.
•	Called the front desk and messaged Adrial about air conditioning on Day 1 not cooling enough. This issue was fixed late on Day 2.
•	Our Minibar was not stocked upon arrival.
•	Had to visit the Reserve lounge on Day 2 to ask for an on-site concierge, because our concierge, Adrial, was not going to be onsite again on Day 2. We got Alam, our 2nd concierge, that gave us a tour that we should have received on Day 1. He said he would make our dinner reservations. My wife had to send Alam a WhatsApp message to remind him about dinner reservations EVERYDAY or else we would have not gotten dinner reservations. We requested dinner reservations be between 6pm-8pm. Only 1 dinner was scheduled between 6pm-8pm. The rest was after 8pm.
•	We received one message about activities the entire stay from our concierges. This was on Day 1 and we did not receive any more. We were supposed to receive a message every morning about the day's activities.
•	On Day 5, Alum told us he was off for the rest of our stay. We were then assigned to Gustavo our 3rd concierge. I didn't think things could have been worse well Gustavo proved that they could.
•	On Day 5 We were told by Gustavo to wait in our room because the manager was coming by to talk to us. We waited over 2 hours and had to get to our 8:30pm dinner reservation. The manager never showed up.
•	On Day 5 the room was not serviced. Green ('Make up room') light was on since breakfast. Had to complain to Gustavo after coming back from our 8:30pm (turned into 9pm) dinner. The room was finally serviced late. The Minibar was not serviced.
•	On Day 6 the concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez, met with me and my wife on our room's patio. I told them everything. They both agreed that we did not receive the Reserve service that we had paid for and they agreed to talk to upper management about refunding us the Reserve rate minus the regular resort room rate (wo/ concierge service). We thought everything was going to be settled after that, but NO!
•	Day 7: We were checking out and I had not heard from Alvaro. I messaged him on WhatsApp (see attachment). Since we booked through Costco Travel they are basically not honoring the agreement from Day 6. Melia owns the resort, not Costco!
After we returned, we contacted Costco Travel. They reached out to the resort and the resort is now saying that they are not honoring anything talked about with concierge manager and the resort manager, Alvaro Fernandez on Day 6.
My suggestion…if you go to this resort do not upgrade to the concierge or reserve service. I wish we had had concierges like the other guests had. If you get Adriel, Alam, or (God forbid) Gustavo, you need to request someone else.

reviews.author: Igor Yushchenko
reviews.text:
Came on Friday, today is Monday. We had to go to Lobby 5 times, as our keys do not work. They could not fix the issue so the best way is to stop by lobby and ask for the “door guy” to open our rooms. No one seems really care, except us that we could not enter into the room. Also, we have two kids and our room is on the third floor and there is no elevator. We asked to change, but no luck.
Beach is good. Food is good. But because the door issue, we could not relax.

reviews.author: Kristen Maurer
reviews.text:
Not the luxury arrival you would expect no towel no drink and then to make matters work we were  not given or told about resort just given incorrect information about the restaurant situation.
We were told restaurants were open or available to us when they were not open.we complained to the concierge regarding the amount of time and inconvenience we had making reservations.  The concierge told us that he would look into it and get back to us.  We never received further communication from him.
If you have a food allergy stay away I have a lactose allergy.  This was on the reservations card and was told to the staff when we arrived at the restaurant.  When questioned about the food, staff did not know what foods had lactose and at Flora I was given butter in her main dish.  I do want to point out that at Mascalzone the staff did pay attention to my food allergy.

At 11:00 am we were lying out by the adult pool.  However, our peaceful morning was interrupted by staff doing yard maintenance including using a very loud chainsaw.
Children were always in the adult area and pool. This is not enforced at all. Screaming babies and children jumping in the pool.

Every morning when we would go out to lay by the pool at 10:00 am we could not find beach towels.  We always had to wait for them.
We would ask Staff how and where to make reservations, get towels, or how to make our airport transfer. We were provided with different answers or staff didn’t know. This was frustrating because we did not know what was going on.
Staff did not explain what they were doing with our luggage during the checkout process. ie where to go, cutting wrist band, room charges.

I asked when they can cut off the wrist band she stated upon departure no one ever cut anything off of us. Another stupid thing but they all start to add up.

WiFi password was not given to us nor was there information in the room. I called and was given the information to use a certain network that didn’t work and so they said “ooo you have an apple phone, you need to to use this other network and the password was like 1000 characters and numbers. Again no information shared and when it was shared it was complicated for no reason.

reviews.author: Hiba D
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, I could only give this resort that’s disclosed as a “5 star resort”, 2 stars. This is because the food was absolutely atrocious, to the point where it was inedible. On 2+ occasions my significant other received raw steak, I mean only pan seared not cooked on his plate. This could seriously make someone very I’ll. On top of this the chips were stale at the buffet, omelettes were so over cooked that they didn’t even taste like eggs anymore. Just a horrendous experience. Even the restaurants were pretty awful. The best experience we had was at Flora, where we were actually able to finish our meals.

Besides the terrible food we loved absolutely everything else about the resort. Bar tenders and staff were lovely & attentive, the resort was spotless. However one thing to note is to be careful on your balcony. You may get locked out and stuck there like we did. The vendors walking up to your beach chairs were consistent and that was extremely annoying and not so relaxing. I had to pretend I was sleeping every time they came by.

The pools were essentially empty, we didn’t stay at the reserve but had access to the adults pool & the resort was empty regardless probably because of the time we went. Barely any kids, which was nice.

Because the culinary experience was appalling, I would not recommend this resort to anyone or come back again.

reviews.author: Anivette Garcia-Soldevila
reviews.text:
Flora Restaurant at Paradisus Resort was amazing.
After all we have gone through during our stay…no pick up from the airport to the hotel, no cold AC in our room, room refrigerator doesn’t work, bad bad bad customer service.
We came for dinner at Flora and starting with the ambiance, decoration plus Stephanie’s, recommendations and service; the food was outstanding.
5 Stars for this restaurant!

reviews.author: Green Genie
reviews.text: The hotel itself is beautiful. The room was nice. I enjoyed the adults only pools. The water seemed clean. Flora was the best restaurant on property, It was the first restaurant I actually was able to eat at on my vacation, but overall, the food was terrible. The food is the reason I would never go back. I felt like I had to survive on fresh fruit and dinner rolls my entire stay.

reviews.author: Justin Baxley
reviews.text: This place is absurdly beautiful and the pools and beach are amazing. Supermajority of staff was great and polite. The problem is that the food was so bad the only explanation I have is malice. Hot food is not held hot and cold food is not held cold which probably explains the number of people from our company  who had to leave with food poisoning or suffered in their rooms most of the week.  A close colleague still hasn't eaten in days. Despite the very clear absence of basic food safety, other things were just inedible, even if you tried. The number of times I finally gave up on a stew because I couldn't even cut it with a knife finally made me give up. I had to cut cooked fish with a steak knife. The unanimously agreed exception seems to be the omelet bar and the cheese selection. The final night we were there, most of us ate bread, cooked vegetables, and rice trying to avoid anything that could be risky. The rice tasted like cleaner. I don't need my food to be amazing. I'm pretty low maintenance in that regard as long as I'm not hungry. But I need to be able to chew the food and I don't like gambling with foodborne pathogens.

reviews.author: D O
reviews.text:
Problems started at check-in: We were a group of five people and I have two rooms under my reservation: 1 room for two people and 1 room for three. I requested that the room for two guests be one single bed a couple days before arrival as I was told this was an option when I booked only and that the other room have a cot brought in or the pull-out couch made into a bed. At check-in, they confirmed that they were able to secure a room with one bed for the two guests and that they had a rollaway bed brought into the other to accommodate the room with three guests.

The rooms were not ready until about 4PM, which was fine, but once we got into the rooms we saw that both rooms had two small beds and the rollaway bed was put into the wrong room. The three guests who were rooming together only had access to the room with two beds through their badges, so I called concierge to request that they move the bed over to the correct room and mentioned that we were told one room would have one large bed. The response I got: “Is that a problem?” I decided to drop is and the concierge agent I spoke to said they would sent someone to move over the rollaways bed. Hours passed, they never came. We moved the bed ourselves and as we were dragging it over to the other room, a worker walked by and said/did nothing.

Then we had a 9:30 PM dinner reservation at the Japanese restaurant on the property: Our server was COMPLETELY DRUNK. Spilling water on the table, delayed to bring our requested drinks, some came some never did, and got all our orders wrong for appetizers and desserts. Any time he came to take an order, he could barely stand as he wrote them down. He would forget repeatedly what was ordered and come back to take our order over and over again as he swayed from side to side. The cook knew he was drunk and kept looking at us shaking his head over the situation. This was quite a shock for our first night on vacation but decided not to say anything because we knew it could cause the man his job.

We got back to our room at the end of the day and we phoned concierge to request fresh towels be brought to us so we could use them on an excursion we were going on the next day. They never came. We woke up the next morning, left for our excursion with towels we went to go grab ourselves and come back to find our room was never cleaned. We requested the room to be cleaned and for fresh towels to be brought to the room a second time. We left for the beach for a couple hours, come back and still nothing. I called concierge a second time to request fresh towels at the least. They never came.

That night, we stopped by the concierge desk in-person to file a complaint about the towels/cleaning service/drunk server because at this point we were quite annoyed. No compensation was offered but he promised to have the rooms cleaned and fresh towels brought to the room. This is now our THIRD time requesting fresh towels over the course of two days.

We go to dinner, come back to the room 2 1/2 hours later and find that the room is not clean and no towels have been brought to the room. I walk over to the concierge counter to speak to them in-person. I let them know that I really don’t care if they clean the room at this point but that I’d like the towels I asked for three times already. He doesn’t apologize about the room not being cleaned/towels not being brought, but calls to request that the towels are delivered to my room.

To no surprise, they never arrived.

The only reason I’m giving two stars instead of one is because of the positive experiences we had with other staff members at the hotel, including bartenders and our amazing waiter at Flora. There are some great people working at this hotel, but there are others that have absolutely soured our experience.

This is our second time here and I see a dramatic difference in the service we received compared to our last visit. After spending over $5000 dollars for a four-night stay at a 5-Star hotel, you would expect much better too.

We will not be returning.

reviews.author: Nancy Street
reviews.text:
An update to this review from a couple of years ago. Unfortunately, not a good one. This is not a 5 star resort. Not even close. It’s important to note that we are members and are supposed to get a higher level of experience. There are significant maintenance issues- the property is neglected- broken tiles in the pool, banged up trash cans everywhere, work is needed on the exterior of the buildings, the beach huts are shabby  and the cushions need replacing. The staff does not pick up bottles and glasses left around the property. The food is worse than when we are here last. There is not much for healthy eaters or people who don’t eat beef or pork. The staff  is nice but they are understaffed and not well trained. Last night our food was served cold and the bottle of wine we ordered never came. Our bed and pillows were uncomfortable. The lovely Melia scent was nowhere to be found. People were noisy and there are smokers everywhere. I can’t imagine we would come back. Our experience at the Mexican properties has been better and we will try Spain. I’m already having second thoughts about our membership.

The Paradisus is a wonderful property. Incredible service, great pools, beach and activities. The staff is uniformly kind, friendly and service oriented. The buffet food is great. The restaurants are mixed- some good, some not good. I would hope management would work on improving them. A highlight of our trip was our concierge, Yaleidi Sims. She is such a lovely person and so efficient and helpful. She made our trip incredibly special. Ask for her!!

reviews.author: Chantall Redd
reviews.text:
Gorgeously built, cleanliness great, food royally disappointing, room temperature very uncomfortable when ac working well, ac froze up 2 out of 4 nights, room was soaked with condensation, was hard to get room serviced with service light on, so had to ask for toilet paper and towels several times, mini bar (water) stocked 1x in 5days so had to bother room service unnecessarily for drinking water. All this would have been mostly ignored if we weren’t forced to pay a second time when checking out and DOUBLE THE ORIGINAL PRICE!!! We would have missed our flight if we didn’t just concede and pay as transportation cannot leave premises without authorization. Regardless it would not be a place we would pay to stay again, mostly because of the food and the difficulty just getting a reservation for the better dining options and solidified by the very frustrating and expensive checkout.
If you do stay here make all your dining reservations ASAP for however many days you are there. If you made reservations through their website BEWARE!!!

reviews.author: Kim T
reviews.text:
We are here now and will provide a full review when we return but this is definitely NOT a luxury or 5 star resort. If you don't have their upgrade level, your wrist band shows what you're worth and how much service you'll get. Which is valid in the aspect of "getting what you pay for". But for those just checking out the resort without knowing the level of service, thinking you'll get treated equally, I would probably avoid. Yes, we've been tipping everyone.

Their restaurant reservations process is outdated IMO. You'll have to be in line, BEFORE the reservation desk opens and line up. Which takes away from your "relaxation in paradise". If you're traveling with your family, someone will have to take time out in the morning to line up. Once you get to the front, you may not even have a reservation. It may be "all booked" for the day and next day because the higher level rooms have priority and can book their reservation for their ENTIRE STAY!

reviews.author: Laura Casper
reviews.text:
Ramon was the best!!! He took care of us every time we went to the beach and helped us out of a sticky situation with one of the many vendors.
Some staff were friendly,  but others just looked at you like you were inconvenience them and said "no". Very few spoke any amount of English, so when you tried to get help or ask a question you couldn't get help. I understand that we are in a different country, but when it takes 15 minutes and 3 people at the front desk to understand you are locked out of your room, that is a problem.
The food was not good, or hot. Everything was mediocre to be generous, and cold to warm, except the steak house. One of the hostesses harassed me to review, then grabbed my phone and was hittingv5 star on everything.  I grabbed my phone back and told her I would review later.
You are constantly harassed on the beach by vendors.
Our shower didn't drain and flooded into the room. They said they fixed it, but didn't.
We had a huge pool of water from the bathroom to beyond the bed. They were in no rush to fix anything.  They finally did and i had them fix the shower again. We still had a puddle the next day, but just used towels instead of trying to deal with them.
Definitely not coming back.

reviews.author: Angela Miller
reviews.text: The resort itself and the property it is on is beautiful. The rooms are nice and fairly clean. The service is not great. Most of the staff is not friendly. Simple requests can’t be met. Simple drinks that you get at resorts are unknown to the bartenders. The food is terrible. It’s either cold, not what is described on the menu, or just lacking in flavor. It seems the staff has not been trained properly. For such a beautiful location this resort could be so much more with better training and better food.

reviews.author: Donellia
reviews.text:
I had mixed feelings about this resort during my stay!

Here is My Overall Experience: Disappointing and Far from Luxurious

I was really looking forward to this trip, having planned for this trip to the best of my ability for what I hoped would be a luxurious experience. Unfortunately, my stay at this resort fell short in many ways.

Cleanliness Issues and Poor Response
From the moment we arrived, cleanliness was a major concern. On day one, we found blood on the floor and the comforter in our room. When I called housekeeping to report it, the person who answered had an attitude and seemed unwilling to help. When I asked how long it would take to address the issue, he rudely responded, “I don’t know, I can’t tell you.” Blood on the bed should have been treated as a priority, but it felt like they didn’t care.

Now, they did fix the issue & tried to make it better. I just felt like why even give this room to people and you can clearly see blood in the room.
Even though housekeeping eventually cleaned and tried to manage the situation, the blood stains remained on the floor for our entire stay (throughout the room). It was unsettling, and I couldn’t shake the feeling of discomfort throughout the trip.

We did tell staff about this issue - however it seems much wouldn’t change so we just dealt with it. It was my partner’s birthday and we just wanted to make the best out of the trip!

Lack of Luxurious Experience
One of the main reasons we chose this resort was the promise of a luxurious experience, especially since we paid extra for the reserve. However, from the start, it felt more like a DIY vacation than a luxury getaway.

For example, when we checked in, the person at the front desk was nice, but we were left to wander around aimlessly when we should have been escorted to the reserve area. This was the experience we were sold, but instead, we had to find our own way, which diminished the luxury we expected.

The reserve building itself seemed old and in desperate need of updates, particularly the pools on the reserve side. If you’re paying extra for a premium experience, it should feel like one. Unfortunately, it didn’t. The pool towels had major stains (like blood), and the pool looked like it was growing algae—far from the pristine luxury I had envisioned. My boyfriend even almost cut his foot on a crack in the pool, which speaks to the lack of proper maintenance.

Staff and Guest Interactions
While some staff members were wonderful—especially at the reserve restaurant, sports bar, Asian restaurant, and Italian restaurant—special thanks to Lenny, Antonio, Asante, and Yaleidi for making our trip special with their kindness and exceptional service. However, a few other staff members made us feel unwelcome. Unfortunately, not all staff were as friendly, particularly when it came to interacting with Black guests. To be direct, it seemed like we were the only Black guests at the resort, particularly from America. Though nothing was said directly, the difference in energy and treatment was noticeable, especially when white guests were around.

By the fourth day, it started to feel like we weren’t as welcome anymore. When we dined at Blue Agave, we felt watched—the lady and man were staring at us while we ate, making us very uncomfortable. The treatment we received was noticeably different compared to that of other guests. Sadly, the other guests also didn’t make us feel welcome, which only added to the discomfort of our stay.

Final Thoughts
In summary, this trip had its bright moments, thanks to a few kind staff members, but overall, it was disappointing. The cleanliness issues, lack of luxury, outdated facilities, and uncomfortable interactions with some staff and guests left a sour taste in my mouth. I want to stay somewhere where I feel pampered, valued, and truly welcomed. Unfortunately, this resort did not provide that experience, and I’m not sure I would stay here again.

I can say that the best part about this resort is the food—it’s good!

reviews.author: Rick Stratton
reviews.text:
Booked 6 months in advance and paid for their Nikté upgrade class. First day here and so far a nightmare; hopefully it improves.

Arrived at 12:30 and was checked in (understand the room won’t be ready until 3pm). At 3pm was told to come back in 10 minutes and so it went on until 4:30.

When we arrived at 12:30 we tried to get a reservation for dinner and were told they were no reservations at any restaurant available and we’d need to book through our concierge.

We were finally showed to our room by the bellboy whom told us our concierge would be there in 5-10 minutes. After 30 minutes and unanswered phones calls to the operator, front desk, manager (every call was transferred to a line that was never answered) I finally again went to the front desk.

After another 15 minutes I was introduced to our concierge Wily (whom seems like a great guy). He promised to make things right……TBD

Change my review rating but can’t give them a five. Overall very nice property and good service. Besides the check in issues, I tried to use an upgrade voucher I received. It states very specifically for “premium food or beverage”. The restaurant would not accept it saying it was for room service only; when trying to confirm what it was for, the front desk said it was a room upgrade and not tied to food at all. UGH!!

reviews.author: Natalie Korsik
reviews.text:
This is my second time coming back to Paradisus. The first time I came a few years back, I had an incredible experience. I raved about this resort to my husband and we decided to come here for our vacation and to celebrate his birthday. This time around the experience was average at best.

The rooms are renovated and spacious, the staff is friendly and helpful, always willing to help. The beach is beautiful and the overall resort is clean and nice.
Those are the good parts, but like with everything, there is a caveat with not so good parts. The restaurant experience was a complete nightmare. Let me elaborate further.

As soon as you arrive, you are required to make reservations for the restaurants on the property- without the reservation they won't seat you. No such thing as you will walk in anywhere you want and be seated. It sounds great, exclusive and helpful until they tell you they don't have any reservations available and their system is not working. So to put it simply, can't go to a restaurant without a reservation but also you can't get a reservation for no explained reasons. Either they don't have anything available or the system is not working. There are plenty of restaurants but we were only able to try 3 because 6 others were closed or would not seat us (no reservation). The safe bet is the buffet, the rest, good luck, won't be seated or the resultant won't be opened. After many attempts of calling and practically begging for a reservation, they would let us know they don't have any available. Finally, we were able to make one the day of for only one restaurant that was opened. The advertisement for 9 restaurants is false and deceiving.

We came here to celebrate my husbands birthday. We were planning to enjoy all the restaurants the resort has to offer only to end up at the buffet for lunch, breakfast and dinner. I am not sure if the resort is facing labor shortage, inadequate management, or possibly will be going out of business soon but it's evident it's on the verge of possibly being shut down. The resort was halfway busy, if that.

I will have to say, the whole reservation fiasco put a bad taste in my mouth. I am not sure we will be coming back and brining our family here. Second time coming here was disappointing.

The staff is caring and has to pick up the slack of frustrated customers  but also forces you to write a review on Google and asks you to take a picture afterwards. Felt very forced and insincere.

To end my honest review with a positive note. The staff is wonderful, hard working, helpful, and works very, very hard to pick up the issues that management need to resolve and not trickle down to their workers to deal with.

All the praise and shout out goes to the wait staff in the ginger bar to Olga, Dominga, Clari, Elisabeth, Antonio. All the attentive staff in the Lunch Box buffet. The management gets none, as they are no where to be found to speak to customers even though we asked numerous times to speak to them.

Cheers

reviews.author: Carlos Gutierrez
reviews.text:
Service here at 90 Degrees has been fantastic! They were very attentive to our needs and very friendly.
The staff (Roxana, Eddy, Caroline) here made us feel so welcomed that we spent most of our time at that pool. I definitely would recommend it to anyone staying here. I give these people at the pool 5 Stars.

We stayed in the Adults side VIP level.
However this was not the case for other areas of the resort. First we arrived and had reserved 2 rooms on the adult side of the resort and as you all know they expect you to make a deposit and then pay the remainder 1 week before you arrive. Well the problem was that when we arrived they did not have the room we reserved available. (Swim up room) They offered us a less expensive room (Garden View).
