We asked to speak to a manager and got the run around for about an hour and half. Finally we got a supervisor and nothing happened since they were not a manager. The hotel was not even at 50% occupancy so there were rooms that they could have provided us with instead of inconveniencing us. Then they did not want to reimburse us for the difference of the room cost for that day. They told us they would be reimbursing us and we still have not seen the reimbursement. It has almost been 1 month since we were there. Estenia Perez (Yield Executive) was who sent the e-mail stating that we would be reimbursed for not having the room we reserved available .

We also had a concierge. The concierge was not that accommodating. We had to call everyday to make reservations for dinner and he would never be able to accommodate our request to have dinner where we wanted. I asked to make reservations for the whole week the day we arrived and he told me they can't do that. However we met some people that were there on vacation as well and they were able to reserve the restaurants that they wanted to eat at for the whole week on the first day.
The concierge (Wolfen) never even walked my kids to the room to explain to them how things worked or explain to them that if they needed anything that all they would have to do is contact the concierge. I also shared a picture with (Wolfen) that there was a cockroach in there room.

Everyone made excuses about everything. I even had an racist experience by one of the employeesthat I will not talk about this here. If Melia is interested in hearing about my experience they can reach out to me to discuss it.
Ivelisse Hernandez - (Sub Director for Paradisus Palma Real) knows about the situation that occurred.

This service does not reflect on the people that did there jobs and did everything possible give us a nice experience.

reviews.author: Doug Lynch
reviews.text: Our concierge was great, food was OK, resort was pretty and drinks were decent but the resort is very poorly run.  My 18 year old had an adult wrist band but got hassled every time she went for a drink. Many of the bars wouldn't serve her unless she showed her id so she ended up having to carry her license around with her, fortunately she didn't misplace it! She was even denied a drink once after showing her license. We had a food credit with our room so we upgraded our steak at dinner, when we went to check out, they wouldn't let us use the credit as supposedly we had to tell them at the restaurant. Every day at lunch, it took forever to get our drinks and food and the food order was never right. The room number they had for us in the system was different than our actual room number which they couldn't fix and caused issues during the trip. The restaurants required you to scan a code for your menu and it only worked about half the time. I could go on but I'll leave it here.  We won't be going back.

reviews.author: Pete London
reviews.text:
Look at all the 1-3 posting reviewers!! We booked this based on the high ratings scores more than the reviews - big mistake. Here is a log of our at Meliã Paradisus in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic.  We give this a moderate rating as there are many staff who do seem to try and the groups were very nice.  However the overall service and food was not great.  Trust the balanced reviews, not the ratings which can easily be staged.

Day 1 - we arrived early and had to wait for our room.  It wasn’t ready until almost 4pm, and then after delivering luggage we discovered it wasn’t what we requested and we had to go back to the main desk. This was resolved by about 4:30pm.

Day 2 we started to notice that the entire room smelled like mold.. this seemed to be in the A/C unit and we were told that no other rooms with our paid-for amenities were available so we lived with it for the rest of the week.

Day 3 the ability to make a request to housekeeping or maintenance services through app was taken away completely and the guest services like wasn’t answered after 20+ rings.  There is no way to get ice but via room service and we tried for 2 days but the requests through the app were ignored.

Day 4 - Room service stopped being functional through the app.

Day 4, it became extremely crowded on weekend - there were times we couldn’t find a single place to sit for breakfast or lunch, and most of the food was picked over or gone completely at the buffet.  There was no way to get a chair at the pool.

Day 5, had to call to get minibar service at 6pm.  They asked what we wanted and delivered completely different items.

Day 5, had to call to get housekeeping service at 5pm while we were getting ready for dinner.  We were taking showers (there is only a thin see-through curtain for the bathroom door) while they cleaned our room.

Jackhammering of the flooring also started outside of our room on day 5, lasting all day.

Day 6, again no housekeeping service or minibar service.  Had to call and minibar showed up but not room service.  Since it was past 5pm we asked that they skip us for the day.

Other notes:

Food at Italian place very bad, like they took from the buffet line.  There was a giant poster of an American top chef stating that they had a special menu. The fish was so bad - over cooked and rubbery.

Much of the food at the sit down restaurants was very mushy, worse than a carnival cruise ship.  The exception was the fish at the Dominican restaurant and the flank steak Minas.

Grounds were nice, and swim up pool was very nice.

Drinks were acceptable, the won’t blend anything and everything is pre-made and very sweet.

Several areas and one of the main restaurants were shut down for days due to an Indian wedding.  It was difficult not to eat in the buffet, most restaurants had no reservations on most days but were visibly half-full if that!

The resort is geared towards finding ways to get you to spend more (than the $500-800 per night you already out down for an all-inclusive). Some staff helpful, others wouldn’t go out of their way unless there was something to sell.  Example, they advertise a $120 beachside dinner.  However when you inquire about it they say the $120 is for one plate to food to share!  How misleading is that?!?

There was a “Beer mixology” event one day.  Tastings included Budweiser rather than the local beer (which cost extra, and as we discovered wasn’t worth paying for).

Suggest staying in the adult section to avoid loud neighbors due to adjoining room doors which let a lot of noise through.  Unfortunately some of the best room configurations are on the family side.

reviews.author: Dave Singh
reviews.text: No this hotel sucks! I expect better for the price we paid. No fun entertainment at night. After dinner we had to go to our room because that’s how boring it was. We were there in February 2023 for a few days for a wedding. Over 90 people from the family and no one was entertained. Usually we stay at the dream and they always had music, dancing or a fun entertainment to watch. The food was alright. The wait at the lobby for our room was tiring. We waited for a few hours. Was not greeted with any excitement. I do not recommend this hotel if you have kids.

reviews.author: Adam Kubsh
reviews.text:
The kids club and overall ambiance is amazing, but that’s about where it ends.  You get a buffet for most of the day, so you only get a plated meal for dinner.  However, dinner is an absolute nightmare with a ridiculous gatekeeper system.  You need to go in-person to a desk, wait in line, and ask for available restaurants and times EACH day.  So be prepared spending half of your morning trying to figure out a plan for eating dinner somewhere.  You also will probably either have a 9pm or later time slot, or literally turned away and told to eat at the buffet because all the restaurants are full.  Yes you read that correctly, they can’t seat everyone for a plated dinner, so you can eat the same buffet 3 times a day if that’s your thing.

There is a nice beach, but you will be hassled relentlessly by people trying to sell you something.  We just hung out in our hotel room for peace which was frustrating.

Overall, I’d say spend your money elsewhere because $500+/night for an open buffet is what you’re getting.

reviews.author: Jessica Kennedy
reviews.text:
I came on a work trip that was paid for but I came a day early and paid for my own room and my view was of WEEDS. There was also people working outside my room so I couldn’t even have my curtains open. We didn’t have any patio furniture and if you wanted to talk on the phone and have someone good service you had to go outside.
Room service- food is gross and takes hours. One time it was ordered at 10:30pm and didn’t show up till 2:30am
Food at restaurants- good luck (steak house wasn’t bad, I recommend the NY STRIP with mash potatoes and order one below how you like it cooked)
Staff- staff was nice, BUT there wasn’t much staff. For 820ish people coming from Tuesday-Sunday and 2 bars open after 11 and 2 bartenders, it took forever to get a drink and there were barely any wait staff if you sat outside
HOTEL ITSELF- it’s very pretty and great views so if that’s all you want, it’s great for that. I asked for patio furniture on Tuesday and it came on SATURDAY (day before I left). It is close to the airport which was nice

Restaurants close from 4-6, so eat before then

reviews.author: Doron Kapitulnik
reviews.text:
The location is amazing, the facility beautiful, clean and well maintained. Staff is kind and welcoming.
But - Food is terrible! Both buffet and restaurants. Ended up eating outside of the resort few times.
Although the staff is great, you are constantly in a tourist trap, even within the hotel. Gift shop selling at x4 $$, the comfy beds at the beach for additional cost and so many more similar experiences.
Won't come back.

reviews.author: Alysha Kubsh
reviews.text:
The positives:
-Kids Club is a great service and the staff in there have been wonderful with our kids. This has been the highlight of our trip.
-Rooms are nicely appointed and grounds are well maintained
-The aesthetics and intimate lounge spaces are visually beautiful
-The Gin-Ger coffee bar near the lobby is a great spot for smoothies and coffee service.

The Negatives:
-the *only* option for food before 6pm (when dinner restaurants open) is the buffet, which has very little variety from day to day and is 2/5 stars. At $800 USD per night for the “premium” Nikte experience, this is disappointing.
-We’ve tried ordering room service 3 times (since the only restaurant is often closed when our kids are hungry) and it takes 45+ minutes and always comes cold.
-The booking process for the evening restaurants is a nightmare. We are on our 4th night (with the “VIP” Nikte service) and still can’t get a reservation in the Mina steak house for our family of 4. It feels like you are entering a lottery to get a dinner reservation to avoid having to eat a third meal in a row at the same buffet.

We have 3 days left in our 7 day trip here at Paradisus and the family agrees that we wish we had spent our money elsewhere.

reviews.author: Kayla Marsh
reviews.text:
Most of the staff was very helpful and nice but we had a large group and some of us got moved to a different resort without being informed until we arrived and tried to check in. No one was helpful in getting it fixed until our concierge Juan was able to get the group placed at another resort passes to at least come over for meals and to spend time together. There was little to nothing for entertainment except for the last two days when they had evening entertainment from 7-10. It was extremely disappointing being they advertise as having lots of entertainment all day. Also they closed all but 3 restaurants for dinner, two of the 7 nights we were there, with little notice and we had to get reservations to eat. If you are looking to just lay on the beach or by the pool it’s a fine place but if you are looking for a fun trip with entertainment or activities I would go somewhere else. It is nothing like advertised. We also paid extra to have a jacuzzi tub …  it is just a tub. There is no hot tub/jacuzzi tub any where at this resort.

Jorge Rafael, Juan our concierge and the other great staff are the only reason I gave it 2 stars.

reviews.author: jean Pierre Fontanot
reviews.text: The hotel is overall very nice and like most all inclusive resorts, very much designed for the masses. Our experience has been dominated by a series of mishaps, since the service is far from what you expect for a hotel this category and the personnel are very poorly trained. We were all very disappointed to the point that we just ended up laughing and making their blunders part of our trip.

reviews.author: INGA DAINIUS
reviews.text:
I am writing to share my recent experience at Paradisus Palma Real Resort in Punta Cana, booked through Apple Vacations, and to express my disappointment with several aspects of our stay.
While the exterior of the resort is undoubtedly impressive, the discrepancies between what was advertised and the reality inside were stark. Our family of two adults and two children encountered numerous issues throughout our five-night stay that significantly impacted our overall enjoyment.
Firstly, despite the resort boasting 16 restaurants and 12 pools on its website, only a limited number of these were accessible to families like ours. Many were reserved exclusively for adults or circle membership tiers, which was not clearly communicated beforehand. Additionally, the level of inclusivity varied, with certain amenities and menu items requiring additional payment beyond what we had initially expected.
Moreover, we were disappointed by the lack of communication from the concierge regarding scheduled events or family-friendly activities during our stay, leaving us feeling uninformed and underwhelmed.
Specific incidents during our stay further compounded our dissatisfaction. Our initial room booking was not honored upon check-in, and while a suitable alternative was eventually provided, it came at an additional cost. The condition of the room itself left much to be desired, with maintenance issues ranging from loose fixtures to a persistent foul odor and even a concerning encounter with a cockroach.
Furthermore, mishandling of our luggage resulted in the loss of a sentimental item, despite repeated attempts to rectify the situation with the concierge.
The dining experience was similarly disappointing, with limited options for reservations, lengthy wait times, and subpar food quality across various cuisines. Hygiene standards also fell short, with instances of dirty dishware and inadequate cleaning of utensils.
Additionally, the resort's amenities such as poolside supplies were overpriced, and inadequate protection against mosquitoes left us with numerous bites.

reviews.author: Felipe Herter
Mike Bronstein
reviews.text:
Absolutely Disgusting: A Nightmare Stay at Melia Paradisus Golf Resort

My recent stay at Melia Paradisus Golf Resort in Punta Cana was nothing short of a nightmare. From the moment I entered my room, I was plagued by an infestation of bedbugs. My entire body was covered in itchy, painful bites, and my skin was inflamed and raw.

The hotel's response to my situation was both shocking and disrespectful. When I reported the bedbug infestation, the staff initially denied its existence. It wasn't until I insisted that they finally agreed to move me to a different room. However, this was done far too late, as I was already suffering from severe bites and discomfort.

Throughout my ordeal, I was met with a lack of empathy and concern from the hotel staff and management. Their dismissive attitude towards my situation was truly appalling. I would strongly advise anyone considering staying at this resort to think twice. The Melia Paradisus Golf Resort is a disgusting establishment that clearly prioritizes profits over the well-being of its guests.

reviews.author: Steph Blodgett
reviews.text:
Sharing my letter that I sent to Paradisus  Palma Real in the DR-I never got a reply...
To management at Paradisus:
I can't tell you how disappointed my husband and I were with our eight day stay from Mar 22-29!  We have stayed at this property numerous times previously and have loved it. It was a completely different and certainly less enjoyable experience this trip.
We booked at the Reserve for our 20th anniversary. When I called the hotel directly to book, I was told the Reserve had been renovated and had all the same amenities-not true! There's one exclusive restaurant ( Sante) since the other part became The Falcon Hotel. Furthermore, when I book the Reserve for "adults only" and you book a large group of teenagers, 17/18 years olds in the Reserve, that is NOT acceptable. I booked the Reserve to have some tranquility-this was far from it. This group of kids took over all the pool space, the bar by the beach, the Sports Bar, etc. The door slamming from their rooms went on night after night. Most were drunk and inconsiderate everyday, along with their chaperones. They went into the restaurants often at lunch without shoes, and sometimes cover ups. I understand you need to book large groups, but they should not be booked in the Reserve area.
We did not find the food this trip to be exceptional either. It was just good.
On a good note, the hotel was well kept and staff service was excellent, especially the Reserve beach service and Sante.
We attended the Circle presentation, too and had considered joining, but we won't probably won't at this time. I even asked for the manager at check out and I was told she was at lunch.
I would appreciate a reply before I post my reviews online about my experience.
Whelp! They didn't reply-so now I'm posting for all to see.

reviews.author: Garrett Seaman
reviews.text: I DO NOT recommend this property but the highlight of this hotel the are the grounds, the room and facilities are lacking.  Staff is over aggressive and highly motivated by tipping, which is fine, but just be prepared that you will have to tip for decent service at best.  Please be aware of the security of your credit cards and ID.

reviews.author: Nykell M
reviews.text: First time at a Melia resort. This resort was not really for us. Not much to do in the evenings; no shows or entertainment. The food was below average. This resorts audience is not younger couples, but more middle aged to older with kids or families. I called ahead to ask if they decorated the room for birthdays and was told yes. But this did not happen. Definitely disappointed with this resort.

reviews.author: Jenna Lee
reviews.text:
This resort looks brand new and has a picture perfect scenery.
The staff is funny and the buffet food is amazing, however, the Mexican restaurant and Hibachi restaurant really aren't good.

I am giving it 2 Stars because the scenery was amazing. Other then that this place gets real boring after a couple of days.

I wish the staff provided the guests with a daily list of activities, otherwise you will be out of the loop and just spend your days wandering around.
Also, I was placed in a room that I did not book, I had to tell the front desk that I was put in the wrong room (one without a balcony) and the receptionist rolled his eyes when I asked to be put in the correct room (one with a balcony & Jacuzzi). When I was put into the correct room the light next to the bed randomly dropped from the ceiling one night and the electricians had to come hang it back up to the ceiling.

Lastly, and most frustratingly, the front desk gave my boyfriend a booklet of "Resort Credits" consisting of free credits that can be used in the Casino , Restaurant and Spa on our LAST DAY.

He said he "forgot" to give them to us when we checked in. He explained you get resort credits if you are booked for a certain amount of nights.

However, we were never able to use these credits because they were given to us a few hours before we had to leave. If I received these Resort Credits on the first day I would have without a doubt used them during my stay and had more fun. So if you are staying at this resort for a while I recommend you ask about the credits booklet because this is the thing that really angered me the most.

Also, Room Service comes really early in the morning, they will lightly knock then let themselves in - Got woken up multiple times by them in the morning and walked in on while showering a couple times.

reviews.author: Emilio Desaro
reviews.text: The place is amazing, they make the best first impression but everything goes downhill from there. The rooms are very nice when you walk in but after you start getting comfortable, you start to notice the TV's to have many channels, broken stuff, and clogged drains. The staff also loves to make false promises all the time. "Don't worry, I'll take care of it".... Bs...  Making a reservation was a nightmare! You're better off telling your concierge. Other than that, the place is beautiful and it really feels like paradise.

reviews.author: Andrea Harvey
reviews.text: I was very disappointed with my stay this time! It’s my fifth time coming to this resort and I absolutely love it! I made a reservation in October, for April and two weeks before I was leaving my reservation was changed numerous times. When I got to the resort, I checked in and got to my room. The room was disgusting!!! There was wet paint and no one told us that there was wet paint and one of my family members got paint all over her clothes! There were broken tiles on the floor that you could feel moving. The shower was a mess! They patched the shower and there was black mold inside the shower! The pull out couch had a piece of metal sticking out and the bed felt like it was going to collapse. I am thinking about not coming back because of my experience this time! I am very disappointed!

reviews.author: Ingrid Rodriguez
reviews.text: No recommend!!! Property is very beautiful and elegant, but services was awful!! Foods wasn’t great!  Many jacuzzi none of them worked. Quilt with paint🤦🏽‍♀️ It's a pity such a beautiful hotel and it's not up to the task.

reviews.author: Farbod S
reviews.text:
Initially I wrote a good review on my second day of stay, Which had been gone fine. later during our trip things changed for worse.
I still believe kidsdom was great and they did a wonderful job keeping kids entertained.
Quality/taste of food is bad. You’ll have a lot of difficulties making reservation for restaurants included in your trip - if possible at all.
Worst of all, they’ll charge you for stuff you didn’t order and didn’t get. Expect a surprise at checkout.
My experience was such that I will stop using all Melia resorts altogether.

reviews.author: Traci Stoll
reviews.text: Compared to other resorts, this resort is sub par. The customer service is below average in my opinion. We had the Royal Service package. The food was absolutely terrible. Waited at the “Royal Service” restaurant for over an hour and still never received my meal. The pasta tasted like something out of a can. My room service omlet was slimy inside. The pool was nice. The alcohol selection was minimal. If this was my first time visiting a Carribean resort I would say this place was good. However, compared to others, I would never choose this one again.

reviews.author: Silvana Petrillo
reviews.text:
First, the most important thing, we made a reservation for The Reserve, on the beach and with special perks, and for the same price they sent us to gran Cana, far from the beach, waiting and Riding a cart every time we wanted to go to the beach or come. That wasn't what we wanted. We asked to changed our rooms to the other building and they refused. That was false advertisement ! Be careful if you made a reservation because that happened with many people we met there!

2- Room was nice but full of ants ! .Hotel was practically empty, and they sent us to the last building #4, last room !! so to go to the lobby, buffet, carts, we walked like 3 blocks !! that was tiresome and annoying !!

3- Restaurants, we couldn't make any reservation for the restaurants, nothing !! i went with my husband to celebrate his birthday and couldn't go to a restaurant in the whole stay !! Only buffet. BTH waiters must use gloves ! they serve food, and handle money ???!!! And they  forced us to use gloves to enter to the buffet? Service was bad, waiters asking for their tips...rude service, asking for things like sugar, etc many times !!

4- No entrainment for kids... Totally different to other all inclusive resorts. I've been in P Cana 3 times and never such a bad experience with a hotel.
I Dont recommend it at all!

reviews.author: A Gaffney
reviews.text:
Had high hopes for this hotel but it was not what I expected at all. First off I am very unhappy that the hotel charged me more money then what I agreed to on there own website. I checked out on the website to a certain amount for the stay but was charged a different price on my credit card. That is fraud. The hotel itself is OK, the food was mediocre. Not many options and in the time between the breakfast and lunch service there is absolutely nothing to eat so if you wake up around between 11-1 your screwed. We only enjoyed the hibatchi restaurant besides that the food was not good. They water down the drinks a lot as well. Overall it was just ok. I would not recommend anyone to stay and I wish I chose the Hyatt ziva in cap Cana that I originally was supposed to stay at.

Update- Your website had the US dollar symbol on the total amount. That would mean I would be charged that amount in US dollars so there would be no conversion needed or overcharge.

reviews.author: Katy O'Hara
reviews.text:
What to really expect...NOT 5 Star Service

Check-in: Our reservation was for "The Reserve" side of Paradisus Palma Real. The Reserve comes with several perks like exclusive and expedited check-in processes. None of this occurred. As a Platinum rewards member we are offered an opportunity to check-in virtually 48 hours prior to arrival to allow for an even quicker arrival, which we took advantage of. Upon arrival to the resort absolutely none of the early or quick check-in processes were observed. Took 40+ min for front desk staff to even begin to check us in. When we asked about all the information we sent during our virtual check-in, they had zero knowledge of the info or even the process which we used, so everything had to be redone. (**Let's also mention the manager on duty was in a loud verbal argument with another guest less than 10 feet away from multiple families checking in**) To their credit the front desk staff did their best to speed up the process and were able to make sure our rooms were neighboring as originally requested.

Concierge Service: DO NOT PAY FOR THIS. Plain and simple this was the biggest let down, regret, and overall waste of money at this resort. As part of "The Reserve" you are assigned (pay for) a personal concierge who is supposed to help make you stay as relaxing, fun, and stress free as possible. We got the opposite with our Concierge, Franklin. Franklin was not onsite the day of our check-in, but we were assured by staff that he would be in contact first thing the next day. It was nearly 24 hours later and after several trips to the front desk did Franklin finally make contact. After Franklin's initial contact getting ahold of him to even ask basic questions about the Golf course, excursions, or the spa was hard. He was less than responsive to texts and was not present around the resort. He did not share any special event info or kids club info. This was really a disappointment because we had read several reviews on TripAdvisor highlighting how awesome Franklin was...apparently, we didn't deserve the same level of service.

Room Service: Our first night we attempted the buffet, but they were nearly closing time and there were very few options left so we decided to settle in our rooms and order room service. We called and placed a simple order for some food and drinks and were told it would be 30-40min. About 90 min later the food had not arrived, so we called down, they had no record of the order so placed it again. Another 90min went by and we gave up and went to bed...no food on the first night! The next evening after a long day of sun, the kids requested a late-night snack so we tried room service again...and again the same wait times with zero food delivered.

Yhi Spa: The spa service left us asking so many questions about the management and customer service of this resort and overall, Melia properties. As a Melia Rewards member you can use points for spa services, it advertised this way. When we arrived, they presented us with a bill for $410, prior to service and we again told them we intended to use points. They told us they would need manager approval despite telling us they would do it the day prior. After waiting for 40min past our appointment time they finally allowed us to proceed with our treatments. Points were eventually deducted from my Melia Rewards account. Fast forward to check-out day and the spa had applied the $410 charge to our room/credit card while also deducting the points.

There were two saving graces to this whole trip. Raul at the pool bar - 10 out of 10 - he was the best! He provided quality drinks and information about things to do in the area. Also, Delvin at Vento - he was the only reason we had any options or plans for dinner when our concierge let us down. He is a true gem and really knows what good customer service looks like at a 5-star resort.

reviews.author: O Benjamin
reviews.text:
As a family of five that has enjoyed luxurious stays in Saint Martin, Saint Barts, and other Caribbean destinations, our expectations were high for our vacation at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. We booked two NIKTE class master bedroom swim outs, expecting the same level of excellence we've experienced elsewhere.

While the concierge staff and individual servers have been exceptionally kind and helpful, the hotel management has failed to deliver the 5-star experience we anticipated. The website promised premium quality drinks as part of our all-inclusive package, but we were served “well” drinks regardless of where we went, with the option to purchase premium drinks separately - a bait-and-switch tactic unbefitting of a 5-star establishment. NIKTE definitely isn’t worth the up-charge.

Our grievance lies with the hotel's deceptive practices (website language of “premium” drinks), not the dedicated staff who've tried their best to make our stay enjoyable. It's disheartening to see their efforts marred by the resort's management.

If you are considering a five star family experience, seriously consider other options before booking at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. The Caribbean has numerous other luxurious and honest resorts that will provide the true 5-star experience you deserve, reminiscent of our stays in Saint Martin, Saint Barts, and beyond.

reviews.author: D kim
reviews.text: Food was awful.  Staff were not attentive nor friendly. Concierge did not answer phone calls or were at the desk. Could not confirm Costco transfer back to airport. Awful stay.

reviews.author: ana martinez
reviews.text:
WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE
I stood at this hotel with my entire family: a group of over 20 people including children vacationing  from New York. Once we arrived , I was impressed with the facilities : very beautiful structure but once we got to the front desk, what a bad experience:!!! All of our rooms were far apart from each other!
A lady whose last name unfortunately was Martinez was the most unpleasant person . She did not explain anything about locations, restaurants , etc and once we asked questions she answered with tons of attitude.
One of my nieces got her babysitter there as well and their rooms were apart (different buildings) and when we asked her to make a change and gave st least those two rooms together, she was not useful at all and just told us that the room available only had one bed . Another employee listened to her and discreetly told me that I was entitled to a sofa bed and that I can order another bed. The lady did not provide this info and when asked, she just rolled over her eyes! Disgusting!

Once I saw this, I asked to speak to Wally who was the Supervisor  and was there checking some paper work . When another employee went to tell him I was requesting to speak with him, he looked at me, and since I am Dominican and look Spanish, he asked the employee to speak to me as he was busy. Then he proceeded to take care of another guest that happen to be Caucasian !
I was very upset and asked him if I would look Caucasian he would come and he totally ignored me!
On top of it there were some coupons we were offered when booked the rooms, and they didn't want to give them to all of us, mrs Martinez just handed the coupons to some in the group and when asked did sent us downstairs to get them. Downstairs they sent us back to front desk and it was a back and forth!

When entered in our rooms, they were missing towels, soap etc. Called service desk and they just told me that they will replenished. Waited for two hours and they never brought it. Thank God we carry some with us!!!!!!
We had a very bad experience in terms of customer service. The price we paid was not low at all and the service was horrible!
I would rate the hotel structure (building) as 5 star but the service is very poor ( very bad 0 stars)
We will never book this hotel again !!!!!!!

reviews.author: Maria Frascone
reviews.text: Me and 18 other people stayed at Paradisus palma real golf and spa for a week in late May. Transfer to hotel was seamless as we got a bus through otium. Upon arriving we noticed upwards of 500 high schoolers staying there on their spring break. Although we were club members and 6 of us had the concierge service, we had such a trouble getting any dinner reservations. When we did get one reservation it would be at 9 pm and split into 2 tables and sometimes even at different times. We complained to higher ups and they were even more useless. This is sad as they did not plan for other people to be there while this entire high school was there, they could have warned us. The best thing there was the bartender at the pool bar, gerenaldo was the best person at the resort!!

reviews.author: Jen May
reviews.text: The food is wonderful. The grounds are beautiful. I am giving this hotel 2 stars because our room had a hotel staff member come in drunk through our sliding door at 3 am... Security didnt care.They didnt even come to our room or investigate.. The door never locked and was not fixed. We asked for a manager and we got the run around. When we arrived the all inclusive buffets were all closed.. Took us 2.5 hours and 5 staff members to find something to eat. Multiple staff members would not stop bothering my daughter, she even told them she was not intrested on multiple occasions and they were still relentless. My husband had to tell the event member on gabi beach to leave her alone while she was trying to paint and he thought it would be fun to take my paint and paint her back... Needless to say she gave up and hid out in the room to get him away..we had one server (maria) all week at fuego and who served lunch at gabi beach who was wonderful. Saw a roach outside  our room.There is a huge language barrier and rather than staff trying to help they just say they dont understand and walk away.. We have been to other paridisus hotels in the past and they were our go to hotel but after the week from hell.. We are going back to only booking at RIU's .

reviews.author: Zuni Diaz
reviews.text:
We're are a family of 3 - we were there from Monday July 9th until Friday July 13th.  First time on a short trip - we usually go for 9-10 days. THANK GOD!! The lobby was beautiful and the welcome desk  staff  were very nice!  The lobby was clean and always smelled cleaned - the quest bathrooms near the welcome desk was clean at all the time.  The food was delicious expect in the "fuego" restaurant - the portion size was simply ridiculous.  Three family including us left and went to the main buffet to have dinner after spending 45 minutes getting served what I called "bird food".  We ask the waiter at the Fuego if we can get a straw for our soft drinks and he said "we don't have any" in the whole resort - can you believe that!!!! The Vento restaurant was excellent the waiter was amazing and the food was great!
*****Now let's talk about the room - when they showed us the room I immediately noticed that the room smelled like mold or mildew!  I asked them - on numerous occasion, if something can be done - but will no avail. At one point a staff at the Hospitality desk said that they will bring a humidifier to "help" with the smell.  Three days later - nothing - no humidifier and the smell was now imbedded in our clothing, luggages, and even in our hair we shampooed our hair everyday.  Sleeping in the room was horrible - the bed felt wet because of the humidity and the sheets smelled like mildew!  AND BY THE WAY THE SHEETS WERE NEVER CHANGED - I ask but they never came to the room.  I purposely put a safety pin on the sheets to see if they were changed - BUT THEY THEY NEVER CHANGED THEM - makes be believe that the sheets may have been the same from the prior guest.......disgusting!!!!!!!  We left on Friday, July 13th arrived home and immediately needed to wash ALL of our clothing even they ones we didn't wear!  I spent ALL weekend doing that.  Left the luggages open to vent them out in the yard for two days. We have traveled A LOT and even have been in Punta Cana on several occasions but this has been the WORST.  Today is Monday July 16th my daughter and I are visiting our doctors because - we have not stop coughing from what I think was the horrible smell in the hotel room - If you're staying there - don't stay in room 1037.  I'm sure you'll regret it.  I gave them a two cause the food was good.

reviews.author: Melanie Lach
reviews.text:
So we arrived at 5pm. Checked in and the room is still NIT READY!!! It is 5:55pm.  This is not acceptable. Long day of travel and arrived at 5:00pm.
So far not impressed and we just got here! And now 2 hours later and just getting our room.  This is absolutely unacceptable!

reviews.author: Sara Naatz
reviews.text: Beautiful resort and beautiful views. However, 90% of the staff is the rudest and least friendly I’ve ever encountered. Buffet food is often cold and over cooked. Much of the resort (including half the beach, several restaurants, etc.) is roped off for Reserve guests only. Really expected more.

reviews.author: anthony manz
reviews.text:
It’s unfortunate that a hotel that is visually so beautiful , offers food unfit for human consumption.
The restaurant s at the palms are in my opinion an embarrassment to a hotel claiming to be 1 st rate.
In fact food was so bad in all venues that I would never come back. For such a visually beautiful facility, it’s criminal to be serving the kind of food offered.
I came in February thinking the water would be warm   .
Well you can’t control the ocean but the pool was so cold , no one went in. It would have helped if the pool was heated, certainly there is enough sunshine to solar heat the pool waters
Yet management was totally unconcerned about the lack of use of the pool by travelers fleeing the cold weather of n . America

reviews.author: Vincent Bianchi
reviews.text: I dont know if all these other 5 star reviews are fake or made by Paradisus but this was not a 5 star stay. First of all there are mountains of seaweed on the beach in front of Paradisus Real making this NOT a beach vacation. The pool is not as impressive as other resorts and the rooms are dated. Food is decent however have to eat in buffet for 2/3 meals everyday. Difficult to communicate with staff if dont speak Dominican. And the drinks are very watered down. Not worth the money imo - should had went to Cancun

reviews.author: Parth Patel
reviews.text: This hotel does not deserve to be considered 5 stars. The experience I had with customer service was just terrible. The property itself is beautiful, but very stressful trying to relax given that the hotel is all-inclusive. Service at restaurants was poor, I had to wait over 30 minutes everyday to get pool towels, and took me 4 hours for the staff to check me in and get me to my room. I will never go back even if it were free! Thanks for a low-quality vacation.

reviews.author: Paul C.
reviews.text:
Huge place and difficult to navigate, luckily there is a shuttle service to cart you around the grounds. I strongly suggest a tour by resort staff to understand how it all works.
Wrist band model allowing access to certain pools and bars. Not ideal.
Most of the food is terrible. Even the 'nice' restaurants had borderline inedible entrees.  Can't say enough about the poor quality and preparation of the food. Even my children had limited choices. Breakfast and lunch were primarily at cafeteria style restaurants, crowded, limited seating. I think we all lost a few pounds. Food / drink delivery by the pool was non-existent. Unlike other resorts we have been to.
Beach/ocean were nice but crawling with vendors (Costa Rica and Cancun the same)
Rooms were clean, decent size, but many items not working (phone, TV, bathroom fixtures, etc). Service response was days slow.
Serious language barrier with nearly all the resort staff.
Pool towels required cards received at check-in. Terrible model that doesn't make any sense and completely inconsistent application.
We would never return to Paradisus Palma and probably not to any Melia owned property.

reviews.author: Daniela Landherr
reviews.text:
How to make this hotel work for you: excessive tipping and set low expectations.

This hotel was recommended to us as one of the best family friendly 5* hotels in Punta Cana, where we spent 5 days. We conclude that the reason why this hotel is rated highly online is because the staff pressure guests to rate the hotel positively. Given our extensive travel experience, I would say this hotel is a 3-4* hotel at max. Unfortunately there don't seem to be many 5* alternatives if you want to stay in Punta Cana with kids (some better hotels don't allow kids), so here is some advice if you plan to stay here:

- Lower your expectations overall
- Expect to spend at least USD $50.00 a day on tipping to get the most out of this place
- Bring your own cash - if you withdraw from the ATM, you get local currency which the hotel refuses to break down into smaller bills for you. If you ask the reception to withdraw cash in USD, they charge USD 119.00 and you receive USD 100.00 (!!).
- Expect fresh paint on the walls and cushions and no warning signs about that, so you can get stains if not careful.
- Ideally order food in Spanish if you have special requirements.
- Expect meat and fish to just never be right, regardless of how you order it
- If you have food allergies, know to explain that in Spanish. For example if you order omelette, they never use a fresh bowl to mix ingredients so watch out if you have allergies or avoid certain food.
- Expect staff to force you to rate them positively, everywhere, anytime (even by the pool). They will ask that you call them out by name and give 5 stars. They will tell you their career depends on that. They plan their timing, if possible, to when you've had a good amount of alcohol. They even use prepared QR codes and want to sit next to you as you fill it out. Don't give into that pressure and submit honest ratings.
- Staff will try to sell you upgrades, spa treatments etc by luring you into listening to a 45 min sales pitch. Always clarify what a voucher really means before you book anything.
- DJ and loud music until 11pm every night - due to poor soundproofing, beach front rooms/suites are more affected

Meals: *
food is generally of low quality. Meat, fish and eggs are too well done, regardless how you order it.

Room: *
Poor soundproofing. You can hear people in the neighboring room showering or having a conversation. Rooms are not cleaned well (floor, mirrors, bathtub and shower never cleaned during our entire stay!). Pillows are 100% synthetic and very poor quality.

Pool: ****
The Reserve pool was the highlight of our stay. It was rather quiet (except for one afternoon when they held a foam pool party) and there was enough space for everyone. Service is attentive when you tip. There are multiple people each day who try to sell you excursions.

Beach: ***
It's always windy, expect some waves. Seaweed along the entire beach. Sand is lovely, soft, palm trees are beautiful. There is a reserved area for The Reserve guests. Every few minutes, someone will try to sell you something which is annoying.

Beach towels: *
no towel service. you get a card and need to pick up/drop off beach towels yourself.

Concierge: *****
Bolivar, our concierge, made an effort to make our stay as pleasant as possible. Out of our 2* rating, an entire star goes to him alone. When we left to the airport, we forgot our son's backpack in the room. Bolivar organized a taxi to bring it to us. He also left some gifts in our room for our son. We really appreciated his efforts.

Paint on walls/clothes: *
Our son and I leaned against a wall and stained our clothes with fresh paint. There was no warning sign anywhere. Staff apologized and cleaned it, but no signs were put up.

Kids Friendlyness: *
Offers activities for kids and a kids club. But in that same hotel they also have pole dancers where you eat dinner with your kids and there is loud partying and a DJ until late.

If you still decide to stay here, I hope all this information helps you feel better prepared and less ripped off than we did. Good luck!

reviews.author: eduarda maciel
reviews.text: I didn’t like the food at the resort and the room service was a disappointment. Every single time the food was cold. The only great service was at the 90 degrees pool bar. The staff at this bar was outstanding. Friendly people and amazing service.

reviews.author: Eliana Aranibar
reviews.text:
This hotel belongs to the same chain as the previous one where I stayed, but it's within the same complex. I first stayed at the other hotel and then moved to this one, which supposedly offered a higher category, specifically in the adults-only section.
My expectation was a better level of service, including perks like an exclusive beach and more personalized attention, but unfortunately, this wasn't the case. The exclusive beach service was never available.
Furthermore, this category includes concierge service, whose role is to assist guests and make their stay more enjoyable (reservations, recommendations, follow-up, etc.). In my case, the experience was very poor. The assigned concierge provided virtually no service: there was no follow-up, no interest, and no suggestions. He only made restaurant reservations. I even noticed a significant difference compared to other concierges who were very attentive to their guests. On my last day, he sent a farewell message, which I replied to, but I never received a response.
As for the hotel itself, it's an older structure, partially renovated, but it still feels like an old building. The room had a strong musty smell, which was quite unpleasant.
On the positive side, I must highlight the food, which was excellent in all the restaurants. The Italian restaurant, in particular, was outstanding.
For this reason, my rating is mixed: the food elevates the experience, but the service and the hotel's facilities fall short of expectations for this category.

reviews.author: Isa Riofrancos
reviews.text:
1. The staff's attention/service was poor; they left our plates and glasses on the table until they were practically unusable, among other things.

2. The pool bars were awful. It's unbelievable that a piña colada was bad (among several other drinks). We had to go to reception because it was the only place where they made decent drinks.

3. There was a constant lack of available food at the buffet.

4. The staff was completely unhelpful. We were a large group (11), and the largest table only sat 10. We told them it didn't matter because we had two children with us, but they wouldn't set the table for us or simply ignored us.

5. One of the air conditioners in the room was broken, and I complained about the shower water four times, but they never came, even though they said they would send a technician each time.

6. The gym was excellent, very well-equipped, but they closed it for maintenance without any prior notice.

It leaves MUCH to be desired for the price you have to pay, it's very pretty and all, but it falls short in many details (and not so small things) that make the experience unpleasant.

reviews.author: Jose Srur
reviews.text: A nice hotel with mediocre service. Our refrigerator in the beach room hasn't worked for four days, and the security guards are constantly yelling at each other. Luckily, we had a butler, Ariel, who was very helpful. We purchased a package deal called Circle (formerly Club Meliá), which was a disappointment. They didn't deliver on any of their promises.

reviews.author: Aitor G
reviews.text:
The hotel is adequate for a beach resort in the Dominican Republic, but it falls far short of the standard Meliá Hotels International sets for a 5-star hotel with The Reserve category within Paradisus.
Upon arrival, although they insisted we were assigned a superior room, the reality is that we weren't: it's the most basic suite. We are Meliá Platinum members, which implies a certain loyalty to the chain in exchange for privileges that were not honored here. They gave us The Reserve wristband, but the room is at the opposite end of the hotel from that area. They claim the hotel is full, but that's not true: even the staff themselves mention that the low season is starting and they are sending staff home.
We tried to make a reservation at one of the six available restaurants, but they directed us to the one they chose because "the others are full." That's not true either: there were clearly empty tables. The constant feeling is that they direct you according to their convenience, not according to actual availability.
From the second day onwards, you begin to notice a lack of quality in basic details. At the buffets, for example, there's a clear shortage of serving tongs: just one for several items (cold cuts, salmon, etc.), which poses a problem for allergy sufferers. Cleanliness also leaves much to be desired; our sheets weren't changed in four days. The Japanese restaurant is particularly poor, inferior to budget buffets in Spain. At the other restaurants, if you go where they suggest, the wait between courses is excessive (20 minutes between the starter and main course).
Getting towels at some of the kiosks is simply impossible: they tell you there aren't any and offer no alternative. At a resort of this caliber, running out of towels and not offering a solution is unacceptable.

Another example of disorganization: I rented a car and provided the driver's information and license plate number beforehand so they could access the lobby and finalize the rental agreement. The next day, they blocked the driver's entrance and forced me to complete the process standing at the door, after being transported in a trolley. Only after calling customer service was the issue resolved.

On our last day, despite being Platinum guests, we were initially denied a two-hour late check-out, with the explanation that they were full. After expressing our dissatisfaction, they changed their story: now it turns out our room is "special" because it connects to the one next door, and they need it. Coincidence or not, the adjoining room was occupied by a corporate group still staying at the hotel, with visible signage on the door. Finally, at 11:55, they granted us those two "complimentary" hours.
To top it all off, we witnessed a woman fall in the central plaza and remain on the ground for quite some time without any member of staff coming to her aid. This feeling of a lack of involvement is constant: what happens simply isn't their concern.
In short: it's not a bad hotel in absolute terms, but it falls far short of the standard one expects—and pays for—at a Paradisus The Reserve. If you arrive with those expectations, it's hard not to leave disappointed.

reviews.author: Toni
reviews.text: We stayed for six days, from December 27th to January 2nd, with my family. I expected more from this hotel, being a Paradius, but it didn't disappoint. We had suite rooms that were very small for suites. Then there was the elevator—one was broken, and there was a queue to go up. The buffet was only good on the 31st night; the other two nights were very poor, and the 1st was shameful—everything was leftovers from the 31st night. My grandson couldn't enjoy the mini club. The opening hours were terrible. I've been a customer of the Meliá chain for years, but it disappoints me more and more each time. We travel quite a bit and stay at other hotels as well, and when they're 5-star, they're much better, but everyone has their own tastes. This Paradius in Gran Canaria has been a huge disappointment.

reviews.author: Muskan Harpalani
reviews.text:
A far below expectations, with a few exceptions worth mentioning.

Our recent stay at this Punta Cana hotel was, overall, disappointing. While the surroundings are beautiful and some facilities are well-maintained, the service leaves much to be desired for a resort that promises quality and excellence.

Many of the waiters were rude, with an unprofessional and even offensive attitude at times. Wait times at the restaurants were excessive—more than an hour for breakfast on several occasions—and even then, the orders arrived incorrectly. The most serious incident occurred at the Italian restaurant, where three members of our group suffered food poisoning after dining there. This is unacceptable and should be investigated urgently.

That said, it's also fair to acknowledge those who did their jobs well. Special thanks to Altagracia, Elexander, Jean Carlos, Alberto, and Greivin, who were attentive, friendly, and professional throughout our stay. Thanks also to Teófilo at the pool bar in the Reserve area, who always served us with a smile and excellent service.

Regarding the food options, we particularly liked the Mina restaurant (specializing in meats) and the Mexican restaurant, where the service was more efficient and the food of better quality.

In short: a hotel with potential, but with serious problems in management, staff training, and health and safety. I wouldn't recommend it in its current state unless significant improvements are made.

reviews.author: Maxime Gazel
reviews.text:
At first glance, the hotel has some real advantages: a very good location, immediate proximity to the beach, several pleasant swimming pools, and a good selection of restaurants. The setting is beautiful and suggests a comfortable and relaxing stay.

Unfortunately, once there, the reality is quite different. Upon arrival, no shuttle service is offered between the airport and the hotel, forcing guests to manage on their own with taxis at clearly exorbitant prices. For an establishment of this standard, this is already a negative sign.

Housekeeping is careless, and communicating with the staff quickly becomes a real ordeal. They don't speak a word of English, and simple requests have to be repeated several times a day. It took us nine days to consistently receive three towels and a bath mat during our ten-night stay. Unacceptable at this price point.

The fact that two "Paradisus" hotels share the same name is utterly confusing. Sun loungers, clearly visible and located directly opposite our room, were off-limits to us, without any clear explanation. The opaque organization was frustrating for guests.

The atmosphere at the buffet was also very disappointing. The staff was often cold, sometimes downright unpleasant, giving the impression of being a nuisance with every request. Again, this was far from the welcome expected in a high-end establishment.

After only three days, our assigned hostess led us, under false pretenses, to a so-called "VIP" area, which turned out to be a sales pitch for Meliá offers. Once we declined, there was no further contact until the end of our stay. This was an inappropriate and rather undignified approach.

Finally, the most worrying point: our 16-month-old daughter contracted chickenpox. The hotel's "doctor" didn't even bother to examine him, focusing first on the payment method ($215) before referring us to an affiliated private clinic, with an upfront cost that could exceed $1,500. This was an extremely shocking and anxiety-inducing situation for parents.

In short, despite the pleasant setting, this stay was a series of disappointments: a lack of professionalism, poor organization, inadequate customer service, and inappropriate business practices. A far cry from the promised 5-star experience.

reviews.author: O Drey
reviews.text:
Honestly, I was very disappointed… the service is appalling, the staff are not at all pleasant… avoid it despite the location being quite nice!

The rooms are beautiful but have many malfunctions… and are very worn! The housekeeping is very poor and you have to chase after the cleaning staff to get a towel… a strange way to operate for a resort of this standard… I unfortunately wouldn't recommend it :(

reviews.author: Yasmin Arias
reviews.text: I've been visiting this hotel for many years, but this year it's fallen far short of previous standards. As a member of the Meliá chain, I think they're doing a very poor job. I believe the company should address the hotel's problems. The pool is dirty, and many sections of the tiles are coming loose, posing a danger to swimmers. As a member currently staying at the hotel, I feel I made a bad investment in the brand. I hope this review helps others considering investing in or staying with this hotel to be aware of the issues before coming. Furthermore, the mattresses are saggy, and even the pillows are uncomfortable. The small dinner buffet has very few options.

reviews.author: Fabio Carvalho
reviews.text:
The COST is not worth the BENEFIT in THE RESERVE package!

I stayed from June 4th to 18th, 2025 and did not have a good experience.

Bad check-in, dirty room, and a 1 hour and 30 minute delay to change rooms. They wanted to put us in an inferior room; we insisted that this was not what we paid for. Terrible welcome!

Halfway through the stay we upgraded our room and had to wait 4 hours for the new suite to be available, which could have been an attempt to correct the terrible check-in experience, but it didn't happen!

Again, dirty room, unsanitary minibar!

Nothing new, bad experience!

Bad reception, unprepared staff!

Concierge doesn't work, only makes restaurant reservations!

Pool/beach service does not include food.

Room service does not include alcoholic beverages in the all-inclusive package.

Vouchers earned only work if you pay something in cash!

During a day trip provided by Meliá at the hotel next door, I received terrible service from the beach manager, Hulery Gonzales, which made me cancel the trip and return!

It could have been better!

FC

reviews.author: N D
reviews.text: I will write a sincere review hoping that the hotel improves things! We stayed there for a week. The hotel is beautiful; you can tell the owner invests a lot of money. Unfortunately, the staff is very poorly trained and managed. They have an app to request amenities (soap, cotton balls, etc.), which I thought was great, but when you make the request online, you never receive anything. The rooms are very poorly cleaned; the floors are never mowed. I asked for a hairdryer three times, and it wasn't until the third day, when I told them they weren't serious, that they finally gave it to me. The buffet is sorely lacking in choice and taste, but the worst part is the sushi, which is inedible. They try to make sushi with leftover cheese and spoiled ingredients. The guacamole is rarely fresh, the potatoes are undercooked, the desserts look nice but tasteless, the meat is undercooked, and so on. The hotel really needs to do something because this is not a buffet worthy of a 5-star hotel. I've eaten better in 3-star hotels. The drinks in the bars are not Famous and very, very diluted, everywhere in the hotel the staff expects a tip to give you even minimal service! We tipped, but it was never enough… On the beach, the only available bar is reserved for The Reserve club. For everyone else, you have to go all the way to the pool for a drink! Between meals, there's nothing to eat; you have to sit in the beach club, which is à la carte, so you have to stay at the table and wait a long time… For room service, I ordered salmon with rice and a cocktail, and I received it with fries, even though I don't eat fried food! The cocktail never arrived. The person who brought my dinner told me I had to go to the bar! So why do you allow this on the app?!!! Your apps are cheating!!! If you want to be a 5-star hotel, you have to earn it and do things properly! Not to mention the staff who harass you to buy a Meliá membership—no thanks, I don't plan on coming back! There were some positive aspects, though: the pools are large and clean, the grounds are beautiful, the beach is lovely and well-maintained, and there are plenty of chairs—no need to get up early to reserve a spot. The à la carte reservation system works well, Patricia is lovely and very professional; she loves her job and puts a smile on the guests' faces. I never had any trouble booking a restaurant; there was always availability. I really enjoyed the à la carte restaurants; the quality is superior to the buffet. It's delicious, fresh, and flavorful—you can tell experienced chefs are behind the dishes, unlike with the buffet. Our favorite was the Mexican restaurant. The hotel is more expensive than other 5-star hotels in the area. We chose it expecting quality and service, but I was very disappointed; nothing justifies the price! This is my honest opinion. We had a nice week, but it could have been better!

reviews.author: Luana Natasha Pedro
reviews.text: Hello! I wanted to say that my stay at the hotel was excellent. Thanks to Reynaldo, who accompanied us and took great care of us. He was an amazing waiter, remembering our drink and food preferences. He even helped us choose drinks at three different restaurants. A wonderful experience!

reviews.author: Olga Olabarria
reviews.text: A disappointment only salvaged by the service and conversation of our waiter, Arizmendiz. Last night we had our romantic dinner on the beach, and the main course was a dry, tough lobster that we couldn't even eat. Even the best Michelin-starred chef can have a mistake or an off day, but unfortunately, it's not the first time we've expressed our dissatisfaction. Unacceptable in a hotel of this category. Once again, many thanks to Arizmendiz for his service and professionalism; you saved our night.

reviews.author: Eli Marujo
reviews.text:
I was disappointed with Paradisus. This was my third time in Punta Cana, and compared to others I've been to, I didn't like it and I don't recommend it. The price is high for what it offers. There's no standardization in the drinks; each place makes them differently. For example, sometimes they put a slice of lime in a margarita, other times they don't, and the taste differs from a kiosk to a restaurant... Sometimes they put dehydrated orange in Aperol, other times they don't...
The service isn't good; the employees complain in front of you, speak loudly... they don't replenish the table properly. Room service doesn't replenish products like toothpaste... floor towels...
The main restaurant is a mess, there aren't enough plates... the food isn't appealing. At breakfast, it was impossible to eat American pancakes and waffles; they tasted like concrete with so much flour...
I consider the other restaurants—Italian, Japanese, Mexican—to be mediocre.
The pools are good and pleasant.
The shows, when there were any, were quite weak; there was a lack of animation like I've seen in other resorts on other occasions when I visited Punta Cana.

On the beach, at the Bali bungalows, was the only place with excellent service, provided by Loyda, who was very attentive and helpful, always concerned with providing good service. She deserves 5 stars.

reviews.author: Bruno Bensoussan
reviews.text:
Terrible service, the reception staff are a joke!!
Lazybones!!
The phone in the room doesn't work, and the TV is very poorly tuned.

I went to reception four times to report the problems, and each time they said "okay," but no one came to fix it!!
At the entrance, we waited an hour because they didn't have our reservation due to their lack of organization, and not an apology or any kind of compensation.
The restaurants are a nightmare; you have to book, and they're always full.
Finally, someone came to fix the phone after two days, but what about the TV when we're gone?
In short, I wouldn't recommend it. For 700 euros a night, it's not what you'd expect from a 5-star hotel.

reviews.author: Al Espin
reviews.text: Compared to Paradisus hotels in Mexico, this one falls far short. In Playa del Carmen, Mexico, they clean up the seaweed. Here, they don't. You can't even go into the sea. You can't even be on the beach because the accumulated seaweed is rotting and smells awful. The hotel lacks vegetation, so there's no shade at the pools, and since everything is covered in concrete, it intensifies the heat. Nothing appealing about it. My next trips will be to Paradisus Mexico, which are far superior.

reviews.author: Philip Lauzon
reviews.text:
We traveled with my parents, who have been Club Meliá members since 2008, and bitterly regret their purchase. PLEASE DO NOT JOIN CLUB CIRCLE. They tried again and again to sell us a vacation plan that is excessively expensive and offers no benefits. Basically, they want your money upfront to ensure they hold you hostage. The hotel has changed a lot since the pandemic and has become impersonal. We received a poor welcome and spent four days without a concierge until Lewis came to our rescue. He took care of us immediately without waiting for instructions from management because he felt sorry for us given how the hotel had treated us. We saw a few familiar faces who recognized us and made our stay pleasant. A huge thank you to:

- Rosanna, Edito, and Jorge at the buffet.

- Juan, the head chef
- Milares, Raul, and Hansel at the beach bar
- Jonathan, the sommelier
- Judica, Fausto, Hector, and Melvin in the restaurants

As for the rest, the area around the pools is noisy with inconsiderate people playing loud music on wireless speakers (supposedly prohibited but tolerated) and children running around everywhere. We had terrible neighbors on the 3rd floor who banged on our heads for 10 days, and we called security 5 times without success.

The rooms are clean and comfortable but noisy because everyone slams the doors due to the lack of self-closing mechanisms and soundproofing. They've also locked the air conditioning at 22°C to save energy, but this means the rooms can be a bit too hot. A huge thank you to Criselle and her team for the outstanding room service. The beach is absolutely beautiful and one of the main reasons we keep coming back to this place.

In short, there's a noticeable lack of coordination between the staff and management. Also, Club Meliá members are always treated last, and they've also restricted certain services in an attempt to sell us an expensive plan now called Circle.

My parents have been extremely disappointed with the Meliá chain for some time now. It's important to understand that they paid annual maintenance fees during the COVID-19 pandemic and lost their vacation weeks in the process. Meliá categorically refuses to reimburse them or transfer their lost weeks unless they purchase a Circle membership. It's a complete farce. We're seriously considering another hotel chain for our next stay, and my parents are looking to transfer their remaining plan for free. Our room numbers are 3022-3024.

We were also heavily solicited during our stay to write "5-star Google reviews." Even one of the restaurant managers practically forced us to do one during our meal by dictating what to write 🫤

reviews.author: Jose Santafosta
reviews.text: The hotel management and its policies are deplorable. Only one restaurant open at lunchtime, so crowded that we left without eating on two occasions. To top it all off, I left an item in my room, and when I called to have it sent to Santo Domingo (at my expense, obviously), they told me they didn't ship and that if I wanted it, I should go get it. Honestly, I don't know how they value it the way they do. They're pirates.

reviews.author: jchrist jimenez
reviews.text:
In the pool bar area, Gerinaldo, Quintino, Víctor, Rina, and Jorge Rafael were excellent. Their friendliness and service were outstanding. "They are the exception."
Otherwise, we didn't have a good experience. For starters, there isn't enough parking. In the restaurants, the service was poor, the staff was insufficient, and the food quality left much to be desired.
Regarding the room, we booked a double room and were given a single. When we went to bed, the sheets were stained with blood. Although some employees seemed willing to help, they lacked the necessary resources and management support to make guests feel comfortable. This hotel is an experience I wouldn't recommend to anyone, and I personally wouldn't return.
3 stars for service because of the bar staff. 1 star for the room because at least it had a bed, water, and air conditioning. 2 stars for location because, being small, everything is close by. Overall, the hotel gets 2 stars for the staff who make an effort to meet the needs of the customers.

reviews.author: Toni Belda Ferri
reviews.text: I didn't like the beach service at all, it was terrible, and I was in the Leve Royal Suite room. The staff was helpful but very slow. The entertainment was very weak. This hotel is geared toward Americans. The best thing was the Leve Restaurant. I've been to the Dominican Republic 10 times on this trip, but things have changed a lot. I'll come back, but never to this hotel.

reviews.author: Rafael Espinal
reviews.text: I've been visiting this hotel for many years, but this year it's far below previous standards. As a member of the Meliá chain, I think they're doing a very poor job. I believe the company should fix the hotel's problems. The pool is dirty, and many sections of the tiles are coming loose, posing a danger to swimmers. As a member currently staying at the hotel, I feel I made a bad investment in the brand. I hope this review helps others considering investing in or staying with the hotel to be aware of the issues before coming.

reviews.author: Matías May
reviews.text:
The overall service, with the exception of Josie Espinosa and the two staff members on the beach, Pedro and another whose name I can't recall, and a few other isolated cases, was a DISASTER. A complete disgrace. Every request we made to the staff was met with a "No" as the first response, no matter how basic the request.

Clearly, there are no influential people making decisions at the hotel; it's been left in the hands of inept employees with no decision-making power. The owners must be focused on working for another chain while they completely neglected the Paradisus Palma Real.
I say this having visited the previous year and knowing what the hotel is capable of.
The situations we had to endure were countless, starting on the first day when the rooms we had reserved weren't available, continuing with the deplorable service in the restaurants and the total lack of internal coordination among the staff, and culminating in having to shower with cold water on the last day (it wasn't the only time during our stay). A regrettable stay; impossible to recommend unless your expectations are extremely low. I appreciate the beach service, the sargassum cleanup, and the beach in general, which is nicer than the surrounding ones.

reviews.author: Rafiel Vásquez Checo
reviews.text: The best time spent with Jorge Rafael and Jairo, such wonderful people! A fantastic time. However, the food isn't great; you have to wait hours for dinner at the restaurants, and if you want to make a reservation, sometimes they tell you there aren't any and give priority to foreigners.

reviews.author: Jones Halluch
reviews.text: Good Wi-Fi infrastructure, works well everywhere, food didn't please me, always a bit cold, and the service also leaves something to be desired. If you want to eat at a themed restaurant that requires a reservation, you'll have to put up with the bad mood of the staff who serve you poorly and don't care at all (that they make the reservation)! They only provide good service based on a tip! Another detail: we wanted to play volleyball at 6 PM and they refused to lend us a ball, saying that recreation ended at 6 PM and that they couldn't lend one, even though it was daylight! The pool also closes at 6 PM, they practically force you out because of the time limit. I'll never go back, not even for free! Terrible service. Good and clean rooms.

reviews.author: ISIDORA LABBE MORENO
reviews.text:
Kanna was delicious and the service was good, but the buffet was terrible. The staff was generally rude; drinks took 15 minutes to arrive, they gave you dirty looks, avoided you, and the waiters argued amongst themselves.
They clean the rooms whenever they feel like it.

reviews.author: Andreia Meirelles
reviews.text: I found the hotel excellent, clean, and the staff service wonderful, especially Felipe who greeted us and Mr. Luiz from the bar, who has excellent charisma. I was a little disappointed with the staff who aren't from the hotel but only run the tours, because until they receive the money, the treatment is one way, but after they've received the service, it's another. The people who sell the tours are great, but those who run the tours are terrible, but apart from that, everything was wonderful. Congratulations again to Felipe.

reviews.author: ramiro L
reviews.text:
The price is not worth it for the service and the hotel's presentation.
They advertise a 5-star hotel, but it's a 3-star hotel.
We paid for the Royal Service, which includes a butler. The butler was incredibly useless.
The service from the rest of the staff was acceptable.
THE ENTIRE HOTEL IS VERY POORLY MANAGED. IT NEEDS A LOT OF SUPERVISION TO FUNCTION PROPERLY.
It lacks all the details it should have to be a 5-star hotel and charge the price they did.
I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT AT ALL. MONEY WASTED.

reviews.author: Silvia De Andrés
reviews.text: The room was adequate and close to the beach. The food was terrible, the restaurants were awful, and the place was very poorly organized. There's nowhere comfortable to have a drink. The only positive comments were the service from the concierge, Starling Tavares, and Martin, who assisted us on the beach.

reviews.author: Osvaldo Paolini
reviews.text: We stayed in August 2019. I had paid for a deluxe room, and when we arrived, there was a terrible musty smell. They moved us to a standard room, which was much better. There were no activities for the kids, just a foosball table and a ping-pong table. In the afternoon, the only food available was hot dogs and hamburgers, which made me sick, so we had to call the doctor (apparently they were undercooked). The spa was an extra charge, and room service cost $5. In short, I would never go back.

reviews.author: MariO Josué Corniel
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice, the room is beautiful too, but the staff at Mas Calzone is horrible. They gave us an appointment at 9:30 and the waiter who served us said to order quickly because we were going to be left without food because they don't cook until 10. As a customer, I am not to blame for the time of the appointment.

reviews.author: Chedy Baez
reviews.text: Very poor service. The employees acted like they were working under duress; they didn't smile or pay attention. The rooms were very clean. The one I was given was very comfortable. The air conditioning barely cooled.

reviews.author: Younes Marlive
reviews.text: We came to stay for two full weeks, we asked to go to the Gran Cana, because for what we paid the queeee would have been to Paradisus and to have a different feeling of vacation, they told us that they will look into it, yesterday they wrote to us to ask us, but I don't know where, the question is, if we change will we have to pay differences or is the consumption different because we are not members? I don't know, after a week... seriously with how much it costs to earn money today, with the desire to forget so many bad things in the world and wanting to be somewhere else... Looking forward to our vacation all year, and this happens to us.

reviews.author: Anaïs Hausmann
reviews.text: Beautiful architecture, a stunning pool, lush and well-maintained gardens, but the service is completely disorganized in every way. Numerous problems arose daily...for everything and nothing. I do not recommend this establishment unless you enjoy a headache!

reviews.author: fabiana brizola
reviews.text: Because a beach cover-up of mine was stolen, Bar Gabi has many security cameras, and when I approached security, they saw that it was another guest who committed the act. They didn't want to bother the other guest, disregarding me, even though I was also a guest.

reviews.author: Luis Quiroz
reviews.text: Andreina and Vianny bar gin ger excellent service from both, the drinks were delicious, a very good experience at the place.

reviews.author: sonia noemi
reviews.text: I loved the service at the 36 and 34 degree pools. Julia Solano and Edickson Morales provided excellent service; they were very kind, charismatic, and attentive. The staff was excellent; it was one of our best vacations thanks to them. We had a fantastic time and they made us enjoy ourselves immensely.

reviews.author: Camila Melendez
reviews.text: The truth is, the hotel is very nice, everything is very clean, and the staff is very friendly, but the drinks are terrible. There were no international beers, only Presidente beer, and the local rum was very bad. The food, both at the buffet and in the restaurants, was very poor, and there was no seafood at all. You have to pay to eat a lobster, and it's incredibly expensive! I won't be back…

reviews.author: Joaquín Atencia García
reviews.text:
Nice place.

The worst service I've ever had. Every single thing is a disaster. They rip you off. The lunch buffet is awful. And the dinner restaurants are just so-so. Never again.

reviews.author: regis gomes
reviews.text: Bad food and drinks, beach full of seaweed, they try to sell you the hotel, timeshare, and other things... it's not worth the extra cost. I recommend staying in the hotels further up from Bávaro, near the Hard Rock and Iberostar.

reviews.author: Mercedes Suarez
reviews.text: Cana Restaurant. The service at this restaurant has improved since we arrived. The staff is very attentive and better than at the buffet.

reviews.author: Drew Talens
reviews.text: Wow. I don’t even know where to start. When we arrived we talked to people in the Reserve about our reservation. We didn’t need a tour because we had already toured the property.
