Our pillows smelled like sweat or piss when we first arrived. So we went to the front desk and they got us new pillows. Took almost 4 hours for us to receive our Luggage from the front desk and when we went up to them they still had our luggage. We had been waiting in our rooms waiting for someone to bring us our luggage. My parents room was good but for my sister and I we called 4-5 days in a row to get a new fridge since everything in the fridge was warm. One of the days maintenance came in and checked out the fridge and said he’d be right back. Yea he didn’t come back at all that day. We had to confront our concierge to finally get it fixed for us. On Wednesday after golfing with my dad we wanted to stop by the SportsBar. We waited almost 15 mins before my dad went up to the bar and get us drinks. Never even took our order after that so we just left. Well guess what Today’s friday and the same thing happened again except this time our whole family sat down. I guess it was swift change so no one wanted to help us. I’ve never seen workers leave so fast once a shift change happened. However she did get us beverages but no one took our order for 15 mins after that so we went to Lunchbox for the buffet. Overall this has been a horrible experience and I definitely won’t be coming back. Horrible Service. Barely attentive staff. Something needs to change because I read a review from 2 months ago basically saying the same thing. Disgraceful. 0/10.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real and unfortunately this has been a disappointing experience.

The restaurants try to position themselves as upscale, but the service does not support that image. Staff at the restaurants and beach bars are often inattentive and slow. It doesn’t feel organized or guest-focused, especially for a resort in this price range.

What bothers me most is that every day a private company takes over the main courtyard area of the resort. Regular guests are pushed out of that space and made to feel unwelcome. That changes the atmosphere completely and makes it feel like hotel guests come second.

Cleanliness is also below what I would expect from a property marketed as luxury.

I still have five more days left in my stay, but I already wish I could go home. Sadly, I would not return.

reviews.author: Nora Shohayeb
reviews.text:
We are so disappointed by this hotel. The website looks so fancy and luxurious. This is not a 5 stars hotel. It is a 2 or 3 stars. The service is bad and slow. The room we got is not what we saw online. It is very old and not renovated. It is spacious and has a nice view of the sea but it is not renovated as the website claims.
The food is bad. The buffet food is cold and tasteless. The dinner restaurant are hard to book and are not that good.
Every time we go to the buffet or a restaurant, I ask for a high chair for my baby. It takes the staff 10-15 min to get it and some of the staff even ignore us.
The room service is almost non existent. I ordered a latte. It came after one hour and was not latte as the menu shows online. Just bad coffee and milk on the side.
All the good places in this hotel are for members.
There are lots of noise at the beach at night. We couldn’t sleep at all.
There are no food on the beach, just cheap and bad juices.
This hotel is a scam. I wouldnt recommend it and will never come back to the dominican Republic.
We paid lots of money to come here, and everything was disappointing.

reviews.author: Astrid Rosario
reviews.text: The hotel is good for taking nice photos; it's pretty and offers activities, but the service was terrible and ruined my stay. I spoke with them and booked a room, and when I arrived, they gave me the wrong room three times. It wasn't the one I requested. After I showed them the receipt for the oceanfront room that was supposed to be child-friendly, they told me they couldn't give me that room, but when I called and bought it, they said yes. In the end, they gave me a room I didn't even want. They made me run around a lot on my first day when all I wanted was to relax. Also, the website promised many things the hotel had, like horses, and when I arrived, they told me they didn't have any of that. The website listed many things, but they had almost none of it. I'm very disappointed, to be honest. If you go, look around and write down the name of the person who serves you.

reviews.author: Guilherme
reviews.text:
Hotel is overrated. The price charged is completely unrealistic for what it offers. Upon arrival, the guy who took our luggage to the room left angry and slammed the door because he didn’t receive a tip. The room was supposed to be for a honeymoon from the start, but they gave us a room with two single beds and did not allow us to change it—unless we paid an extra U$$800.
There’s no coconut water, no freezers around the resort to grab drinks freely. There’s no ice cream. There’s no heated pool. It was hard to even find a bar that had food. You have to order food and wait for it to be prepared, sometimes taking more than 20 minutes. There’s no ice cream.
I tried to book a restaurant for dinner, but there was no availability—not even for the next day. And the restaurants don’t allow reservations more than two days in advance. I went to get a beer at the beach kiosk, and they said my reservation didn’t cover beach beer. I went to another bar to get wine, but the wines are extremely expensive (yes, they charge for wine at an “all-inclusive” resort).
The room amenities are low quality. Liquid soap. There’s no music, no parties, no shows. It claims to be adults-only, but there are lots of children. Food service is only available at certain hours at the buffet (the only place with food for those who couldn’t get restaurant reservations). I asked for a Corona at a bar, and they said I wasn’t entitled to it.
This is the worst all-inclusive resort I’ve ever been to. The price for this ? Almost U$$3.000 for 7 days and for my honeymoon!

reviews.author: Scott
reviews.text:
Firstly, the ratings are heavily skewed because the waitresses and waiters supposedly need reviews with their names on it, but it doesn't review them, it reviews the entire hotel, so people put a 5 Star on it so those quickly glancing at the hotel to decide where to go, will see the review and think it applies to the entire hotel, when it really was just about that one server.  Scam.

The AC in the rooms are improperly installed.  They don't drain the condensation generated from cooling the room to the outside.  So, the rooms get incredibly humid, despite being a lower temperature, so everything gets sticky and uncomfortable.

Food is terrible.  I felt that everything I had was "I guess I can eat that" rather than a "I want to eat that" or "This looks great to try".

Paid the extra money for a Concierge that couldn't get a reservation for any decent times.  But that's a whole other thing.  You have to get a reservation at their restaurants for dinner, or you have to go to their buffet which is essentially recycled food.  The room service food was horrible.  They clearly just re-plated the leftover food that wasn't eaten during the buffet and warmed it up.

One of our guests got an infection from drinking some of the water.  Had to go on antiparasitics to get cured.

Service at the restaurants, if you could get in to them, was slow and uninspired.

I have been to half a dozen 5 Star Hotels in Cancun, Jamaica, Cabo, Aruba, etc.  This is NOT worthy of 5 Stars.  3 sure, 4 maybe, 5... Absolutely not.  I wouldn't return here if it was half the price.

The best food we had was off the hotel grounds.

Also, don't use their excursion desk for SCUBA diving, as the company they work with is not PADI certified.

reviews.author: Anthony White
reviews.text:
I'm not sure how this resort has such a high rating. The hotel service is good and that's about it. The rooms are nice, but you only have a glass door in the water closet for privacy. Your significant other will hear EVERYTHING when you are using the toilet.

The food and the service was horrible. A lot of the food dishes are local, and the American food is bland and unseasoned. Mashed potatoes at breakfast (yeah breakfast), were literally boiled and smashed, not blended. They did not have any butter or seasoning. The ribeye steak at one of the resaurants was tough and only about .5" thick.

Some of the restaurants are not open every day. The steak restaurant was closed when we arrived Saturday. The large buffet was closed as well two of the days that we were there.

There aren't many activities here. They had a cheesy concert in front of the main pool. Speaking of pools, the pools and the beach close at 6:00 PM. Really, I couldn't believe it.

I will definitely do more homework if I go back to the DR. Don't believe these reviews.

reviews.author: Ravi B
reviews.text:
Checked in late with a baby, and despite informing the hotel in advance, the room was not ready.

To make matters worse, none of the basic room amenities were functioning properly — the telephone, fridge, hair dryer, and even the safe lock. We contacted concierge four separate times, but since the room telephone wasn’t working, we were forced to walk from an extreme end of the property to the lobby each time and then wait to get assistance — an unacceptable experience when traveling with an infant.

2 days and 6 times we complained about replacing the fridge, each time they said they will send someone but no one showed up. All my baby food got spoiled. Room service was so slow that a few times my baby slept crying.

Basic 101- travelling couple with an infant - allotted us a room with 2 twin bed instead of a king bed and no baby crib (despite requesting it 3 weeks prior)

We requested a room change and also asked multiple times for the devices to be replaced. Even after giving the hotel over 24 hours to resolve these issues, no action was taken and there was no follow-up.

A property that calls itself 5-star should at the very least ensure basic room functionality and timely service. Unfortunately, both basic amenities and service response were severely lacking. This experience was frustrating, exhausting, and far below the standard expected of a hotel in this category.

I am at the hotel while writing this. Lets see if management reads this and resolves this.

Location wise its a great resort, service was poor.

reviews.author: Graziele Sodré
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience — not recommended for honeymoon

We arrived at the hotel after more than 12 hours of travel expecting to finally relax and start our honeymoon in a beautiful place. Unfortunately, the experience began in a very frustrating way.

When we checked in, we were given a room with two single beds that could not be joined, even though we are a couple on our honeymoon. On top of that, the air conditioning was not working and the phone in the room also did not work, which meant we couldn’t even call reception for help.

After going to reception and asking for assistance, we waited over an hour with no solution. We were exhausted from the long journey and the situation became extremely stressful. Only after insisting several times did the staff offer a solution.

The “solution” was moving us to a lower category room, which felt like a downgrade. When we entered the new room, it had a strong smell of mold, so strong that I had to take an allergy medication. Because we were extremely tired, we had no choice but to accept it.

To make things worse, because we spent so much time trying to solve the room issue, we missed the reservation time for the restaurants, which closes at 5 pm. Now the hotel staff is being very bureaucratic about where we are allowed to have dinner.

This is supposed to be our honeymoon, and unfortunately what should have been a special experience has been extremely disappointing. I chose this hotel because of the good reviews, but our reality has been the opposite.

For couples planning a honeymoon, I would honestly not recommend this hotel. The service and the way this situation was handled were far below what we expected.

reviews.author: Pradeepa Jayaprakash
reviews.text:
I am currently staying at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana, with checkout scheduled for December 26. I never imagined I would be writing a review like this during my holiday — and especially on Christmas Eve — but the experience so far has been deeply disappointing and has truly spoiled what was meant to be a special vacation.

It has become very clear that guests are treated differently based on bracelet color. While I understand the concept of tiered service, what I have experienced as a green-bracelet guest goes far beyond differences in amenities. I have repeatedly been ignored by servers, had difficulty getting restaurant reservations, and have been treated with noticeably less courtesy, while guests with brown bracelets are openly prioritized right in front of us.

One situation was especially upsetting. At one of the restaurants, when I tried to order dessert, the server abruptly took the menu out of my hands without any explanation. This is unacceptable in any hospitality environment, let alone a resort that advertises itself as “luxury.”

As an Asian guest, I am also left wondering whether some of this treatment may be influenced by racial bias or expectations around tipping. Either possibility is troubling. No guest should feel pressured to tip just to receive basic service, and no one should be treated differently because of their appearance, nationality, or perceived spending level.

Tiered service should never mean neglect, rudeness, or a lack of basic respect. Every paying guest deserves professionalism, courtesy, and dignity — regardless of bracelet color.

Sadly, this situation has overshadowed my stay and taken away much of the joy from what should have been a relaxing holiday vacation. Until these issues are addressed, I cannot recommend Paradisus Palma Real, particularly for travelers booking through third-party partners such as Costco Travel.

— A disappointed holiday guest

reviews.author: dan bednarski
reviews.text: We have not even stayed at the resort yet but the booking is trying to do a bait and switch on us for prices. We booked a stay at the hotel with flights. The next day, we get an email notifying us that there was an issue with booking our return flights and if we wanted the flights it would be $900 more (2 people). After rounds of complaints through their horrible booking system, they notify me that they are making a final offering for the same flights for $490 more than originally booked. All at the same time the couple that we booked with has not had a single issue and they paid the advertised rates. Blatant rip off.

reviews.author: Rachel Lee
reviews.text:
I recently returned from a 4-day stay at Paradisus Palma Real and ended up in the ER. My experience was unfortunately overshadowed by a severe case of food poisoning or stomach flu that began on my final morning. The symptoms persisted throughout my travel day and flight home, which was incredibly difficult. For context, I ate at the main buffet six times and had dinner at Blue Agave the night before falling ill. I found the food quality to be below average overall, finding many of the "hot" buffet items frequently cold.

On a positive note, the resort itself was lovely. Our room was clean, well-located, and offered a beautiful balcony view of the pool. Note the walls are thin, so you could hear the neighboring room very well. The staff were kind and professional; however service in general felt very slow. I enjoyed the evening entertainment with dance shows.

reviews.author: Christian Echevarria-Reina
reviews.text:
Total failure in customer service. We were trying to plan our wedding here but have since thought better of it.

We weren’t able to get ahold of the coordinator for wedding planning for weeks over email.

We were told by the general line that there were day passes and when we showed up security would not let us in to buy one. Turns out there is no such thing.

We called the general phone number and the person who answered was annoyed that we asked to be transferred to a number within the hotel.

When we finally spoke to the wedding department they put the blame on us for emailing what they said was a “general email” (there was not a specific email provided anywhere we could discern).

There seems to be a pervasive culture of finger pointing and bureaucracy in customer support where every person claims they are not in charge of X and that they do not know how to solve X.

It does not seem like they care very much about the customer experience.

reviews.author: Christine Kapo Ng
reviews.text:
I am staying here right now for my 40th birthday and I truly regret this decision. Upon check-in, we waited about 20 minutes until we were able to get to the desk (we were first in line). Everyone but us were offered beverages. When we finally go to the desk, I told him I was here for my 40th birthday and he just laughed at me and didn't really offer any amenities or special services. I tried to reach out to the hotel several times over the past few months to get a group rate and no one ever responded. All my friends booked their rooms individually.
We finally get to our room (which was very far away from the front desk) and both of our keys did not work. We try to go to eat at the Beach Club which stays open til 6pm (it is now 4:30pm), only to be told by an annoyed waiter that they stop serving in 15 minutes and if we don't order now we won't get any food. We order, some of the items are "sold out".
We tip him for helping us with the food and getting our friends drinks after 4:45pm, he then offers to help us make a reservation at the Mexican restaurant where he'll work that night. Another thing to note, you can only make restaurant reservations in the morning from 9a-4pm but didn't know that before arrival, we were not able to secure any reservations because the reservation desk was closed for the day. This is a huge flaw, when we book our room, we should be given the opportunity to make reservations for our first night so we have something to eat. The only other option is the buffet.
Luckily, our tipped server decides to help us and we get reservations to the Mexican restaurant. You walk in and there's good tequila bottles displayed everywhere but they're not for the "regular customers". You have to pay extra for Don Julio, Patron, Espalon - etc. We ordered a Margarita and a Paloma. They use premixed - homemade mixers, everything tastes weird and non-alcoholic. Food at dinner was fine, my vegetarian friend ordered the Mushroom tacos. We were all served our food and we were waiting for her plate to arrive so we can eat together. We asked about her plate and then the waiter says "oh it's sold out". Why would  you tell us now? So my friend can't eat when we all eat?
There are also no performances or entertainment at night. They had a saxaphone player at 730 play for like 20 minutes and then silent disco was offered.
Breakfast this morning was a mess, all the tables are not bussed and we had to walk around and grab our own utensils and cups so we could eat.
Service at the beach is slow, basically nonexistent... it seems like the waiters are only waiting on specific people (probably because they have been tipped). My biggest issue is, Tips are earned upon doing a good job - they seem to only do their job here once you Tip them.
Needless to say, this is not how I pictured my 40th birthday to go. I thought it would be relaxing with fun activities, delicious food and drinks. Now I am running around trying to figure out how to get water (because they didn't put any in my room) and how to get into my room (because the room key didn't work), how to make reservations (because the kiosks don't work), how to order a drink (because the wait staff doesn't want to take your order). This is truly disappointing for a place that isn't exactly cheap.
Please do better. And if you read everyone's reviews, they all point out specific people that made their experience better - most likely because they have all been tipped.
I stayed at the Paradisus La Perla in Mexico and that place was incredible. No complaints. I decided to come here because I was really expecting the same level of service, hospitality and quality of food and drinks because it is also a Paradisus. This is absolutely not the same at all.

reviews.author: Anand Sundararajan
reviews.text:
Overall, especially given that this experience was our honeymoon, this was by far the worst experience that I have experienced in a tropical resort. A few staff members improved our otherwise awful experience.

The problem started off in the beginning with our room.

1) This hotel has a clear, unwritten policy to confidently lie that complimentary upgrades are not available, especially when booking through Amex travel. We have clear proof of this unwritten policy as we came to know of several folks that were offered paid uogrades until they brought up complimentary upgrades and then magically, those rooms vanished. Now, despite this lie, we were given an "upgrade" to the Reserve, however, even this, considering the exceptionally poor customer service, did not make any improvement to our unremarkable stay.

2) Our concierge proved to be indifferent at best and unhelpful at worst.

3) Our honeymoon special consisted of two macaroons and some chocolate covered strawberries.

4) The location is very good, however, the inconsistency of service combined with an unclear tipping culture makes getting good service a near impossible task despite nearly $400 spent on tips over the course of a one week stay.

5) The food menus were poorly designed with no dietary restrictions or allergies in mind especially for vegetarians. Separately, the food was terrible.

6) Rooms were noisy and could hear everything from the neighbouring rooms.

7) The staff and middle management need clear training on how to de-escalate situations and actually find ways to make customers happy vs. trying to make everything the customer's fault. For example, getting our minibar refreshed or getting our room cleaned required multiple followups. The first question asked despite repeated follow-ups is whether we had left our "do not disturb" on.

8) We wasted our precious time filling out a form ahead of time and the staff were not informed of any of the requests on the form and there was no effort made to reach out regarding something as basic as an airport pick-up.

I would highly recommend that this resort take a fresh look at their staff training, menus and general approach to hospitality. The managerial staff can learn a thing or two from the servers and waiters who actually managed to put smiles on our faces. I will not visit any Melia or Paradisus property again in the future and waste my time / money.

reviews.author: Kaylee Camp
reviews.text: Can not stress this enough do not stay here. Our room had roaches and door wouldn’t close all the way and wasn’t sealed at bottom. The pools were never clean on the reserve side. Had napkins and cups in them.  The air conditioning barely worked. The wait staff and all employees were very rude and never friendly with the exception of two employees. The food choice were subpar. Then we go to dinner and had roaches all on the table and chairs. Also at the sports bar on the table. This is ridiculous and disgusting DO NOT EVER STAY HERE!!! Don’t waste your money go to Hyatt Ziva instead!!!!!!

reviews.author: Noah Waldman
reviews.text: Terrible food options and quality. No healthy options, all vegetables were soaked in oil. All the specialty cuisine restaurants were awful renditions of the actual cuisine. I got sick from fruit too. Beyond terrible resort, do not go here unless you want to eat dog food out of a trough

reviews.author: Sam Beigi
reviews.text:
This was the 3rd Melia group hotel we’ve chosen for our vacation, initially in Grand Canaria, then Riviera Maya, and now in Punta Cana, despite the perfect experience we had with the first 2 hotels, Punta Cana was an absolute disappointment. I booked an ocean front suit which is among the most expensive room in their portfolio, and upon check in, we’ve been given room 9284, which was a nightmare, old, out dated, dirty, and so on. We had to leave the faucet running for five minutes to get hot water, beds were aweful, and it was an absolute mess. At check out, we realized that our room was not 9284 and the check in staff gave us the wrong room and their system shows our room was actually 9264. Not sure if it was an intentional error or not given that some rooms are renovated and some rooms not.

Melia hotels was our favourite hotel until this vacation, and going forward, we are going to explore other brands, since the consistency of quality for a 5-star group of hotels is the utmost priority to our family.

I should mention that all staff in all department gets a 5 star from us.

reviews.author: Vital Smolski
reviews.text: We booked a suite for over $1000 a night, luckily we did that for only couple nights and will be switching hotels tmr  and just because there is no way we could have found another hotel right away…. We arrived at 11:50, including elderly in-law over 70 years old and toddler under 2 years old, this is 5star resort, our room is the biggest on the premises (ocean-front suite) - it’s now 16:20 and we still are told suite is not ready…??!? Terrible experience… Hosmil is the front office supervisor and the only thing she was able to say was ‘oh ok we’ll give you late checkout at 2pm tmr because other people are coming in’ - yeah just like we are waiting. They also told us previous guests checked out at 12pm and now 3 people are working on cleaning the suite… so it took 3 PEOPLE AND 4.5 HOURS to get $1000/a-day-room ready…. And now it’s not even a suite , just a room full it two beds not even queen….. I demand an explanation

reviews.author: Claudia Wang
reviews.text: The room has issue with sound proof. Extremely noisy. We can hear exactly what the other room is doing and could not sleep at all. Even they are talking at normal voice. And we asked the front desk to change a room... Nobody takes care of us. We complained at the front desk and they said nobody will be living at the other room tonight, however, the room is occupied again and very noisy again. We called front desk and they said they will take a look and the phone was hanged off. the concierge service is very terrible!!! the vacation becomes too suffering, can’t sleep

reviews.author: Taya Photographer
reviews.text:
I was honestly shocked by the laundry prices at this hotel in the Dominican Republic. I just wanted to wash a few of my T-shirts and a pair of shorts — nothing special. But when they gave me the price list, I couldn’t believe it: each item costs 5 USD. One T-shirt – 5$, one pair of shorts – 5$, and so on for every single piece.

In the end, they tried to charge me almost 100 USD for laundry, even though this hotel advertises itself as All-Inclusive. It’s ridiculous. I never expected to pay that much just to wash a couple of light items in an all-inclusive hotel. Very disappointing and uncomfortable experience with their “extra services.”

reviews.author: kristina HuDSON
reviews.text: Staff and rooms were great!!! However this resorts water system had me dealthy sick for 5 days. Also do not eat the salads!! I’m afraid to travel after this experience with my heath from the water.

reviews.author: Aida Kamali
reviews.text:
Paradisus Palma Real – Extremely Disappointing Experience

I would never recommend this hotel. We booked what was advertised as an all-inclusive package, but it was far from it. Food was only available at very limited times and in specific locations, leaving us with no real options throughout the day. The staff was unhelpful and in many cases outright rude. Service by the pool was nonexistent—no one ever checked on guests, and when we asked for help, most employees didn’t seem to know anything.

On top of that, there were no basic amenities such as a shop for essentials or even an emergency convenience store within the hotel. For a resort of this size and price, this was shocking. My husband and I travel four times a year for quick getaways, and this was by far the worst experience we’ve had anywhere.

We expected a relaxing, stress-free stay, but instead we dealt with poor service, lack of food options, and no sense of hospitality. This was our first and last visit to Paradisus Palma real

reviews.author: Joe Oliveiro
reviews.text:
I'm sharing my experience with this hotel. I would highly recommend against staying here.

I am writing to express my deep disappointment and frustration with the treatment I received from your nighttime supervisor, Samson, during my recent stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. What should have been a memorable and pleasant experience was completely ruined by his unprofessionalism and lack of customer service.
To provide some context, I paid for an upgrade to my room to enhance my experience at your hotel. Part of this experience was meant to include my girlfriend spending the night with me, making my last evening truly special, as she was staying at a different hotel in Punta Cana with her family.

Prior to this incident, I spoke with my butler about bringing my girlfriend to spend the night. He informed me that it was possible but that I should confirm with the front desk. On March 21, I visited the front desk and was assured that my girlfriend could join me at any time as long as she was registered upon arrival for an additional fee of $135. I made it clear that this was not an issue, and I planned my evening accordingly.

When we arrived at the security gate, we were told that we needed to wait for permission to enter, which they said would take about five minutes. After waiting for 30 minutes, Samson, the nighttime supervisor, came out and outright refused to let us in, stating that he would not allow her to be registered. I tried to explain that I had received prior approval from the front desk and that I was fully prepared to pay the registration fee. His response was dismissive and unprofessional, stating that he was the supervisor and made the decisions.

I attempted to convey how important this evening was to me and how deeply disappointing it was to have our plans disrupted in such a manner. Instead of listening or trying to resolve the situation, he remained indifferent and continued to refuse entry. His lack of empathy and unwillingness to even consider my explanation was appalling.
What makes this experience even worse is that when I returned to the hotel alone to find out his name, he refused to properly identify himself. He mumbled his name so quickly and quietly that I could not understand him. I had to ask another staff member to confirm his name.

This entire experience was deeply upsetting and has left me with a very negative impression of what was otherwise a pleasant stay. The fact that I paid for an upgraded room and was assured that my girlfriend could be registered only to be treated so poorly is unacceptable.

I expect this matter to be taken seriously. This is not the level of service one expects from a hotel of your reputation and caliber. At the very least, I would appreciate an apology and a clear explanation of why your staff was not aligned on this policy.
I look forward to your prompt response and to hearing how you intend to address this matter.
Sincerely,

reviews.author: Cindy Rasines
reviews.text:
Our family vacation at Paradisus Palma Real was TERRIBLE extremely disappointing from the very beginning. We had booked a one-week stay, but we left after only three days due to multiple issues.

First, upon arrival, there was no staff available to assist us with our luggage. A large group had arrived before us, so we were left to carry our own bags, even though we had two small children (ages 2 and 5). This was unacceptable for a so-called luxury family resort.

The housekeeping service was another major failure. We checked in on Friday, and by Saturday at 3:30 p.m. our room still had not been cleaned. I specifically requested service since my 2-year-old uses diapers and the trash already smelled unpleasant from the previous day. No one came until 10:00 p.m., after I had to leave the trash bin outside the door and go to the lobby to complain. This level of neglect is completely inexcusable.

On Saturday morning, while having breakfast, we even found a small cockroach walking on our table — absolutely disgusting and unacceptable for any resort, let alone one that claims to be high-end.

To make matters worse, on Sunday night, while I was in the room with my children quietly watching TV, security knocked on our door to tell us that our baby had been crying and we were “making too much noise.” I was shocked, frustrated, and outraged. This is supposed to be a family resort — babies cry, and that is a normal part of family life. For security to harass us for this was humiliating and deeply upsetting.

This entire experience was uncomfortable, frustrating, and incredibly disappointing. I requested a refund because what was supposed to be a relaxing family vacation turned into a stressful nightmare. I will never return to this property and strongly advise families to reconsider before booking here.

reviews.author: Vitaliy Savsyuk
reviews.text: Hope this review finds you and they don’t delete it.  When booking this resort I seen no negative reviews and it was a little sketchy.  But me and my family came from New York for our Baby moon here.  When booking online we selected king bed and all pictures showed a nice room with king size bed but upon arrival they said sorry we don’t have a king for you.  This greatly unsettled me because we would have booked a different resort.  I asked multiple times to pay for upgraded room and doesn’t matter the cost to me but just get me something other then two small twin beds.  The staff was incredibly rude and not accommodating.  They also say you get 150$ resort credits but you really don’t you get a dumb coupon book to use for get this “room upgrade” but they don’t have a room upgrade so you get stiffed on that as a perk of the resort.  Also showers smell moldy becuase the water doesn’t drain in the showers but sits in the corners of the shower because it’s horribly pitched.  The reservations for Restirants are non existent, they are always booked up and never available.  And there’s only one restaurant for food and the food sucked.  Got sick 3 day in.  STAY AWAY

reviews.author: Liz Rutter
reviews.text: The setting is beautiful but that's where it ends.  We are here for a wedding and the treatment we're receiving is incredibly poor. The concierge is a joke.  Tipped him as soon as we met have not heard from him once.  Since this is an all inclusive they're trying to make you as cheap as possible, they force you to eat at the truly disgusting buffet by saying there are no dinner reservations. Ever.  To get one dinner reservation at a restaurant I needed to l the BRIDE to schedule it,  unacceptable.  Blue Agave food was good,  drinks were not.  Room service is fine.  Gilberto at the pool bar is a delight. The rooms are tired, we have several more days here and if we game prepaid I would be looking for different accommodations for after the wedding.  We will not return.

reviews.author: cassie waggoner
reviews.text: Currently staying here -By far the worst experience for a vacation ever. The entire resort is under construction, no main pool, no shops, no casino. None of this was told when booking.3 restaurants closed including The main restaurant for the reserve area we booked, also closed. Not allowed to swim in beach( I realize this isn’t their fault) but there is nothing to do. Our concierge can’t even bring us ice or water for days. Wasted 4 grand to be woken up by hammering at 7am and sit at a pool and beg for ice. Will never return here,highly suggest booking anywhere else in PC

reviews.author: Maria Banks
reviews.text: I’m currently staying at this hotel and unfortunately this has been the worst experience I’ve had at a hotel. The thing is, there’s been a series of events that have made me feel impresioned instead of relaxed. From rude employees, rooms with smelly sheets, leaks in the hallways, lack of entertainment, and the epitome of it all was that they didn’t allow me to make a reservation for the restaurants and told me to deal with it. Yes I did try talking to management about this experience yet I’m still waiting for response. Definitely a NO go!!

reviews.author: Andrew Sargeant
reviews.text: If you are black or not white, I would not recommend staying at this five-star resort. Yes, the hotel looks appealing, but when it comes to customer service, the staff does not seem to prioritize assistance for anyone who is not white. While dining, I have noticed the staff going out of their way to cater to white guests who do not tip them, whereas black guests, despite tipping, have had to flag down staff just to get their attention. I have also observed that none of the white guests left tips, yet the staff continues to go above and beyond for them. This behavior is difficult to understand.

reviews.author: Alex Egelson
reviews.text: Food poisoning twice in four days - food was terrible.  Front desk and concierge employees were extremely unhelpful, dismissive and unprofessional, both with our family and other guests before / after us.  On the other hand, the bellhops and third-party tour employees were terrific and tried their best to help.  Location was beautiful and room was very clean and comfortable, but the food and front desk / concierge staff ruined the trip for us.

reviews.author: Adila Khan
reviews.text:
Why do they block the ocean view with a big TV?
First they messed up our booking. Then refused to accommodate. You pay top dollars to get an ocean front juinor suites with a balcony and they bolt a TV right in the middle of the room between the door to the balcony blocking the view! WHY? (See pic)
TV is also bad quality with poor picture.
The staff was nice and polite but that is about it. They will acknowledge the issue but never solve it. I wouldn't recommend this resort!
Blue Agave resturant 7/27/25 :we asked the front for strictly no pork. They reassured us, ok no pork. Ordered food and confirmed no pork. What is the first thing they served us. Cheese with pork! Server start collecting plates while we were eating. He did not understand even when we tried to explain that we are still eating.

reviews.author: Samantha
reviews.text: One of the worst travel experiences I’ve ever had. My family stayed at Paradisus Palma Real, and the resort completely failed to take guest safety or concerns seriously. Housekeeping stole my father’s wallet from our locked room, and management brushed it off, blaming us. Their response to my complaint was careless and full of errors. Persistent beach solicitors made it impossible to relax. This was our first trip to the Dominican Republic and definitely our last. I wouldn’t recommend to anyone ever!

reviews.author: eaviper
reviews.text:
I have to be honest, the food at this resort was not up to par. The buffet was disappointing and the upgraded restaurants were not much better. Making reservations was a hassle and the food quality just didn't meet expectations. One night at the steakhouse was enough for us to walk out.

Unfortunately, there wasn't much in terms of entertainment for the kids either. We were expecting more from an upgraded resort.

In my opinion, if you're looking for a great vacation spot, I would suggest looking elsewhere. This resort just didn't live up to its reputation. Check out the reviews on the Better Business Bureau website when they are trying to sell you the upgraded club membership. this resort has definitely cut back on their quality of Food.

reviews.author: Sidney Taylor
reviews.text: I stayed at the Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort on last week February 13 - 15. I was with two fluent Spanish speakers and was treated like an imbecile because I was not a fluent Spanish speaker. I didn't go on vacation to be a laughing stock for all of the workers. There was 0 hospitality for me at the resort, while others were treated with the utmost respect. During check-in, the concierge was connecting with my two friends who are fluent speakers and then I was asked was I too fluent and Dominican. Before I could answer for myself, the lady who checked us in scrunched her face and immediately said no. I am more than capable of speaking for myself and it was very unprofessional for the worker to treat me that way. I would never in a million years just someone for being who they are. I felt judged and ridiculed the entire time and it truly ruined my travel experience. My group paid for one of the highest services therefore I should have been treated with respect. I didn't even have a problem with the workers speaking Spanish and just allowing my friends to translate what I couldn't understand. There were some things I knew how to say in Spanish but didn't feel comfortable trying at all. I thought I would be continuously laughed at if I made a mistake. I never want to come back to this resort again!!! The workers should be ashamed of themselves for how they treated me. I spent money and time from work to enjoy myself, but I couldn't even do that. I couldn't even practice the spanish that I did know.

reviews.author: Don Vo
reviews.text:
FALSE 5/5 Ratings as there was a vendor night and you were to get all 8 stamps on this passport scavenger hunt in order to "win" a 2 night free stay. You locate staff members wearing white polos with red/blue stripes and they will stamp for you. Last one was to take a picture and post and give them 5/5 stars on google reviews. JAIRO took my phone and rated it 5/5 and asked us to put glowing reviews and add his name to it. I didn't do this as I thought it was a LIE and DECEIVING - no wonder google reviews has great reviews which again are BLATANT LIES. People are just doing it to try to win a prize!

Front Desk/Guest Services especially ALDO has an attitude, unfriendly and RUDE. This resort is DEAD so they are just lazy and didn't want to do their jobs.

Kids club is great - they are attentive and sweet with kids. Alexandra and other staff (forget name) were good with kids!

Food was ok - everything is the same every day. There was MOLD in bread and some of the food was cold (definitely leftover food). Some restaurants were closed as again the resort is DEAD. Staff was great especially JUAN. Always had a smile on his face and stopped by to talk when we saw each other.

Not alot of kid activities - more of an adult only resort. Kids were bored after a few days.

We had air conditioner issues due to room being warm and was set lowest to 69 degrees while other parties in our group's room were cold and could go way below 69. Was told several times from front desk that 69 degrees was the lowest or they will send someone up to fix it. NO ONE CAME AND WASN"T Fixed until we had to bicker and front desk told us they will fix thru computer??? If it was that easy to reboot thru computer, why couldn't they do it in the 1st place then give us all the trouble. Front desk seemed bothered with our request to fix the AC and they had such an attitude, rolling their eyes, unfriendly, rude. Again, they were NOT busy -just lack customer service and too lazy to do their job.

I DO NOT recommend this place. This is my honest review and not all the 5/5 ratings due to people trying to win a prize!

reviews.author: Carlos Jimenez
reviews.text:
This was probably the worst experience I’ve had at an all-inclusive. I’ve stayed at Melia hotels in Spain and Italy and always received amazing service and hospitality however this was not the case with their Punta Cana resort.

I booked an oceanfront suite that would lead us right into the beach for our anniversary. They put us in the wrong room, a junior suite instead of the regular suite. When I told our “VIP concierge” he said he would look into it and after I followed up with him twice he had no answer for me.

We couldn’t get reservations for any of the restaurants even though we had our “VIP concierge” since we booked at the reserve.

The service was horrible. I had to get up and get water for ourselves when we were seated at a table for over 30 minutes. Then on another occasion we had been sitting and no one brought us utensils and I had to take them from another empty table. The buffet was bland and the food looked like it had been sitting there for hours.

It is the absolute last time I will ever visit this resort or any of the Melia Punta Cana resorts. Horrible experience.

reviews.author: Abdulaziz Ozden
reviews.text:
A disappointing start to our honeymoon

We checked in today for our honeymoon stay. During the booking process, I clearly mentioned that this trip was for our honeymoon, and I even called the hotel to confirm. They told me that as long as we informed the front desk upon arrival, they would take care of everything.

However, the first thing we were met with at check-in was an aggressive attempt to upsell us to a more expensive room for $2,900 USD. When we declined, they kept lowering the price little by little, which felt pushy and insincere.

To be honest, this whole experience drained our energy from the very start. Instead of feeling welcomed and excited, we began our honeymoon with zero morale. Very disappointing treatment from a hotel we expected so much more from on such a special occasion.

Note: I truly hope you will be able to change this perception. I will sincerely update my review after I leave the hotel, based on the overall experience.

reviews.author: Zarif Hanif
reviews.text:
This island is truly beautiful, and the people are incredibly friendly. I wish I had only positive things to say, but unfortunately, our experience at the resort was quite challenging. We arrived around 5 PM on Tuesday to celebrate my niece’s birthday, choosing this location because it was advertised as a preferred Jet Blue luxury vacation.

Arrival and Room Issues
Upon arriving at 5 PM, it took us over an hour to check into our room in Building 4, Room 15, on the first floor. From the moment we walked in, the room smelled musty and moldy, and the air conditioning wasn’t working. The outside temperature was 79°F, but inside the room, it was an uncomfortable 85°F, making it hotter inside than outdoors.

After five hours of frustrating back-and-forth calls to the front desk, I finally went there in person. At around 10 PM, they agreed to move us to a different room, but by that time, my two children, ages 2 and 6, had been baking in the overheated, musty room for hours. We were relocated to Building 1, Room 15, where the AC worked, and it smelled much better. However, the room was missing basic amenities such as robes, toothpaste, and an iron. At that point, I was just relieved to have a functioning AC and let the other issues go.

Room Conditions
The rooms are equipped with twin beds, which are extremely small, similar to dorm room beds. There’s also a full-size pull-out bed, but it’s uncomfortable and springy. When we checked in, we were told that our room options were limited because we had children under 18, leaving us with no choice but to accept this room type.

Problems Encountered
No Hot Water: Hot water was a rare occurrence during our stay. For a resort marketed as a luxury destination, this was unacceptable.

Broken Bathroom Fixtures: The bathroom fixtures were poorly maintained. The faucet was loose and barely attached to the wall, which added to the frustration of dealing with an already malfunctioning room.

Odor: Our initial room had a strong musty odor that made it uncomfortable to stay in.

Unresponsive Front Desk: I requested several items from the front desk, including an iron, shampoo, body wash, and a robe. Although the shampoo and body wash were eventually provided, I never received the iron, forcing me to borrow one from a family member staying two buildings over.

Outdoor Bathtub and Cabana Issues: The outdoor bathtub, which lacked a proper cover, was filled with leaves and dirt, rendering it completely unusable. The outdoor garden cabana was in a similar condition, neglected and dirty, making it impossible to enjoy.

Staff and Language Barrier
Despite these issues, I must commend the housekeeping, waitstaff, and chefs. They were incredibly friendly, helpful, and did their best to accommodate us. However, there was a significant language barrier for English-speaking guests. While the staff was somewhat familiar with basic English phrases, many things were lost in translation. Although this is understandable, given that this is a Spanish-speaking island, it still posed some challenges for us. It’s not the staff’s fault, but it's something to be aware of when visiting.

Overall Experience
Overall, I love the island and the friendly people, but this resort is definitely not a well-maintained facility. Having traveled to multiple destinations and stayed at many resorts, I can confidently say that we will not be visiting this resort again, nor any resort managed by this holding group. It has not been a good experience. We still have a few more days here and will try to make the most of it, but that’s as far as it goes.

reviews.author: Raymond Sue
reviews.text:
Bittersweet Review

Beautiful weather . Beautiful resort.
Great place to be at if you’re coming from a colder country.
However, my overall experience was a let down.
Checked in first day. Missing 2nd balcony chair. Requested many, many times for additional chair as all units have 2 accessible for their stay. Staff followed up with a phone call but did not bring the second chair the whole visit.

Food was good. Buffet was tasty, and al la carte was entertaining. Housekeeping kept room tidy and replenished towels daily. Staff were friendly. Day time activities were fun and entertaining.

Beach vendors were an annoyance to our stay. Constant rude behaviour of trying to get our attention and wanting us to buy something or show us something to purchase. One of them threw a sandball at us because we did not respond.

Some of the Circle Club and Reserve resort staff were likewise an annoyance and disturbance to our stay within the hotel. Continuously trying to sell us packages/upgrades to our stay (circle membership, etc) and approaching us when we were just trying to relax and enjoy our vacation.

Health and safety hazards at the pool. Management needs to keep the pool safe to all guests by doing their due diligence in the maintenance of the tiles inside the pool.
Had a freak accident. Cut my right ankle inside the pool with a sharp broken tile.
First aid was provided by lifeguard, followed by standard paper work to fill out an accident report. Then was transferred to the medical clinic located inside the resort. The doctor was great and provided medical treatment. Was then told I need to go to the local private hospital to get 6 stitches.
I have medical travel insurance, but hotel opted to pay for all medical fees. However did not compensate the transportation fee of getting there and back.
Guest service staff was very sympathetic and tried his best to accommodate me for the remainder of my stay.

Hotel wanted me to sign a nondisclosure agreement about this accident, right as I was about to check out, which I thought was absolutely ridiculous.  Felt as if it was an intimidation tactic to sign or else you can’t leave. After bantering back and forth, I refused to sign the document as I do not feel comfortable signing anything without legal counsel present.

P.S: the pool was likely not closed or cleaned after I bled in it, and I’m sure the tile was not fixed either.

Enjoy your stay, folks.

reviews.author: Cale Carmichael
reviews.text: Do not come here. Just had the worst meal of my life after a series of very poor meals.  The food is just inedible.  That may sound like hyperbole but it is not.  I had a very fair review of this resort written before this experience.  The concierge was not helpful and lied to me several times about what just happened to me and my family.  I gave him several opportunities to make this right, but he refused.  Tried to escalate this, but was told I needed to wait.  This is not an option as we leave in the morning.  It is not possible to rate this resort lower, but they deserve it.  One of the biggest problems is no one is in charge.  A meal or 10 is bad, but no body cares.  Things go missing from your room, no body cares.  If you have 30 or 40 screaming 18 year olds, please come here.  They will love it, especially if you are paying for it.

reviews.author: Janelle Mejia
reviews.text:
I simply do not recommend this hotel.

I originally had a review praising the hotel because I was forced to upload something at the beginning of my experience. But after sitting down and analyzing the entire trip - I have to be completely honest:

First - the staff (you know who you are) lie to you about giving free services to you by forcing you to sit and listen to “Melia” membership presentation where they try to swindle you off $4-5k a year with a $300 monthly fee on a contract that last 5 YEARS. absolutely ridiculous. They falsely advertise that if you listen to it then you’ll either get free golf or spa/facial/massage session. My group of friends had to fight the front desk after sitting for an HOUR LONG PRESENTATION to then be told “you can’t book the golf session it’s too late”. It caused unnecessary stress for everyone. To then be forced to get up early the next day and fight for it again. I was also lied to about a massage. I told my “concierge” my availability and he said he would send a confirmation but never did. He proceeded to avoid the group and me on our last day. THANKS FOR WASTING MY TIME s.o.s.a.

Food - Mediocre at best. The only restaurant that was good was FLORA. Other than that the food at the buffet was cold and the “popular” Italian restaurant got FOUR of us sick. Unreal.

They have large pools and I did like one bartender there. He was very nice. But they have vendors trying to sell you something every 2 seconds. One optium vendor I specifically said “sorry we are leaving tomorrow” and he said “I hope so”. Extremely rude.

The beach was really dirty. They don’t clean it enough and you have vendors with parrots and iguanas coming at you all the time even if you say no to them. We couldn’t relax because they even yell at you when you’re sleeping.

They have one “night life” bar which was small and they repeated the same music. And they close pretty much everything by 10pm. The bar by the lobby stays open later but they don’t allow you to take your drinks to your room. Which is crazy.

⚠️ Casual Racism⚠️ it’s a bit disappointing when we are hit with colorism or stereotypes. I will not go into details but it is important to be mindful of all nationalities and races staying at the hotel. The staff should be trained on how to be hospitable to everyone and not make weird jokes or comments that come off wildly ignorant and offensive.

reviews.author: Zeke Trezevant
reviews.text:
Unfortunately, this was not the dream vacation I planned.  The resort is absolutely stunning.   The food was less than average.   My hot water was off for at least one of our four days there.  We asked the resort to arrange transportation to the airport, which accepted credit cards.  The driver they sent me had to stop at a gas station, and they charged my credit card.

Spoke to hotel management to no avail.

Don't think we will be back.  :(

reviews.author: Bonnie Mai
reviews.text:
*WARNING* This resort fell short of expectations in every regard - extremely disappointed with my stay. Will avoid Melia hotel chains altogether from now on.

1. The staff went through my belongings and stole $300. I had an envelope of cash that I needed to pay a tour operator and realized when I got to my next destination that I was missing money. I stayed in room 3316 and there was a security camera right outside my room - I doubt hotel management will open an investigation (given the lack of care throughout my stay, which I will describe later) but if they do, it would be quite straightforward to figure out. I welcome them to do so with no expectation that they actually will.
2. All inclusive resorts are meant to entice you with a variety of restaurant options. Paradisus only has one buffet open for breakfast and lunch, with the exact same  offerings each day. On their website, they claim that other restaurants are open for lunch, for example, but nope - that is misleading and your only option is, you guessed it, buffet.
3. The unprofessionalism of the staff was evident since the second I stepped foot into the resort. It's a really uncoordinated environment that results in negative guest experience. I waited close to two hours beyond when the front desk claimed the room would be ready. Then when I got to my room, I realized they gave me the wrong one. Several minutes later, I am undressing to change out of my plane clothes and a male staff barges in with the master key, without knocking, and claims to be stocking the mini fridge (it was already stocked). Throughout all the buffet meals, the staff only ever fills your small cup of water once and ignores you the rest of the meal. There is also no place to readily get drinking water throughout the resort - not providing water for guests in a place where you can't really drink the tap water is the perfect metaphor for how Paradisus treats its guests - they just want your money (in fact, they will be happy to steal some extra too) and couldn't care less about their guests.

reviews.author: Ralph Kassin
reviews.text:
Hi.
I brought my family to the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana on 1/15/25-1/23/25.  I brought 12 people with me and we had 4 suites
I have stayed at Melia resorts 8 times.
I have gone to Punta Cana 15 times.

Unfortunately, this was the worst vacation of my life.
From the minute I landed all we had were issues.
For example first day and second day no air conditioning.
No wifi for 6 days.
They broke into my safe and stole money.  They stole money from my sons wallet in his back pack.
My wife burned her arm in the buffet.  She spent 3 days in  the doctors office. Her arm got infected.
We could not get reservations in most of the restaurants.
I can go on and on.
Although problems can occur on vacation, it is how management addresses these issues is what is important.
Unfortunately, I met with management every day and nothing was done to help us or accommodate us.  I met with Lizandro (assistant manager) as well as Luisa ( manager). Neither did a thing for us.

I have flown over 4 million miles in my career. I am a million mile flyer on 3 different airlines, and have stayed at several hundred hotels worldwide.  I have never been treated by any hotel in the world this way.

I recommend you stay at any other location than this.

Best regards.
Ralph

reviews.author: Betsy Hernandez
reviews.text: First,  as a traveler to wait 3 hours for a room you reserved  is ridiculous, the food wasn’t that good , the laundry service was a nightmare, the shower in my room was clogged and every time I wanted to shower I had to call so they could turn the hot water on , just a horrible stay for the price paid it’s definitely NOT WORTH IT!! Go somewhere else!!!!

reviews.author: Glenn Brown
reviews.text: This place looks nice but good luck trying to find a place to eat. You cannot make dinner reservations until you arrive but when you get here the and try the registrants have no availability. All that’s left is the hot, horrible and stuffy buffet. There are better resort options on the island. We are considering ending our trip and going home early.

reviews.author: KA KTUS
reviews.text:
Don't book this hotel - you don't get any value for your money

especially, if you book an oceanfront room, because all the services surrounding it have been taken away from the Palma Real and are reserved either to Circle Members, the adults only or the Zel, so what you get is an old, run down room with limited sea view + smells and noises from the services/ bars you are not allowed to use!

We were staying in the Oceanfront Suite No. 9354 with my wife and teen aged daughter from December the 26th to January the 4th 2025. I booked the room through the hotels official website. Rooms were promoted with a seasonal discount of -30% and a free transfer for a stay for more than 4 nights, but we didn't get neither the discount nor did someone pick us up from the airport!

Originally I looked up the neighboring Zel a new brand Melia, but the Zel is very far away from the beach and does not provide the proximity to the sea we were looking for.

Of course we assumed, that an oceanfront suite in this proximity of the beach, which comes along with an exclusive price tag, would also include the essential services and infrastructure of the hotel right in front of it. Furthermore not one of the pictures on the hotels webpage, nor the google reviews or google maps did, not even the map they gave us when we checked in, did indicate something else - on the contrary the pictures of the pool bar have been photo-shopped so you can not see the plate indicating, that it serves only to members of the "circle".

Waiting for a transfer in vane, we got to the hotel late in the evening and had to realize only the very next morning trying to enter the beach bar in front of our room in order to have breakfast, that we were refrained from entering it, with the explanation, that they were only serving “socios”, as they called the members of "The Circle".

We learned that very moment, that we are not allowed to use  the facilities below our room and our daughter not allowed to use the pool we had a look at from our balcony, not any other close.

First I thought this surely must be some kind of very big misunderstanding, having talked to Luisa from Guest Services 12/27/24 I realized, that this was all part of an outright scandalous scam the management of the Melia is carrying out here!

Would we have known, that this was only the start of things we would have pulled out of this building renovation case immediately (pls. look @ pics), instead of spending 5 afternoons waiting for the maintenance team (the app did not help, tickets were ticked of as „solved“ immediately, but nobody came):

1. fridge did not work (had to throw away medicine)
2. safe  did not work
3. shower hose burst
4. drain of the hand-washbasin leaked
5. drain of the shower started leaking
6. TV's had no channels any more after we got a missing remote for our 2nd TV

When I mentioned all those issues to Luisa she told me, I quote “esta buscando pedos…”, that is you are looking for farts (= problems). She finished our conversation telling me in front of witnesses, that she would contact my embassy and get me kicked out of the country…!

So this is exactly the kind of reaction you would expect to be delivered by the guest service manager of a five star resort, isn't it?

I send an email complaining about this to her colleague Juan Pena and it took me two more of those and him more than four days to contact me.

They never offered us another room though, but an upgrade for our "next stay"...But there was a catch to this too: They tried to make me sign a NDA - stripping my of all my rights incl. indemnification - yeah that was the cherry on the cake (pls. see the scan..)!

As to New Years Eve, would you be surprised to hear that the F&B team actually blocked the access to the dinner buffet between 8 and 8.30 p.m. in order to "refill" the full buffet (see pics) that wasn't so lavish after the refill anymore 🤣needless to say, that they had their own party with the best bits of it a couple of days later…

Mano en el corazon turned here to:
Una mano en tu bolsillo y otra te tapa la boca...

reviews.author: P C
reviews.text:
We stayed at this location, October 23 to the 28th for a family wedding. Although the property is nice, the customer service and maintenance department are absolutely terrible. Our family wedding was Thursday the 24th and our section of the hotel lost power. One hour before the wedding . A lot of the ladies in the wedding party arrived late because they could not properly get ready. No power. Eventually power is restored around 5 PM as a result of the power loss. Conditioner also started to malfunction .
They reprogrammed the air conditioner and we thought OK. The next day we went on an excursion. Came back the AC was broken and our entire hotel room Water all over the floors due to the ac issue.  We went to front desk and asked for additional towels to be dropped off to our room while at dinner so We could mop up the floor and prevent Any issues from falling which the wet floor Produce.  When we got back from dinner there were no towels provided.The next morning, we went to the hotel front desk and asked To have our changed Due to broken AC and flooding. They told us to come back at 8:30 which We did, however Have any solution to offer us? We asked to speak to supervisor and they said they had already spoken to him And that he was working on it. The supervisor never came to greet us and show any empathy towards our issue. We were told to go back to our room pack our things within 10 They would take us to a new room.
We eventually got our room and hopeful, we can Day of vacation with family. I highly advise you to avoid this property their customer service and management. Are a joke.  The front desk staff on Saturday, October 27 Carlos and Nathaniel were completely incapable to provide any solution or empathy, additionally the supervisor on duty, Carlos, but we never met Should also be reprimanded For a terrible lack of customer service. Do not choose this location as you’ll be very disappointed by
The lack of quality service and value you’d receive.  zero stars To the individuals listed above, shame on you!

reviews.author: Victoria Elkin
reviews.text: This review is about the service we got as soon as we got to the hotel on the first day. We came with a toddler and were told we can’t get the guarantee upgrade we paid for because we had a toddler, got a room in the last building all the way at the end, on the second floor with no elevator. Then after arguing with the supervisor we got a different room at 8pm on the third floor with no elevator. You can’t do restaurant reservations even if you go to reserve as soon as you get to hotel because they keep telling you there is no seat available. The buffet stuff don’t clean the tables on time and we were looking for available clean table for long time every day for dinner or breakfast, even cleaned ourselves few times. Over all would never go again, this is definitely not a 5 star hotel , not a 5 star service ! The reception personnel were very rude and talked Spanish btw each other and I found understand they talk about us.

reviews.author: Jamie Pyron
reviews.text: We brought a conference with 200+ attendees here and it was challenging. The concierge service was not consistent for every attendee, there was a huge language  barrier with staff, our wristbands didn't work for our rooms on more than one occasion, it was very challenging  to reserve a restaurant on your own, the beach was uncomfortable with locals constantly hustling you for $$ with exotic animal pictures, excursions, jewelry, etc. Several attendees struggled with the balcony doors. If you close the balcony doors hard, they auto lock behind you. Four to five attendees were locked outside on their balconies and had to wave down staff to assist. Multiple attendees were double charged upon check-in, and have yet to receive a refund. Attendees complained constantly about the food, the menu never changed and the food was considered glorified cafeteria food. Melia app is unusable; it would be much better if it were redesigned to assist us without having to us staff for everything. When traveling, you don't want to have to interact with someone over everything. The biggest challenge was probably the language barrier. It was impossible to make it better with everything that went wrong because of the language barrier. The resort is absolutely beautiful, pools are amazing, nightly entertainment was great, but the challenges made the Beauty & food hard to enjoy.  Overall, I am consider myself highly dissatisfied.

reviews.author: Miguel Raya
reviews.text:
The resort was beautiful, massive and stunning. There was plenty of pools and beach options to relax in. What ruined the experience was the bad service,
harassment and food. We were being misdirected and told different things by the staff members when it came to making a reservation. We were told  at check in that all restaurants were available except the reserve restaurant. We came back later to talk to someone about making a reservation at the front desk. We were told only a few restaurants were available to us. If we “hooked up” this person, she would get us in the exclusive restaurants. This turned out to be bogus information for this individual to scam us for money. The resort will limit you to 1 reservation per day. In the meantime, you’re stuck eating atrocious food from their buffet, in room dining and bar section. Sometimes when you ordered a drink, it would be watered down. Expect to be harassed and bothered by their salesmen. I was insulted and harassed by Abraham because I declined to sit for 45 minutes to his presentation. What an unprofessional clown!  I came there to relax and be unbothered. The complete opposite occurred. No idea what he was selling me. Refused to provide any paperwork to verify any details. Others will walk by constantly trying to get you to say yes to their excursions. Along the beach, you’ll be bothered by street vendors. It is a beautiful resort that is severely flawed by the people who run the place.

reviews.author: Yuriy Podoshev
reviews.text:
Hotel has gorgeous grounds, beautiful lobby, beach and pool areas. It's generally well maintained outside. This is  where good things end.

Every night / morning there is strong smell of burning/smoke in the air. Apparently a known issue with garbage being burned in the nearby area since 2022. Google it. The more inland you room is the more you can smell it.

Housekeeping - we had to call numerous times within first 24 hours of arrival to replace damp and smelly pillows and to get our room cleaned. We were ignored. Even multiple escalations to the Guest Services didn't work, until we spoke to the most senior manager. Ended up sleeping on self-created pillows, made from our own clothing the first night.

Food - we didn't expect a gourmet experience, however we were mostly disappointed. We ate in most restaurants, Flora being on top of the list and Mexican pretty decent. Italian and Steak restaurants were mediocre. Lunch buffet was just ok. Breakfast was below average, as an example they only serve instant coffee. Food had nice presentation, but was mostly tasteless.

Restaurant reservation - don't waste your time with the "lunch box" reservation desk. Guest services are far more efficient and flexible.

Lastly, we booked our room directly with Melia. The representative booked our 14 year old child as a 12 yo and when I called back to point out the discrepancy, he assured me that it will not be a problem due to a "known system issue" and that the reservation is noted. Fast forward to our checkout from the resort - the hotel had demanded large sum of money, holding us hostage a few hours before our flight home.

reviews.author: Brent Swanson
reviews.text:
DO NOT BOOK AT THIS RESORT!
Areas where the resort failed to deliver basic standards of service:
Room Reservations:
•	Unable to confirm room bed, given twins not king
•	Long, unorganized, and delayed check-in process
Resort Layout & Infostructure:
•	Resort is challenging to navigate, little to no signage
•	Room door had gap against the door jamb when closed allowing bugs into our room
•	Air conditioning in the rooms was subpar with no humidity control
Food:
•	The main buffet was awful. The food was mediocre, it was very understaffed resulting in long lines and food stations running out of food
•	The fruit was mostly all unripe, tortilla chips were stale, cheese was sweating, and the pizza was undercooked to highlight a few
•	Food signage was unclear, missing, or mislabeled which made navigating with dietary restrictions very challenging.
•	The restaurants are only open for dinner! Tried to make a dinner reservation at 10:45AM and was told that every single restaurant was booked solid.
•	Limited snacks, sit down service only
•	My room service chicken quesadilla came with a hidden 2-inch-long chicken bone which was disgusting to bite into.
•	You are not able to order any food at the pools.
Bars & Beverages:
•	Adults only pool bar selection was incredibly limited and was bottom shelf package only.
•	The pool bar also closed at 6pm
Beach & Pool:
•	Hands down the most disgusting Caribbean beach I have ever visited. The water was brown and smelled worse than our beaches back home in NJ
•	No attempt to clean up the washed-up seaweed and it lined the water edge
•	The number of hecklers allowed to wander around the beach chairs is outrageous.
•	The pools closed at 7PM!
Customer Service:
•	This was the most unfriendly, unaccommodating, unhelpful staff I have ever encountered in all my years of traveling and working in the hospitality industry.
•	Calls for support from the hotel room often times resulted in calls going unanswered
•	I was shocked by the lack of English spoken and understood by the staff, most understood zero English.
•	The house keepers were not properly trained and entered room multiple times unannounced.
•	I physically went to the customer service desk at 11am, 1pm and 3pm to try to speak with the manager, Stephanie, and was dismissed each time. I still have not heard from anyone at the resort regarding my experience.
Avoid the Paradisus Palma Real and any other Melia resort while visiting the Dominican Republic.

reviews.author: David Villa
reviews.text:
Very nice resort but will not recommend coming here. Service is not what you’re hoping for in an all inclusive. Eduardo Pujols which is the supervisor wasn’t not helpful at all.

Big issues:

1. Bed room reservations aren’t guaranteed. So for our honeymoon we have to sleep in two separate full beds instead of the king bedroom suite we booked.

2. Our Suite Room comes with a personal concierge and it’s a scam. They don’t reach out to you and to use their service they request additional money for their services. If Fernando Ducoudray is assigned to you ask for a different person.

3. We submitted a complain because everything is driven by their app that doesn’t work. We can’t call them to order anything because the phone doesn’t work.

4. We have one of the most expensive rooms, and the essentials are not working. Phone to call out doesn’t work, lobby is far from the premium suites and you have to walk there every time you want something.

5. We requested to become members but it’s impossible to get one to show you around. Doesn’t make sense a resort not interested in making money.

6. The spa is impossible to make a reservation.

reviews.author: Celina Virjee
reviews.text:
We have been at Paradisus Palma Real for 3 days and are highly disappointed that we wasted our money and long awaited vacation on this resort. From the moment we arrived it has been disappointing and subpar. LThe biggest issues have been poor service and terrible quality food/food preparation and handling. Here is a list of specific examples from the last 72 hours:

1. As soon as we arrived, we were told they did not have our name listed on their guest reservation list. The individual who met us at the shuttle said we didn’t have a reservation and that we have come to the wrong place. As you can imagine, we were totally stressed and panic stricken as we scrambled to find our email confirmations for this expensive trip we had paid for. When we showed them our email confirmation they shrugged it off and took us to the check in counter where we were told the room would not be ready for half an hour. We were taken to the buffet to pass the time, but the food options were very limited. We saw another person with a plate of fries, we asked for the same thing for our toddler
and were sent from one staff person to the next only to be eventually told they didn’t have any. Yet we saw them with our own eyes. Then we were served raw burgers and I am pregnant - this is unsafe and unacceptable. This was the start of our food troubles. We took our time for an hour and then went back to the front desk and our room was still not ready. Highly frustrating with a baby.

2. We have yet to encounter any staff member who can clearly communicate in English. Most staff start speaking to us in Spanish and we are really struggling with communication. We have had room service orders that are wrong because of the language barrier, leaking fridge that was not repaired properly the first time with some communication challenges and very frustrating experience trying to ask for anything in the buffet. Also the servers in the buffet aggressively take away our full plates when we are still eating and frantically saying no we are not finished - this is wasteful and frustrating since it has happened at every meal. Tonight we were told we needed to go to the other side of the buffet since half of it was closing as not enough patrons. It was 8 PM. Tough to relocate with a hungry baby who is eating.

3. The food quality and preparation/handling is very poor. As mentioned above, we were served raw pink burgers. I am a physician and pregnant - this was very alarming to me as it does not meet basic food safety standards. The next morning we ordered omelettes, the eggs were completely raw inside and I had to take them back. There was a large amount of salt thrown into them and not mixed so the eggs were inedible. The bread and cereal are stale. The milk for our baby has been consistently warm ?sitting out. We called room service asking for chicken fingers, which is on the menu - we were told they don’t have any. We asked for fresh juice - they did not have any. At the coffee bar I have asked for 3 different types of smoothies written on the menu in the last 2 days - they first didn’t have chocolate then no banana then no mango. I’m not sure what they do have. The buffet food is always cold.

4. We have seen multiple cockroaches outside our room.

We have stayed at many resorts in the Caribbean and Mexico over the years and this has truly been our worst experience. I have never written a negative Google review but I am upset that our vacation has been a nightmare and we threw away so much money at this place. We initially had a reservation at Finest Punta Cana, which was recommended by multiple friends/colleagues. However we had a great experience at Paradisus Los Cabos two years ago so we thought we were making the right choice by switching to here. We were sorely mistaken. For families, I urge you not to spend your hard earned money and precious family time at this resort. It is a truly regrettable experience. I tried to reach out to Guest Services about our experience but the email bounced back and nobody seems to be able to help me speak with a manager.

reviews.author: Lizette Fernandez
