reviews.text: This is the worst resort I have ever visited, please do not be fooled this place looks nice but, looks are deceiving. I booked for 8 days and I REGRET it!!! This place is trash, garbage and, I honestly DO NOT RECOMMEND anyone to spend their money to come here. I booked for my family and myself, total of 4, and each of us feels the same. I am going to write in order. Almost every where you enter has a STRONG smell of scented aromas, if you’re an asthmatic ,suffer from migraines, or are aware that these scented aromas are hazardous and harmful, I felt so sick! Don’t even let me get started on the cigarettes and cigars that are allowed in every section of this resort, which is absolutely ridiculous! The food is horrible, in 2 separate occasions I found hair in my food and my son as well. The only soda they have here is Coca Cola and sprite, which tastes like they kept it in the sun for months before serving it, either it has no flavor or tastes like sugar. The very little activities they have did not do it for us. Bar’s… ginger bar is ok if no one smoking, kicks sports bar is so small, it’s crowded all the time because there is nothing else to do! So disappointed NEVER again. I am not writing all this for my health please believe me. THIS PLACE IS DEFINITELY NOT WORTH SPENDING YOUR MONEY!!!

reviews.author: AVA
reviews.text:
A total disappointment! I spent 6 days at the Paradisus Palma Real with my partner, everything was a disaster from the moment we arrived. During the check-in process they made a mistake with our room, after that it took them 2 hours to give us the correct one, and even then they did not have the details requested in the reservation for our special occasion.

These mistakes often happen in hotels, but what surprised us was that the hotel staff seemed neither to care nor to be surprised by the situation.

To every question we had about the hotel they told us that the butler would be in charge of informing us. What a surprise, the butler was of no use, he did not respond to messages in a reasonable time, nor did he solve our problems. Additionally, on two occasions he mentioned having booked our dinner, only to arrive at the restaurant and find out that it was not the case.

The hotel has a big problem with the service and communication between its departments, the hair dryer in our room did not work, we insisted three days in a row that they change it, in the end we gave up, the same thing happened with the bathrobes, they They took them and never replaced them.

The staff does not do their job well, no one serves you at the pool or beach, and they always have a bad face. As for the food and drink, a constant disappointment, the quality is really not up to par with a 5-star hotel. After all these events we decided to talk to the manager, it was of no use, the example of disorganization. In short, he would never recommend a stay at this hotel to anyone.

PS. Don't be fooled by the good reviews. Employees who serve you acceptably harass you to leave good reviews through a QR that leads you to create a review of the hotel. They insist that you mention their name, but the review is for the hotel. In short, they want to maintain the image that the hotel is a 5-star experience, while not making the adjustments required to significantly improve. Very unfortunate.

reviews.author: Jurabek Menglibaev
reviews.text: If you’re used to the level of customer service and attention to detail of Cancun, Mexico, do not even consider visiting this resort. It’s evident that most workers simply don’t care about your needs and will try to avoid any initial requests you may have by saying it’s impossible. The food at any restaurant is quite sub-par and the food is terribly under seasoned. No matter where you go in the resort there is an issue with the food. It’s always either terribly chewy, undercooked, or charred to a crisp. Food options are extremely limited, especially for kids who are often forced to consume nothing but terribly bland chicken nuggets that have been sitting under a heat lamp for hours. There are also security concerns with peddlers on the beach constantly harassing guests to buy parasailing tickets or go snorkeling. These people are not only very persistent and don’t let you rest, they also try to extort unknowing guests for money and in some cases steal belongings when nobody is around. Hotel staff and management lured me into a timeshare presentation with the promises of a “special lunch” as well as “room and service” upgrades. Upon listening to these people try to lock me into a contract for several decades and politely declining, they provided no services that were initially promised by just listening to their presentation. Essentially, I was robbed of several hours of my time. The grills at the buffet are questionably dirty just like everything else in the buffet. The food at the snack by the beach, the only place to eat lunch if you’re not a special circle member, has some of the least appetizing and dry food ever. For the thousands that were paid up-front, it was expected that the management would not block advertised foods and services behind several pay-walls and tier-based memberships. When complaining to management, I couldn’t even get to talk to someone for 3 hours. I wouldn’t ever consider returning here considering that the food, location, services, and overall resort are much better in Cancun for an even cheaper price! Even if you tip the workers, which I had done, the level of service or food doesn’t improve. Terrible experience, ruined vacation and such a waste of time and money!

reviews.author: Jessica Baumgartner
reviews.text:
The unlimited golf was anything but we had to still pay $200 for cart fee that they forgot to mention til we were there. Then the adult only section was overflowing with kids the entire time we in the pool area.
The food options were subpar. We stay at all inclusives every year. This was by far our worst experience.
We only went there since the golf option seemed like a nice perk for our vacation without our children. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: G5trance
reviews.text: This message is for the resort manager at Paradisus palma real ” JUAN CARLOS LLORET” . Your hotels buffett food was horrible, whether it was breakfast, lunch, or dinner. You had no fresh juices, all were artificial and tasted horrible.  Simple drinks like pina coladas did not taste well at all. I say this to highlight the all inclusive fee for food and drinks of $150 per person per night. I guess this is where you cut costs so you can turn a profit. It’s so sad though because it delivers a horrible experience to the customer. The cheese is always out and sweating, the fish is not stored in ice until ready to be cooked, burnt pancakes, loafs of bread are stale and not changed for days and all this is left out for waves of different weekly customers. Absolutely no quality control at this place. If you read this review, i’m doing you a huge financial and physical health favor, stay away….. you’ll be wishing you were back home immediately if you go to this place.

reviews.author: Anthony Malfitano
reviews.text:
I am here right now and I am so disappointed of the quality . I was here 2 years ago and it has totally went down hill.
Getting a reservation for dinner is impossible. Restaurant have changed  and they will not accommodate you no matter what. All the restaurants are catered to members and there is only a select few that a paying regular customer is allowed to go to. They have segregated sections for pool , beach and restaurants and if you’re not a member good luck using any of those  areas. Yesterday when we arrived we had lunch outside at a place called “the lunch box” . We were starving from a long day of traveling. A few items from the menu that we ordered were not available and the items that we did get were absolutely DISGUSTING . When I tell you the food looks like it was sitting out for hours and it was served cold . Hamburger , chicken and ribs were cold . They threw some sauce on them and served it to us . I would not recommend booking here. price is HIGH and service is very LOW.

reviews.author: Olsi Dajti
reviews.text:
This place is trash !! Worse food , worse service, the rooms are freaking filthy.

Roaches everywhere 🤮.

Management team sucked so bad!!

We were group of 17 people.

I’m not mad and that’s why I’m saying all this . This is really all true !!

I have more pictures that will just make you 🤮

reviews.author: Alexbabelife
reviews.text:
I’ve traveled at really nice inclusive resorts around the world, so maybe I’ve been too spoiled. I am writing this review without bias and truly based on my experience day 1 of my 5 (and I like never write 1 star reviews)

Upon check in (445pm) I was not really properly shown how to get around the resort. I wasn’t helped with how to login to wifi. I wasn’t told about when the restaurants open or how to make reservations.

My room was super hot. The AC was off, no big, I turned it on. The room has a gorgeous bath tub. Went to run myself a relaxing bath, there’s no hot water. Went to order room service, the phone doesn’t work. Someone came by asking if I needed towels and I told her about the room phone issue. She said she was calling her supervisor. It’s been 4.5 hours and he never came to check on the phone.

I was super hungry and tried to walk to a buffet because none of the restaurants opened till 6, no one who worked here seemed really interested in helping me locate the right spot. I went ahead and made a reservation at the sushi restaurant and sat around 20 minutes to wait until the restaurant opened, no big. But as I sat there, one employee busted out laughing and speaking super loud across the room to 2 other employees and finally one of them hushed her like tone it down. Once sat at my table, I was met by a waiter who poured my water and answered my questions about the menu, but he seemed to not really be sure of the answer. And later, another server came over without an introduction and stood over his shoulder criticizing his use of the iPad without introducing herself or explaining why she was there (and the whole interaction occurred in Spanish, so although I should def understand Spanish while visiting in the DR, I don’t speak the language). There just seems to be a lot of fraternizing around the resort amongst employees. Food was meh.

Came back to my room hoping to order room service bc I was still hungry from the unappetizing meal. The phone room still isn’t working. The qr code and online site won’t allow me to sign in with my last name, room #, and check out date to order room service. I walked (long walk) all the way to the front desk to ask for help with the site and my phone. They said someone would come check my room phone. It’s been an hour since he said someone would come.

After 4.5 hours of attempting to eat at this resort, there seems to be no way to order room service no matter who I’ve asked. There seems to be no buffet despite who I’ve asked. There’s nowhere to get food quickly without a sit down restaurant and I was so unhappy with the lack of experience at the sushi restaurant that I’m scared to try another.

Call me hangry. But I’m pretty calm and just thinking this day 1 experience, SUCKS. So far, 0/10 would not recommend

reviews.author: Mrudula P
reviews.text: First of all the staff were great and the location was perfect too. That is all that is going for this place. The rooms are bad, smelly and outdated. First thing you see when entering to your qaurters is the garbage. We booked a luxury suite and when we got there , the front desk said that they didn't have any available. So we had to be downgraded to a normal room. It was just not us, many families were having the same argument/discussion there. The hotel was definitely not well prepared for their bookings. Breakfast was decent and that's it. Lunch is passable. Except for the Italian restaurant all the others can be avoided. This was the first time I had a bad experience while booking my vacation from Costco. We always look at Costco travel first since I trust them . Going forward, I plan to be cautious and careful.

reviews.author: Holly Romey
reviews.text: The food is inedible. 6 people in our group got food poisoning. This place is just a pretty picture. Our room keys didn’t work. Service was rude unless they wanted a review. People on beach are pushy. Oh, and be careful not to get locked out on your balcony.

reviews.author: Tone Banks
reviews.text: My wife and I spent 7 days at the resort. Our room was very spacious and the service & hospitality was exceptional. However, we were extremely dissatisfied with the food for this all inclusive resort. For some reason all the food was cold from the buffet. The food from the some of the restaurants were served lukewarm as if it had been prepared well in advance. Some food tasted old or freezer burnt. That definitely put a damper on our stay.

reviews.author: Shana Witter
reviews.text:
Family of 3 have been at Paradisus Palma Real for 3 days and are highly disappointed that we wasted our money.

The biggest issues have been poor service with the exception of jordania who was great.

We checked in and went to dinner, when we returned we noticed that money was stolen from our rooms!

One of the staff members even hid my sisters jewelry under the rug to retrieve at a later time.

When i brought our concerns to their attention. It appeared as if a thorough investigation would take place.

They said it would take 24 to 48 hours to investigate. Our attempts to escalate matters and seek resolution from the management team, were pointless.

The lack of accountability and urgency were dissapointing to say the least. Paradisus Palma Real let us down.

Beautiful resort but this terrible experience made us never want to visit Punta Cana ever again.

reviews.author: MARIA IGNACIA VIVEROS RUEDA
reviews.text: We stayed for a week at this hotel, and it was a horrible experience, the worst we’ve ever had at an “all inclusive” hotel, and we’ve been at least in 5-6 different Caribbean places. There was a convention that lasted 4 days, and they didn’t notify us in advance. They changed our room from deluxe to classic, the buffets were closed -without previous notice- almost every day at dinner (our baby has food allergies, one of the reasons for us to go “all inclusive”), service was rude and concerned only about the event assistants, with little exceptions. We don’t recommend this place, there’s no balance between the price they charge and the quality of rooms and service, they gave us terrible moments instead of relaxing vacations.

reviews.author: Athan
reviews.text: Regrettably, my stay at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa was overshadowed by communication challenges with the staff, who struggled to comprehend English. The disturbing presence of roaches in both my initial and replacement rooms raised serious hygiene concerns. Furthermore, the disappointment extended to the limited evening food options, as the main buffets consistently closed early. Overall, this experience fell well below expectations, and I cannot in good conscience recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Angela
reviews.text: Terrible hotel with bought reviews! Some of the rooms my family stayed in had a whole ceiling of black mold which was huge, the AC was bugged and the room smelled terrible! The service also terrible, barely any staff speak English, only their language, barely any bilingual! The location is alright, beach was severely murky this time. Nothing for kids to do, except the basic swimming pools. Definitely if you travel with family go to a different place.

reviews.author: Lexus Delivery
reviews.text:
A ""3 Star""  Hotel at best some equipment dont work  a Blender at the Beach Bar did not work he had to go and borrow one form the restaurant which then left the restaurant with no blender in this back and fourth about the blender was going on for the whole week we were there. Why not just buy another blender,
THE HOTEL FRONT DESK OPENNED MY ROOM DOOR AT 11pm
saying he made a mistake ufff !!!!!!!!
Most Staff member were very nice But the Hotel lacks Professionalism  its definitely Not a 5 Star Hotel
I stayed at a Ocen Front Suite which entitles you to many extra amenities such as a butler, a VIP Restaurant and no one told us until 4 days into our stay.
Miss Communication at best my wife and I travel the worl and we are never staying in a Melia Hotel Ever Again
HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE AND WE STAYED IN A SUITE I CANT IMAGINE THE REST !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Jade Pinckney
reviews.text: Very horrible experience!!! Along with the 12 other people I checked in with. Expedia gave me $100 off my spa appointment at the hotel. The hotel made the appointment and confirmed the discount for me, only to charge me full price even with the paperwork in hand! They threatened to make me miss my flight if I didn’t pay full price which I did not sign for. Never got an upgrade or free gift with the price I paid. My door was broken and I had to wait a whole day to get a new room(I was ignored from multiple phone calls) I never received my free wine and gift WHICH WAS ALSO PROMISED IN MY PAPERWORK! complained about it the second day and they said it would be done and never did it. The food service was poor and we could not eat at any other restaurant because the reservations were booked up to two days!!! DO NOT STAY HERE!! Everytime I went up to the front desk for issues a customer was yelling at the staff very unhappy. Currently I am fighting for my money back from this horrible unsafe experience. I REPEAT DO NOT STAY HERE THIS PLACE IS A JOKE!!

reviews.author: Katherine Brown
reviews.text:
I wish zero stars was an option.

Stayed March of 2024. Absolutely horrible. You couldn't pay us to stay there again.

The food was terrible. Restaurants didn't have any reservations earlier than 9pm. The resort was dirty. Our first room's bathtub didn't work. Then when we moved to a second room they didn't turn the a/c on for 24 hours. We slept all night sweating in 90 degree weather with no a/c. Staff pretended to not speak english when convenient so there was literally no one to talk to to help with the issues above.

Ready for the worst part? It was our honeymoon.

RUN. Stay anywhere else and save yourself from a horrible location.

reviews.author: Elana Same
reviews.text: stayed for 7 days and got a round trip from the airport to the resort and back to the airport, they never picked us up from the airport and we had to pay someone else to take us to the resort and we lost a lot of money and when we asked for a refund, they never gave it to us. Now it’s the end of our stay and we are trying to get a taxi to the airport and they aren’t giving it to us, plus there is nobody to talk to, everyone is “unavailable”.

reviews.author: Badger Taylor
reviews.text: Very disappointed in the quality of food and service offered for dining. The only options for breakfast and lunch are the buffet. At check in there were no openings for dinner reservations the entire stay. Often we would either have to pad pockets/tip to get a 930pm dinner reservation or just eat a the buffet. It’s supposed to be an all inclusive, but nothing is included and there is no service unless you want to HEAVILY tip everyone for water refills or just bring you’re own drinks from the room. The tub in the room wouldn’t hold water. We called for maintenance on day one, we wound up taking the stopper out as it was cross threaded to put it on correctly. They came our last day to check the tub. This was a constant struggle and fight to have anything organized or scheduled. I can’t wait to get home and relax.

reviews.author: Access Scanning Document Services, LLC
reviews.text: Services is good and food ok. Senrowny Sosa from customer service promised me a 1 certificate of stay for attending a meeting regarding Melia memebership. He completely ignored and did not want to send the certificate for unknown reasons that he did not mention. Do not go to this meetings if offered to you.

reviews.author: Andrew Reynolds
reviews.text:
We had been to this resort years ago and really enjoyed our stay. We decided to come back and were ultimately disappointed. We had the regular package, not the exclusive club. Only writing this review because this should not be considered a 5 star hotel or have a 4.5 star ratings.

Pros:
Full bar, great bartenders. Absolutely no complaints here
Beach - very nice beach, great weather. Unfortunately, if you aren't in the exclusive club seating is limited. Exclusive club seating was widely empty most of our trip as well.

Cons:
Service - service was shockingly poor. Our room was bug filled, we called to complain and they sent us bug spray that was some knockoff that didn't even work. In order to sleep without getting eating alive with mosquitos, we had to go and buy Deep words spray.
Food - the food was terrible. We have been to all-inclusive places before so our standards were not set high. We get the drill. That being said, the lunch was absolutely inedible. The last two days we ate bread. The dinners were better, however they don't give you access to the best places. We decided to pay for one of them the final night and my girlfriend got food poisoning; not great.

Recap : Overall, we had a decent time. I would not recommend or ever come back, they treat you terribly and make no attempt to fulfill even basic hotel requirements. A huge letdown from what this place used to be.

reviews.author: Tom Tobin
reviews.text:
Our holiday experience has in my opinion been very misleading and disappointing.

I have 2 kids age 2 and 3 and the number one thing that I search for is kids facilities so when I came across this hotel I was happy there was sufficient facilities for my kids to be entertained. Pool and play area etc which is displayed on the photos only to find on arrival there was absolutely zero - I would not have booked this hotel if I knew there was nothing

Upon arrival I found the staff to be very abrupt there was a series of events we were not on their system as being
Booked - we got put in a room with one bed - there is 4 of us - I quickly highlighted that we booked a room with 2 beds so my 3 year old had somewhere to sleep -
So they moved us to a different room but wasn’t as nice as the one we had pre booked online - so we upgraded to a
Suite which was costly but we really wanted to have a nice suitable room for our family . Disappointed we had to pay more that same night it took the staff 8 hours to bring me a crib for my baby who was inconsolable from being
So tired - 2am they brought it - also there was people who could access our room it was clear
They had put us in someone else’s room
As there were people just walking in our room

The other issue was the food - we was so poorly I was vomiting and my partner had severe diarrhoea- the buffet area in the first few days had air con which was dripping from
The ceiling vents into the food on display.

The next few days I noticed the air con had been turned off most likely because of
The dripping but this meant that the whole buffet area was wet and food warm and condensated it really was vile and I’m certain this was the reason for the illness .The so called al la carte restaurants on site wasn’t upto much either the food served was vile served by rude and ignorant staff

Unfortunately by day 5 we just could not imagine spending the remainder of our holiday at this hotel so we spent a further £2,500 just to enjoy the rest of our holiday at another hotel

reviews.author: Maren Mikhail
reviews.text: This is by far the worst resort I have been on! We are a family of 3 with an infant. First of all we had to wait till 5 pm for the room to get cleaned! With an infant it was very inconvenient because I would have to wait out in the sun till the room was cleaned for me to bathe my child. Second we gave a lot of tips out to the employee to get us water for the baby and we would wait hours and hours for them to get us the water. In order to make restaurant reservations it was a hassle always booked and they make you eat at the buffet. There’s no good hygiene the chef cooking eggs or making grill have no gloves on and would empty the cheese bare hand with nails dirty it was disgusting and it was repeated multiple of times by different employees. Every time you ask for a food as simple as cheese they say we don’t have anymore even though it would still be early in the day. They claim that you have a concierge that will do all the reservations and anything that was needed! Our concierge Deysi was absolutely the worst to deal with she would see us down the hall and turns her head away. We would ask her to make reservations for the restaurant she always has an excuse why she couldn’t do the reservation. THERES ABSOLUTELY NO NIGHT LIFE THERES NOTHING TO DO AT NIGHT! Very disappointed with this resort especially I paid a lot to be here and had higher expectations than this!!

reviews.author: Chen Noah
reviews.text:
I stayed in many all inclusive resort all over Mexico and the Caribbean, this is by far the worst one I stayed in.
Inside the building where all the regular rooms are there is a night club that is open until 2am. The music is so loud, no one can sleep in the noise.
If you want to upgrade to stay at a quieter building you need to be the Reserve which is adult only or The Reserve family section which is over 10 minutes walk from the beach with no view at all.
After many complaints they promised to reduce the music a little which helped, but every night we had the same problem again and again.
This hotel is very run down.
Food is average minus. The only good thing is the service, still cant compare the service to any of the Mexico resorts I have been to.

reviews.author: Kevin Larrison
reviews.text: Buffet is awful.    Dinner restaurants are half full but there’s supposedly no reservations available.    Room was nice and the ladies that cleaned our room were wonderful.   Minibar guy came some days but  never on the days when we were out of something.   AC unit broke one day. 80 degrees in the room.   First guy came to fix,  put the thermostat in bypass and said he fixed.    Still blowing hot air, so second guy came.    We left for dinner reservations.   Came back 4 hr later.  Room was still 80.    Called front desk 3 times.    Guy comes 30 mins later and tried the same trick.   I proclaimed the air blowing out of the supply is hot.    He left and said he would be back in 5 mins.    Additional call to the front desk and nothing.    No one came back.   So slept in my room with it being 80 degrees.   We were there with a very large corporate group.   Im totally surprised they picked this place.   Bar tenders were a mixed bag.  Literally some couldn’t make a vodka,sprite with a lime.   Heck some bars acted like they never heard of lime and insisted that a lemon was same thing..   I will say that the dinner restaurants were pretty decent, and our waiters George and Rosanna were absolutely amazing.  Lennison was our bellman and he was a shining star as well.   With the cost of this place I would highly encourage you to go to a newer and nicer resort.

reviews.author: James Cook
reviews.text:
Thought I was staying at the Palma Real but room was moved to the garden inn which used to be the reserve. 90 minutes to check in and the place smells like a damp basement with the room being worse.  No towels, soap and mini fridge not stocked in the room. Toilet broken and tonight there is no running water in the room.  Dishes still here from two days ago, beds not made and floor unswept for two days.  Food is not good.  I never write bad reviews but I need to warn people because of how much this resort charges.  The garden inn property is a 2.5 star resort on its best day.  Don’t be looking for a beach either, you have to take a golf cart to the nice resort to see it

Thank you for the canned reply.  Unfortunately the stay got worse.  Last night topped it off when I went to bed and noticed blood stains on my pillow that had been changed with linens while we were out.  The absolute most disgusting thing I have ever experienced at a resort.  You should all be ashamed and embarrassed

reviews.author: Kat P
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus this week for six days five nights. The resort is very beautiful and great nightly entertainment and that’s about it. The service here was TERRIBLE. The worst customer service we have experience on any island or country we have ever traveled to. To begin our room was not ready for check in and we waited two hours. we were told if we upgrade to the reserve we will get better amenities personal butler private beach and high end drinks. We upgraded. What a joke. First off our butler Mack was supposed to meet us when we check in which we waited for him during our 2+ hour check in and he was a no show. We then were told he’d meet us where we eat. Never showed. Two days later he decides to grace us with his presence. He was asked one thing to book our reservations every night at a different place around 8/830 which ever was available. He said this is not a problem. Ok great. Except every single night every single restaurant there was an issue with our reservation that he didn’t book or he booked them two hours earlier or an hour later. One night the hostess even yelled at us and we called him and they argued back and forth on phone. Anyway we let it go. Every meal at the reserve or any dinner restaurant is a 30 minute to one hour wait to get in and then you wait for food for 1-2 hours. I have never experienced this on a trip in my life. And if you tried to speak to anyone for help NO ONE SPOKE ENGLISH. We used our translator apps and even then no one seemed to understand anything. We are vegetarians we would simply
Ask for meat to be removed from our orders without fail every time the meal came with meat even though every time they say they understand no meat. Several times they had to take meals back bc they put meat in it. Next you try to relax on beach but how can you when fifty times a day people are trying to sell you excursions or cigars or whatever. They are relentless you say no thank you they don’t leave you say maybe next time they try harder. Then we said ok well book speed boats. We spoke to one guy he offered us one price we wrote it down showed it to him he agreed. We show up at 2 pm and he tells us a price $60 more. We show him that is not the price we agreed on he said no. Ok so we said forget it as we walked away another guy tried to sell us same excursion except for the original price we agreed with the other guy. The first guy comes running and screaming and fighting with him. It was so uncomfortable and strange. The first guy ended up taking the deal for the original price he offfered. Literally the most inconvenient and useless waste of time. The excursion by the way promises boat ride to “natural pool, dolphin sightings, and snorkeling.l with starfish turtles and fish.” Literally sent to another side of beach blocked by fifty party boats loud as hell and we are hounded to buy drinks. Ok we do. Then we’re told come on we need to see dolphins we go and it’s literally caged in area in ocean run by Aquarium where our driver whistles for the dolphins to come to the fence which they never did and then he says oh well they’re not coming and says well leave. And we do. Then he stops the boat in middle of random area in ocean and when ask what happens now and we’re told we have to snorkel he throws some bread a few small white fish come sand thats it time to leave. What a joke. Then next day we’re hounded to book buggie excursion we said we weren’t interested because we didn’t want to waste the whole day we were told oh no it’s only three hours total very quick. Ok we book it they tell us meet on the beach and someone will pick you up. We walked one mile across beach to find this so called truck which was a dumpster with seats no air conditioning and multiple people
Crammed in to dry 50 min at 35 miles and hour. We get there and once again all they do is hound you to buy things before we even get into center. We asked to do a private tour.  We then are told we’ll visit natural cave the beach and come back. Instead the driver stopped us at every shop. The trip ended up being 5 hours long.

reviews.author: Amanda Fabiano
reviews.text:
If I could assign zero stars to this resort, I definitely would. Despite being a loyal visitor for many years, my recent experience has convinced me never to return. Traveling with a group of 13 people, I made multiple attempts to ensure our rooms were suitable, reaching out to the resort beforehand. Unfortunately, they were unhelpful and upon arrival, our rooms were not as requested.

Upon checking in, I was informed that my room, although an hour past the designated check-in time, was still not ready. The check-in staff displayed a shocking lack of courtesy.

The overall service was abysmal. Requesting basic amenities like water for the room required multiple calls, and the response was often that they wouldn't deliver until 9 AM. Dinner reservations were a nightmare, involving early morning waits only to be told there was no availability until 9:30 PM. Safety concerns at brunch included a lackadaisical approach, such as the grill person using the same tongs for raw chicken and then handling other food items. The food quality was subpar, and requests for simple items like tea at breakfast were denied. It seemed that "no" was the default answer for any reasonable request.

When inquiring about the noticeable decline in service, the resort attributed it to COVID, but I suspect it's more related to ongoing renovations and cutbacks on amenities.

During checkout, our group decided to leave a day early. However, the resort insisted on having me sign a document claiming my departure was for personal reasons, unrelated to their service. This tactic, along with literally stopping my Uber on the way out, exemplifies the resort's greed and commercialization.

Regrettably, what was once a great resort has fallen victim to profit-driven decisions. My advice: steer clear of this place.

reviews.author: Leo Lisen Bai
reviews.text:
Avoid this resort at all cost, whether travelling as a couple, or as a family with a 13-month old (us), especially when you don't speak any Spanish!
1. Services requests of all kinds made in English, although repeated frequently, were not understood by the vast majority of resort staff, 90% of the time. Communications of any kinds were a MAJOR pain
2. Room keys frequently failed and we were locked out multiple times and had to get keys revalidated. Front desk staff were not even apologetic about this.
3. No concierge attended to our needs, we didn't even get one when we checked in
4. Quality of food was downright abysmal, if you get any at all. We were often left waiting 2+ hours at different dinner restaurants wondering where our orders have gone
5. Wifi in our room didn't work till the VERY last day of our 7-night stay
6. Downright FALSE info was frequently given out (such as opening hours of a theme park), again probably due to communication gap noted above. All we got was a simple "sorry" while we wasted hours with an infant in tow
7. Half the resort was under renovations and nothing was mentioned when we made the booking

The only shining spot was the staff at Kidsdom. They were fantastic and took great care of our baby when we needed their help. However, their great help isn't enough to make up for everything else that fell WAY short at this resort.

Leo

reviews.author: Tiffany Lundt
reviews.text:
I strongly discourage anyone from considering a stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Our experience at this resort was a complete nightmare, characterized by a shocking lack of customer service, accountability, and follow-through. Our family, a group of 9, embarked on an 11-hour journey to reach Punta Cana, eagerly anticipating our first-ever visit to this beautiful destination. We chose Paradisus Palma Real, believing it would live up to the exceptional standards set by its sister hotels, Paradisus Cancun and Paradisus Playa Del Carmen, which had provided us with memorable experiences during our previous trips (only a 4-hour flight away). Unfortunately, our decision to stay at Paradisus Palma Real turned out to be a grave mistake, and our vacation plans were negatively impacted in every way imaginable.
We had high hopes for our vacation, having purchased rooms through our Circle Melia Program and upgrading to what was promised to be an enhanced service and concierge experience. However, our dreams of a relaxing getaway were crushed as we spent our entire vacation battling with the hotel.
We had upgraded for benefits such as concierge
Services, tickets to the Katmandu Theme Park, dinner reservations, and a catamaran excursion that was included in our package. To our dismay, none of these promises were fulfilled. Instead, we found ourselves endlessly ping-ponging between different hotel staff throughout our 7-night/8-day stay.

From the moment we arrived, the confusion and disappointment began. Despite being promised a concierge service as part of our upgraded package, we were left in a state of bewilderment regarding who our concierge was supposed to be. When we finally managed to identify them as Lewis and Mack, their unhelpfulness was astounding. We ended up having to make most of our reservations ourselves, defeating the purpose of paying for an upgraded service.

Our attempts to escalate matters and seek resolution from the management team, which included individuals named Katerine, Danielle, and Yohanery, were equally fruitless. These individuals demonstrated an astonishing lack of accountability and a disheartening lack of urgency. They moved at a snail's pace, taking the entire week to address our concerns, only to provide vague and unapologetic responses. It was a deeply frustrating and disappointing experience throughout our entire 7-night/8-day stay.

If you value your time, money, and sanity, I urge you to steer clear of Paradisus Palma Real. This resort's woeful incompetence, lack of customer service, and inability to fulfill promises have left us with an unforgettable, but for all the wrong reasons, vacation experience. Save yourself the disappointment and find a more reputable and customer-centric destination for your next getaway.

reviews.author: Serdar Badem
reviews.text:
I'd like to start by expressing my frustration with these "fake reviews" on google maps. I am deeply concerned about Melia management's involvement in these fake reviews.

Property is old, dated, not very well maintained.
Checkin experience sucks,
Feels like a used car dealership where you are seated to get your room keys etc. - it took me 2 hours dues to various reasons(multiple reservations etc)
Front desk staff is unfriendly they are like an angry mob.

Most of the staff does not speak English
Service quality is horrible. There are some good people but overall, it lacks.

Food is horrible
Worst part is the food, the buffet. and the service. They were not able to handle the crowd during the high season.
Food is terrible. They way food is handled is bad, covid rules are not enforced.
I puked the sushi after the first bite. I cant explain how terrible it tasted.

Covid & food safety lacks
The staff serving food and handling money at the same time.

Key cards dont work
Bracelets with the key cards dont work very well, we had to go back to the lobby multiple times to get it all working.

Entertainment is good
There seems to be a lot of effort that goes into organizing various events every day

Room cleaning was OK

Overall this property and the room we stayed with this terrible level of service is not worth the $825 i paid per day. All inclusive does not work. Our first and last time in this property.

reviews.author: Jocelyne Morales
reviews.text: Not what I expected. Food was bad quality, at the buffet the food was always cold, the same food everyday recycled it was HORRIBLE. Flys all over the fruit, & the food at the restaurants were just as bad. There’s a huge lack in activities, the music at the pools were so low and half the time it wasn’t playing. The swim up bar was closed. The rooms were okay but the cleaning service was terrible. My bed was only made and new towels would be placed on the tub. Besides that, nothing in the room was cleaned all the trash stayed there the room would still be a mess. If I knew the hotel was going to be this bad I would have stayed somewhere else. You get what you pay for.

reviews.author: Ismael Triana
reviews.text: I wanna say that the worst 2 people in the world work at this hotel. We were having fun in one Off the restaurant the people in side were dancing with us and having fun but some guys named eddy and Santiago told us to take off are music just because it bothered them and they work here. I thought the Clint was the one to have fun not management. Worst place ever I’ve been coming here for 7 years and this is the first time I ever complaint never coming back and this year I brought my family of 25 with me wow if I could leave a lower reviver on these 2 I would the said they don’t care about the client.

reviews.author: Manny Rodo
reviews.text: We attempted to have dinner in the Italian restaurant.Waited 1 hr for our starters that only came for 3 of 5 people. then we got the order of the table 3 away.  The meatballs were raw meat, tortini was cold. This won't end here. The trip advisor review will be precise. With every detail about the disappointing food at this resort. I felt sorry for the manager having to deal with the incompetent chef.

reviews.author: JD William
reviews.text: We were part of the large group who takes yearly trips. This was by far the worse resort for service and food we have ever stayed at.  The grounds and building are beautiful, but what isn’t is the attitude and service we received. We could not get into any restaurants without tipping someone heavily - they kept saying everything is booked and it was a mess.  The buffet where they force you to eat is a poorly run school cafeteria. People taking your seats, people not using tongs, general lack of organization, we got our own water.  We had constant issues with our door and bath tub. Nobody ever came or seemed to care when we complained.  Our food experience was  horrible, ribeye at Rare was tough and sushi was all premade and blah.  After 5 nights we are at airport eating at Wendy’s and glad to be flying home. Totally a waste of money and easily could be avoided with better hotel management and restaurant management and someone to train employees how to be helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: J Marie
reviews.text:
Many issues with this resort. As an avid traveler and one that will pay good money for a positive experience, this was not a ‘you get what you pay for’ experience.

We won this trip though work and without knowing much, we assumed we would have an okay experience. We then upgraded our room and we are regretting it 100%. The room upgrade is not worth it at this resort. Do not do it.  The rooms are beyond filthy. There’s drainage issues in the sink and in the shower. Everything in the room looks clean but is filthy from the countertops to the floors. They never stocked our mini fridge with water - which is supposed to be included. The bed linens were questionable. They definitely have a detergent build up and between the towels and the sheets nothing ever seemed ‘dry’. It was 6 days of musty.

If you upgrade to the reserve, which we did, online it guaranteed things like a butler and turndown service. None of these things were included. The only exclusive thing there was a restaurant - which was low quality too. They boast that you can get premium drinks as well and they even display premium bottles at the bar but we were told we can only have their well drinks. There was no exclusivity realized at any of the bars.

The alcohol is severely watered down here. I never drink straight tequila but here I was able to as it was quite watered down.

The food is absolutely abhorrent. Any chicken dish had tons of bones in it. Almost every offering had more of a ‘mystery meat’ vibe to it. All of the food at the restaurants were sub par. Nothing was exceptional. They’re serving really low quality stuff.

Please tell me why everything is shut down between 11am-1pm. You cannot be served any food between then unless you get a hamburger or hotdog on the beach which tastes like briquets.

There is no entertainment whatsoever. It’s a very boring place.

I’ve stayed at many all inclusive and this was a 3/10. Only giving a 3 because the beach was pretty nice. This experience makes me never want to come back to the Dominican period.

reviews.author: Aida Selmi
reviews.text:
If i can give this hotel 0 star i would
This is the worst resort i have ever been
When we came in to our suite which we paid a lot of money to get a beach view we found drops of pee on the seat toilet and the room was dirty
It was human hair everywhere even in the coffee cups and the sheets which is unacceptable
We asked someone to come and clean it so they did
The first night my husband took a bath in the tub and the water wasn’t draining by the time he finished all the room was full of water from the tub leakage so we had to clean it ourselves because it was too late and ready to go to sleep we didnt wanted to be bothered by a housekeeping cleaning at midnight
And the worst part is the noise of the Ac .. it was so loud to a point my baby couldn’t sleep either
We had the worst night ever.. my husband and I woke up with a bad headache from it
In the morning we made complain and they said they will try to find us another room with a view
And then they said they didn’t have available but they re gonna try to fix all the issues and they confirmed that they did fixed them
When we got to our room after dinner all the issues were still there
We called them but they put us in hold for too long so my husband has to go to the lobby and address his concern
They said they will send someone to help us moving to another room especially we have a baby and the last we wanted to deal with is packing in the middle of the night and bothering a sleeping baby
We waited forever for this people to come and take our luggage but nobody came we kept calling they kept hanging up the phone on us
Finally we lost our mind and had to go the stupid lobby again to get help and we still don’t know how the night is going to end up
This is the last thing i hoped for my family christmas vacation
Without mentioning all the other bad things
Ill edit the review in the near future to tell you more about thus miserable experience with the food and everything you are supposed to know before booking with this hotel
Please stay away
Find a better resort for a cheaper
Here you don’t get what you pay for🙁🙁🙁🙁 so mad and disappointed
Ill keep you updated

reviews.author: Alyssa VanKleek
reviews.text:
My stay was less than enjoyable. I do not recommend this hotel and that is unfortunate because I had high hopes with how much money we spent.

On the first day, after I unpacked my bags, I went to leave my room and the door would not latch. I called the front desk and a security person was sent to fix the door about half hour later. It look him almost an hour to get the door to latch. Later that night when I was ready to go to bed I went back to my room and the deadbolt did not work. It took over 2 hours and 3 trips to the front desk (and my room was not close to the front desk) to get maintenance out. They eventually fix it but the door still looks not completely secure. After an hour the second time I asked to be moved to a different room but was denied.

For the first 3 days I did not have any chairs on my balcony. I finally came back to my room one afternoon and there were 2 chairs as there should be. The next morning I was excited to wake up and sit on my balcony. As soon as I sat down on the chair, it broke and I fell through the chair. I notified staff the chair was broken but if was never replaced.

The power went out multiple times. On my second last day it went out while I was in the shower and the water stopped as well. I stood in the shower for 10 mins covered in soap and shivering while I waited for the water to come back. Eventually I got enough cold water to rinse off.

At least one day my room was not cleaned.

The elevator to the side that I was on was in an area of the hotel that is being renovated. I had to use the stairs every time I left or came to my room on the 3rd floor. Because of the construction there was also no way to get to my room without getting rained on when the weather was wet.

The food was not good. Everything was cold at the buffets. It was impossible to get food anywhere between the breakfast and lunch swap over.

reviews.author: João Quinas
reviews.text: I have a reservation for the end of May, I was thinking that this hotel would be a great experience. Somehow my reservation was changed for the Hotel Grand Cana, I’m trying to reach out the Real Palma hotel to understand the possibilities to stay in the Real Palma building. So far without success. I called several times and nobody was able to find a solution. I really hope soon change my review. If anyone could help with this issue would be great.

reviews.author: Seth Waller
reviews.text: Probably deserves 2 stars, but so many other reviewers gave 5 stars I have to try to balance the average.  If you're considering this resort, please read some of the other lower-rated reviews on this site.  At best the resort is average, but we paid for all-inclusive 5-star.  Food was fair, people were friendly, unfortunately not terribly competent.  Pool closes at 7PM, but music stays rocking (loudly) until 10 PM.  Butler stocks bar on 2nd day and never returns.  Everyone speaks Spanish, and the answering machine is in French.  Jacuzzi on the balcony flooded the balcony before the pump broke altogether.  Showed the maids that someone had taken the English pages out of our hotel guide (the book that shows you services, restaurants, etc.), so they took the guide away and didn't bring one back.  I've heard GREAT things about the DR, so I can only conclude that I picked the wrong resort.

reviews.author: V L
reviews.text: What a joke. Wedding info on the website is a maze. Contacted customer service to be connected to the wedding department, only to be given a local number that no one answers. Finally submitted a request for info on the website and was introduced to the "Romance Manager" - Heinicy. I gave her my details and heard nothing for a week. Followed up and she responded saying she'd get back in a few minutes. Nothing. Followed up next day and with no acknowledgement/apology, sends me the wrong resort info. I let her know to send details for the correct resort and guess what? NOTHING. Sad way to do business. I will gladly take it elsewhere to avoid a wedding disaster with this awful communication.

reviews.author: Paul Smetanin
reviews.text:
They charged me for two people by mistake and promised a refund at check in.  It has been 5 weeks and now they are avoiding my calls.  Vladimir R. was the manager dealing with the issue.
Juan, the hotel has done nothing. We organized our conference of over 200 at the hotel.  What, now we have to sue the hotel for $800?

reviews.author: Krista Perry
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at your resort this past weekend and I did not have a good experience from the beginning. No one mentioned that the resort I booked (Palma Real Golf & Spa) was under construction and we would be moved to the Reserve hotel. I am extremely frustrated with your lack of customer service and transparency. If I knew our hotel would be changed I would have made other reservations or requested to be moved to a different hotel. I had planned to be at that specific resort because of the restaurants, bars, pool, and direct beach access. There were no night time activities and the food was sub par.

This was such an important trip to celebrate my sister's wedding and it was underwhelming and I am very frustrated with the whole experience.

reviews.author: Madelyn Genao
reviews.text: Very disappointed with this resort. We arrived at 3:30pm and were told that the buffet closes at 5pm. We arrive at the buffet at 4:15pm and they tells us that the buffet actually closes at 3:30pm. If staying here know that from 3:30 - 6:30 pm there are absolutely no restaurants open. I ordered room service since there was nothing else open. They charge $5 to bring room service. I ordered a chicken panini which came in about 45 minutes which is not bad but I was given a “chicken panini sandwich “ and they forgot to put the chicken. I got 3 slices of bread with cucumber and tomatoes. I called back and received the correct order about 30 minutes later. We let that slide and came to one of the restaurants around 7:00pm just to find out that you have to make reservations before 5pm. They did not want to give us a reservation because we did not “book on time” yet we were never told that we have to reserve in advanced. We managed to get a reservation for 9:00pm after speaking to 6 different staff members and wasting about an hour and a half trying to get a reservation. This is my first time writing a review for anything but this resort has really disappointed. Not only was the food cold, disgusting and late but I was also told that I have to order later on because I “spoke too fast”.

reviews.author: Orlando Ares
reviews.text: En la piscina central Eddy es el mejor bartender  con un cariama placentero muy atento cordial amable voveremos definitivame

reviews.author: David Lu
reviews.text:
Summary: beautiful facility and events but multiple bad experiences with employees ruined the vacation. Mediocre food and facility is full of aggressive salespersons.

Facility: 5/5 beautiful facilities on the beach. Love the architecture and design. Great pool and beach setup.

Water: 1/5 only drink bottled water. Restaurant water is their local tap water and will give you bacteria. Found out first hand when I arrived back. Not pleasant.

Food: 3/5 complete hit or miss. The majority of the buffet food is quite horrible but has a good desert bar. Make sure to get your reservations in for the sit down restaurants - these were decent. No real dress code.

Employees: 1/5 multiple encounters over multiple days many rude employees and we did not cheap out on the tips. With each of the departments (front desk, bell boy, reservations, cleaning), there were employees that were rude and made you feel uncomfortable. Not looking for bad attitudes on a beach vacation... For example, bell boy took our luggage, lost an article of clothing, and attempted to blame us for losing it... Also picture this, you are sitting on a white sand beach sipping a mojito and enjoying the ocean views. Two minutes in, a salesperson comes. Another two minutes pass another one yells at you from afar. Repeat every day and every two minutes for multiple days... Do not get me wrong there were a handful of superb employees there too but the amount of bad experiences made it unruly.

reviews.author: Ralph Ward
reviews.text: For those who long to feel swindled, this place is ideal. Calling all masochists that want to disburse hard earned money to experience the lowest hospitality standards in the Caribbean. If you want to labor for 45 minutes to find a beach chair all the while having paid for an un- locatable VIP section only to discover that the “VIP” section is more crowded than the non-VIP section and that getting a drink is harder than solving trinomial math equations, this place is for you. If you’re the type of person that enjoys a room with a broken toilet, a broken telephone, a leaky refrigerator and a thermostat that only knows “sauna” or “freezer”, then your dream will become reality. Should the whole family be in the mood for a buffet serving soggy chips, two day old bread, an assortment of tasteless cheeses, awful pastries, eggshells in the scrambled eggs then, you have arrived! If you’re in the mood to interrogate hotel staff for basic information, such as, how does a family of five book restaurant reservations to be told on day 2 of 5 that as “VIPs” our personal concierge can handle that when no one thought to inform us of the existence of said person, then your stay will be all that and more. All of this and further misadventures can be had for the bargain price of over $1,200 per night. Since I’m the sort with a curious mind I spoke with other guests and our experience was no exception. The positive online reviews are baffling and raise a lot skepticism. When my wife wrote an honest social media review, Melia offered to refund the price of 1 night in exchange for no further postings on social media, so, this answers the question of how they could possibly have good reviews. Complaining is not in my nature and in fact this is the first and only negative review that I’ve ever written. I was compelled because the price of this resort comes nowhere close to its standards. To be fair, we encountered one wonderful employ (Manuel Torres) who was kind, humble and went to great lengths to ensure our comfort and satisfaction. He was the one exception. The total lack of indoctrinated hospitality and service training was otherwise endemic indicating a leadership vacuum. Full disclosure, Paradisus offered us 2 free nights at the same hotel however our experience was so abysmal that we refuse to return to this property at any price, never mind the travel costs of five people. In other words, the offer has no value to us and we clearly expressed that when we rejected it off hand. Melia operates nearly 400 hotels in over 40 countries, you’d think someone there with a modicum of common sense would offer perhaps 1 night at another location.....NOPE. Trust me, if you want to punish yourself walk around with a stone in your shoe for 6 days and you’ll get the same experience and save thousands.

reviews.author: Fateme Ag
reviews.text:
Cockroaches in the food and room!

Unfortunately our stay was very disturbed after finding cockroaches in the food of the buffet and in the room.

Not a surprise that a day after our stay our 6month old son got infection and fever. We had to go to the hospital to do tests and blood work for him.

reviews.author: Rose De Costa
reviews.text: I would never recommend this place to anyone after having a very bad experience in the last five days. Food is just horrible. Customer service is absolutely slow. I had a rough night when they were working on a giant machine in front of my room for 3 hours. Overall just a horrible experience. I would say do not waste your precious hard working money on this place.

reviews.author: Lisa Jeffries
reviews.text: This hotel just isn't worth the hassle. Our relaxing "get away" from our stressful frontline jobs was completely interrupted the moment we walked into the lounge to check in. We booked and paid for a presidential suite over a year in advance and when we arrived the manager told us the suite was overbooked and they had to downgrade us to a smaller room. The food at this resort isnt good at all, so they only reason we returned for our 2nd time was the presidential suit, which we couldn't even get. When we asked why they didn't contact us previously, they said it was their policy to not update guests prior to their arrival on hotel mistakes. We understand mistakes happen, but it is completely unprofessional to downgrade a guest the day of their stay. Our butler Ralphy was amazing and tried to accommodate our needs promptly, but overall we will never return to this property or any of their sister properties due to horrible business etiquette. The hotel offered us a small refund of our money, which we haven't seen yet.

reviews.author: Donovan Daniel
reviews.text: Worst resort experience I’ve ever had. I ordered room service at 9 AM and Didn’t arrive until 11:30 am, I also woke up one morning during my stay to a water leak coming from my roof. I called the front desk to get it fixed and they said they couldn’t do anything about it. Also employees here are very rude and run away from you when you request something service is very slow. Food is nasty. Pools are disgusting and have food and cups in them. Please spend your money wisely and do not come here this was the worst experience I’ve ever had at a resort.

reviews.author: Hadi Alinouri
reviews.text:
We came to this resort with high expectations, we booked the Royal Service. We came for my friend's wedding. We came with over 100 guests, and was expecting a high end experience, but instead came to the resort from hell.
Let me point out all the issues:
1. Our room had a wet mattress, the door handle was broken, the ocean front smelt like someone forgot to flush the toilet in a public washroom. The safe did not work. Our luggage took over 2 hours to get to our room, the room smelt like mold, the fridge was never filled up.
2. The staff, oh my goodness, I have never encountered such rude and cheap behaviour from the staff. Every two seconds all they would ask for, TIP, TIP, TIP. Well I love tipping, but you need to give me service for a tip, not just keep asking. It was so annoying. I was going crazy.
3. The wedding, we booked the beach terrace, which was close to Gabi Beach, but that same night, there were two other big parties, where our dj had to put the music to full blast, but it was still not loud enough to hear, as the other two parties were putting their music to full blast. The buffet at the wedding was worse than a 1 star restaurant. I didn't touch anything, and if fact the food in the whole resort was so bad, I actually lost 9 pounds when I came back to Canada.
4. The excursion team, who would book our excursions, were the most unfriendly cheap people. They kept trying to overcharge us for our excursions. That's when I decided to book directly with the company, instead of using these middle men to book with. Once again, all they would ask for was TIP TIP TIP. Oh my goodness!!
5. The bars would actually hide bottles and say they were out of the bottle. Especially with Black Label. They would say they are out, when I can clearly see from the mirror behind them, that there were bottles under them. LIARS!!
6. The Manager Domingo, worst hotel manager ever! I will be contacting Melia Head office for this. He is a complete Liar! Need I say more!
7. No one at this place spoke English! All they knew how to say was TIP TIP TIP. Well how about you give me my royal service I was promised, and sure I will tip.
8. I have never gotten into so many fights with staff in my life.

I will never ever ever ever book any Melia resort again! All they care about is money in their pockets, and treat guests like garbage!

DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE!! I URGE EVERYONE THINKING OF GOING HERE, YOU ARE IN FOR A SPECIAL TREAT!!!

reviews.author: Myishia Hunter
reviews.text: This place is smoking mirrors. It's has beautiful grounds and the appearance of a 5 star hotel but it's not even close. The food was cold at the buffet and there weren't any signs/labels on the food. If you have food allergies or dietary restrictions, your pretty much out of luck. Hotel keeping steal your  things in your room and the people  at the front desk are no help. Please take heed to this post and do not stay here! You will regret it.

reviews.author: esther doh
reviews.text: We booked Palma Real for next week and were notified that the hotel is closed for renovations! They are moving us to another resort. We planned this vacation with friends and they also got moved but to a different resort than us! If we wanted to stay somewhere else, we would’ve booked elsewhere! And now our families are scrambling in how to make our vacation work in two different places with young kids.

reviews.author: Sewon Hur
reviews.text:
The good, the bad, and the ugly.

Overall, I wouldn’t recommend the Paradisus Palma Real. There are lots of negatives but I’ll start my review with the positive.

The GOOD: the restaurants in terms of taste are quite good. I would say the the restaurants compare favorably to hyatt zilara and hard rock in cancun and azul resort in playa del carmen. The restaurant wait staff are attentive and polite. The pool is clean and well-maintained. The beach is beautiful but too much seaweed.

The BAD: Even though there are many good restaurants in the hotel, only the main buffet is open for breakfast and lunch. Moreover, for dinner only a few restaurants are open and therefore it’s quite difficult to get a reservation, meaning that you spend the great majority of time dining at the main buffet. (All restaurants except for the buffet require a reservation.)

The work staff, excluding restaurant wait staff and bartenders, are not friendly.

The UGLY: even though the food tasted good at the restaurants and the staff were friendly, our entire family of six were sick the majority of our stay. When we let the concierge know about the food poisoning situation we got no response.

The check-in and check-out process was the worst experience. They tried to put us in a distant room on the third floor of a building with no elevator access. We had two seniors, two babies, and a big stroller. How did they expect us to get around? When we asked for another room, they said that was the only option, even though the hotel was half empty given the season. When we refused the room and waited in the lobby for a hour, they gave us a room on the first floor but one that flooded each time it rained. The shower stall was also broken and was a safety hazard.

The check out process was equally terrible. We called that we were ready to check out and were told that someone would come for our bags. 25 minutes pass. We call again and they said they would send someone for the bags. 25 minutes pass again. I eventually chugged all the bags to the lobby (when traveling with kids there is a lot of stuff). When I told the staff about what had happened, no apology. Due to the delay we missed our opportunity to eat since the one restaurant that is open for lunch closed.

So there you have it: the good, the bad, and ugly. I don’t think I’ll be coming back to this resort and I certainly wouldn’t recommend it.

reviews.author: Hasan Ertas
reviews.text: Terrible service and quality. This place apparently went down the toilet. This was my third time and it was terrible this time around. We came with a group of 22 ppl and every family had issues with either their check in process, room quality, lack of running water etc. The buffet took a turn for the worse in the past. The staff has gotten to be rude and lacks the common courtesy they used to have. Go stay at another place like Barceló or Eden rock. It’s not worth paying all this money for this place anymore (and we are a seasoned traveling family all around the world at 4/5 star places)

reviews.author: Sean Adour
reviews.text: Worst vacation experience I’ve ever had, literally stayed a day and left when we were supposed to be there for 5 days. My wife got food poisoning and they messed up our room, I’d give 0 stars if I could!

reviews.author: L T
reviews.text: I don’t even know where to start. I went with my boyfriends family (July 21-27 2018) which was 19 of us altogether. Every single one of our rooms had a problem. Let’s start with my room. First, our back door did not lock, our safe wasn’t working, the sink was filling up with water, the beverages in the fridge were warm, and there was a cockroach in our room. To top things off, one night we came back to our room where we noticed the “do not disturb” sign on our door. My boyfriend walked in first to inspect the room to make sure no one was in there before I entered. We noticed that our safe was open and so was his suitcase. Luckily, nothing was taken from us but that is not the point! In his parents room, the shower was leaking water all over the bathroom floor and nothing was done to fix this issue until the last night we were there (we were there for six nights). The service was horrible! We finished our meals even before we were served our drinks. Speaking of drinks, no one at the resort knew how to make one! I ordered a simple baybreeze and they couldn’t even make that. Also, a waitress was holding a corona, when i was ordering my drink, so I asked for that and she had the audacity to tell me that they did not have any Corona. The food was subpar and honestly not worth it. You had to make reservations in order to eat unless you wanted the buffet which gets old. They have two pools and you can’t even go into the adult section of the pool because it’s for royal service members only which is ridiculous (we were in that section for a few days beforehand with no issue or being told it was for certain members). The beach was filled with seaweed and people constantly nagging for you to do activities or buy something. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND TO STAY SOMEWHERE ELSE! The price we paid was NOT worth all of this trouble.

reviews.author: R Torres
reviews.text:
This was a huge disappointment. For the amount of money we spent on this vacation so much was lacking. For some perspective, my wife and I cruise a lot and do it very economical. But when we spend a decent amount of money ... The service was subpar at best. You got more attention from people trying to sell you things on the beach then you did from staff. None of the room service was ever right. I called 3 separate times and each time the order came very very late and very wrong. An example I called room service around 11 to have 10 beers and champagne brought to my brother in laws room at 2. He was getting married. They showed up at 330 with 4 hot beers.
Nothing is clearly labeled. And no communication is done about what is or is not happening on the resort. They do a very poor job of even attempting to entertain. But q great job of trying to get yoi to spend more money.

My wife and I walked by glasses left out in a walk area that stayed there for 2 days and begin collecting friends. One morning I watched 3 staff walk right by them. Finally on the end of the second day they we picked up.

The restaurants constantly lose reaervations. And food takes  at least an hour to come out. Often undercooked or cold. The liquor is cheap and I had to find someone to tell them to stock decent liquor at the bar I was drinking at.

I miss the smell of cleaner. Disinfectant does not seem to be used much and I'm not a fan of that. I fully believe that is the cause of several of our friends and family having stomach problems while here. I don't understand moping with disgusting water.

Pros.... there is lots of space. You won't feel crowed.

reviews.author: Michael Mete
reviews.text: (Stayed at The Reserve Beach at Paradisus Palma Real).  As disheartening as this is to write, I must be truthful.  As far as the resort and the staff go, the place was great.  Food is better than any other all-inclusive I have been at in the Dominican as well.  But unfortunately, the 'administrative' part of the trip was the worst experience I have ever had in my 20+ years of travelling throughout the world.  The check-in process took almost 1 hour.  On top of the long check-in, because there was some fraudulent activity on my card after I had booked the hotel (originally paid in December 2015 for a December 2016 trip), I no longer had the original credit card.  After much persistence from the staff requiring me to have the actual card (even though they had already had my payment for almost 1 year), I showed them the statement charge on my phone which still wasn’t enough.  They wanted the entire statement to be emailed to them.  Sorry, not sending all my personal stuff to them.  Needless to say, I actually upgraded my room in October/November 2016 with my new credit card, but apparently that wasn’t any good either as they needed the original.  Needless to say, the solution was for the resort to again charge my ‘new’ card for the entire payment and promised that I would receive the credit 1 week later.  That charge occurred on December 10, and wouldn’t you know it, still no refund as of Dec. 27th.  Almost $2,600 and 3 weeks later, still nothing to show for it.  Really a shame that this payment experience has cost the resort future business from me and the 6 other couples that were on the trip.  It’s a shame and unfortunately looks like I need to get my lawyer involved to get my refund.

reviews.author: N Giron
reviews.text: I was notified a few days ago that the hotel would be closed in 2 weeks and my reservation was cancelled but transferred to a sister hotel called Grand Cana which is not beachfront. I have spent numerous hours trying to get in touch with reservations/ front desk/ customer service at Palma Real, Meliá Dominican Republic, and Meliá Spain. Every time I call I get hanged up on, transferred to nobody, or put on hold for over 15 minutes while the person waits for me to lose patience and hang up. I cannot believe that trying to get in touch with someone at the hotel has been so difficult and just a total lack of respect and concern. One person tells me my reservation is still at Palma Real, another person confirms my reservation has been cancelled. This is a complete joke of a chain, and I can’t believe this is how this hotel treats its customers.

reviews.author: Patricia M
reviews.text: I want to start by giving credit where it is due. The staff at the buffet restaurant, beach & pool were amazing!!! My family of 4 stayed for 8 days, 7 nights. This is our 4th trip to Dominican Republic & we love it here! Now, to get down to it....our room was a 1 bedroom Master Suite. No complaints really, it was dated, had a few minor issues that maintenance quickly took care of but again, nothing major. The pool is about 95% 4.75' deep & not something we were prepared for. We thought the kiddie pool would suffice but it's only 1.75' & too shallow for my 8&11 year old. We bought floaties for the kids so they were able to chill at the main pool with us without worry.  The reservation for restaurants were a joke even though we tried to make them days ahead. No way would I want 830pm reservations as my only option so we mostly ate at the buffet. It wasn't horrible but definitely not worth the $ to eat at a buffet almost every night. We've always paid for upgraded vacation packages & feel we never really benefit so we didn't pay for the " Reserve" or "Family Concierge" this time. I am glad we didn't because everyone waiting to go to the Reserve part of the resort were so far from the beach & main area of the resort. We decided to check out the kid zone which is by the Reserve section & my goodness it was a hike. You have to rely on golf carts to transport you or walk. If I had to guess I would say its a good mile. Not too bad if you weren't in extreme heat with two children.... Definitely dodged a bullet on this decision. We personally liked the main area or "regular" non upgraded package we had. Great access to beach & nightly entertainment. Now, the fun part. The front desk is awful if you have something non conforming come up. We wanted to rent a cabana & were treated like trash because we were not part of the "reserve" group. We were told we could use the cabana as a special access for $60 per person. OK, I get it, it's extra. But we were talked down to because we had a regular package.  Our room was in almost an apartment style building & cleaning started at 730am, ok again no biggie, but it was so noisy every morning super early! Hello, it's vacation. I personally didn't want to be disturbed by yelling in the halls at 730am. By the way don't get too excited about the resort credits / coupons. Non are really applicable....they just sound good when making the reservation for the resort. The staff (minus front desk) were amazing but we will unfortunately not come back.

reviews.author: H P
reviews.text: Don’t stay at this hotel If want to sleep on a cabana. I was in room 1022 and the security guard kicked me off the cabana I was sleeping on that was right in front of my room for someone else. I’m in the hotel business and this is the worst hospitality ever. Don’t stay here

reviews.author: Peter Proulx
reviews.text: Beautiful resort, lousy service. Under staffed and it shows, 75% of the staff have bad attitudes. Each day 1 towel was provided in our room. In room amenities from our phone, tv and hair drier all broken. 30 mins to get utensils at the buffet and another to get water at the table. The food was great, it’s a shame I can’t recommend Melia.

reviews.author: Erin Leppek
reviews.text:
I was supposed to stay at this resort from June 10-15 for my friend’s wedding. Due to COVID-19 the wedding was moved to next year and the hotel was closed, not accepting guests. All reservations are free cancellation, but adding people apparently makes the reservation non-refundable for some reason.... When the island closed its borders and the hotel canceled my reservation, I expected a refund, as they can’t deliver on their end of a deal. Yet, the resort refuses to refund our money and the customer service representative we were assigned isn’t responding to emails or calls anymore. This is unacceptable for any resort, but especially a 5 star resort. As it stands, I would not recommend booking with this resort.

Edit: They did offer to rebook us for next year, but they were non-responsive for over a month, and we never did see the “Melia points” that we were getting as a refund. Eventually the credit card company refunded our money.

reviews.author: Carla Guzman
reviews.text:
To all Brides, please take it as a warning! Do not book with Paradisus. The Romance Manager (Heinicy) will continue to ignore you throughout the process. Wasted time and money Please do not fall for the scam.
I traveled to Paradisus, met with her and was promised a contract, which never happened. She will ignore your phone calls and emails, please do not trust this resort.

reviews.author: Thao T
reviews.text: I had to cancel my reservation a day before my arrival, my travel agency sent in a date request form to the resort per their request. It took a few weeks for our agent to reach anyone. Once the resort approved my change request, I was asked to contact the resort directly to change the date. It was impossible to reach anyone at the resort, the phone was always either busy, voice mail full or no one answered. They won't issue a refund but I am unable to make any changes. So I paid a lot of money for a vacation I cannot take. Please save yourself the headaches. Travel issues come up and you would want a resort with reliable customer service or someone you can reach when issues come up.

reviews.author: victoria avras
reviews.text:
I don't know where to start, I can't believe all the positive reviews for such a horrible stay.  It is by far the worst review I have ever had the displeasure of writing for the most horrible experience we could have imagined.   Check-in: we arrived at 3:30 pm - rooms weren't ready.  Requested rooms on the same floor (instead we were 3 building apart).  Buildings have no elevator they tried to "upsell" us on an ocean view room for an additional $1,825 for the week. We received absolutely no "orientation" to the resort, no map and no beach towel cards.
